name: Evergreen Club 5K Fun Run!
description:
COURSE MAP

Digital Map

 

 

EVERGREEN CLUB 5K FUN RUN

The Evergreen Club is a part of the Clubhouse International community, which positively impacts the health and well-being of those recovering from a mental illness. This is our 5th annual 5K Fun Run! Historically, adults with mental illness are also more likely to experience multiple physical health ailments including diabetes, heart and pulmonary diseases, increasing the likelihood of early mortality.  Thus, we are excited to be promoting and encouraging a life of wellness.

Run or walk in person starting at 9AM. Start/finish line at North Bank Shelter in Riverfront Park. For those not yet comfortable running in person, you can sign up for our virtual event, and run or walk on a route in your neighborhood, wherever you are in the world! 

All participants will receive a T-shirt with registration. T-Shirt and Swag Bag pick up will be Friday, August 21st beginning at 1pm at the Evergreen Club (2102 E Sprague Ave.)

The Evergreen Club 5K is our largest fundraiser of the year. There will be opportunities to make additional donations during the registration process.  All donations will help people living with serious mental illness thrive through meaningful community and work opportunities. 

ABOUT THE EVERGREEN CLUB

The Evergreen Club provides people living with serious mental illness opportunities to find meaning and purpose through community and work. Clubhouse members can find jobs through our employment programs. Additionally, members also receive support and assistance embarking on new career paths, pursuing educational opportunities, and secure housing. Proceeds from the Evergreen Club 5K go to Clubhouse programs which provide recovery and support services for people living with mental illness in the greater Spokane area. 

For more information please visit: 

Our NEW Evergreen Clubhouse commercial- https://youtu.be/nPnBbM1PleU?si=_8DUibe5HdmAEZ3b

Mental Illness Recovery - Clubhouse International https://clubhouse-intl.org/

Healthy Minds | Creating Community and Giving Hope: Clubhouse International - YouTube https://youtu.be/2SiaQb3WMpI?si=hZh2hlIzXMCdawmQ

 

2026 Sponsor Opportunities:

 

Platinum Sponsor: $1000.00

All Platinum Sponsors will receive formal recognition on race day brochure and fun run website,

in the Evergreen Club newsletter and on Evergreen Club social media.

Platinum sponsors will have company name/logo on fun run T-shirt and receive 4 fun run

registrations.  Platinum Sponsors may place promotional materials in fun run grab bags,

have a vendor booth or provide promotional signage at the event.

 

Gold Sponsor:  $750.00

All Gold Sponsors will receive formal recognition on race day brochure and fun run website,

in the Evergreen Club newsletter and on Evergreen Club social media.

Gold sponsors will have company name/logo on fun run T-shirt and receive 2 fun run

registrations.  Platinum Sponsors may place promotional materials in fun run grab bags,

have a vendor booth or provide promotional signage at the event.

 

Silver Sponsor:   $500.00

All Silver Sponsors will receive formal recognition on race day brochure and fun run website,

in the Evergreen Club newsletter and on Evergreen Club social media.

Silver sponsors will have company name/logo on fun run T-shirt and receive 1 fun run

registration.  Silver Sponsors may place promotional materials in fun run grab bags,

have a vendor booth or provide promotional signage at the event.

 

Individual Kilometer Sponsors: $150.00

All Individual Kilometer Sponsors will receive formal recognition on race day brochure

and fun run website, the in the Evergreen Club newsletter, and

on Evergreen Club social media.  Individual Kilometer Sponsors may place promotional

materials in fun run grab bags or provide promotional signage at the event.

 

Swag Bag Sponsor: $100.00

All Swag Bag Sponsors may place one promotional item in fun run swag bags. All Swag Bag

Sponsors will receive formal recognition on race day brochure and fun run website,

in the Evergreen Club newsletter and on Evergreen Club social media.

 

Evergreen Club Member Registration Sponsor: $25.00

Sponsor an Evergreen Club member’s fun run registration fee. All Member Registration

Sponsors will receive formal recognition on race day brochure and fun run website.

 

Friends of Evergreen Club Vendor Booth: $50

Bring a table, pop up tent and displays to Riverfront Park to showcase products,

merchandise, gifts and services during the fun run.  All vendors will be recognized on

race day brochure and fun run website.

 

*Swag Bag promotional items can include branded merchandise, coupons, business cards and/or informational literature.

*All promotional signage, displays and booths are subject to Riverfront Park Rules and Regulations.

 

All donations are tax deductible and can be made on our website at www.Evergreenclub5K.org

name: Fall - Mud Mountain Dam Marathon & Half Marathon
description:
September 19, 2026 – The Full Marathon Returns!
We’re excited to announce that the Full Marathon is coming back in 2026, and will also be part of our. Start planning now for your next Boston Qualifier on this beautiful, fully paved downhill course, no tunnel, no dirt, no BQ time penalty!

There’s no excuse not to do the dam thing!

Marathon
The marathon course begins at Mud Mountain Dam (elevation 1,400′). Runners will follow a fully paved route through picturesque farmlands and forested areas, tracing the path of the Carbon River. The race finishes in front of the historic McMillin Bridge (elevation 200′), with a total net elevation loss of approximately 1,200′.

Half Marathon
The Half Marathon begins in the scenic town of South Prairie (elevation 467′) and follows a gradual downhill route along the paved Foothills Rail Trail. Runners will enjoy a picturesque journey through farmland and forest, winding alongside the Carbon River and finishing in front of the historic McMillin Bridge (elevation 128′). The course features a net elevation loss of 339 feet.

name: Fall Frolic
description:
FALL FROLIC

Hosted by Club Oly Road Runners

Sunday, October 4, 2026

Frolic your way through a 5K, 5 mile or kids run starting and finishing at Heritage Park in Olympia, WA. 

The course is a flat and fast around the lake with an out and back portion.  Families, strollers, walkers are welcome. 

 

Registration:
5K or 5 Mile:
Early registration: $35 per person
Late registration 9/27/2026 through 10/3/2026: $40 
Day-of registration: $45 

Club Oly Members receive $5 off with club code at checkout.

Groups of 4 registering together: $10 off per person
Groups of 5 or more registering together: $13 off per person
Group registrations are not eligible for the member discount. 
Kids Frolic 1K (12 and under only): Free 
Register early to guarantee your swag and to avoid the price increase.
 
Packet pickup: 
  • Saturday, 10/3/2026from 2 to 4 pm at Fleet Feet
  • Sunday, 10/4/2026 from 7:20 to 8:20 am at the packet pickup tent in Heritage Park. 
 
Race Day Schedule of Events:
7:20 to 8:20 am: Packet pickup
8:45 am: Kids Frolic 1K
9:00 am: 5 mile race starts
9:05 am: 5K race starts
10:00 am: Awards for 5K race
10:15 am: Awards for 5 mile race
Awards for Top 3 overall men/women/non-binary 5K and 5 mile and top 3 in age group. Age groups are 0-9, 10-14, 15-19, then every 10 years.

name: Falla Walla Half Marathon, 10K & Heroes 5K Run
description:
5th Annual Falla Walla Half Marathon & 10K

Starting at Walla Walla Community College on the east side of town, runners and walkers will be treated to beautiful views of the Blue Mountains with rolling fields of wheat, grapevines and fall foliage. The trail starts on asphalt nature paths. Once the run route reaches Bennington Lake, runners will run on gravel service roads. The half marathon will include a section out and back on a chip sealed county road returning to loop back onto the last half of the 10K route. The race meanders through open grasslands and wooded areas with stunning views of the surrounding valley. This is NOT a fast or flat course! It includes rolling hills with elevation gain on the way out and high speed return at mile 6-8 of the half marathon and the last two miles of both the 10K and half marathon. No strollers or dogs are allowed for these events. 

What to Expect: All participants who register before September 7th will receive a free race T-shirt.  In addition, there will be finisher medals (for half marathon & 10K), aid stations with water, Heed and gels, post-race snacks, a free local craft beer (for participants 21 years or older), music, award ceremony and lots of cheering!

Everyone knows that half the reason you run these crazy races is for the shirt, swag and finisher’s medal and the Falla Walla event will not disappoint.  T-SHIRT AVAILABILITY AND SIZE ARE NOT GUARANTEED IF YOU REGISTER AFTER SEPTEMBER 6.

________

3rd Annual Heroes 5K Run

Welcome to the Heroes 5K Run which will take place in conjunction with the Falla Walla Half Marathon and 10K.  The 5K run is a memorial for three Walla Walla health care professionals who have passed away and is to honor these three remarkable people. 

Runners and walkers alike will be treated to the beautiful Mill Creek asphalt nature pathway.  Strollers are allowed for this event but are asked to stay to the right on the pathway.  Sorry, but no dogs are allowed for safety of runners. 

What to expect: There will be awards for the top 3 female and top 3 male finishers. All participants who register before September 7th will receive a free race T-shirt.  All finishers will get a finisher medal.  In addition, all kids 12 years and under will be given a backpack tag. The first 140 participants 13 years and over who register will also receive a commemorative glass. At the finish line there will be a beer garden where anyone 21 years and older can receive one free beer from Quirk Brewing Hot drinks and a seasonal treat will be provided by Eastgate SDA. T-SHIRT AVAILABILITY AND SIZE ARE NOT GUARANTEED IF YOU REGISTER AFTER SEPTEMBER 6.

What this run is really about:

• Melissa Harting was a registered nurse at Providence St. Mary Medical Center in the Emergency Department. She began her long-time career at Providence St. Mary Medical Center starting out as a Certified Nursing Assistant and later moved into an Emergency Tech role.  In 2018 she was accepted into Walla Walla Community Colleges Nursing Program where she graduated and obtained her Registered Nurse licensure in 2020.  On October 4th, 2023, Melissa passed away at the age of 44.  She was a dedicated mother, friend and healthcare provider in all of her roles. 
• Robert Becker was the 2nd year lead instructor for the Walla Walla Community College Nursing Program and had been teaching nursing students for over 34 years when he retired in June 2023.  Many of the nurses in the Walla Walla Valley and beyond have had Rob as an instructor.  His love for teaching and inspiring students went above and beyond.  Rob passed away November 8th, 2023, at the age of 68.  He was a devoted professor, mentor, and friend to many and a loving husband to Patti. 
• Ryan Pleasants, 41, of Walla Walla, WA, passed away on January 7, 2024, while on duty for the City of Walla Walla Fire Department. Ryan dedicated his life to serving his community, starting in the Cowlitz County - North County area as a mountain rescue EMT for 2 years. This was followed by a 19-year career as a firefighter/paramedic with the City of Walla Walla Fire Department, culminating in his promotion to Firefighter Engineer for his 20th year with the department.  He continually showcased his commitment and passion for the community he served, his family, and his fellow fire brothers and sisters. 

The proceeds from this 3rd Annual Heroes 5K Run will benefit those in our community in bettering their lives. Melissa Harting and Rob Becker’s portions will go to their individual memorial funds at the Walla Walla Community College Foundation to help nursing student financially as they complete their nursing degrees. In honor of Ryan’s legacy, Ryan’s portion of the funds will go towards a scholarship to help current and future EMS providers advance their careers and improve the quality of care they will provide. This scholarship will be housed and managed by your local United Way of the Blue Mountains.

Thank you for giving and for honoring these three Heroes of our community. 

No Refunds and No Deferrals 

Must be present to receive free T-shirt and commemorative glass

name: Float Dodger 5K
description:

name: Fowl Fun Run 5K & 10K
description:
Join us for the 48th Annual Fowl Fun Run!

Run the Valley with Skagit Runners

We offer two distances: a 5K run/walk and a 10K run. Both courses are run on flat, low-traffic farm roads in the Skagit Valley.

Stay for food, refreshments and for the opportunity to win a pumpkin pie!
 
Free Kids' Half-Mile Run
The half-mile kids' run for those 8 years and under starts promptly at 9:15 a.m. This fun run is free, but children must be registered in person by 9:00 a.m.

Race day schedule
8 am - 8:25 am: Volunteers set up


8:25 am - 9:30 am: Day of race registration (NOT GUARANTEED A FINISHERS MEDAL)


8:25 am - 9:30 am: Check in for pre-registered participants


9:15 am: 1/2 mile kids' run start


10 am: 5K & 10K start


10:05 am: Turkey begins the 10K


Noon: Both courses close


Packet Pick-Up: 1-5pm Friday, November 13th at Skagit Running Company (724 S 1st St, Mount Vernon, WA 98273)

 

Day of Race Registration: Please arrive early if you plan to register on the morning of the race.

Price increase $40 5k and $50 10k.

(NOT GUARANTEED A FINISHERS MEDAL)


Day of Race Packet Pick-up: Pre-registered participants may pick up their bib numbers starting at 8:25 a.m. on race morning.


Food and Refreshments: Traditional pumpkin pie available as a post-race treat!


Awards: Every participant will receive a finishers medal. Special awards will be given to the top 3 male and female finishers.


Beat the Turkey! Tom Turkey will be starting the 10K five minutes after the gun. Finish the 10K ahead of him and receive a special award at the finish line!

name: Frosty Moss Relay
description:
Welcome to the Green Season on the Olympic Peninsula of Washington State
Towering evergreens. Endless moss and ferns. Miles of waterfront. Snowcapped mountains. Need a cure for gray-season blues? Frosty Moss has you covered.

Pavement + Trail Runners Unite
From the Sol Duc River to Sequim Bay, the 80-mile Frosty Moss course follows the paved Olympic Discovery Trail and the singletrack Adventure Route. The 30-mile Mini Moss course begins at Ediz Hook in Port Angeles and end at Sequim Bay.

Celebrate After the Race
As if your day wasn’t epic enough, 7 Cedars Resort is ready to help you celebrate. They will host hot food, cold drinks, awards and fun after the race.

name: Galloping Gertie
description:
GALLOPING GERTIE!
Join us for a half marathon, 10K and 5K that shows off Tacoma’s and Gig Harbor’s finest views. Each race will run on the iconic Tacoma Narrows Bridge (Galloping Gertie), which features stunning views of the Puget Sound, Mount Rainier, the Olympic Mountains, and the surrounding cities of Tacoma and Gig Harbor. This is one of the few races that traverse the bridge span to span. All participants in the race will receive a custom finisher medal, free downloadable race photos and a cool tech tee! The best part? It all supports great local charities! 

WHAT IS GALLOPING GERTIE?
Galloping Gertie is the nickname of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, a local icon that spans the Puget Sound between Tacoma and Gig Harbor, Washington. Crossing it provides breathtaking views of the Puget Sound, Mount Rainier, and the Olympic Mountains.

The original Tacoma Narrows Bridge suffered a catastrophic collapse in November 1940, just four months after it opened. It earned its nickname while it was under construction, when workers observed the bridge deck jump during periods of high wind. A fatal error in the engineering of the bridge resulted in its collapse when the winds caused something called aeroelastic flutter. At the time, Gertie was the third longest suspension bridge in the world.  

The replacement bridge opened in 1950 (this is the existing westbound bridge) and the newer eastbound bridge (the one you will run across) opened in 2007. The engineering disaster that resulted in the collapse of the bridge makes the Tacoma Narrows Bridge one of the more famous in the world.

Visit the official race website for full race details, course maps, and race weekend information: Galloping Gertie Half Marathon

name: Girlfriends Run
description:
THE GIRLFRIENDS AND PINK BRIGADE HAVE RAISED OVER $900,000 OVER THE LAST 18 YEARS!
The 20th Annual Girlfriends Run offers a Half Marathon, 10K & 6K designed specifically for women to get together to do something good for themselves and to help support a very important women’s cause.

We started this event to honor and support one of our BFFs, Joleen Skarberg, who was diagnosed with Breast Cancer and continues to run it every year with her daughters, sisters, nieces, cousins and girlfriends! Watch for her – she’ll be wearing #1!

About half the gals run, half walk and many do a combination of running and walking. It doesn’t matter how you get to the finish line, as long as you get there!

description:
THE GIRLFRIENDS AND PINK BRIGADE HAVE RAISED OVER $900,000 OVER THE LAST 18 YEARS!
The 20th Annual Girlfriends Run offers a Half Marathon, 10K & 6K designed specifically for women to get together to do something good for themselves and to help support a very important women’s cause.

We started this event to honor and support one of our BFFs, Joleen Skarberg, who was diagnosed with Breast Cancer and continues to run it every year with her daughters, sisters, nieces, cousins and girlfriends! Watch for her – she’ll be wearing #1!

About half the gals run, half walk and many do a combination of running and walking. It doesn’t matter how you get to the finish line, as long as you get there!

name: Girlfriends Triathlon & Fitness Festival
description:
GIRLFRIEND, YES, YOU CAN CROSS THE FINISH LINE!

This 28th Annual Girlfriends All-Women’s Triathlon & Fitness Festival at a beautiful venue along the Columbia River offers something for everyone so rally your girlfriends, train together and then cross the finish line with your best girls!

It is one of the most scenic areas with views of the Columbia River, Mt. Hood, Mt. St. Helens and Vancouver Lake. The course is flat and fast with a down-current swim close to the shore so perfect for a 1st time Triathlon or Multisport event! Kids Triathlon and a Sunset 5K/10K are scheduled Friday night and Co-Ed events on Saturday so make a whole weekend of it for the whole family.

PARKING IS INCLUDED IN REGISTATION FEES.

name: Give NCW Turkey Trot
description:
Give NCW Turkey Trot is a great way to start your holiday season! The event features timed 5K and 10K races and an untimed, free run for kids. The 5K and 10K races are held on the Apple Capital Loop Trail along the Wenatchee riverfront. The Kids Race is held on a short course near the grounds of Pybus Public Market. Strollers and leashed dogs are permitted.

This family friendly event kicks off the annual Give NCW online giving campaign hosted by the Community Foundation of NCW.  Special thanks to Presenting Sponsor, Wenatchee Valley Medical Group and Gold Sponsors, Cordell Neher & Co. and Cashmere Valley Bank. Thanks to their sponsorship, every dollar from registration fees goes to support Give NCW. This giving campaign starts Thanksgiving Day and runs through Dec. 31 and supports over 75 nonprofit organizations in NCW. Race proceeds will be shared among the nonprofit organizations that participate in the campaign.

The “Best Dressed Individual” will receive a $500 Giving Card that can be redeemed to support nonprofits on Give NCW, and the “Best Dressed Group” will receive a $1,000 Giving Card. 

Planning to bring your dog? Enter your canine companion during the registration process and for an extra $5 donation, your pup will receive a Turkey Trot bandana (if it is among the first 150 to register) and a chance to win a Gift Basket from our friends at Firehouse Pet Shop!  

Location: The two races start and finish on the trail behind Pybus Public Market. The Kids Race is held in the boat launch parking lot behind Pybus Public Market.

Start times: 9:00am kids race; 9:15am 10K; and 9:30am 5K. 

Youth who are 12 years and younger can run untimed for free in the 5K, with a paid adult. Do not register them unless they want to be officially timed and qualify for the commemorative socks.

Packet pickup at Pybus Market: Wednesday, Nov 26th from 2:00pm-8:00pm or Thursday (race day), Nov 27 7:00am-8:45am. There will be NO DAY OF REGISTRATION

Swag: The first 750 paid registrants will receive a pair of commemorative Turkey Trot socks.

Aid stations: There are two aid stations - one at the 5k turnaround and one at the 10k turnaround with water and Gatorade. Porta potties are located at the start/finish, but not along the course. Note that the restrooms inside Pybus Market will not be open.

Course map: See below

Website: https://cfncw.org/turkeytrot

Email: melissa@cfncw.org.

name: Glenoma Park 5K
description:
5th Annual Glenoma Park 5K Run/Walk -  In Memory of Darian Paige Atkinson

Date: July 12, 2026 

8:30 AM – Registration
9:00 AM – Race Start

Join us as we celebrate the 5th Annual Glenoma Park 5K Run/Walk, honoring the life and legacy of Darian Paige Atkinson. This year, the course will be run in reverse, offering a fresh experience for returning participants.

Course Overview

The race begins at the scenic Glenoma Community Park, heading southeast across Glenoma Road onto the old Orchard Road. Runners will turn right to loop through the Kosmos Wildlife Area, then continue uphill toward the base of Dog Mountain before circling back to finish at the park. The course features mostly dirt trail, with the final quarter mile on a shaded paved road.

Kids 5 and under participate for free!

Prizes & Giveaways

Overall Awards
First Place Male & Female: Custom DPA Tumbler & Medal
Second Place Male & Female: Custom DPA Medal
Age Group Awards
First Place (12 & Under) – Girl & Boy: Custom DPA Tumbler & Medal 


Participant Perks

First 100 Registered Participants: Exclusive Custom DPA Koozie and swag bag.

Prize Drawing: All registered participants are automatically entered. Additional raffle tickets may be purchased on race day. Must be present to win. As in previous years, you may choose which prizes you want a chance to win.


Important Dates

June 29: Last day to pre‑register before the price increase and to purchase a shirt or hoodie
July 11: Last day to pre‑register online
July 12: Day of registration at 8:30am

All proceeds support the Darian Atkinson Scholarship, helping local seniors further their educations.

name: Go Fourth One Mile Run/Walk 2026
description:
**REGISTER BEFORE THE PRICE GOES UP!!**The Go 4th Mile Run/Walk is July 4th. It starts at 9:45 AM in front of Longview's Monticello Hotel. Preregistration ends at Noon on 7/3/26 and is just $15.00, Packet pickup and same day registration is from 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM in the lobby of the hotel. The same day entry fee is $25.00. 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Cowlitz Valley Runners are partnering with a patriotic non-profit organization, Helping Every Veteran In Need (HEVIN), in this family friendly Independence Day event.  You can help veterans through a donation to HEVIN when you register for the Go Fourth Mile. Learn more about HEVIN at www.hevin4vets.com

Come join us for a one mile race (run or walk) on the route of the Longview, Washington Go 4th Festival's July 4th parade. It starts at the historic Monticello Hotel and finishes near Martin's Dock at beautiful Lake Sacajawea Park. Hosted by the Cowlitz Valley Runners, in partnership with HEVIN and sponsored by the Monticello Coffee House and Lounge, the Child & Adolescent Clinic, Red Leaf Organic Coffee, Cortex Marketing, and Norpac, this is a fun event for the whole family. Hundreds of fans (lined up to watch the Go 4th Parade that will follow the race) will cheer the runners and walkers on this fast, flat, scenic course. The focus is on family fun, so the entry fee is minimal.  In keeping with the community, non-profit volunteer philosophy of the Go 4th Festival, the Cowlitz Valley Runners will apply proceeds to scholarships for high school seniors pursuing higher education. 

Awards: Medals  will be awarded to the top male and female finishers. Ribbons will be awarded to the the second and third place male and female finishers, and to the first male and female finishers over 50 .  Plus, we have several random door prizes!! WALKERS CAN WIN TOO!!

Running t-shirts: Order your Go 4th Mile 2026 shirts online by June 20th.  Pick up shirts at packet pickup at the Monticello Hotel lobby on race day from 8:30 - 9:30 AM.

name: GOAT Run
description:
* 50K * Marathon * Half Marathon *

The Great Olympic Adventure Trail Run (GOAT Run) is a trail 50K, marathon & half marathon that traverses Kelly Ridge between the Olympic National Park and the Strait of Juan de Fuca in Washington State.

The route follows the single track Adventure Trail for the majority of the course, plus some unpaved forest road mixed in, and less than a mile on pavement. The finish line is in Olympic National Park at the deep, glacially carved Lake Crescent. Famous for its turquoise blue waters of exceptional clarity, the lake is the perfect place to end the race.

The course reaches a maximum elevation of 1,619 feet, with a cumulative elevation gain of 1500 ft for the half, 3500 ft for the marathon, and 3700 ft for the 50K. Challenging? Absolutely! This is a difficult course. But it’s worth it! *(note: half course is long, about 14 mi)

What’s included?

In addition to an epic outdoor experience in the far northwest corner, all runners receive a professional well-organized event, a well-marked course, food and snacks at water stations along the course, a piece of custom race swag, free shuttle to start, chip timing, after-party at Log Cabin Resort including heavy snacks and water / electrolyte. Bring cash or card with you, as we will have a beer / cider garden at the finish line!

Where to stay

Olympic Lodge in Port Angeles is offering a special 25% off discount for GOAT Runners.
Booking link here. 
Or phone direct at 360-452-2993 and use booking code GOAT to receive the same discounted pricing.

GOAT Run is Cupless

Unnecessary waste and trash is something we are working to eliminate from our events. As an organization dedicated to maintaining a clean race and doing our part to keep our trails clean, starting in 2024 we will be going cupless. This means we are eliminating the use of disposable cups at our races. Runners will carry their own hydration vessels, weather it be a backpack, water bottle, or a compressible cup such at the HydraPak speed cup.

Giving Back

This race is a friendly, community-based event, and a portion of race proceeds is donated to the Peninsula Trails Coalition and the Peninsula Chapter of the Back Country Horsemen of Washington, in appreciation for their countless hours of trail construction and maintenance on the North Olympic Peninsula.

Refund Policy
  • 50% refund available until August 15, NO REFUNDS AFTER THIS DATE
  • No deferrals to next year
  • Transfers are allowed until 3 days before the race. Transfer instructions.
  • You will have the choice during the registration process to buy cancellation insurance (unavailable for Canadian racers – rules of the insurance company and not us or RunSignUp). With the insurance, you will get a full refund in certain circumstances including including accident, illness and family emergency, even after the August 15th date. Click here for more info and FAQ about the RegShield insurance.
  • If we are forced to cancel for any reason, runners will get a free transfer to the next year, or an 80% refund

Full information on our website.

name: Gobble Gobble 5K & 10K
description:
Kick start your Thanksgiving morning with Puyallup’s own Gobble Gobble 5K & 10K! Gather your friends and family and run/walk this festive community tradition starting and finishing at Pierce College Puyallup.

Enjoy a fun and scenic chip-timed course while celebrating Thanksgiving with the local running and walking community. The first 200 registrants will receive the FAMOUS Fork Finisher Medal (Yes… you can actually use it to eat your Thanksgiving dinner afterward!).

Registration Includes:
• Chip Timed Event
• Finisher Medal
• Commemorative Race Bib
• Branded Junk Brands Headband
• After-event Snacks
• Entry into Prize Giveaways

We will also be collecting donations for the Stahl Jr. High food pantry. Suggested donation items include single-serving microwavable mac & cheese cups, single-serving breakfast cereal, granola bars, protein bars, microwavable soups, and Pop-Tarts. Help us support local students and families this Thanksgiving season.

Whether you’re looking to burn a few calories before the big feast, create lasting memories with family and friends, or continue your holiday running tradition, the Gobble Gobble 5K & 10K is the perfect way to start your Thanksgiving Day.  The Gobble Gobble 5K & 10K is proudly becoming a Puyallup Thanksgiving tradition!

Long sleeve lifestyle tee shirts are available for purchase: $22 for S - XL, $27 for 2XL & 3XL.  Thanksgiving is the busiest running day in America, so our swag cutoff date is earlier than most events. Shirts available for purchase and medals are guaranteed until October 5th.


Packet Pick - Up will be held on Sunday November 22nd South Hill Mall (Inside in front of Dick's) from 11 AM - 6 PM. 


If you wish to pick up your event swag on Thanksgiving morning there will be a $20 service fee.

Absolutely NO dogs, scooters or bicycles.  Our insurance does not cover dogs, and Pierce College does not allow dogs on campus for this event.  In addition, we want to protect our furry friends and your fellow runners/walkers.  Thank you for your cooperation!

name: Gorge Ultra Distance
description:
Join us in the Pacific Northwest this summer for an epic 17-mile endurance challenge, SUP racing through the heart of the Columbia River Gorge. Starting at Home Valley and finishing in the protected waters of Bingen Harbor, paddlers will experience what is arguably the most consistent downwind run on the planet.

While Mother Nature never gives a 100% guarantee, this race is strategically timed during the peak of the season to maximize our chances for world-class bumps. Don’t miss your chance to race in one of the most iconic stretches of water in the world!

description:
2026 marks the 1st annual official City of Granite Falls hosted 5k run. 

We are celebrating the 250th Anniversary of the United States of America. The run will highlight the history of Granite Falls.  

Once runners have completed the course, there will be medals awarded to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winners. Participants, family and friends can then enjoy festive activities that are held all around the main street including food, music, vendor booths, activities and more.

The GFPD Outreach and Support a registered non-profit 501(c) is the organizer and all proceeds will go to supporting our local police department.

See you July 4th, 2026!

name: Gravel Unravel - WhyNotChee
description:
WHY-NOT-CHEE HAS BEEN CANCELED FOR 2026

The Gravel Unravel Experience

Gravel Unravel is an endurance gravel bicycling series on the Olympic Peninsula of Washington State This series is brought to you by a partnership between Peninsula Adventure Sports and La Vogue Cyclery  This event is designed for those who wish to challenge their physical abilities to the maximum while enjoying the lushness of Olympic National Forest. Participants can ride short (25-35 miles), medium (45-55 miles), or long (65-80 miles) distances on majority gravel courses (percent varies by race/distance) while enjoying towering evergreens and vivid green moss and ferns. There are both competitive and non-competitive Gran Fondo style divisions, and all are welcome to give the Gravel Unravel a try on their own terms.

We are grateful to our Series Sponsor Eleven Winery for making Gravel Unravel happen again for 2026! Eleven Winery has been with us since year one of Gravel Unravel, and we thank they for their unwavering support.

  • Race 1: Bon Jon Pass Out - June 13, 2026 (Peninsula Adventure Sports) - SPOTS LIMITED TO 400 RIDERS
  • Race 2: Why-Not-Chee - July 18, 2026 (LaVogue Cyclery) - SPOTS LIMITED TO 400 RIDERS

Racing categories are Open, Open Masters (45+), Open Super Masters (60+), Non-Binary, Womens Open, Womens Masters (45+), Womens Super Masters (60+), Juniors (under 18), and Singlespeed. The top three overall winners (Men, Women, and More) in each distance will receive an award / podium.

You can also Gravel Unravel in the non-competitive Gran Fondo style in the Short and Medium distances. Loosely translated from Italian as “the big challenge”, think of it as more of a group ride or tour. Set your own goal, be it to go fast or ride for fun, or heck just to finish! E-bikes are allowed in the non-competitive ride as a separate category.

Why-Not-Chee

Wynoochee Lake is a hidden gem on the South Side of Olympic National Park just outside the park boundary in National Forest on Chehalis ancestral lands. Built in 1972, the Wynoochee Dam is used for flood control, irrigation, and industrial water storage.  The race starts and ends at Satsop Center, which is also a campground - we will get camping information out soon!

New format for 2026! This year we will have a 23-mile loop course, with just under 2,000 feet of cumulative elevation gain. You have a choice of doing 1, 2, or 3 loops - your friends and family can cheer you on at Satsop Center as you come through for your next loop!

Course map

All roads in the Wynoochee Lake area are open to non-motorized use year-long and the courses only represent a small sampling of possible routes in the area. This area is remote and rugged with the nearest cell reception being nearly 40 minutes away unless you are up on the highest ridges.

Pricing for Why-Not-Chee:

  • Adult pricing is $75 per person, regardless of distance.
  • Junior (under 18) = $35 (any distance)
  • Race Bundle Get $5 off each race if you register for Bon Jon Pass Out and Why-Not-Chee at the same time.

Price increase of $10 one week ahead of the race

SPOTS LIMITED TO 400 RIDERS.

What’s included in your Why-Not-Chee Out entry fee?

In addition to an epic outdoor experience in the far northwest corner, all participants receive a professional, well-organized event, RFID timing, a well-marked course, on-course snacks and medical support, mechanical support, and post-race hot food and cold drinks. There will be a beer garden at the race finish should you want to purchase a frosty bevvie.

Camping

We will have an onsite camping at Satsop Center and will post and email the camping link as soon as it is available.  

Additionally, free dispersed camping is allowed on the remainder of Olympic National Forest land according to these guidelines and regulations.

Refund Policy

  • No refunds, however you will have the choice during the registration process to buy cancellation insurance (coverage not available for Canadian riders). With the insurance, you can get a full refund if you are unable to attend the event due to several covered reasons including accident, illness and family emergency. Full insurance information HERE.
  • Transfers are allowed until 3 days before the race. Follow these instructions to transfer to another participant.
  • No deferrals to next year
  • If we are forced to cancel for any reason, runners will get a free transfer to the next year, or an 80% refund

Any other information, including course maps, can be found on our website.

name: Halloween Trick or Trot Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
🎃 👻 Trick or Trot! 👻 🎃
Run in our annual Halloween Run, where healthy fitness meets frightful fun! We'll even give you some free Halloween candy after your run! Find a friend, set a goal, and join this unique 5K, 10K, or 13.1 Half-Marathon run!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

description:
🎃 👻 Trick or Trot! 👻 🎃
Run in our annual Halloween Run, where healthy fitness meets frightful fun! We'll even give you some free Halloween candy after your run! Find a friend, set a goal, and join this unique 5K, 10K, or 13.1 Half-Marathon run!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

description:
Race Information
The race starts at 8:00 AM.
Packet pickup starts 30 minutes before the race and ends 10 minutes before the race starts.
All runners must register on RunSignup. 
No on-site registration.

5K & 10K Course (0.78M)
https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6645318825 
The course is an out-and-back (1.56M)
The 5K does the out-and-back two times.
The 10K does the out-and-back four times.

13.1M Course (1.09M)
https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6084281506 
The course is an out and back. (2.16M)
Half Marathon does the course six times. 

Course Time Limit
3 hours and 30 minutes.

name: Haunted Hustle 5K & 10K
description:
We’re back from the beyond for the Haunted Hustle 5K & 10K Run/Walk—a fun, costume-themed, non-timed, and family-friendly Halloween tradition! Come dressed for fun, grab your friends, and kick off Halloween with a bang. A prize will be awarded for Best Overall Costume, so get creative!

Participation is limited to the first 200 registrants across the 5K and 10K, so don’t wait—this spooky favorite fills fast.

Both races feature a course starting at Clarks Creek South in Puyallup, taking participants on a memorable run/walk through the cemetery, with a mix of sidewalks and off-the-beaten-path sections for a hauntingly good time.

Registration includes:
Event bib
Finisher medal
After-race snacks
Prize Drawing 

Whether you’re running, walking, or just in it for the costumes and community, Haunted Hustle is the perfect way to celebrate Halloween.  Important: For the safety of all participants and pets, NO pets are allowed on the course.

Costumes on, spirits high—join us if you dare! 🎃👻

name: Healthy Kids Running Series Fall 2026 - Vancouver, WA
description:
Who We Are: Healthy Kids Running Series is a five (5) week running program in the spring and fall for kids Pre-K through 8th grade. Each HKRS Series takes place once a week and offers age-appropriate running events including the 50 & 75 yard dashes, the 1/4 mile, the 1/2 mile and the 1 mile run. Kids will earn points for each race they complete based on their finish.

Pricing: The registration fee covers the entire five (5) weeks of the Series which includes race bibs for each week, a runner shirt, a finisher medal and any sponsor giveaways. Registration is non-refundable and non-transferable. Online Early Bird registration increases three weeks prior to the first race event. 

High School: We also welcome our high school runners! Our high school students will be running a 2 mile race. 

Challenger: This Series offers a Challenger Division which is an adaptive 75 yard race for children with disabilities and/or special needs. This allows for parents, siblings, and friends to be on the course with runners to provide support as well as bringing their own supportive devices such as crutches, braces, wheelchairs, etc. to be used by runners. 

Single Day Racing: Single day registration opens 1 hour before each race and must be completed onsite. The fee covers one race only. Single day participants are not eligible for series scoring, overall results, or an event T-shirt. Participants may upgrade to the full series to receive scoring and a T-shirt for races after the upgrade. Upgrade instructions can be found HERE.

Awards: All participants receive a medal on Week 5! Trophies will be awarded to the overall top finishers in each of the divisions listed below (broken out by boys and girls respectively): 

Pre-K 50 Yard Dash

Pre-K 75 Yard Dash  

Kindergarten & 1st Grade

2nd & 3rd Grade   

4th & 5th Grade  

6th to 8th Grade    

High School 

Challenger

Share your running photos with our community! Find us on Facebook @HealthyKidsRunning or Instagram @healthykidsrs!

name: Heart and Sole Fun Run and Roll 1K and 5K
description:
See you at Camp Korey for our first annual 1K & 5K Heart and Sole Fun Run & Roll!  

This fun community event will definitely be one filled with a lot of heart and many different types of soles! Whether you are feeling the challenge of a 5K or are more interested in the less serious 1K, ALL are invited to come and enjoy a morning filled with fun, inclusion, and a sprinkle cookie of silliness!  Whether you are doing the 5K or the 1K everyone will be swapping out those timing chips for potato chips and chocolate chips!  See you at the Finish-Line party!  

Everyone is welcome and encouraged to come out and join the fun!  
(5K = 3.1 miles) and (1K = .62 miles)

📍 Event Details

Event: Heart and Sole Fun Run & Roll 1K and 5K
Date: Saturday, September 19th 
Location: Camp Korey
5k Check-In: 8:15 a.m.
1K Check-In: 8:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m.
Waves start rolling out: 10 a.m. 

To celebrate our summer camp theme "Waves of Wonder" we will have 4 creative starting waves!  Sign up for the one that feels right for you!

5K: 10am - Grey Whale Wave- This is the wave for those who, much like the Grey Whale will be travelling the farthest! (5K = 3.1 miles)

1K: 10:15 am - Sailfish Wave- The sailfish is the fastest fish in the ocean at 68 mph!  This wave is for our fastest runners and rollers! 

1K: 10:30 am - Clownfish Wave- This wave is for those in costumes who want to have a bit of fun and show off as they make their way to the finish line!

1K: 10:45 am - Sea STAR Wave- YOU are the star!  Walk, Roll, Stroll, Prance, Skip, Gallop...this wave is for everyone!  However you want to get to the finish line, this wave is for you! 

Finish-line Party! Stick around after the race for a fun finish-line party with a food truck, coffee truck, local community booths to check out, and some choose your own adventure activities! Can you say foam party? Community Art Project? Dance Party? Firehose Shower? Costume Red Carpet Fashion Show? We can and will! 

Every participant will receive a Heart and Sole Fun Run and Roll medal and a post-race goody bag!

COSTUMES are highly encouraged!  Individual Costumes! Group Costumes! Inflatable Costumes! You name it, we want to see it!  No theme, just feeling whatever is in your heart and sole for the day! We will have a costume runway show at the finish line so be ready to fend off the paparazzi! 

💲 Registration

Early Bird: $30 through July 1, 2026
                    $35 July 2 - September 18, 2026
Day of:        $40 on September 19, 2026 at the Heart and Sole Fun Run and Roll

Free for kids under 12 - Reach out to info@campkorey.org to receive your specific coupon link! 

Free for Camp Korey campers and immediate camper families - Reach out to info@campkorey.org to receive your specific coupon link! 

Pre-registration deadline: July 1, 2026
Pre-registered participants will receive a finisher medal, swag, snacks, and water

Our hope is that everyone will be able to participate in this event independently, but if your runner or roller needs extra support or help to the finish line, we will have dedicated volunteers to pair with anyone with a need!  

🌟 Why should YOU put your Heart and Sole into an event like this?
Funds raised from this fun run and roll will directly support the mission of Camp Korey!  When you put your sole into this fun run and roll you will directly support the ongoing mission of Camp Korey!

Camp Korey is more than a camp.
It’s a place where kids with life-altering medical conditions can just be kids, entirely free of charge. We believe that all children should be able to experience both the joys of childhood and the profound, life-changing impact of camp. Every year, thousands of campers and family members gather in a community of people with shared experiences to sing, dance, laugh, grow, and discover their potential in a medically safe and adaptable environment.

Here, campers with 90+ diagnoses can take a true break from being “patients” and rediscover the joy of being a kid.

Don’t want to run or roll with us but still want to support, we have a variety of fundraising side trails you can join in on!  

You live out of town but still want to participate – register as a virtual runner, track and share your run, and you will get a finishers medal to celebrate YOU!

name: Heart and Sole Fun Run and Roll 1K and 5K
description:
See you at Camp Korey for our first annual 1K & 5K Heart and Sole Fun Run & Roll!  

This fun community event will definitely be one filled with a lot of heart and many different types of soles! Whether you are feeling the challenge of a 5K or are more interested in the less serious 1K, ALL are invited to come and enjoy a morning filled with fun, inclusion, and a sprinkle cookie of silliness!  Whether you are doing the 5K or the 1K everyone will be swapping out those timing chips for potato chips and chocolate chips!  See you at the Finish-Line party!  

Everyone is welcome and encouraged to come out and join the fun!  
(5K = 3.1 miles) and (1K = .62 miles)

📍 Event Details

Event: Heart and Sole Fun Run & Roll 1K and 5K
Date: Saturday, September 19th 
Location: Camp Korey
5k Check-In: 8:15 a.m.
1K Check-In: 8:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m.
Waves start rolling out: 10 a.m. 

To celebrate our summer camp theme "Waves of Wonder" we will have 4 creative starting waves!  Sign up for the one that feels right for you!

5K: 10am - Grey Whale Wave- This is the wave for those who, much like the Grey Whale will be travelling the farthest! (5K = 3.1 miles)

1K: 10:15 am - Sailfish Wave- The sailfish is the fastest fish in the ocean at 68 mph!  This wave is for our fastest runners and rollers! 

1K: 10:30 am - Clownfish Wave- This wave is for those in costumes who want to have a bit of fun and show off as they make their way to the finish line!

1K: 10:45 am - Sea STAR Wave- YOU are the star!  Walk, Roll, Stroll, Prance, Skip, Gallop...this wave is for everyone!  However you want to get to the finish line, this wave is for you! 

Finish-line Party! Stick around after the race for a fun finish-line party with a food truck, coffee truck, local community booths to check out, and some choose your own adventure activities! Can you say foam party? Community Art Project? Dance Party? Firehose Shower? Costume Red Carpet Fashion Show? We can and will! 

Every participant will receive a Heart and Sole Fun Run and Roll medal and a post-race goody bag!

COSTUMES are highly encouraged!  Individual Costumes! Group Costumes! Inflatable Costumes! You name it, we want to see it!  No theme, just feeling whatever is in your heart and sole for the day! We will have a costume runway show at the finish line so be ready to fend off the paparazzi!

name: Here and Now Project 5K for Today
description:
The Here and Now Project invites you to join us for our Seventh Annual 5K For Today! This will be a hybrid event. We are incredibly excited to return to Rogers High School in Puyallup for the in-person event and will continue to offer the virtual option for those who cannot join us in-person. By joining this family friendly walk, run, roll you will be supporting the paralysis community. Proceeds from this community activity will help us connect and empower the community through direct outreach to people who are newly injured, private support groups, recreational activities, and annual gatherings.

THE DETAILS:
  1. Register individually or start a team with family and friends! All participants will receive a race bib, sticker, and t-shirt for participating.
  2. Stylish short sleeve event T-shirts in unisex, women's, and youth sizes are included with your registration. We have a new option to order a unisex long sleeve shirt for an addition $3.00 fee. Your T-shirt is not guaranteed if you register after July 8th. We will order limited extras (short sleeve only) in order to attempt to provide shirts for later entries, however these will be subject to availability and sizes will be on a first come-first served basis.
  3. While registering you will have the option to purchase additional H&NP swag from the store.
  4. Don't feel up to running, walking, or rolling but still want to support the cause? Create an individual or team fundraiser and share your personal experiences of H&NP with your respective networks!
  5. Join us on the strava app as we connect in the weeks leading up to main event.
  6. Tag us in photos on social media using the hashtags #5kForToday and #HereAndNow5k as you prepare for the race! Plan your routes, share tips, engage along the way as we get out and DO LIFE. Be sure to follow along on Facebook and Instagram for some fun contest announcements!
  7. Complete your 5K/3.1 mile run, walk or roll with H&NP in person on August 9th (or virtually between August 9-16).
  8. On-site race will start at 12:00PM, immediately following event packet pick-up from 11:00-11:55AM, please plan accordingly! (More packet pickup info below.)
  9. Virtual participants can upload a picture and submit results on our results page.
  10. Connect with us! We'd love to hear your story and connect you to our community as we support each other.
  11. Registration closes at 11:59PM on August 7th (for both the on-site and virtual events). Sign up today!
  12. All pets must remain on a leash at all times.

Make sure to register early for to take advantage of our early bird prices!

**February 14th ONLY – $35.00!!**
February 15-June 7– $40!!
June 8-July 9 – $45!
July 10-August 7 – $50 
*17 and under have a $5 registration discount


PACKET PICKUP:

We are excited to have two ways to pick up your race packet and swag this year:
1. Pre-Race Packet Pickup: Fleet Feet (Puyallup location) - Saturday, August 8th, 1-4pm.
Address: 115 S Meridian, Puyallup, WA 98371

2. Race Day Packet Pickup: Rogers High School Registration Area - Sunday, August 9th from 11:00-11:55am
Rogers High School: 12801 86th Ave E, Puyallup, WA 98373
We encourage participants to pick up their packets in advance to avoid lines and reduce congestion at registration on the day of the event. You may pick up packets on behalf of family or friends. Virtual participants will have their race packet and swag mailed to them. 

More information about The Here and Now Project can be found at www.hereandnowproject.org
If you have questions, please let us know!
The Here and Now Project | info@hereandnowproject.org

name: Heroes Walk, 5K & 10k Fun Run Presented By Lithia CDJR and Camp Chevrolet
description:
CHECK IN BEGINS AT 9:00 AM 


Empowering Communities and Fortifying Families to End Veteran Suicide and Strengthen our Heroes to Lead their Communities.

HONOR HEROES - FORTIFY FAMILIES - CELEBRATE FREEDOM

Walk in support of veterans to choose LIFE. The enemy did not have victory in war, and will not win in the day to day battle for our veteran’s lives. Together we can end veteran suicide and fortify families after service. Live life abundantly with a community that hears, sees and recognizes the sacrifices of our HEROES. Family and supporters of our veterans are encouraged to join. Let’s gather in a big way to show the love and support of our veterans and the USA. 

The circle of return from military service to civilian life is a personal and community process. Join a community wide celebration and resources fair as we help veterans and families make the journey back home after service. 

Schedule: 

9 AM Registration Opens and Community Resource Fair

10 AM Opening Ceremonies 

11:00 AM Walk Commences on paths through Riverfront Park.
Those walking with kids are welcome to bring scooters, wagons, bikes or strollers to make your time easier with little ones. 

12 PM Victory Celebration and Closing Ceremony 

1 PM Resource Fair Closes


Heroes Walk brings awareness, solutions, and builds a connected community to end veteran suicide and homelessness by providing resources for wrap around care for the whole veteran and their family or support system. The content and event day will be mindful of the multigenerational crowd. 

Organizations desiring to join the resource community fair or sponsor the event, please email info@heroeshomestead.org.  Services for adults, children, veterans and spouses (including Gold Star families), as well as basic life needs and life enhancement and more are welcome to join.

name: Holiday Grinch 5K
description:
🎄💚 Grinch Out Puyallup 5K Sunday, December 6th 💚🎄

Get ready to Grinch out the City of Puyallup in this festive, fun-filled holiday run! We’ll start and finish at Firemind Brewing (211 W. Stewart Ave., Puyallup, WA 98371) and spread a little mischievous cheer through downtown.

Break out your best Grinch gear—costumes are highly encouraged—and bring your friends and holiday spirit for a run that’s all about fun, laughter, and community.

🎁 Give back this season:
Please bring a new, unwrapped toy for children ages 5–14 to help support kids in need right here in our community.

✨ Event details:
- Start/finish at Firemind Brewing
- Holiday-themed 5K fun run
- Limited to the first 200 registrants

🥞 Pancake Breakfast Fundraiser benefiting the Skooklie Foundation:
Stick around after the 5K and keep the holiday cheer going with our Pancake Breakfast Fundraiser, with proceeds benefiting the Skooklie Foundation—because running is better when pancakes support a great cause!

Spots are limited, the Grinch is coming, and the fun is guaranteed—don’t miss out! 🎅💚

Event long sleeve shirts are available for purchase for $25 until November 11th.  Please add $5 for 2XL and 3XL shirts.

description:

name: Hope and Heroes Run
description:
🦸 CAPES ON. COSTUMES READY. WASHINGTON — IT'S TIME TO UNITE.

💚 Hope & Heroes Run is Washington State's first-ever PANS/PANDAS awareness run — created to shine a light on a neuropsychiatric condition that is too often misunderstood, misdiagnosed, and faced in silence. On October 11, 2026, Washington shows up for these children and their families.

Join hundreds of heroes at beautiful Marymoor Park in Redmond for a family-friendly 5K, 10K, Kids Dash, and Heroic Sip & Stroll- superhero costumes are strongly encouraged. Run with your family. Join a community of heroes. Celebrate courage, community, and hope as the littlest sidekicks cross their very first finish line. This is October done right.

Whether you're a seasoned runner, a total beginner, or just here to watch your little sidekick zoom across the finish line in a cape, there is a place for every hero here. All ages. All paces. Strollers welcome. All of Washington welcome.

⏰ START TIMES

8:15 AM — Check In Opens

9:15AM — Super Sidekick Dash

9:30AM — The Unstoppable 10K 

9:35AM — Heroic Sip & Stroll 

9:45AM — The Fearless 5K 

 
🏃 THE RACES

⚡ The Fearless 5K — 3.1 miles You don't have to be fast to be fearless. The Fearless 5K winds through the beautiful paths of Marymoor Park and is open to every age, every pace, and every hero in between. Stroller friendly. Timed finish. Register by September 25, 2026 for a guaranteed event t-shirt and finisher medal.

💪 The Unstoppable 10K — 6.2 miles The most unstoppable thing in the world? A hero who decided to show up. The Unstoppable 10K is the ultimate hero challenge — 6.2 miles through the scenic paths of Marymoor Park. Stroller friendly. Timed finish. Age group and overall awards. Register by September 25, 2026 for a guaranteed event t-shirt and finisher medal.

⭐ Super Sidekick Dash — 0.4 miles · Ages 0–5 Every superhero needs a sidekick — and this one gets their very own race. Children ages 0–5 take over the course for a mighty 0.4 mile dash in full superhero style. Superhero costumes strongly encouraged — capes, masks, and superpowers of all kinds welcome at the starting line. Every single finisher receives an official Super Sidekick Finisher Ribbon — because around here every hero wins. Parents and guardians welcome to run alongside.

🥤 Heroic Sip & Stroll — 3.1 miles Not all heroes run. Some stroll — and they do it in style. The Heroic Sip & Stroll is a relaxed, superhero costume-encouraged, non-alcoholic stroll through beautiful Marymoor Park perfect for those who want to be part of the action without the race pressure. All ages. Strollers welcome. All capes encouraged.

 
🏆 COSTUME CONTEST

Think you have what it takes? Suit up as a superhero for your chance to win — because every hero needs a cape.

 

 👕 T-SHIRT

Register by September 25, 2026 and receive an official Hope & Heroes Run event t-shirt included with your registration. 

 

Come for the capes. Stay for the cause. See you at the starting line. 🦸💚

name: Hope in Every Step: A Virtual Run for Recurrent Pregnancy Loss Awareness
description:
Grief is a journey, and every step forward is a testament to resilience and remembrance.

Join us for Hope in Every Step: A Virtual Run for Recurrent Pregnancy Loss Awareness, an event dedicated to raising awareness of those affected by recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL). By participating, you are not only supporting the RPL community but also helping fund vital education, advocacy, research and support programs through the Recurrent Pregnancy Loss Association (RPLA). Sign up today and help us spread awareness and move toward healing, hope and change - one step at a time. 

This year's race will take place between Saturday, August 22 (Rainbow Baby Day - a day celebrating babies born after pregnancy loss) and Sunday, August 30 (Grief Awareness Day - a day recognizing the varied aspects of grief).

How does a virtual run work?

A virtual run lets you complete the race anytime, anywhere. Instead of gathering at a traditional race site, you will track your distance using a fitness app, smartwatch, or manually, then submit your results online. It is a flexible and convenient way to stay active and be part of a community from anywhere in the world.

But, while there is no single race location, you don't have to participate alone.  Check out the "Groups/Teams" to find local meet-ups or virtual teams.

name: HopeBridge 5K Fundraiser
description:
HopeBridge Community 5K Robinswood Park, Bellevue, WA | Late June 2026 | 9:30 AM

Join us for the first ever HopeBridge Community 5K, a morning run bringing together runners, families, and community members from across the Eastside. All ages and paces are welcome. Come for the run, stay for the community.

 
About HopeBridge

HopeBridge is a teen-led nonprofit based in King County, Washington, dedicated to supporting Asian American teenagers in their daily lives. Founded in early 2026, HopeBridge works with local schools and community partners to create spaces where Asian American teens feel seen, supported, and connected.

Our work is built around three core goals:

Navigating Academic Pressures We help Asian American teens develop healthier relationships with achievement, stress, and their own expectations, so that success does not come at the cost of their wellbeing.

Embracing Cultural Identity We create space for teens to explore what it means to grow up between cultures, honoring both their heritage and the world they are building for themselves.

Mental Health Advocacy We work to reduce stigma around mental health in Asian American communities by sharing stories, hosting events, and building partnerships that make support more accessible.

 
Our Fundraising Goal

Every dollar raised at this event goes directly toward HopeBridge programming in King County. Our goal is $3,000, which will fund community events, school partnerships, and outreach efforts throughout the year. When you register, you are not just running a 5K. You are investing in the mental health of teenagers in your community.

name: Hot Dog Hustle 5K
description:
The Hot Dog Hustle Fun Run and Walk is held at the Renton Community Center Campus. Runners and walkers travel along the paved beautiful Cedar River Trail before looping back to the Community Center Campus. At the end, participants can enjoy FREE HOT DOGS as we celebrate Independence Day, along with the City of Renton’s 125th anniversary.

Competitive runners, fun runners, walkers, and families (with or without) dogs are all invited to this annual event. Accurate and professional chip timing is provided by Negative Split. If registered before 9:00AM on Wednesday, June 17, participants will receive a Hot Dog Hustle 5K t-shirt.

Registration Windows:

  • Early Bird Registration                    April 22 to June 7
    • Guarantees you a Hot Dog Hustle 5K t-shirt
    • Ages 4 to 17 fee:                  $12.50
    • Ages 18 and up fee:             $17.76
  • Standard Price Registration           June 8 to June 18 (by 9am)
    • Guarantees you a Hot Dog Hustle 5K t-shirt
    • Ages 4 to 17 fee:                 $17.76
    • Ages 18 and up fee:            $25.00
  • Last Call Registration                      June 18 (after 9am) – June 26
    • Not eligible to receive a Hot Dog Hustle 5K t-shirt
    • All-Ages fee:                          $25

**No Day of Registrations!!!!

Race Bib Number Pick Up:
If you have pre-registered, you may pick up your race bib and shirt (if applicable) at The Renton Community Center, 1715 Maple Valley Hwy. Renton, 98057, Thursday, July 2, 9:30AM – 5:00PM. If you are picking up for family members or friends, you will need their race day registration confirmation. You also can pick up your race bib and shirt onsite the morning of the race starting at 8:15am. 

Race Guidelines for Humans and Dogs:
Strollers are welcome on the course for both humans and dogs.

  • Your race bib is your timing chip. Please wear it outside of your clothing facing forward for accurate timing.
  • Timing will conclude 45 minutes after the start of the race.
  • Walkers stay to the right of the racecourse.
  • Extra t-shirts will NOT be available for purchase on race day.
  • No more than two dogs per person.
  • All dogs are required to be current on vaccinations.
  • No dogs under six months of age.
  • Dogs must be on leash no more than 6 feet in length.
  • Owners are responsible for the well-being and safety of their dog(s) at all times
  • No female dogs in heat. 
  • No aggressive dogs or aggressive owners. Any signs of aggression towards other dogs or participants will result in being asked to leave the event.

Course Closure:
Recreational walkers/runners are non-competitive and will not be timed if finishing after 45 minutes. If you are participating in this event but are not being timed, please be considerate and not cross the finish line where timing is taking place. Keep to the right or left of the timing chute.

Awards and Results:
Awards will be given to the top three runners overall in the following categories: 

Male 70+, Female 70+, Male 50-69, Female 50-69, Male 18-49, Female 18-49, Non-Binary Adult 18+, Youth 1-17.

name: Hot for a Cause 5k
description:
You’ve braved the cold with us — now it’s time to face the heat.

Join us for the inaugural Hot for a Cause 5K, a summer run/walk benefiting Yakima Union Gospel Mission and the men, women, and children in our community who endure dangerous summer temperatures without shelter, safety, or support.

Hosted at the same venue as our beloved Cold for a Cause, this event brings awareness to a different side of homelessness in the Yakima Valley: surviving the intense heat of summer. While many of us seek air conditioning and relief, thousands of vulnerable individuals face long days and sleepless nights exposed to the elements.

Every registration helps provide shelter, meals, outreach, recovery services, and hope to neighbors experiencing homelessness and hardship.

Whether you run, walk, or cheer others on, you’re making a difference for those who face the heat every day.

name: Howl - O - Ween
description:
Get your pups ready for a tail-waggin good time at the Howl-O-Ween Dog Run/Walk on Saturday, October 10th at beautiful Bradley Lake Park! This event has gone to the dogs! Choose your distance with either a 1 Mile or 2 Mile option and enjoy a fun-filled morning celebrating the fall season with fellow dog lovers and their furry friends.

We will have three different dog sizes: Small, Medium, and Large/XL. Your furry friend will receive a cool finisher medal, treat swag bag, and a fun Howl-O-Ween themed bandana. Be sure to dress up and join our costume contest featuring categories for Funniest Costume, Spookiest Costume, and Best Dog & Owner Combo.

We will also be hosting a pet food drive benefiting Metro Animal Services, so please consider bringing pet food donations to help animals in need. Plus, shop Firehouse Pets for the perfect Halloween costume and accessories for your furry companion.  Grab your leash, your costume, and your favorite four-legged friend and join us for a spooktacular morning in the park!

Disclaimer: All dogs must remain on a leash at all times and must be able to interact safely with other dogs and humans. For the safety of all participants, any aggressive behavior toward people or other animals will not be tolerated. If at any time our team observes aggressive behavior, you and your pet will be asked to leave the event without a refund.

  • Medium Dogs 9:30 AM
  • Large/XL Dogs 10 AM

name: I Can And I Will Run!
description:
I can and I will is the mantra Olivia and her mom, Alisa, have been saying since 2018. Whether it's prepping to be poked by a needle or running up a big hill, we remind ourselves that we can and we will! We take these words to heart and they have been pushing us to do big things!

Our goal with this run is to raise money for the Uncompensated Care Fund at Seattle Children's Hospital. Race day is Sunday, October 18th, 2026. The event offers kids dashes, a professionally timed 5k and a 10k, as well as a virtual run for our friends and fans who are not able to travel to Seattle. The start will be at Green Lake Community Center using both the inner trail, and surrounding park for the 10k, finishing back at the start. The kids' runs will be held near the starting line after the other races are completed. We will have t-shirts for those registering early as long as supplies last as well as finisher medals!

We created this event to help Seattle Children's Hospital provide world class care to patients regardless of their ability to pay. Everyday a family walks into Seattle Children's Hospital and learns something that will forever change them. No parent should have to deal with a difficult diagnosis for their child and face financial hardship when seeking care for their child. 

Every step you take will make a difference in the lives of families who are impacted by a devastating diagnosis and wondering how they will pay the medical bills. 100% of race net proceeds from this fun run will benefit uncompensated care at Seattle Children’s Hospital. Thank you for your participation and help. You are ensuring that families can focus on their child's wellbeing; not the medical bill in their mailbox.

If you've been to the Run before, awesome, thank you for the ongoing support! And if you are joining us for the first time, welcome to the party!

name: I love the 90s 5k
description:
I love the 90s 5k! 

Get ready to groove and run down memory lane at the I Love the 90s 5K, where you can lace up your sneakers & jam to classic 90s tunes!
Join us for the I Love the 90s 5k! Lace up your sneakers and get ready to groove to the best hits of the 90s while running through beautiful Green Lake Park in Seattle, WA. This in-person event is a blast from the past, celebrating all things 90s. Whether you're a fan of grunge, pop, or hip-hop, this 5k is for you! Dress up in your favorite 90s attire and relive the nostalgia with fellow participants. The course will take you around the scenic Green Lake, providing a picturesque backdrop for your run. So grab your friends, put on your Walkman, and let's make some memories together at the I Love the 90s 5k!
 
Questions? Concerns? Email us! General inquiries:  info@run2befit.com

name: Inland Northwest Cross Country Invitational (INWXCI)
description:
The Inland Northwest Cross Country Invitational @ The Course

Experience race day at THE premier new cross country running venue in America — The Course in Spokane Valley — with a fast, exciting 5K cross country event designed for runners of all ages and abilities.

Held on Sunday, August 23rd — the day before high school cross country season officially begins — this event is the perfect way to kick off the fall racing season. Whether you’re sharpening up before competition, chasing a personal best, or just looking to experience an incredible new course, this race delivers championship-level atmosphere on a state-of-the-art cross country venue built for the top runners in the region…and for one day this August, everyone gets a chance to see what the fuss is all about.

name: Issaquah Schools Foundation Monster Mash 5K
description:
Help us raise a MONSTROUS amount of support for local students on October 24th! ISF Monster Mash 5K is a community-based, family-friendly event that raises funds for programs that serve students attending all 27 ISD schools.

We welcome all-ages and abilities. Convenient onsite parking, phased start times, and a professionally chip-timed course ensure a great experience for all. You’ll appreciate the flat, paved, out-and-back route whether you’re setting a new 5K PR or enjoying a brisk walk together as a family! Bring your creativity – festive costumes are encouraged!
This event sells out every year, so don't wait to register! Every registration submitted by October 12th receives a 2026 Monster Mash technical race tee & medal. Registrants receive free event photos and raffle tickets for prizes as well! Placement awards for fastest finishing times will also be presented. See below for details.

name: Jack & Jill Marathon & Half
description:
• Ranked #35 Fastest Marathon in the U.S. (FindMyMarathon) 
 • 1 in 5 runners BQ
 • ~1,000 feet of net downhill with NO Boston Qualifier time penalty
 • Smooth, fast rail-trail surface built for negative splits
 • Jack & Jill has sent thousands of runners to Boston
 • Iconic Snoqualmie Tunnel experience
 • Abbott World Marathon Majors Age Group World Rankings Qualifier
 • Professionally timed with live tracking, detailed results, and printed results cards
 • Super Pacers for key Boston Qualifying times

Over a decade of experience delivering one of the fastest and most trusted downhill races in the country.


What Runners Are Saying

"BQ and PR!! Boston 2026 here I come💙🦄💛 Jack and Jill was my race to get a larger buffer"- Carolyn

"BQ last July at Jack and Jill, Boston 2026 here I come! I love running this course, I would run it just for the peace and tranquility the course provides. P.S. - I love the tunnel, part of the experience" - Jon

"The finish line was awesome! They announce your name and let you know if you qualified for Boston. The crowd was amazing at the finish. And yes, I rang that PR bell with Pride! Would I run this marathon again? Absolutely!" - Annie|

"10 min PR from my Boston Time, so it was very successful! Was a really fun race and loved the finish line!! Such a great atmosphere!"
