name: 2025 RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM - "Together we can Wipe-Out DM"
description:
🐾 Baroooo! Welcome Everypawdy! 🐾
We’re tail-wagging excited that you’re joining us for this year’s RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM!

This year, we're doing things a little differently - and we can't wait to see how YOU Bark Out Loud for the pups! Our goal? To quadruple the awareness about Degenerative Myelopathy (DM) by inspiring dog lovers everywhere to take action alongside you.
Because let's face it - everyone knows at least one dog lover!

This year’s design gives you new and creative ways to build your own community, honor dogs past and present, and help prevent this heartbreaking disease.

 
🌟 Event Details

  • Location: Wherever you are! It’s virtual so walk, run, ride, or roll from your own neighborhood.
  • Dates:  November 9-23, 2025...JUST EXTENDED!!!
  • Registration: FREE! (But we kindly suggest a $25 donation to help us continue our mission.)
  • RACE Packet, FAQs, and More: Scroll below for full details!

 ******************************************************

 🐶 Why We RACE

Because some pups can’t - and we can!
Degenerative Myelopathy (DM) is a devastating disease, but the good news is it’s preventable through proper genetic testing prior to breeding. Together, we’re barking out loud to spread awareness and save future pups.

 ****************************************************** 

🚶🏽‍♀️ Ways to Participate

Choose your style - move your way!

🏃 Competitive Runners

  • "The Fast & the Furriest 5K Run" - Fastest 5K in a single day
  • “Iron Paw Endurance Challenge” - Most miles run total over the week

🚶 Competitive Walkers

  • “The ShadeOutDM Sprint” - Longest distance walked in a single day (tie-breaker: fastest time)
  • “Miles for Mutts Marathon” - Most miles walked total over the week

🐕 Dog Jog

  • Are you already walking your dog daily? Make it count by participating virtually with your pup(s) – non competitive
  • There will be a special award for the “Top Dog Distance Challenge” - Top 10 distances on our WoofTrax Event

🐾 Couch Dog - (Supporter)

  • Don’t want to go out, but still want to cheer us on? This is your moment! Every event needs a barking fan club - and we know a few pups who’d rather bark from the window. WOOF, BORK, WOOF!

🚴 Cruisin’ for Dogs

  • 🚴 “Pedal for the Pups” (Bicycle) - Top Pedal-Powered Distance (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🏍️ "The Ruff Riders " (Motorcycle) - Ruff Rider Mileage Master (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🛴 ,"Sidewalk Surfers" (Scooter) - Scooter Squad Mileage Leader Distance Award (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🛹 "Shreddin’ to Save Tails" (Skateboard) - Gnarliest Skate Miles Logged total over the week
  • 🛼 "Skates, Blades & Barks" (Roller skates, Roller blades, Ice Skates) - Distance Award (Most miles skated total over the week)
  • 🐴 "Hoofbeats for Hope" (horse) - Distance Award (Most miles ridden total over the week)

🏊‍♂️ Surf & Swim Supporters for Dogs

  • 🏊‍♂️ "The Big Splash Swim"  Furthest distance swam over the full week
  • 🏄‍♂️"Ride the Tide Challenge" Awards for the Most consecutive days surfed over the week

🐶 Aqua Paws - Pup Swim or Dog Surf

  • 🐶🏊 "Doggy Paddle Dash" - ALL swims logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • 🐶🏄 "Surf’s Pup Showdown" - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES! 

NEW! ♿ Wheelin’ Warriors 💪💜 - for our handi’cappable people and pups with any type of disability or special need who want to roll, stroll, or simply be part of the race community! 

We proudly include participants using wheelchairs, mobility scooters, adaptive devices, or living with mobility, sensory, cognitive, or chronic health conditions - and of course, our amazing pups in wheels too. 🐾🦽

  • "Pups With Grit" (pups in wheels) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Racing with Heart" (people in wheels) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Rolling, Not Strolling" (mobility scooters) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Adaptive Allies" (handicappable people) - ALL walks logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!

You're not just joining a race, you’re helping us show the world what strength, heart, and inclusion really look like.

 

*Log your miles by using our Group "2025 Walk to Wipe-Out DM by ShadeOutDM" on WoofTrax https://link.wooftrax.com/lxa416 
 

******************************************************

👕 How to Get Your Official RACE T-Shirt

Only participants who raise $200 or more will receive an official Shade Out DM Race T-Shirt!
This reward is based on individual fundraising totals - not team totals or general donations - so be sure your donations are credited to your personal page!

Check out our Fundraising Prize Wave (below)  -  Additional shipping charges may apply for shipping outside the USA.

🎯 Make it your goal to earn a shirt, and challenge your friends, family, and coworkers to earn theirs too!

 ******************************************************

📌 How to Sign Up

  1. Register Online
    Choose to support an existing team or start your own.
  2. Start a Warrior Team
    If your dog has taken or is taking the DM journey, start a Warrior Team in their honor. (You don't have to have a pup with DM to start a team, Teams can be Advocacy, Corporate, Rescues, Schools, Clubs, etc.)
  3. Get Your Bib
    You’ll receive a race bib via email (check spam or log into your profile).
  4. Strike a Pose!📸
    Snap a photo of your pup (or stuffed animal!) wearing sunglasses and your race bib.
  5. Post & Tag!
    Share on social media during race week and tag #ShadeOutDM in ALL your posts!
    (Let’s flood the feed and get people asking, “What’s DM?”)

Build your Team Early to ensure you receive your Prizes prior to RACE week! (International winners may choose to donate back their prizes or may be asked to cover the additional shipping fees)

Prizes will begin shipping mid October - While supplies last! *

****************************************************** 

🧬 About Degenerative Myelopathy (DM)

DM is often called the canine version of ALS (Lou Gehrig’s Disease). It’s a progressive, genetic disease affecting the spinal cord and over 100 dog breeds (& mixed breeds now too). Symptoms usually appear between ages 8-14, starting with ONE hind-leg weakness & loss of coordination, eventually leading to full paralysis, incontinence, organ failure, and respiratory failure all while their mind is still fully aware.

The tragedy?

  • Many vets still don’t know about DM
  • It’s often misdiagnosed
  • It’s entirely preventable with genetic testing

DM is on the rise - NOW is the time to speak up for the pups!

******************************************************

💜 About Shade Out DM Foundation

Shade Out DM Foundation is a 100% volunteer-run, registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We are dedicated to:
📚 Educating ~ 💬 Supporting ~ ♿ Loaning ~ 📣 Advocating

Our Mission:
To improve the health and well-being of dogs affected by DM while preventing future cases through awareness and education.

Your Support Helps:

  • Fund KC’s Kruisers Loaner Cart Program for dogs in need
  • Attend veterinary and breed-specific conferences
  • Contribute to DM research
  • Provide awareness materials and educational outreach

All proceeds go directly toward these efforts.
🌐 Donate at: www.shadeoutdm.org

 
Let’s RACE to #ShadeOutDM - because no dog should suffer needlessly!
Together, we can make a difference. 💜🐾

name: 2026 - City to the Sea Half Marathon & 5K
description:
CUESTA COLLEGE'S - CITY TO THE SEA HALF MARATHON & 5K

RUNNING WAREHOUSE - HALF MARATHON (13.1 MILES)

Start with the sunrise at historic Mission Plaza for this one of a kind race. The City to the Sea Half Marathon, presented by Running Warehouse, is a breathtaking point-to-point race beginning in San Luis Obispo. The course guides runners past iconic local landmarks, through scenic country backroads, and along the picturesque Bob Jones Trail, culminating at the edge of the Pacific Ocean in the charming coastal community of Avila Beach.

This beautiful course delivers a truly unique Central Coast experience - from the charm of downtown SLO to the relaxing vibes of the Pacific shoreline.

Half Marathon Start Time: October 18th, 2026, 7:00AM

Location: 989 Chorro Street, San Luis Obispo, Ca 93401 ¦ Mission Plaza

The events top 100 men & women will take home a commemorative 2026 City to the Sea mug. All half marathon participants will receive a finisher’s medal and a custom event t-shirt to commemorate their accomplishment. After crossing the finish line, runners can enjoy savory provisions and beverages for purchase—cheers to those 21 and over—a celebratory beer on us!

 

AVILA - SEASIDE 5K (3.1 MILES)

Begin and end your run at the Pacific Ocean. The Avila-Seaside 5K is an out-and-back, with a loop, course with roughly 60% of the route showcasing breathtaking views of the beach, harbor, and "The Peaceful Sea". Keep a keen eye open for sea lions, otters and whales along the route. The course joins the scenic Bob Jones Trail before finishing at beautiful Avila Beach Resort.

5K Start Time: October 18th, 2026, 7:00AM

Location: 6464 Ana Bay Rd, Avila Beach, CA 93424 ¦ Avila Beach Resort

All 5K participants will receive a 2026 finisher’s medal and a custom t-shirt to commemorate their accomplishment. After crossing the finish line, runners can enjoy savory provisions and beverages for purchase—cheers to those 21 and over—a celebratory beer on us!

More Information

After crossing the finish line explore a vibrant selection of community vendors while taking in live music from a local band. You’ll have the option to purchase a variety of meal options from Mulligan’s, or venture into the charming coastal village of Avila Beach to bask in the sun, savor a wine tasting, or stroll the iconic Avila Beach Promenade and Pier. For half marathoners, buses will take you back to the start-line in San Luis Obispo. You may also arrange for your own private transportation if you prefer.

Refund Policy

Please note that entry fees are non-refundable and non-deferrable. However, we understand that unexpected circumstances can arise. You may transfer your registration with a fee. If you can't attend the event please let us know. We will add someone from our waitlist. Our goal is to provide flexible options while continuing to deliver a high-quality experience year after year.

Questions? Please visit www.citytothesearun.com or email us at city2thesea@gmail.com

name: 2026 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.20.26
description:
2026 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.20.25

18 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run), 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run) and 6 Youth Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

CASTAIC LAKE. 
The 35th annual Castaic Lake Triathlon takes place at scenic Castaic Lake just 20 miles north of Los Angeles. The Castaic Lake Recreation Area, located just north of Santa Clarita, is an 11,200-acre multi-use facility with two lakes, boating, world class fishing, hiking, walking, horseback riding, wake boarding, jet-skiing, camping, picnicking, kayaking, and sailing.  August is a great time to enjoy the water in the high 60s, and a staging area aptly named Paradise Cove. "Tri-cation" Friday night camping available through Castaic Lake.


THE COURSE. 
The swim course is a modified V shape in Paradise Cove at Castaic Lake, with 8 lifeguards in the water on paddleboards.  The bike course then goes out on back roads to limit your interaction with cars.  The bike course does include some U-turns on back roads to allow this, so athletes should slow down at the turn around points.  The run is primarily on the rolling trails overlooking Castaic Lake. 

WHO WE SUPPORT
All proceeds will benefit the Canyon High School Cross Country and Track Teams (we've been doing this for 33 years to support our programs).  

This is a great triathlon for new triathletes.  For years our coaches and athletes have encouraged new triathletes (young and old), and created a welcoming atmosphere of support.  We offer an enjoyable experience for triathletes of all experience levels.  


AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG).
Mid June temperatures are often cooler in the morning, with early morning fog burning off to reach the mid 80s.  Our event will possibly be around 60 degrees.

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 

Water temps in June typically range in the mid to high 60s.  Email updates will be sent out closer to the race with updates. Use the 20% 2026CALTRI discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

The Castaic Lake Recreation Area, located just north of Santa Clarita, is an 11,200-acre multi-use facility with two lakes, boating, world class fishing, hiking, walking, horseback riding, wake boarding, jet-skiing, camping, picnicking, kayaking, and sailing.  August is a great time to enjoy the water in the high 60s, and a staging area aptly named Paradise Cove. "Tri-cation" Friday night camping available through Castaic Lake.


THE COURSE. 
The swim course is a modified V shape in Paradise Cove at Castaic Lake, with 8 lifeguards in the water on paddleboards.  The bike course then goes out on back roads to limit your interaction with cars.  The bike course does include some U-turns on back roads to allow this, so athletes should slow down at the turn around points.  The run is primarily on the rolling trails overlooking Castaic Lake.

All proceeds will benefit the Canyon High School Cross Country and Track Teams (we've been doing this for 33 years to support our programs).

name: 2026 Cal Tri La Crema - 6.28.26
description:
2026 Cal Tri La Crema - 6.28.26. Located in Sonoma County, the La Crema Cal Tri Sonoma triathlon starts at iconic Johnson's Beach with a Russian River swim, a scenic bike ride along River Road towards the ultimate destination, La Crema Estate at Saralee’s Vineyard, where athletes run through the vineyards chasing that elusive finish line. Athletes 21+ are encouraged to enjoy a wine pour after the race.

7 EVENT OPTIONS. 3 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, SwimBike and 1640 Yard Swim) and 4 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, SwimBike, 400 yard Swim & 5k Run). All events start at Johnson's Beach with the exception of the 5K which starts and ends at La Crema Estate at Saralee’s Vineyard. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

name: 2026 Cayucos Turkey Trot
description:
Thanksgiving Day Family 5k Fun Run / Walk

Check-in and bib pick-up will start Wednesday, November 25th at the Cayucos Pier from 2-4pm.  Each registered participant will have an assigned bib number and Thanksgiving-themed running socks, while supplies last.

On race day, check-in will begin at 7:15am.  We are set to start at 8:30am so be sure to give yourself enough time.  Dogs, strollers, and kiddos on scooters are all welcome.  

All proceeds will equally benefit Cayucos Elementary School and the California Association of Highway Patrolman Widows & Orphans' Trust Fund.

Thank you for your incredible support, and we can’t wait to see on race day!

name: 2026 CVC San Diego Triathlon and San Diego Tri Series 5K
description:
Mark your calendars for event #2 of the San Diego Triathlon Series & the Triple Crown of Triathlon
📅 Sunday, August 16, 2026
📍 Chula Vista, CA – San Diego Bayfront

This Year, We are Back to the Fantastic ONE PARK Venue! Start / Transition/ Finish line/ and Beer Garden all in one place! See the beutiful new landscape and the Gaylord Hotel

Dive into one of San Diego’s most exciting and scenic multisport races of the summer! The CVC San Diego Triathlon & 5K is Event #2 in the prestigious San Diego Triathlon Series and part of the coveted Triple Crown of Triathlon. Whether you're a first-timer or a seasoned competitor, there’s a race here for everyone. 🌊☀️

Set against the calm, warm waters of San Diego Bay, this athlete-friendly race offers flat, fast courses, great for achieving your personal best—and even better for enjoying the beautiful coastal views while you’re at it. After your race, celebrate with friends and family in our on-the-water 🍺Seek Beer Co. - Beer & 🍸Margarita Garden and soak in those post-race vibes!

Race Options
INTERNATIONAL TRIATHLON
1,000 M swim - 38 K (23.3 mi) bike - 10K (6.2 mi) run 
Ages 16 & over

SPRINT TRIATHLON
500 M swim – 19K (11.6 mi) bike – 5K (3.1 mi) run 
Ages 13 & over

SPRINT RELAY
500 M swim - 19K (11.6 mi) bike - 5k run 
Ages 13 & over
SPRINT DUATHLON
1 mile run - 19K (11.6 mi) bike - 5k run 
Ages 13 & over

SPRINT AQUABIKE
500 M swim - 19K (11.6 mi) bike
Ages 13 & over

MINI TRIATHLON
200 M swim – 9K (5.8 mi) bike – 2.4K (1.5 mi) run
Ages 11 & over

ITSY BITSY TRIATHLON
100 M swim – 4K (2.3 mi) bike – 1.2K (.75 mi) run
Kids 7-10

SD Tri Series - Chula Vista 5K (3.1 mi) run

name: 2026 Humboldt Redwoods Marathon, Half Marathon, 5K
description:
We'll forgive you if you have trouble concentrating on the road ahead of you while running The Humboldt Redwoods Marathon, half or 5K. After all, you'll probably be looking up at the old-growth redwood trees which tower over the course! This race is in Humboldt Redwoods State Park and the Half Marathon follows the second half of the iconic Avenue of the Giants Marathon course.

All courses are USATF Certified. The Marathon is a Boston qualifier. The race starts and finishes at the Dyerville Bridge.

name: 2026 Jingle Bell Run - Los Angeles, CA
description:
Get ready for this year’s Jingle Bell Run, the original festive race for charity brought to you by the Arthritis Foundation. Wear your favorite holiday gear, and let's jingle all the way toward a cure!

Whether you're running, walking, or strolling, bring your friends, family, and coworkers along for the ride. Together, we're spreading joy and making strides towards a brighter future — saying "YES" to life, despite arthritis.

Don't miss out on this special occasion to make a real difference while celebrating four decades of impact with the Jingle Bell Run. Let's lace up, hit the pavement, and jingle our way toward victory over arthritis!

name: 2026 July 4th Virtual Run - Los Angeles
description:
🇺🇸 July 4th Virtual Run 2026

Join runners and walkers from across the country as we celebrate Independence Day with the July 4th Virtual 5K!

Whether you run, walk, jog, or hike, this unique event allows you to participate wherever you choose—on your favorite local route, neighborhood streets, treadmill, track, or vacation destination. Complete your distance anytime on or around July 4th and become part of a nationwide celebration of fitness, freedom, and community.

Your Registration Includes:
✅ Official July 4th Virtual 5K race bib
✅ Personalized commemorative event T-shirt
✅ Your name, hometown, and submitted result printed on the back of the official event shirt
✅ Exclusive digital finisher medal

That's right—this isn't just another race shirt. Participants who submit their results will have their finish time included on the back of the shirt alongside fellow runners and walkers from around the country, creating a one-of-a-kind keepsake of this special event. Already participating in a local July 4th race? Simply submit your official race time from that event and be included in the July 4th Virtual Run results and commemorative finisher shirt alongside runners from across the country.

Not interested in submitting a time? No problem! Your name and location can still be included in the official results listing.

After results are collected, shirts will be produced and mailed directly to participants, making each shirt a unique snapshot of the event and everyone who took part.

Run Anytime. Anywhere. Together.
Celebrate America's 250th birthday spirit by staying active, connecting with others, and creating a lasting memory you'll wear with pride.

Register today and become part of the July 4th Virtual 5K community!

  • Fitness and Health Expo – check out a new product or service from a select group of fitness and health professionals
  • Live music – hear the great sounds of Soul3Sixty playing live on the main stage

name: 2026 Lace'n It Up 5k Run/Walk & Celebration Walk
description:
Lace'n It Up 2026

Join Links for Life to kick off PINKtober!

Join Links for Life to kick off Paint the Town Pink! and Breast Cancer Awareness Month at our Lace'n It Up 5K Run/walk & 1k Celebration Walk on Saturday, October 3, 2026 at the Park at River Walk. This year's event is set to be our biggest yet - featuring special survivor recognition, local vendors, food & drink, music, raffle prizes, and more!
Links for Life raises breast cancer awareness and celebrates local survivors with this fun community event. All net proceeds raised are donated and invested directly into our programs and services. This includes funding diagnostic services such as mammograms, providing wigs and head coverings, and offering nutrition education alongside monthly grocery cards. Links also provides education throughout Kern County on breast health, free support resources and screenings, and the services and resources available to survivors as they navigate their cancer journey. 

 

Thank you to our presenting sponsor:  California Resources Corporation!

name: 2026 Lake Casitas Short Course Championships (Middle School Racer Sign Ups ONLY)
description:
Lake Casitas Short Course Championships is a high school level meet, home of the Ventura County Championship on the beautiful Lake Casitas Cross Country Course where many legends of the sport have run over the last 30 years. The middle school level race will return in 2026. This will be one middle school race with all genders and grades. If registrations are over 200 runners, we may increase to two races.

IF LESS THAN 40 SIGN UPS BY OCTOBER 27TH, WE WILL NOT RUN THE MIDDLE SCHOOL RACE, AND YOU WILL GET A REFUND.

Important race information: 

  1. Course Map Link HERE
  2. Middle School Race Time:  4:15pm
    1. High School races will follow at 4:45pm and 5:15pm. Stick around to watch the "big kids" race!
  3. Awards: Top 30 boys and Top 30 girls will receive medals in the finish chute. 
  4. Cost: $5 goes towards timing with live chip timing and awards. Paid here, on RunSignUp. Parents can register their athletes. 
  5. Directions: 11311 Santa Ana Rd, Ventura, CA 93001. From the main Lake Casitas gate, turn right and drive about 2 miles to the cross country course and boat launch ramp
  6. Parking: NO BUSSES OR CARS WILL BE ALLOWED PAST THE LAST GATE AFTER 3:45pm. If you get to the course early, park in the group campsite area before the last gate. There will be people there to help direct you. Busses should park along the top road before the gate. However, if you park down on the course level you will not be able to leave until the final race is completed for the day and the runners have left the finish area (usually about 6:00pm). It is a ¼ mile walk from the parking area down to the starting line/check in area. After drop off, some bus drivers may prefer to park in the paved lot to the left (south) of the entrance station of the park and then return to pick the team up. There is a $10 charge per vehicle entering the park. Please be sure parents and friends aware of this charge so that they may plan carpools. 
  7. Water: Please provide water for your teams and make sure your runners pre-hydrate. Faucets are available to refill your containers around the Spectator Hill, by the restrooms, and in the camping areas. We will have water in cups at the finish line for athletes. YOU MAY PROVIDE WATER TO ATHLETES DURING THE RACE. 
  8. T-shirts and snack bar: We will have custom Lake Casitas Short Course Championships t-shirts for sale as well as a light snack bar. Halloween themed, get yours before we sell out!

Questions? Contact Garrett at garrett.reynolds@oxnardunion.org 

IF YOU MISS THE SIGN UP WINDOW AND YOU ARRIVE AT THE LAKE WITHOUT SIGN UP, YOUR PARENT/GAURDIAN CAN DO RACE DAY SIGN UP FOR $25.

name: 2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.1.26
description:
2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.1.26. Started in 1978 as the Human Race Triathlon, Cal Tri Newport Dunes is the longest running triathlon in the world operating from the same location. Also started in 1978 was the Ironman World Championship Triathlon Oahu but it moved to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii in 1981. This serves as the Cal Tri Events National Championship Race with registration in the 1500-2000 range.

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon,  RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. Disneyland Park & California Adventure Park. Balboa Island Ferry. Newport Beach.

AIRPORT. John Wayne (SNA)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 60 F / 73 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 65 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% 2026CALTRI discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2026 Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot
description:
The annual Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot celebrates its 11th Year on Thanksgiving Day 2025! Please come be part of the family fun...

REGISTER TODAY and join us at The Palisades Village Green in downtown Pacific Palisades on Thanksgiving morning -- November 27th -- to get your holiday season off to a running start!

(NOTE: The 10K course is a second lap of the 5K course)

10 Things to Know for About The 11th Annual Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot…

  1. Parking is available in and around the Alphabet Streets. Be advised Palisades Village is closed and locked.
  2. If you live near downtown Pacific Palisades, please walk. Less cars makes a better experience for everyone involved
  3. Head directly to Sunset & Swarthmore and look for the Registration Area (US Bank Parking Lot)
  4. Festivities start at 7:00 AM -- the earlier you come, the more fun your day will be
  5. Both the 5K and 10K start at 8:15 AM. The race program will conclude by 11AM
  6. LA Leggers and Fast runners to the front. Slower runners, walkers and strollers please move to the back of the field
  7. Medals and Water will be available at the Finish Line
  8. Dogs allowed this year. Please lean up after your dog (bring bags) and be mindful of other runners.
  9. 5k runners ideally should finish by 9:30 AM. 10K runners by 10:30 AM
  10. Medical Staff will be on-site

name: 2026 San Diego Tri Classic & San Diego 5K
description:
Mark your calendars for the San Diego Triathlon Classic
📅 Saturday, September 12, 2026
📍 San Diego, CA – Liberty Station

🔥 About the Event
Swim. Bike. Run. Celebrate.

Swim the calm waters of San Diego Bay, ride through beautiful Point Loma and Rosecrans National Cemetery, and run past a battleship along the waterfront trails of Liberty Station.
• Scenic, historic course
• Flat Waterfront Run
• Amazing community vibe
• Great swag & post-race celebration
 
🏊‍♂️🚴‍♀️🏃‍♂️ Triathlons Swim/ Bike/ Run

Olympic: 1500M Swim • 40K Bike • 10K Run
Sprint: 500M Swim • 20K Bike • 5K Run
Relay Olympic: 3-person team

description:
The 41st Annual Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary Firecracker Run is one of Santa Cruz's most beloved Fourth of July traditions — and 2026 is unlike any other. Our nation turns 250, and we're throwing the party Santa Cruz style at Harvey West Park on July 4th.

Choose your distance — the legendary 10K Thrill of the Hill, the flat and fast 5K, or the Kids 1K Fun Run. Whether you're chasing a PR or pushing a stroller, there's a race for you. Stick around after for burritos, Izzy's Ice, and awards.

As a 100% volunteer organization, every registration dollar goes directly to local youth through our 2026 beneficiaries and Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary Foundation. We're going for 1,000+ runners this year — grab your crew and be part of history.

name: 2026 Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary Ride - 29th Annual!
description:
The Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary Ride is a 3-day, 200-mile fully supported cycling adventure from the heart of Sonoma wine country, across the Golden Gate Bridge, and down the California coast to Santa Cruz. For 29 years, 100 riders have come together to raise money for kids and families who need it most — over $2,100,000 and counting. This is not a race. It's a community. Limited to 100 riders. Sells out every year.

You don't have to ride to make a difference.

Every dollar donated goes directly to our beneficiaries. 100%. No exceptions. Donate today and be part of 29 years of giving.

Donate Now →

 

The Beneficiaries

Primary Beneficiary

Second Harvest of Santa Cruz County

This year's Rotary Ride is proud to support the first-ever Second Harvest of Santa Cruz County elementary school-based food pantry — a groundbreaking program that brings healthy food directly into schools, so kids have access to nutritious meals not just at school, but to take home to their families.

Food insecurity affects 1 in 4 children in Santa Cruz County. This pantry model meets families where they are — at their child's school — removing the barriers of transportation, stigma, and time that keep so many from accessing the support they need.

Your support through the Rotary Ride is a direct investment in healthier, more food-secure futures for children and families right here in our community.

Santa Cruz Children's Museum of Discovery (MOD)

MOD is a hands-on learning playground inside Capitola Mall where kids explore, create, and discover through 5,000+ square feet of interactive exhibits. Your support helps ensure every child in Santa Cruz County — regardless of income — has access to the wonder and joy of early learning.

 

Common Roots Farm

An urban farm right in the heart of Santa Cruz where people with disabilities grow food, flowers, and lasting friendships alongside their community. Through farm skills training, internships, and education, Common Roots Farm creates meaningful opportunities and genuine belonging for all.

Ride proceeds also support youth in our community through the Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary club's Charities & Grants and High School Scholarship programs.

 

The Route

Day 1

Healdsburg to Rohnert Park

~51 miles

Bus from Santa Cruz to Healdsburg · Fabulous lunch at Rick Hofstetter's riverside chalet on the Russian River · Hotel Centro Sonoma Wine Country, Tapestry by Hilton · Handcrafted hors d'oeuvres & cocktail hour poolside · Catered dinner & festivities

Day 2

Rohnert Park to Pacifica

~88 miles

Early start · Lunch in Sausalito · Cross the majestic Golden Gate Bridge · Ride through San Francisco · Pacifica Lighthouse Hotel at Rockaway Beach · Dinner & celebration at Nick's Restaurant

Day 3

Pacifica to Santa Cruz

~64 miles

Finish Line Party at West Coast Community Bank, 75 River St. · Family & friends all welcome · Guests arrive by 12:30 pm · Riders gather on the Riverwalk at 12:45 pm · Triumphant arrival together at 1:00 pm · Food, music, raffles & auctions

Visit our Route Maps page for downloadable maps and turn-by-turn directions.

 

The Cost

$600

Registration Fee — Everything Included

2 nights premier lodging · All meals & snack stops · Bus transportation to Healdsburg · Sag & first aid support · Happy hours · 2026 commemorative ride T-shirt · Finish Line Party admission

 

$1,000 min

Fundraising Commitment

100% goes directly to our charities. Most riders far exceed the minimum! We make it easy — Fundraising is as Easy as 1, 2, 3 →

 

The History

Jon & Ken's Most Excellent Adventure

In 1997, two guys with bikes started something that would change Santa Cruz forever. 29 years, $2.1 million raised, and thousands of smiles later — here we are.

In 1997, Jon Sisk and Ken Whiting had a simple idea: get on bikes, ride through some beautiful California countryside, and raise a little money for kids who needed it. No grand vision, no corporate sponsor, no marketing team. Just two guys, two bikes, and a community that showed up.

Twenty-nine years later, that simple idea has grown into one of Santa Cruz's most beloved annual traditions — still capped at 100 riders, still run entirely by volunteers, and still selling out every single year.

"No large riding experience is needed — only a love for our beautiful state and a desire to have some fun while supporting youth in our community."

— The Sunrise Rotary Ride spirit, since 1997

The ride winds from the heart of Sonoma wine country in Healdsburg, through the Russian River, Tomales Bay, across the Golden Gate Bridge, and down the California coast back home to Santa Cruz. It's 200 miles of rolling hills, remote seaside roads, and some of the most spectacular scenery our state has to offer.

The ride is exceptionally well supported — all food, premier lodging, medical and sag included. Seasoned riders find great challenges every day. First-timers build their experience and hit personal bests. Everyone crosses the finish line smiling.

 

Why You Will Be Amazed

What makes this ride different

100% volunteer-run

Every dollar donated goes to charity. Every person making it happen does it for the love of it.

All experience levels welcome

Seasoned riders find great challenges. First-timers build confidence and hit personal bests.

 

Fully supported

Sag, meals, lodging, first aid — you focus on the ride. We handle everything else.

Real community

The friendships made on this ride last long after the finish line party wraps up.

Ready to Ride?

Limited to 100 riders. Sells out every year. Sign up today.

Sign Up Now →		 

Can't Ride? Donate!

100% of every donation goes directly to our 2026 beneficiaries.

Donate Now →

name: 2026 SHAY 5K Run/Walk
description:
Spreading Help Around You is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that was founded in 2014 in honor of Shaylyn Anela Pinoliar, who tragically passed away on November 14, 2012. Our mission is to help and support families who have lost a loved one, educate them on the importance of being prepared during such a time of loss, and provide active service to the community.  As well as promoting Pedestrian Safety Awareness. This year, we proudly launched the SHAY Scholarship Program, marking an exciting new chapter in our commitment to supporting education and empowering future leaders. 

Each year, since Shaylyn’s passing, family, friends, and community members gather to honor her memory with an Annual 5k Run/Walk on Thanksgiving morning. Last year, we moved the event to Saturday after Thanksgiving. It was a great success, and we look forward to continuing the tradition this year to honor her memory.

Mark your calendar for July 26, 2026, and get ready for an unforgettable day of racing along the beautiful Solana Beach coastline. Whether you’re a first-time triathlete or a seasoned racer, this event has it all—an exhilarating ocean swim, a scenic bike ride, and a thrilling coastal run to the finish line.


Why You Should Join:
Prime Beach Location: Race in one of Southern California’s most picturesque beach towns
All Levels Welcome: From first-timers to pros, this triathlon is designed for everyone
Exclusive Finisher Medal & Swag: Walk away with a fantastic tech tee and a finisher’s medal
Support a Cause: This race benefits the Life Sports Foundation, helping foster children and at-risk youth live healthier lives through sports and fitness

Sprint Triathlon
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Duathlon
1 mile run - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Aquabike
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike

Sprint Aquathlon
1/4 mile swim - 5K run

Solana Beach 5K

🏊 Ocean Swim with a Twist: Dive into the excitement with our surf-entry ocean swim. Safeguarded by dedicated lifeguards and supportive swim buddies, you'll experience the thrill of the Pacific in a safe and encouraging environment.

🚴 Cycle the Legendary Pacific Coast Highway: Pedal your way along the world-famous Pacific Coast Highway. With its breathtaking views and smooth terrain, the bike course promises both challenge and charm, perfect for setting personal records or simply enjoying the ride.
 
🏃 Run with the Ocean Breeze

🎉 A Finish Line Like No Other: As you cross the finish line, be prepared for a tunnel of high-fives, a cascade of cheers, and an atmosphere brimming with excitement. This is more than just the end of the race; it's a moment of triumph, a celebration of your achievement. Come Celebrate in the 🍺 Seek Beer Co Beer Garden!

Whether you're a seasoned triathlete, a duathlon enthusiast, or an aquabike aficionado, the Solana Beach event is tailored to offer a memorable experience. Embrace the challenge, bask in the coastal splendor, and make memories that will last a lifetime.

Join us for an event that’s more than a race — it's a coastal festival of sport, spirit, and community. Register now to be a part of this unforgettable adventure! 🌟

name: 2026 Vintage Festival 5K Fun Run
description:
Join us as we kick off the 129th Valley of the Moon Vintage Festival with the 5K Fun Run! Kicking off the Daytime Festival, the 5K FUN RUN will take you through vineyards, majestic tree-covered roads, and some of the most scenic areas of downtown Sonoma Valley. Join your family, friends, and neighbors for a fun and active morning, enjoying the fall colors and fresh air of harvest season. After crossing the finish line on the Historic Sonoma Plaza, continue the fun at the Daytime Festival, a time-honored community celebration open to the public. All ages and levels are welcome to register and run (or walk). 

Check out the other Vintage Festival events including the Sonoma Valley Harvest Dinner, Grand Tasting, Grape Stomp Contest and more!

The Valley of the Moon Vintage Festival celebrates the grape bounty, community spirit, and rich history of Sonoma Valley and its annual grape harvest. Presented by the Sonoma Valley Vintners & Growers Alliance and Foundation (Sonoma Valley Wine),  Vintage Festival event proceeds fund the SVVGA Foundation to support charities, grants, and scholarships throughout the Sonoma Valley.

name: 2026 Winters Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest
description:
RACE EVENT DESCRIPTION:

Grab your costume and running shoes and head out to the 2026 Winters Runners and Walkers Club Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest on Sunday, October 25th.  We’re going to have a WICKEDLY good time.  This event is a thriller for the entire family.  In addition to the 1 Mile Adult, 5K Timed & 10K Timed, kids will scream with excitement on the 1 Mile Monster Dash. We will have an individual costume contest, as well as a best group costume contest.  Please join us for Winter’s 7th Annual Halloween Fun Run sponsored by the Winters Runners and Walkers Club. So, if you dare to challenge yourself to a spooky fun time, sign up TODAY and we’ll be waiting for you at the starting line…  Trick-or-Treat!  Happy Halloween!  Nutrishop Electrolyte mix will be available at one of the 5k/10k course water stations.

ONLINE REGISTRATION CLOSING:

Cutoff date for Online Registration is 10/23/26 at 11:59 PM.

REGISTRATION AND PACKET/PU:

Late Registration and Packet Pick-up 10/24/26 (Saturday) in front Hooby's Brewing 9 E. Main Street Winters, Ca 95694 Winters from 10am-4pm & Race Day 10/25/26 (Sunday Race Day) at Rotary Park, corner of Railroad St. and Main Street, Winters, Ca 95694 from 6:30-9:30am.  Sunday Race Day registrations close at the start of each race. 

START TIMES:

8:00am Start 10K (3 Hour Limit after race start time)

8:10am Start 5K (3 Hour Limit after race start time) 

9:30am 1 Mile Kids Monster Dash and 1Mile Adult

REGISTERED PARTICIPANTS:

All Races Finishers receive custom medals. 5K and 10K finishers receives Chip Timing. 1 mile Adult, 5K and 10K Finishers receives a custom medal + Tech Tee + One Free Hooby’s beverage (must be 21 years old for beer) (wine not Included) “ONLY FOR USE ON 10/25 FROM 8:00AM-12:00PM”. 1 Mile Monster Dash Finishers receives a custom medal + Tech Tee.

All Shirts Guaranteed before 10/9/26).  

NOTE:

The 5K & 10K course is open to regular traffic, please observe all traffic laws. Volunteers may be at intersections along the course. The 5K & 10K course will start opening sometime after 10:00 AM, there is a 3 hour timed course Limit for 5K and 10K races after the race start times. The start line will be separated by Pace Markers. 

AWARDS:

Place Awards for 5K&10K Male and Female 1st, 2nd, 3rd place winners. Costume Contest prizes for Individual and Best Group choices 5k / 10K and 1 mile races.

FEES:

1 mile Monster Dash $20.00. 1 mile individual adult/teen $20.00.

5K W/O Shirt 1/26 until 9/11 $30.00. 9/12 until 10/24 $35.00, then $40.00 on Race Day.

5K with Shirt 1/26 until 9/11 $35.00. 9/12 until 10/24 $40.00, then $45.00 on Race Day.

10K W/O Shirt 1/26 until 9/11 $35.00, 9/12 until 10/24 $40.00. then $45.00 on Race Day.

10K with Shirt 1/26 until 9/11 $40.00, 9/12 until 10/24 $45.00. then $50.00 on Race Day.

LODGING:

HOTEL WINTERS  12 Abbey St, Winters, CA 95694 (530) 505-9123 https://www.hotelwinters.com/

FAIRFIELD INN AND SUITES by Marriott 702 Matsumoto Lane, Winters, Ca 95694 (530) 240-3200  https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/sacwi-fairfield-inn-and-suites-sacramento-winters/overview/

ABBEY HOUSE INN   101 Abbey Street Winters, CA 95694 (530) 795-5870  https://abbeyhouseinn.com/ 

DATE:

October 25, 2026

TIME:

8:00 am – 11:30 am

EVENT CATEGORIES:

One Mile Monster Mash (Untimed), One Mile Adult (Untimed) 5K (Timed), 10K (Timed)

WEBSITE:

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Winters/WintersSpooktacularFunRun

FACEBOOK:

https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61561302874455

TIMING AND RESULTS:

TCR TIMING.

FACCHINO PHOTOGRAPHY

name: 2026 XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon & San Diego 5K
description:
Mark your calendars for event #3 of the San Diego Triathlon Series & the Triple Crown of Triathlon
📅 Sunday, October 11, 2026
📍 San Diego, CA – Mission Bay

Proud Host of the 2026 USAT State Championships 🏆
The XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon is proud to once again host the 2026 USA Triathlon State Championships — featuring Age Group, High School, and Club Championships!

Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance / Duathlon / Aquabike / Aquathlon

What This Means for Racers:
🥇 State Champion Titles
Compete for the honor of being crowned California State Champion in your triathlon division (Sprint or International), as well as in High School and Club categories. Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance 
🎽 Coveted State Champion Jersey
1st place winners in each age group, high school, and special category earn the exclusive right to purchase and wear the official California State Championship jersey.
🚩 Club State Championships
All State Championships also serve as the Club State Championships. Clubs (age group & high school) can earn the designation of Top Club in California and win a Club State Champion banner from USA Triathlon.

🎟️ Qualification for Nationals

Sprint Triathlon → Qualifies you for Sprint Nationals
International Triathlon → Qualifies you for Olympic-Distance Nationals
Top 35% of finishers or top 5 athletes (whichever is greater) qualify.
State Championships after June 1, 2026, qualify athletes for both 2026 AND 2027 Nationals.

🎓 High School Championships

Eligibility: Any student currently enrolled in high school and up to six (6) months post-graduation.
Exemption: All athletes who finish a State High School Championship race will automatically qualify for Sprint Nationals, provided they are age 15 or older by December 31, 2026.
🌍 Open to all athletes — residency in California is not required.

Why Race Mission Bay?
Race in San Diego’s iconic Mission Bay, claim your place on the podium, and showcase your achievement in the California State Championship Jersey. 🚴‍♂️🏊‍♀️🏃‍♀️

👉 Don’t miss your moment to race, win, and represent — Register today!

Join us at the birthplace of the sport for the XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon!

2026 is the 38th annual XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon benefitting Life Sports Foundation. San Diego is the Birthplace of Triathlon! In 1974, the first Mission Bay Triathlon was as a run-bike-swim-run event on Fiesta Island by the San Diego Track Club. Every year competitors from around the country and from around the world, come to Mission Bay to celebrate the birthplace triathlon.  We invite you to become part of this wonderful legacy event and become part of history!

The event offers races for adults and kids,  from complete beginners to seasoned Professionals. There are many different races going on simultaneously, and while a traditional Triathlon is Swim / Bike / Run, KOZ Events, the organizer of the San Diego Triathlon Series,  offers more of a Multisport Race. Our race is very inclusive and we make triathlon accessible to as many people as possible. We have the traditional Swim/bike/ Run Triathlon but we offer so much more. If you do not like swimming, we have the Duathlon which is a Run/ Bike/ Run, if you don’t want to bike then choose the Aquathlon Swim / Run, or if you don’t want to run choose the Aquabike  Swim/Bike. We even have a Mini Distance Triathlon for beginners that want to try out the sport. We even offer free training groups every week to help people get started, train, and get connected to the San Diego Triathlon Community.

Our race is very inclusive and we make triathlon accessible to as many people as possible. We have the traditional Swim/bike/ Run Triathlon but we offer so much more. If you do not like swimming, we have the Duathlon which is a Run/ Bike/ Run, if you don’t want to bike then choose the Aquathlon Swim / Run, or if you don’t want to run choose the Aquabike  Swim/Bike. We even have a Mini Distance Triathlon for beginners that want to try out the sport. We even offer free training groups every week to help people get started, train, and get connected to the San Diego Triathlon Community.

name: 2026 YMCA Run in the Parks 5K & Kid's Race
description:
The Annual Laguna Niguel Family YMCA Run in the Parks is back! We are excited to celebrate the 47th year of this beloved community and family tradition in honor of Independence Day. This year, participants can choose between a 5K run and a Kids Run. Every race entry directly benefits the YMCA’s scholarship fund, which helps ensure access to YMCA programs for individuals and families most in need throughout our community. Thanks to the generosity of our supporters and events like this one, the Y continues to provide critical scholarships and remain a place of support, connection, and opportunity for all. The Y is here for you, for the community, and for good.

Register by 6/15/26 to guarantee your race shirt size. All registration after this date will be first come first serve on available race shirt sizes.

Making it's big return this year is the Diaper Dash - a fun-filled race designed just for our youngest runners! Children ages 3 and under can crawl, toddle, or run their way to the finish line in a 25-foot or 50-foot dash while family and friends cheer them on. Parents are welcome to run alongside their little ones, and every participant will receive a special medal sticker to celebrate their big accomplishment. Registration is just $5 per child. Join us at the Laguna Niguel Family YMCA and make your little one's first race a memorable one!

name: 2027 Granfondo San Diego
description:
San Diego's Favorite Cycling Event! - Voted Best GranFondo in America & Top 10 Best Century Ride in the USA

Welcome to the ultimate celebration of cycling, flavor, and the breathtaking San Diego waterfront! Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey at the Southern California-Italian fusion extravaganza – our Gran Fondo awaits!
More Than a Century Ride

🚴 Routes: Choose Your Path, Seize Your Glory! Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or a weekend warrior, our event caters to all levels. Pick your challenge from our diverse route options: 100, 60, or 35 miles. As you pedal through the stunning landscapes, know that every mile brings you closer to the full GranFondo experience!

🏅 Swag: Earn Your Medal, Revel in Victory! Cross the finish line triumphantly, and the cheers of the crowd will resonate with your achievement. Your reward? A well-deserved medal, the tangible proof of your cycling prowess. But the celebration doesn't stop there – brace yourself for the Fantastic Finish extravaganza!

🎉 Fantastic Finish Celebration – Unleash the Festivities! Immerse yourself in the post-ride revelry at our Fantastic Finish Celebration! Live music will set the stage for your triumph, and the bike valet ensures your trusty steed is taken care of. Delight your taste buds at the Italian Pasta Fest and quench your thirst at the Beer Garden – the perfect way to relish your victory!

🌇 SoCal Meets Italy – A Fusion of Culture and Cycling! Picture this: the vibrant energy of Southern California seamlessly blending with the charm of Italy against the backdrop of San Diego's picturesque waterfront. It's a two-day festival that goes beyond cycling – it's an immersion into a world where passion for food, fitness, and community collide.

🏞️ Downtown San Diego – The Perfect Host! Our event unfolds in the heart of beautiful Downtown San Diego. The cityscape adds an urban flair to your cycling adventure, making every turn and twist of the route an exploration of San Diego's charm.

🚵‍♂️ Gran Fondo Highlights: Challenging Routes & Exciting Competitions! Feel the rush as you tackle challenging and inspiring routes that cater to the cyclist in you. Engage in the thrill of timed King and Queen of the Mountain competitions – an opportunity to showcase your climbing prowess. The Bike & Fitness Expo awaits, where you can explore the latest trends and innovations in the cycling world.

🍝 Italian Feast – Savor the Flavorful Finale! Cap off your cycling odyssey with an Italian Feast at the Finish. Indulge in delectable dishes that celebrate the essence of Italy, bringing a delicious conclusion to your GranFondo adventure.
 Presenting Sponsor

🚀 Join Us for an Epic Experience! Are you ready to be part of a cycling spectacle like no other? Embrace the challenge, savor the flavor, and revel in the community spirit at our GranFondo. Secure your spot today and gear up for a weekend of cycling, festivities, and memories that will last a lifetime! 🚴🍝🎉

name: 2027 SFA Los Angeles Marathon Team
description:
Sarcoma Foundation of America (SFA) is a proud partner of the 2027 Los Angeles Marathon Weekend. The ASICS Los Angeles Marathon weekend takes place March 6 - 7, 2027.  The race weekend includes a 2-day Lifestyle Expo at the iconic Dodger Stadium, and the LA 5K and LA Kids Run on Saturday, followed by the Charity Half Marathon and ASICS Los Angeles Marathon on Sunday.

SFA invites you to join our marathon team. When you participate, you are choosing to join hundreds of others who want to make a difference for sarcoma patients and their families. Funds raised through our race team drive innovative research for sarcoma. 

Secure access to your guaranteed race entry* today!

Runners seeking to join the 2027 Los Angeles Marathon SFA race team will receive the following perks:

  • Guaranteed entry 
  • Custom SFA marathon shirt
  • Personal fundraising page
  • Dedicated staff to support fundraising
  • Complimentary registration
  • Note: Runners must commit to a minimum personal fundraising goal:
    • Marathon ($750) 
    • 5K ($250)

Your support will go beyond the finish line when you join our community of teammates from across the country as you train for this incredible event.  Our SFA Team is here to provide support every step of the way!  

Our Marathon Team’s Impact

SFA Marathon Runners have raised over $130,000 to support sarcoma research. We hope to raise an additional $10,000 through the 2027 Los Angeles Marathon Weekend, to continue to support those impacted by sarcoma. 

For additional information, please contact Annie Blake at ablake@curesarcoma.org.  

Together we can find a cure!

description:

Join us this Independence Day 🇺🇸 for a powerful morning of community 🤝, celebration 🎉, and giving back at the 2nd Annual San Diego 4th of July 5K & 10K , held in honor of Ethan Hamilton.

name: 310K Run/walk powered by Leslie Cohen Law
description:
2025 Results at this link

https://www.racefoxresults.com/leslie-cohen-law-5k 

Leslie Cohen Law PC is once again proud to be hosting the 310K Run/Walk, a 5K event that raises funds for the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project. Now in its 15th year, the 310K is a community-driven race that takes place right on the beach in Santa Monica, drawing many returning runners and walkers year after year. The event welcomes participants of all paces—whether you're running to set a new personal record or walking with friends to support a great cause. With in-person and virtual options, the 310K offers a meaningful way to give back while enjoying one of the most scenic race routes in beautiful LA.

 

For the 2nd year in a row, we return to the California Incline!

This year, the 310K will take place on Sunday, November 22nd—a great way to kick off Thanksgiving week with purpose and community spirit.

Our new location last year got such rave reviews that we need to make it a tradition. We will once again start at the iconic Santa Monica Pier and run down and then back up the California Incline.

Our Beneficiary

Proceeds from the 310K support the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project (DAP), which provides free bankruptcy-related legal services to individuals and families across Greater Los Angeles. Through clinics, educational workshops, and one-on-one legal representation, DAP helps clients understand their rights, navigate the legal system, and find paths toward financial stability. DAP is part of Public Counsel, the largest pro bono legal aid organization in the United States. Leslie Cohen Law PC received the James King Community Service Award from Public Counsel in 2016 in recognition of the impact of the 310K.

name: 33rd YCMA Stair Climb & Urban Hike
description:
At 1,005 feet, the U.S. Bank Tower is home to the tallest stairwell west of the Mississippi. During the Climb for Los Angeles, 4,000 participants race or walk up 1,664 steps (75 stories) then take the elevator down to Maquire Gardens where the Block Part awaits - complete with food, activities, music, and beer garden.

If sightseeing from the ground is more your style, begin and end at the same location with our Urban Hike option, passing MOCA, The Broad, Disney Concert Hall, The Grand LA, and more along the way.
 
Registration fees

name: 3rd Annual Santa’s Reindeer Run - 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
🎅🏃‍♀️ 3rd Annual Santa Reindeer Run 🦌✨
Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25
Sunday, December 20, 2026 

Get ready to jingle all the way at the 2nd Annual Santa Reindeer Run! Join us at beautiful Bolsa Chica State Beach for a festive morning of holiday vibes, ocean views, and Santa Claus himself! Whether you’re here to race, stroll, or rock your favorite holiday outfit, this is the perfect way to kick off the season.

All finishers receive a festive medal,  free race-day photos, and yummy finish-line treats. Plus, dress up for our Holiday Costume Contest for a chance to win extra prizes and epic bragging rights! 🎄🎁

 
🎅 Special Appearance by Santa!
Santa will be waiting at the start and finish lines for photos, hugs, and high-fives. Be sure to grab your holiday photo with Santa! 📸

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
📍 Location: Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25

6:45 AM — Bib Pick-Up & Same-Day Registration Opens
7:30 AM — Half Marathon Start
8:30 AM — 5K & 10K Start

9:00 AM - Family 1- Miler

9:30 AM- Kids 200 yard Dash

9:45 AM - Santa PAWS Doggie Parade
 
 
⏱️ Timing & Awards
✔️ Chip-Timed Race with live results
🏅 Finisher Medals for All Participants
📸 Free Race-Day Photos
🥇 Overall & Age Group Awards for the top 3 men & women in each distance

Awards Ceremony Times:


🚗 Parking & Drop-Off
Parking Fee: $15 per vehicle — State Park accepts card only
Main Entrance: 17851 Pacific Coast Highway, Huntington Beach, CA 92649 (gate opens at 6:00 AM)
Drive west after entering the main gate until you reach Lot 25 — the last lot on the right, near Warner Avenue & PCH
Drop-Off Option: Get dropped off at Warner & PCH, just steps from Lot 25
Free Public Parking: Available in Sunset Beach behind Jack in the Box (17243 Pacific Coast Highway)
Tip: Carpooling highly encouraged!
 

 ✨ Join the Holiday Magic!
Lace up, grab your Santa hat, and jingle through the miles at Bolsa Chica State Beach! The Santa Reindeer Run is the ultimate way to celebrate the season with friends, family, and festive fun.

🔗 Register today at CaliFlowRuns.com

name: 3rd Annual TRANS PRIDE 5K – 10K, Picnic, Resource Fair
description:
🏃🏼‍♀️🏃🏽🏃‍♂️‍➡️ 🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️

🏳️‍⚧️ We’re back for our 3rd year! 🏳️‍⚧️

 

Don’t miss this year’s 3rd Annual Trans Pride 5K/10K in Los Angeles - or join virtually from anywhere!

RUN / WALK / PICNIC / RESOURCES / FOOD TRUCKS / RAFFLE PRIZES

Our joy is revolutionary, so let’s come together for a day of movement, resource sharing, fundraising, and more! ALL allies and LGBTQ are welcome and wanted! Our community energy is powerful and uplifting and we need each other more than ever so sign up early and bring a friend! 

🎉 NEW - introducing the -  TRANS JOY BUNDLE    

A special collaboration between Angel City Football Club (ACFC) and the Trans Pride 5K/10K celebrating trans athletes, trans visibility, and community.

WHAT'S IN THE BUNDLE?

🏳️‍⚧️ Trans Pride 5K or 10K - Registration

⚽ Angel City FC's Pride Match - Ticket

🎉 Enjoy Fan Fest before the match

🎟️ Dedicated section for TP5K

☕ Entered to win TP5K race day giveaways, merch, and coffee

🤑 Save $20 while supporting programs that directly benefit trans communities. The Trans Joy Bundle also includes discounted pricing for your TP5K/10K Registration and ticket to the ACFC Pride Match.

AND... A CHANCE TO BE ON THE FIELD FOR THE FLAG PRESENTATION

🏳️‍⚧️ All Trans Joy Bundle ticket holders will be entered to win a spot to join us on the pitch for the Angel City FC Center Flag presentation.

30 winners will be selected at random. 

Drawing #1: June 28
Drawing #2: July 19

Purchase through July 25.

 

AT THE Trans Pride 5K ALL are welcome and wanted!

☀️ Open to all ages and skill levels

☀️ LGBTQIA+ individuals and allies

☀️ Family-friendly

Not into the fun run part? That’s okay! There will also be a Trans Resource Exchange, Picnic, and Raffle to raise funds for our Finish Line Grant (learn more below)

WHEN: Sunday, July 26th, 2026 ☀️

WHERE: In person - Crystal Springs Picnic Area - Pettigrew Field Griffith Park - 4730 Crystal Springs Dr. 🌈

Don’t live in LA? Grab a few friends and register for the virtual run! Head outside and enjoy moving your body for a cause. Take pictures and post and be sure to tag @transpride5K to spread the word.

Finish Line Grant: ☀️SUBMIT HERE☀️ Open for submission until July 3! We are seeking talented artists and athletes who inspire, create, and uplift our community. One individual will receive the Finish Line Grant to assist them in their endeavours directed towards making a lasting impact on our Trans community and beyond. 🌷 🤩 

LOOKING FORWARD TO SEEING YOU THERE!

🏃🏼‍♀️🏃🏽🏃‍♂️‍➡️ 🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️

🏳️‍⚧️ We’re back for our 3rd year! 🏳️‍⚧️

 

Don’t miss this year’s 3rd Annual Trans Pride 5K/10K in Los Angeles - or join virtually from anywhere!

RUN / WALK / PICNIC / RESOURCES / FOOD TRUCKS / RAFFLE PRIZES

Our joy is revolutionary, so let’s come together for a day of movement, resource sharing, fundraising, and more! ALL allies and LGBTQ are welcome and wanted! Our community energy is powerful and uplifting and we need each other more than ever so sign up early and bring a friend! 

🎉 NEW - introducing the -  TRANS JOY BUNDLE    

A special collaboration between Angel City Football Club (ACFC) and the Trans Pride 5K/10K celebrating trans athletes, trans visibility, and community.

WHAT'S IN THE BUNDLE?

🏳️‍⚧️ Trans Pride 5K or 10K - Registration

⚽ Angel City FC's Pride Match - Ticket

🎉 Enjoy Fan Fest before the match

🎟️ Dedicated section for TP5K

☕ Entered to win TP5K race day giveaways, merch, and coffee

🤑 Save $20 while supporting programs that directly benefit trans communities. The Trans Joy Bundle also includes discounted pricing for your TP5K/10K Registration and ticket to the ACFC Pride Match.

AND... A CHANCE TO BE ON THE FIELD FOR THE FLAG PRESENTATION

🏳️‍⚧️ All Trans Joy Bundle ticket holders will be entered to win a spot to join us on the pitch for the Angel City FC Center Flag presentation.

30 winners will be selected at random. 

Drawing #1: June 28
Drawing #2: July 19

Purchase through July 25.

 

AT THE Trans Pride 5K ALL are welcome and wanted!

☀️ Open to all ages and skill levels

☀️ LGBTQIA+ individuals and allies

☀️ Family-friendly

Not into the fun run part? That’s okay! There will also be a Trans Resource Exchange, Picnic, and Raffle to raise funds for our Finish Line Grant (learn more below)

WHEN: Sunday, July 26th, 2026 ☀️

WHERE: In person - Crystal Springs Picnic Area - Pettigrew Field Griffith Park - 4730 Crystal Springs Dr. 🌈

Don’t live in LA? Grab a few friends and register for the virtual run! Head outside and enjoy moving your body for a cause. Take pictures and post and be sure to tag @transpride5K to spread the word.

Finish Line Grant: ☀️SUBMIT HERE☀️ Open for submission until July 3! We are seeking talented artists and athletes who inspire, create, and uplift our community. One individual will receive the Finish Line Grant to assist them in their endeavours directed towards making a lasting impact on our Trans community and beyond. 🌷 🤩 

LOOKING FORWARD TO SEEING YOU THERE!

name: 40th Annual Tinsel Triathlon
description:
Tinsel Triathlon & 5K
Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon
As one of the oldest and largest independently owned reverse sprint pool triathlons on the West Coast, it is certainly an ideal end of the season endurance race.  The 35 year old event truly can be the perfect venue for Triathletes of all levels.  For first timers who have always wanted to be triathletes the course is well defined, attainable and loaded with helpful volunteers.  We are also an awesome setting for the seasoned triathlete. The course layout lets you push yourself hard for a solid workout.  What better way to get your game on ... Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon!

The Tinsel is a Sunday Triathlon run on a usually sunny, yet crisp, Southern California day with all roads closed and the coffee hot.  The 5K run takes place in a scenic, calm area of West Hemet, California in Riverside County.   Known as a "flat & fast" course, the 12 mile bike ride gives the rider a feeling of being on the country roadside.  The race ends in the 25 meter heated pool at West Valley High School, triathletes will swim 150 meters (up & back 6 times) to the finish line where you receive a unique Tinsel finisher medal.  The awards ceremony follows immediately and the bling is top shelf!

name: 44th Annual Providence Saint John's Health Center Brentwood Run
description:
🏃‍♀️ Join Us for the 44th Annual Brentwood Run 🏃‍♂️

Be part of a beloved Brentwood tradition as the 44th Annual Brentwood Run returns to San Vicente Blvd! Established in 1977, The Brentwood Run is Los Angeles' oldest road race.

This historic race features an out and back course with a slight incline in the second half. It is considered a easy/fast and enjoyable run or walk course for participants of all levels. Beyond the race, enjoy a huge expo with local vendors and a dedicated kids area. Best of all, your participation benefits the Brentwood Library and supports the local community!

name: 49th Annual Manhattan Beach 10K
description: Come join us for the 49th annual Manhattan Beach 10K on Saturday, October 3, 2026 at 7:30 am. Experience one of the most scenic 10K courses in the South Bay with live music and a post-race expo at the finish line! 4,000 runners will take to the streets for this course through downtown and residential Manhattan Beach, finishing at the Manhattan Beach Pier. Awards given to top 10 in age group and team categories with prize money awarded to overall winners.

name: 4th Annual 5k Honor and Remember Walk/Run
description:
This is a 5k walk-run race for all ages. It is at Central Park in Rancho Cucamonga, October 3, 2026, with a registration sign in at 7 am. Start of race is 8:30 am. Award medals will be issued as well as "On the Spot" gift cards.

This race is hosted by Legends Live Forever Foundation in honor of LCPL Dylan Merola who was KIA Kabul, Afghanistan August 26, 2021, during the humanitarian efforts of Operation Freedom. The proceeds for this event go strictly to the foundation's scholarship program as Dylan wanted to attend college and further his education.

name: 50th Annual Holiday Run and Walk for Health
description:
We are very excited to bring back the Kiwanis Holiday run. This year will be the 50th running of this event. We have partnered with Rotary Club of the Delta to make sure we bring a high-quality event. We have worked to provide a better course, and lots of medals. We also hope our school’s challenge will be bigger than ever. There will be a medal to the top five runners in every age category, as well as cash prizes and trophies to our top three High school, middle school, and elementary schools. 

Many people have put a lot of work together to make this event happen, none more important than former race director Paul Schorr.

We hope you join us for the 50th Annual – Kiwanis/ Rotary – Paul Schorr Memorial Holiday Run and walk for health. Do it for the Health of It!

description:
Join the 5AM Crew for a Group Hike starting at 5PM at the Mt. Baldy 5000 for a fun way to tackle the course. A group leader will lead you on this non-competitive group hike.

name: 5K Entry Hot Dog Lemonade with or without Pet
description:
The Hot Dog & Lemonade 5K is a one-of-a-kind experience where running, dogs, and summer vibes come together in a fun and energetic atmosphere. Inspired by the relaxed California lifestyle, this pet-friendly 5K combines fitness, community, music, and a fresh social vibe perfect for enjoying with your dog, friends, or family.

More than just a race, Hot Dog & Lemonade 5K is designed to create memorable experiences for dog lovers and runners of all levels. Participants will enjoy themed areas, official race photography, exclusive merchandise, and a collectible finisher medal inspired by the classic American hot dog and lemonade stand concept.

Whether you run with your dog or on your own, this event celebrates fun, community, and the energy of summertime in a unique and unforgettable way.

name: 6th Annual Viva Frida 50 Mile Challenge
description:
“Viva Frida” 50-Mile Challenge- A Journey of Strength, Art, and Self-Love

This July, take on the “Viva Frida” 50-Mile Challenge, a tribute to the bold, brilliant, and resilient spirit of Frida Kahlo. Known for transforming pain into art and embracing her true self with fearless authenticity, Frida continues to inspire generations to rise above, express freely, and walk through life with courage.
 
Why 50 Miles?
Every mile symbolizes Frida’s powerful voice, vibrant creativity, and unbreakable strength. Whether you walk, run, bike, or move in your own way—let each mile reflect your journey of self-expression, healing, and empowerment.
Challenge Dates:
July 1 – July 31, 2026
How to Join:
1. Register online 
2. Choose your activity (walk, run, jog, hike) —mix it up!
3. Track your miles throughout the month.
4. Share your progress on social media using #VivaFridaChallenge
5. Complete your 50 miles and receive your commemorative medal, tech-tee and waterproof sticker! 
Bonus:
Wear bold colors, flowers in your hair, or anything inspired by Frida’s iconic style as you complete your miles. Dedicate your challenge to a cause, a personal transformation, or to reclaiming your power—just as Frida did through every brushstroke.
Let’s celebrate her legacy by moving with intention, loving fiercely, and living colorfully.
 
Viva la vida. Viva Frida!

name: 8th Annual KIWANIS  RESOLUTION 5K Run/Walk, and 10K Run/Walk
description:
KIWANIS Resolution Races are in-person runs at Mountain View Shoreline Park! We’ve both a 5K and 10K event to choose from, with Digital  Chip timing for both.

 

This year we are again running on Saturday January 3 to give  holiday travelers a chance to participate too. Start the new year out with a great run on a great day on the Bayland trails!. It's a beautiful location with free parking, great race, with post-race snacks and lots of awards.

 

Please note that no dogs or pets are allowed in Shoreline Park.

 

We will again have a 1K Kids run this year for ages 1-10 and this year all 1K participants will also receive a race T shirt. Plan on bringing all kids and the neighbors too! 

 

Race Day is Jan 3, 2026. The 10K starts at 10:00 AM and the 5K starts at 10:15 AM. All inside Mountain View Shoreline Park. Parking is free for all.  

 

All participants who register by December 15 will receive a specially designed race T-shirt.

 

Also please upload photos from your race experience to this website. We'd love to share your experience of the race. 

 

You may visit our permanent website WSJKrun.org for information about past races and Kiwanis current charitable work. Or Click HERE for more info about Kiwanis of West San Jose and/or HERE for specific programs information.

name: 8th Annual Roger’s Run & Walk June 20, 2026                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        FREE Signups Below Sponsored By Surgical Artistry & Modesto Moves
description:
Roger's Race (Walk & Run 5K) is a free event open to the public.  It is a partnered event put on by Modesto Moves Training Team and Faith Home Adult & Teen Challenge (FHTC) located at 6643 Faith Home Road, Ceres.   This is a fun run; however, a timing clock and timing chips will be used this year.  Awards given for overall 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers.  Sponsored by Surgical Artistry and presented by Modesto Moves Training Team, together providing race guidance and runners/walkers to the event.  We also donate 100% of all proceeds collected by the Moves organization to Faith Home Teen Challenge.  FHTC is a faith based recovery program reaching out to men to show them how to get their lives back through a faith based concept.   Whether you are faith based or not, there is a positive impact to the local community with the work that is being done at FHTC.  Roger's Run was a dream of Roger Williams, a Modesto Moves walker, who passed away suddenly in July of 2017.  Modesto Moves, along with FHTC, made the dream a reality in 2018.  Roger's Run is his legacy to FHTC where he worked until the time of his death.    

The event will include a pancake breakfast provided by FHTC (suggested $5/person donation), drawing prizes (no cost, bib number is your entry) and raffle prizes (tickets sold by Modesto Moves).

name: 8th Annual Super Bulldog Jog 5K Run/Walk
description:
The Bulldog Jog is a 5K run/walk for all ages.  Course will begin and end inside the school, however the majority of the 5K will run through our surrounding community residential streets.  Located exclusively on the school’s campus, will also be the “Health Fair," which will include “FREE” pre- and post-run festivities (beginning at 7am) featuring a variety of entertainment, as well as health and fitness information.  This event will offer not only finisher medals, shirts, and timed bib at a low cost to those who register, but also fun activities for the whole family at the Health Fair.

-----------------------------------------------------

El Bulldog Jog es una carrera/caminata de 5 km para todas las edades. El recorrido comenzará y terminará dentro de la escuela; sin embargo, la mayor parte de la carrera se realizará por las calles residenciales de nuestra comunidad circundante. Ubicada exclusivamente en el campus de la escuela, también se realizará la "Feria de la Salud", que incluirá actividades gratuitas antes y después de la carrera (a partir de las 7:00 a. m.) con una variedad de entretenimiento, así como información sobre salud y ejercicio. Este evento no solo ofrecerá medallas, camisetas y dorsales cronometrados a bajo costo para quienes se inscriban, sino también actividades divertidas para toda la familia en la Feria de la Salud.

name: 9/11 Heroes Run - San Diego, California
description:
The 9/11 Heroes Run 5K welcomes runners, ruckers, and walkers of all ages and fitness levels to honor the heroes of 9/11 and those who've served our nations since. We activate & unite communities and empower local veterans, active duty, first responders, and families of the fallen.

TMF is proud to partner with GORUCK again with rucking divisions at every run. Rucking is a sport based on special forces training in which participants walk or run while carrying weighted rucksacks. All participants registered for the GORUCK division will earn this year's exclusive TMF GORUCK patch. Learn more about GORUCK here.

name: 9/11 Run to Remember
description:
Join us for the 9/11 Run to Remember at the California 9/11 Memorial in Clovis, California— the largest permanent 9/11 memorial outside of New York City.

This meaningful community event honors the 2,977 lives lost on September 11, 2001, including civilians, first responders, and military personnel. More than a race, this is a morning of remembrance, unity, patriotism, and reflection.

Whether you run the 5K or walk the 1 Mile course, every step helps ensure we never forget.

name: A Merry Christmas Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎅 🎄  Join the Christmas Run! 🎄 🎅
Jingle All the Way: A Merry Christmas Run!" is a delightful Holiday run that reminds us of the true essence of Christmas – spreading love, giving selflessly, and cherishing the joy of togetherness with family, friends, and even strangers, all while getting a run in before the Christmas festivities! 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)
