name: A Merry Christmas Run 5K/10K/13.1 SAN FRANCISCO
description:
🎅 🎄  Join the Christmas Run! 🎄 🎅
Jingle All the Way: A Merry Christmas Run!" is a delightful Holiday run that reminds us of the true essence of Christmas – spreading love, giving selflessly, and cherishing the joy of togetherness with family, friends, and even strangers, all while getting a run in before the Christmas festivities! 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/

- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events

name: A Snail's Pace x ASICS Sunset Mile
description:
Join us for the second event in our Sunset series - The Sunset Mile!

Music, food and running! Celebrate a night under the lights with us by running 4 laps on the track! This event is open to all ability levels. 

All participants will receive a post race meal ticket for our food truck partner, Birreria y Tacos Doña Betty. Finishers will also receive a commemorative race medal, and winners of each heat will get a special surprise.

ASICS will have spikes and super shoes for you to demo during the race so you can hit your fastest time! 

Heats will be seeded based on expected finish times, and will be announced the day before the event. Please estimate as close to your current fitness as possible. BE HONEST WITH YOUR PROJECTED TIME!

Space is limited and will sell out. 

**Race director reserves the right to review and revoke winning times.

name: A Snail's Pace x Saucony Sunset Relays
description:
Music, food and running! Celebrate a night under the lights with your running crew, racing nothing but RELAYS all night - 4x100, 4x200, 4x400, 4x800, 4x1600 and the distance medley relay (AKA DMR - 1200m, 400m, 800m, 1600m). This event is open to all ability levels. 

4x100m - 1 heat

4x200m - 1 heat

4x400m - 5 heats

4x800m - 2 heats

4x1600m - 1 heat

DMR - 3 heats

All participants will receive a post race meal ticket for our food truck partner, Birreria y Tacos Doña Betty. Finishers will also receive a commemorative race medal, and winners of each heat will get a special surprise.

Saucony will have the latest Endorphin line shoes for you to demo during the race so you can hit your fastest time! 

Heats will be seeded based on expected finish times, and will be announced closer to race day. Once heats are set, we are unable to move your start time. If you miss you call time, we cannot place you in a later heat. Please check in with the clerk of the course no later than 45 minutes before your heat time. Please estimate as close to your current fitness as possible. 

Space is limited and will sell out. 

**Race director reserves the right to review and revoke winning times.

name: Abbot Kinney One
description:
The Abbot Kinney One, presented by On & Electrolit, and produced by the Venice Run Club. 

We are thrilled to announce the 3rd annual Abbot Kinney One race. This USATF-certified one-mile race will occur on Abbot Kinney Boulevard in Venice, California! This race is a unique opportunity for runners of all levels to challenge themselves, enjoy the beautiful scenery, and experience the vibrant culture of Venice.

The Abbot Kinney One will be held on June 28th, 2026.  The full schedule of events is as follows:

  • 8:00am: Friends and Family Mile (Non competive, walk, strollers, jog)
  • 8:15am: 6 yrs - 11 yrs Mile 
  • 8:30am: First Responders Mile 
  • 8:40am: 12 yrs - 14 yrs Boys & Girls (Jr. High and High School will run together)
  • 8:40am: 14 yrs - 18 yrs Boys & Girls (Jr. High and High School will run together)
  • 8:50am: Men's Masters Mile (40 yrs & older) 
  • 9:00am: Women's Masters Mile (40 yrs & older) 
  • 9:10am: Men's Open Mile 
  • 9:20am: Women's Open Mile
  • 9:35am: Men's Elite Mile (Time submission or by Invitation)
  • 9:40am: Women's Elite Mile (Time Submission or by Invitation)
  • 9:50am: Dog Mile

Registration

All registrants will receive the following:

  • Official bib number for the race
  • Chip timed results
  • Free race photos
  • Race Medal
  • More giveaways to be announced

First Responders Mile & Elite Mile 

To apply for entry into these heats, email proof of qualification to our race director: Justin Shields l justin@48forchange.org

Pre-Race

Packet pick up will take place at the On LA Store Cabana - 1426 Abbot Kinney Blvd, Venice, CA 90291. 

  • Saturday, June 27: 10AM – 4PM:

Please follow the Abbot Kinney One event page on Instagram to stay current with key event announcements.

name: Advanced Sailing August 22 US Sailing 101
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.  

**A minimum of 6 hours of sail time at the Intermediate level (Catalina Capri 22) is required post Intermediate sailing course. 

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential, and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through BoatU.S.. Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended. The course will be held rain or shine, so please dress accordingly for weather conditions.

name: Adventure Run
description:
Get ready for a fun-filled morning of fitness, adventure, and family time at the Elevated Athletics Kids Adventure Run! Designed for children ages 2.5–11, this exciting event features a .67-mile loop course packed with interactive obstacle stations that keep kids moving, laughing, and challenged every step of the way.

Along the course, participants will tackle a variety of fun obstacles, including:

Crawling challenges
Hill climbs
Rope pulls
Balance and agility stations
And many more surprise obstacles designed for all skill levels!


The Adventure Run is not a race — it’s an experience focused on building confidence, encouraging movement, and creating positive outdoor memories. Parents are encouraged to join their children on the course, making it a perfect opportunity for family fitness and teamwork.

Whether your child is running, climbing, crawling, or cheering on friends, the event is all about staying active, having fun, and enjoying the outdoors together. Come join us for an unforgettable morning of adventure at Tahoe Paradise Park!

name: AFNA Walk & Run - SF Bay Area
description:
Join us for a family-friendly Walk & Run event in the beautiful Almaden Lake in San Jose, CA. The event starts and finishes at the Almaden Lake Park and runs along the adjacent creek trails on trail and bike paths. We will have a small celebration at the finish line area. We will have both 5k and 10k races in this event.

About Assam Foundation of North America (AFNA):

Assam Foundation of North America, Inc (AFNA) is a publicly supported non-profit organization serving since 1982, under section 509(a) of the Internal Revenue Code with tax exemption under section 501(c)(3) with Tax ID. #: 61-0994468.

description:

The event will be held, Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026 Aim High at Coyote Valley Sporting Clays in Morgan Hill, CA, and includes a 20-station clay shoot competition, multiple raffles for firearms and other prizes, as well as breakfast and lunch.

name: Akash Wine Run 5k
description:
THIS EVENT WILL SELL OUT! SIGN UP TODAY!

Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, February 28, 2027 for an exciting annual event that features Akash Winery & Vineyards. name: Alameda Island Running Festival
description:
We are back for another year of racing with our start and end on Alameda Point. The race start and finish will be back at City Hall west with the Health and Wellness expo presented by Alameda Health Systems on the grass area 
As with all of our events, a portion of our registrations will be donated to our Beneficiary Alameda Education Foundation. you can read more about them from our direct links below:
  • Alameda Education Foundation: https://alamedaeducationfoundation.org/
 
Race Weekend Packet Pick Up:
  • Thursday and Friday September 17th and 18th : Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St, Alameda, Ca. 94501
    • 10:00am - 6:00pm * we encourage you to get your BIB and shirt early and sleep in race morning! 
  • Saturday 1:00pm - 5:00pm Race Start/Finish Expo 950 West Mall, Alameda, ca 94501
  • Sunday: 6:30am - 8:15am Race Start/Finish Expo 950 West Mall, Alameda, Ca. 94501
 
Race Events and Schedule: 
  • Saturday: 
    • Hella Bae Running 5k and 1 Mile Shake-out run presented by Skechers : 1:00pm
    • Yoga on the grass presented by Breathing Room Studio
  • Sunday 
    • Half Marathon: 7:30am
    • 10K: 8:00am 
    • 5k Presented by Penumbra: 8:15am
    • Family Fun Run: 10:00am
 
Race Timing and Restrictions:

the Island Running Festival is a chip-timed event.  Participants can run, jog or walk the entire course. 
Jogging strollers are permitted but are asked to start in the back of the pack.  Wheelchair athletes are permitted but due to safety concerns and street closure restrictions cannot travel faster than the fastest runner.   No bikes, scooters, skateboards or other wheeled vehicles are allowed. Dogs are not allowed on our race courses.  We love dogs, but there are those who are not so comfortable around them and there are also dogs that are uncomfortable around hundreds of other people, therefore NO DOGS ALLOWED on the course or at the finish line.

We will provide bike parking for those of you that prefer to bike to the event. See the race website for more details. 

 

Medical and Water Stops:

We will have a dedicated paramedics team on site and available to help assess your race day medical needs and administer acute first aid when necessary. A medical station will be located near the finish line and team members will be roaming the course. 
Water Stops: see maps page for more info
  • Half: Mile 2, 5.5 & 11
  • 10k: Mile 2, 5.5
  • 5k: Mile  2 & 2.5 
 
Volunteers:
We can always use volunteers and it takes the support or our community and friends to make these events successful. if you are interested in learning more visit our website and volunteer support page or reach out to info@outfrontendurance.com

name: Alameda July 4th Parade R.A.C.E.
description:
Come out for our July 4th tradition and run this flat and fast point to point 5k thru the closed streets of Alameda. We will be starting again at 8:30am to provide ample space between our runners and the Parade that follows. 

This year we are celebrating 250 years with some great SWAG and the long anticipated SHUTTLE service from the race finish back to the start FREE of charge. 

General Overview: 

The 5K run (3.1 mile) and walk takes you through beautiful Alameda winding thru business and residential streets. This run benefits the Midway Shelter of Alameda and kicks off our historic Island Parade, the longest in the country! Runners start in the Park St Business District and end at the Webster Farmers Market location with completely closed roads and spectators beginning to line up for the Parade that follow at 10:00am

Packet Pick-up:

  • 7/1 thru 7/3: Laurens Closet. 1420 Park St, Alameda. Hours 10:00am - 5:00pm  
  • 7/4 Race morning registration opens at 7:30am 1440 Park St, Alameda ~ La Penca Restaurant. Corner of Santa Clara

Race Day Details: 

  • Start: 1420 Park St. Alameda, ca. 94501
  • Packet Pick-up : 7:30am
  • Race Start : 8:30am
  • Finish: 1526 Webster St, Alameda, CA 94501 (Tues/Saturday Farmers Market Location)

This race is BIB timed but we will have no AG awards this year. With a focus on community involvement we have great finisher shirts and customs medals as well as some "run the island" SWAG at the finish

 

Our expo will have the best of local businesses focused on health and longevity, and of course our Beer Garden sponsored by Faction Brewery. 

 

If you are traveling via Bart or public transportation please review the schedules below to get you to the race start, and picked up from the race finish. And if you park at the start, don't forget to follow the signs to the Post run Shuttle back to the start: Shuttle will run from 9am - 1pm with priority to runners with BIBS but will be open to all of our community ! 

  • Bart Website: https://www.bart.gov/
  • AC Transit Site: https://www.actransit.org/

name: Albany Community Triathlon 2026
description:
The community of Albany, California welcomes you back to a great community triathlon event!
Come on out to enjoy a super short, super FUN, beginner-friendly, family-friendly, spectator-friendly "Super Sprint" triathlon to boost your fitness while raising money for the Albany Athletics Boosters, supporting Albany Middle School and Albany High School athletics and leadership programs.

Key information about the event is provided below.

Additional details about the course and an extensive FAQ can be found at AlbanyTri.com.

Date & Venue: Sunday 20 September 2026 7:50am-Noon, Albany Aquatic Center & Memorial Park

Join the in-person, multi-sport fun at the same great venue we've used since 2008, located at 1325 Portland Ave, in Albany, CA.

Main Course: Super Sprint Triathlon (9:15 am)

The main Super Sprint course is the same as it was since 2019, indicated on our website's course info page and is for individual participants aged 9 and up. A group of 2-3 athletes can also complete as a relay team of adults, mixed adults/youth, or all youth (ages 8-17).

The swim takes place in the Albany Aquatic Center in a well-maintained 25-yard outdoor pool where swimmers get their own split lane and can swim at their own pace. The mostly flat bike course circles the streets around Albany High School and Memorial Park for a total of 12 laps clockwise. The run course also encircles AHS and the park for 3 laps on the sidewalk in the opposite direction (counterclockwise).

  • SWIM: 400 meter (0.24 mile) — pool swim in your own split lane (17 lengths of a 25y pool, 10 split lanes)
  • BIKE: 10 km (6.2 mile) —12 laps around the block, CW
  • RUN: 2.5 km (1.6 mile) — 3 laps around the block, CCW
  • First swim heat start time: 9:15AM — with subsequent heats starting every 15 minutes. Last heat starts at 11:30am.

The bike and run courses are on city streets around AHS and Memorial park which will be clear of cars and closed to traffic. The route is very flat, having a slight incline or decline (1-2%) along 1-2 blocks of the 4-block loop. Additional course details can be found at https://albanytri.com/course-info.

Short Course: Mini Triathlon (7:50 am)

The short course mini triathlon is about 1/4th the distance of the main course and is for participants aged 6 and up — kids and adults. This race is for individual participants only — no relay teams — and includes the following legs:

  • SWIM: 70 meter (75 yard) — pool swim in your own split lane (3 lengths of a 25y pool, 10 split lanes)
  • BIKE: 2.5 km (1.6 mile) — 3 laps around the block, CW
  • RUN: 1 km (0.6 mile) — 1 lap around the block, CCW
  • First swim heat start time: 7:50AM — with subsequent heats starting every 10 minutes. Last heat starts at 8:50am.

Short course is open for kids AND adults! The short course mini triathlon is mostly for kids, but adults looking to get a taste of a triathlon without committing to a longer event are welcome, too. Parents are invited to register with their young kids and accompany/chaperone them on the course while doing the race together! Individuals can also do a DOUBLE and sign up for both short course and main course events. Relay teams are not allowed for the short course.

Swim Heats & Pool Info

As with all triathlons, the event starts with the swim. The Albany Aquatic center outdoor pool has 10 split lanes, so participants will start in separate heats of 20 swimmers, with 2 swimmers splitting each lane of the 10-lane pool. You can stop and rest on the walls as much as you want within the allowed swim time for your heat. Heat start times and allowed time per heat is as follows:

  • Short course first swim heat starts at 7:50AM with subsequent heats every 10-minutes till 8:50 AM.
  • Main course first swim heat starts at 9:15AM with subsequent heats every 15 minutes till 11:30-45.

The outdoor pool has a variable depth ranging from 4 to 13 feet. All participants must acknowledge on the registration form that they or their child is competent to swim in deep water unassisted or using a kickboard. The shallowest lane (4 ft) can be used for water walking instead of swimming if you indicate this on the registration form.

Swim Heat and Lane Assignments

The first swim heats of the main and short courses are reserved for faster, more experienced athletes — especially faster cyclists. You can indicate your preference for the first heat on the registration form. You can also indicate any "family & friends" preferences for other participants you want to start the swim with. Be sure to coordinate with those other participants to ensure everyone registers and indicates their family/friends preferences! 

After the first swim heat preferences are accounted for, the remaining heat assignments will proceed from the earlier to the later heats based on registration date. For example, after heat #2 is populated, subsequent registrants will be slotted into heat #3, and so on. So register sooner if you'd like to start in an earlier heat! There will be limited ability to change heat assignments before they're finalized.

Lane Assignments in the pool are first-come, first-served. If you want to swim in a lane next to a friend, family, or team member, just head to the pool together 5-10 minutes before your heat starts and coordinate on lane selection as the previous heat of swimmers finishes. It's ok to ask other swimmers if they're willing to switch lanes, if necessary.

What You Get

Participants will receive the many health benefits of outdoor physical exercise, connecting with fellow community members, post-race snacks, special event swag, finisher medal (all kids get a medal, and adults get one if they're in the top 3 of their age group or overall), and entry to win raffle prizes. Event shirts will be included with your registration fee if you sign up by 9/1. A limited number of shirts will be available for separate purchase at the event. Register early to guarantee a shirt! For the full registration pricing schedule, see this page.

All proceeds benefit the Albany Athletics Boosters, a 501(c)(3) organization supporting public school sports programs in Albany CA.

Key dates:

  • Last day for early bird registration: Thu July 31, 11:59pm
  • Last day to have shirt included with registration: Mon August 31, 11:59pm
  • Last day to register online: Wed September 16, 11:59pm
  • Packet pickup: Sat September 19, 1-4pm, Road Runners Sports, Berkeley 
  • Race day: Sun September 20. Check-in starting at 6:45am 
  • Late registrations: A limited number of registrations may be available at packet pickup on Saturday. No race day registration.

You can indicate your preference for the first heat on the registration form. You can also indicate any "family & friends" preferences for other participants you want to start the swim with. Be sure to coordinate with those other participants to ensure everyone registers and indicates their family/friends preferences! 

After the first swim heat preferences are accounted for, the remaining heat assignments will proceed from the earlier to the later heats based on registration date. For example, after heat #2 is populated, subsequent registrants will be slotted into heat #3, and so on. So register sooner if you'd like to start in an earlier heat! There will be limited ability to change heat assignments before they're finalized.

Lane Assignments in the pool are first-come, first-served. If you want to swim in a lane next to a friend, family, or team member, just head to the pool together 5-10 minutes before your heat starts and coordinate on lane selection as the previous heat of swimmers finishes. It's ok to ask other swimmers if they're willing to switch lanes, if necessary.

Participants will receive the many health benefits of outdoor physical exercise, connecting with fellow community members, post-race snacks, special event swag, finisher medal (all kids get a medal, and adults get one if they're in the top 3 of their age group or overall), and entry to win raffle prizes. name: Albany Community Triathlon 2026
description:
The community of Albany, California welcomes you back to a great community triathlon event!
Come on out to enjoy a super short, super FUN, beginner-friendly, family-friendly, spectator-friendly "Super Sprint" triathlon to boost your fitness while raising money for the Albany Athletics Boosters, supporting Albany Middle School and Albany High School athletics and leadership programs.

Key information about the event is provided below.

Additional details about the course and an extensive FAQ can be found at AlbanyTri.com.

Date & Venue: Sunday 20 September 2026 7:50am-Noon, Albany Aquatic Center & Memorial Park

Join the in-person, multi-sport fun at the same great venue we've used since 2008, located at 1325 Portland Ave, in Albany, CA.

The main Super Sprint course is the same as it was since 2019, indicated on our website's course info page and is for individual participants aged 9 and up. A group of 2-3 athletes can also complete as a relay team of adults, mixed adults/youth, or all youth (ages 8-17).

The run course also encircles AHS and the park for 3 laps on the sidewalk in the opposite direction (counterclockwise).

  • BIKE: 10 km (6.2 mile) —12 laps around the block, CW
  • RUN: 2.5 km (1.6 mile) — 3 laps around the block, CCW
  • First swim heat start time: 9:15AM — with subsequent heats starting every 15 minutes. Last heat starts at 11:30am.

name: Albert Rivera Menudo Run
description:
For over 40 years, the Al Rivera Menudo Run 5K/10K has reached athletes, novices, family, friends, and community members. This event historically begins on a beautiful August morning at Whittier Narrows "Legg Lake" Park.  This years event will feature a 5k Run, 10k Run, Fun Run, Kiddy Run and a Team Race!

Medals will be awarded to the top 3 male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k in each of the following age divisions: 0-14, 15-18, 19-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-79, 80-89, 90+.  *There are no awards for the Fun Run or Kiddy Run*

For the team event, the top 3 teams will receive a trophy.

ALL participants will receive a bowl of menudo, and participants that are 21+ will also receive a beer.  Make sure to bring your ID for your free beer!

 

NO REFUNDS

name: Alien Run – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
The Alien Run is landing just in time for an epic celebration of the unknown! Get ready to run, walk, or teleport your way through a course filled with cosmic energy, mysterious encounters, and out-of-this-world fun. Whether you're racing across galaxies or just cruising under the stars, this adventure is your chance to celebrate the wonders of the universe — and maybe spot a few visitors from beyond! Suit up, power up, and let's make some extraterrestrial memories!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Sunday

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Almond Bowl 5K & 10K November 1st, 2026
description:
Join us, in person, on November 1st, 2026 for the 52nd Annual Almond Bowl in the beautiful Lower Bidwell Park!

Keeping with the Chico tradition we will be hosting a 5k and 10k race starting on South Park Drive and finishing near the Sycamore Field. The price of this race includes your race shirt from Upper Park Clothing, a race bib for you to wear during your run and plenty of post-race snacks for after your run! 


This race, along with the Bidwell classic, are fundraisers for our local high school's cross-country teams and band programs! Additional donations can be accepted in the registration page! 

 

RACE START TIMES


5k: 8:00am

10k: 8:10am

 

REGISTRATION

Registration for this year's Almond Bowl will be available online. In person registration will be available during packet pick up only. 

 

Race Fee Schedule

Dec 11th - March 31st - (online)              10k $50.00

                                                                        5k $40.00

April. 1st - August. 31st - (online)           10k $55.00

                                                                        5k $45.00

September 1st - Oct. 30th                        10k $60.00

(online @ 9am)                                             5k $50.00

In person Registration at Packet Pickup 
 
                                                                      10k $60.00

                                                                        5k $50.00
 

In person registration will be available at Fleet Feet Chico during packet pickup ONLY. (October 30th and 31st, 2026) Packet pickup will be from 10:00am - 2:00pm Friday and 9:00am - 2:00pm on Saturday. 

 
Registration Information
Online registration closes October 30th at 9:00 a.m. Registration will be available in person on October 30th and 31st at Fleet Feet Chico from 10am-2pm on Friday and 9am-2pm on Saturday. You need to Register by Friday October 9th to guarantee yourself race shirt. If you register between October 9th - November 1st your shirt will NOT be guaranteed. Limited number of extra shirts will be available first come first serve at packet pickup. All left over shirts/unclaimed shirts will be available for pickup or for sale (non-registered runners) AFTER the race on November 1st. Shirts will be first come first serve starting at 9:00am.  

OFFICAL COURSE CERTIFICATION AND MAPS

5K and 10K: Flat, fast loop through beautiful (newly paved!) lower Bidwell Park. 

Click here for both course maps.

 

DIRECTIONS AND PARKING FOR OPTIONAL RACE LOCATION

To the course:
Enter Chico via Highway 99 either from the north or from the south. If you are coming from the north on 99, take the Highway 32 offramp and turn right at the first intersection. If you are coming from the south on 99, take the Highway 32 offramp and turn left at the second intersection. Now you're heading west on 32 (East 8th St). From here. If coming from north 99 take the highway 32 exit and turn right onto 8th St. 

Take 8th St just under a half-mile, then turn right on Sycamore St.
Sycamore St runs a few blocks into Woodland Ave, which runs parallel to the park. The park itself will be closed to vehicle traffic on race day, so find a parking spot on or near Woodland Ave. Please be courteous and park legally. Do not park in a way that blocks local residents' entry to or exit from their homes.
There are several entrances to the One Mile Recreation Area from Woodland Ave. For race-day packet pickup, look for the sign marked pre-Registered. For any other assistance, make your way to the Information booth.


 

PACKET PICKUP

Packet pickup will be held at Fleet Feet Chico on the following days and times:

Friday and Saturday October 30th and 31st, 2026

10:00am-2:00pm (Friday)

9:00am-2:00pm (Saturday)

Fleet Feet - Chico
241 Main Street
Chico, CA 95928
(530) 345-1000

 
Race Rules:
Be courteous when overtaking slower runners or walkers in your elected race location. We want you to race hard and fast, but with safety of yourself and others in mind.

Where your Race number so it is visible on the participant's front!

Run your race with pride!

You must cross the timing mat for your chip to be read. If you are planning of racing for top finisher, the race is based on gun time and first to cross the finish line.

All other placements (age groups) will be based on chip timing.


Run, hard, run fast and have fun!


No pets will be allowed on course during the race.


All strollers must start at the back of the pack.


Thank you for understanding. 
 

AID STATIONS AND RESTROOMS
There will be 3 for the 10k and 2 for the 5k.

1.     Cedar Grove Bathrooms – Water 
2.     Peterson Drive Gate – Water 
3.     99 Overpass (Vallombrosa side) – Water

name: Almond Bowl 5K & 10K November 1st, 2026
description:
Join us, in person, on November 1st, 2026 for the 52nd Annual Almond Bowl in the beautiful Lower Bidwell Park!

Keeping with the Chico tradition we will be hosting a 5k and 10k race starting on South Park Drive and finishing near the Sycamore Field. 10k: 8:10am

Race Fee Schedule

                                                                        5k $40.00

Online registration closes October 30th at 9:00 a.m. Registration will be available in person on October 30th and 31st at Fleet Feet Chico from 10am-2pm on Friday and 9am-2pm on Saturday. name: Aloha Run Long Beach
description:
More Than Just a Race—It’s an Experience
 
The Aloha Run was created for runners, joggers, and walkers who want more than just a start line and a finish time. Our 5K and 10K races combine fitness with fun, offering a relaxed and supportive environment for participants of all ages.

From upbeat island music to smiling volunteers, every detail is designed to keep you motivated and smiling from start to finish. Whether you are looking for a San Diego 10K to test your pace or a 5K in Long Beach to enjoy with your family, you’ll find the perfect blend of competition and celebration here.

name: Anaheim Firecracker 5K/10K
description:
Congratulations! You’re about to kick off Independence Day the best way possible—with a run that celebrates community, fitness, and freedom!

Start your holiday morning with an exciting 5K or 10K run or walk along a scenic Anaheim course, surrounded by runners, walkers, families, and plenty of patriotic energy. Whether you’re chasing a personal record, enjoying a relaxed walk with loved ones, or simply soaking in the festive atmosphere, this event is designed for participants of all ages and abilities.

Rock your red, white, and blue, bring your patriotic spirit, and get ready for a memorable morning of movement, celebration, and fun!

Let’s make this Independence Day one to remember—on your mark, get set, go!

 
Parking & Race Day Information
Parking will be available in the Canyon High School parking lot, as well as on nearby streets and in surrounding neighborhoods.

The race will begin promptly at 7:00 AM near Canyon High School. A brief opening ceremony will take place before the start, so participants are encouraged to arrive early to allow time for parking, warm-ups, visiting expo booths, and any pre-race needs.

🚻 Portable restrooms will be available on site. Please plan ahead, as lines tend to be busiest in the 10–15 minutes leading up to race start.

 
Race Timing & Course Guidelines

  • All runners will receive a timing chip attached to their bib
  • Your official time begins when you cross the start timing mat
  • Course markers will be placed along the route
  • Strollers and dogs are welcome
  • Clearly marked turnaround points will be provided for both 5K and 10K participants

Hydration & Finish Line Fun
Participants are welcome to bring their own hydration. Additional hydration stations and local expo booths will be available near the finish line for post-race refreshments and celebration.

Packet Pickup

  • Saturday, June 27 from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM at A Snail's Pace (1040 E Imperial Hwy # F2, Brea, CA 92821)
  • Tuesday, June 30 from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM at Brewery X (3191 E La Palma Ave, Anaheim, CA 92806)
  • Friday, July 3 from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM at A Snail's Pace (1040 E Imperial Hwy # F2, Brea, CA 92821)

Awards
Awards will be presented to the top three finishers in each age group.

Age Groups
14 & under
15–20
21–29
30–39
40–49
50–59
60–69
70+
 
More Information
Have questions? Visit our FAQ page on our website for answers to common questions.
If you need additional assistance, please contact: eperez1@anaheim.net

name: Anaheim Turkey Trot 5K/10K  -Corner of Katella on the SANTA ANA RIVER TRAIL.  Across the street from Honda Center
description:
Anaheim Santa Ana River Trail Turkey Trot 5K/10K
Run up a Thanksgiving appetite at this year’s Anaheim Santa Ana River Trail Turkey Trot! Caren Ware Events brings you the ultimate race bling and the best holiday-themed motivation to stay healthy and active. Enjoy a scenic run along the paved Santa Ana River Trail and finish with a view of the iconic “Big A” of Angel Stadium.

Event Location:
Just north of Katella & S Douglas Road on the Santa Ana River Trail, between Angel Stadium and the Honda Center.
Closest Google address: 2610 E. Katella Ave, Anaheim, CA 92806 (former JT Schmid location).

 
What Each Participant Receives:
A collectible themed turkey shirt, beanie, or stuffed event turkey
A custom cast Turkey finisher medal or a choice of race beanie
Chip timing by ITZABOUTTIME with age division awards (3-deep per 5-year span)
A fresh slice of pumpkin pie with whipped cream at the finish
Fun, camaraderie, and holiday cheer
Enjoy music, a festive “along the fence” event expo, Thanksgiving decorations, and photo ops!

 
Race Day Schedule:
6:30 – 8:00 AM: Registration & walk-up packet pick-up
7:50 AM: Warm-up session
7:55 – 8:10 AM: Rolling start for 5K & 10K (must start by 8:10 AM)
8:11 AM: 1-Mile Fun Run start
9:00 AM: 5K Awards Ceremony (top overall & age divisions)
9:30 AM: 10K Awards Ceremony
All participants must wear the correct bib on the front for proper scoring.

 
Early Packet Pickup 

Pickup Details:

TBD

You may pick up packets for others; no ID required.

Race Day Pickup: 6:30 AM at registration booth near start/finish

 
Course Information:
Location: Santa Ana River Trail, Anaheim (paved, multi-use trail)
Enjoy views of Angel Stadium along the way
Shared path with cyclists, walkers, and dog walkers
Safety: Stay right, allow space for others, and follow public path rules
Pro tip: Write what you’re thankful for on your race bib!
 
Parking Information:
Designated Event Parking: Angel Stadium back lot (adjacent to Transit Center) – $10 race day cash pay to attendant or make payment  via zelle carenfasttrack@aol.com or venmo caren-Ware-1 have proof to show attendants. Or prepay when registering.
Enter via Douglas Way off Katella
Proof of parking payment required, (Please show attendant digital parking pass, run sign up payment receipt, Venmo payment, zelle payment  or pay cash)
Limited additional parking at Transit Center Lot B
 
Restrooms:
Public restrooms available at the Transit Center
Limited porta-potties at start/finish and near the 1-mile mark
 
Awards:
Age Division Awards: 1–7, 8–10, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80–84, 85+
Top overall male & female in 5K, 10K, and 1-Mile Fun Run
 
Additional Details:
Street tacos and tamales served at the finish line (vouchers available to be pre-purchase online)
Finisher medals handed out immediately at finish option of beanie (limited quantity)
Event takes place rain or shine
Thank you for supporting Caren Ware Events, spreading health and hope through our races. We look forward to seeing you there!

Questions? Email: carenfasttrack@aol.com

name: Anime Fan and Fitness Festival
description:
Initial Mile proudly presents to you Anime Fan and Fitness Festival, the festival where anime and fitness collide.

Join us for our second annual Anime Fan and Fitness Festival in Gilroy, CA on Saturday, September 19, 2026 where we will be brining back our Anime Fan and Fitness Festival 5k Run and Walk and will be adding our newest events the Anime Fan and Fitness Festival 10k run and the Little Ninja Dash!

Whether you’re a seasoned runner, a casual jogger, a dedicated fitness enthusiast, a creative cosplayer, or a passionate anime fan, the Anime Fan and Fitness Festival was made just for you. All experience levels are encouraged so gather your friends, family, lace up your shoes, and step into a world where miles meet anime as we bring anime energy to every stride. Cosplay is highly encouraged, so suit up as your favorite character and make this run a true celebration of anime culture! 

After crossing the finish line, stick around at victory village to celebrate, support small businesses, enjoy some local bites, cheer on our local performers and participate in our Fandom Anime Quest where you'll have the opportunity to complete a series of Fandom challenges and earn our Initial Mile Warrior Badge.

10k Run Registration Release Fees:

January - June: $50

July: $55

August - Race Day: $60

5k Run Registration Release Fees:

January - June: $40

July: $45

August - Race Day: $50

Little Ninja Dash Fees:

Registration is FREE but must register your little ninja by July 31 to receive finisher ribbon.

Each Registration Comes With:

  • Official race timing results from SVE Timing.
  • Official race bib.
  • Finisher wooden medal.
  • Option to purchase a finisher t-shirt for additional fee.

name: Annual San Bernardino Turkey Trot
description:
San Bernardino's Family Fun Thanksgiving Tradition returns for its 12th year!

Join us on the Saturday before Thanksgiving, the 21st of November.

We are excited to return to our scenic course through Cal State San Bernardino! Moving our start times an hour later this year.

Please come out and "wobble before you gobble".  Come out and continue your family fun tradition with your closest and newest friends at our new location.

A portion of the net proceeds will go towards supporting Alexander Foundation and Exonerated Nation.  

It is important to note that any runners that register after November 10th are not guaranteed a participant shirt.

5k, 10k and kids 1k courses around campus.

  • Chip timing for 5k and 10k run/walks
  • Custom-designed diecast finisher medals to all 5k/10k participants  
  • Age group awards three deep to top male and female 5k & 10K winners in 18 age categories
  • Shirts for 5k/10k participants in adult unisex and youth sizes
  • Discounts for teams/group of 8 or more (*contact is sbturkeytrot@gmail.com or hit the contact us button)
  • Team competitions with awards to the biggest team and the fastest team
  • Finish-line festival featuring costume contest, music, food, freebies, and fun for adults and kids of all ages

PACKET PICK-UP 

Tentatively scheduled for Friday, November 20th, 1-4pm

On The Spot, 2999 Kendall Dr, San Bernardino, CA 92407

You can pick up your bib, t-shirt, at packet pick-up or on race day morning at the event venue starting at 7:00 AM.

We expect heavy traffic race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

RACE DAY SCHEDULE 
7:00 AM - Late registration / packet pick-up 
8:00 AM - 10k start 
8:15 AM - 5k start 
9:30 AM - 1k Kids Run

9:00 AM - 5k & 10k age group winners announced*

*Age group awards are based on chip time.

name: Apple City 5k
description:
The inaugural Apple City 5k!

Come run fun easy trails and be a part of the Watsonville community!

Going back to the roots of farming in Watsonville, the Apple City 5k at Pinto Lake County Park is a dedication to agricultural history and life of the Pajaro Valley. 

Participants will experience the scenic meadows and trails of the county park, with gentle trails circling the whole park. 

The kids 1k will go around the soccer fields near the starting/finish line. 

This race is hosted by the Santa Cruz Track Club Fall Race series with 50% of funds going to the Pajaro Valley Education Foundation to support the students of the Pajaro Valley.

name: Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot
description:
Founded and produced by the Silicon Valley Leadership Group Foundation, the Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot is America's largest Thanksgiving Day race. It allows participants to start Thanksgiving Day off on the right foot by celebrating generosity and wellness with thousands of other runners and walkers committed to investing in their community. All event proceeds are donated to four nonprofit beneficiaries: Healthier Kids Foundation, HomeFirst, Second Harvest of Silicon Valley, and Second Harvest Food Bank Santa Cruz County.

This family-focused event welcomes participants of all fitness levels—elite runners, joggers, and walkers—to enjoy the flat and fast course that flows through downtown San Jose's local neighborhoods and businesses.

So kick off the holiday season by joining your Silicon Valley neighbors at San Jose's biggest Thanksgiving Day block party. Sign up to make the Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot your newest Thanksgiving tradition!

name: Artesa Wine Run 5k
description:

name: Ascot Hills Challenge 5K
description:
Event proceeds benefit Wilson High School Fire and Police Magnet Cadet Program and Ascot Hills Park.  

​The Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD) and The Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) have partnered in bringing the very first LAFD fire academy magnet school program to Woodrow Wilson High School in El Sereno, CA, joining the existing LAPD student police cadet program.

 
Join us on the best 3.1 mile trail course in East Los Angeles! 

Our 5K course will challenge all levels of runners, walkers and hikers.  The race is chip-timed for those seeking friendly competition and/or a chance to win a commemorative LAFD challenge coin.

​If you enjoy trail running, walking or hiking, you'll be certain to enjoy this event with spectacular views of Los Angeles, Dodger Stadium and the Hollywood sign, all visible from within the park.

name: Avalon Benefit 50 Mile/50K Run
description: The Avalon Benefit 50 Mile/50K Run is the oldest Ultra Trail Run in California with the 50 Mile run entering its 44th year.   The 50K joined the party seven years ago and instantly became a California classic in trail running traversing all of the same trails that the older run uses.   Running the Avalon Benefit 50Mile/50K provides you a first rate, up-close and personal experience of one of California's natural jewels in trail running across Catalina Island.   The run begins and ends in Avalon and in between you simply have to run the entire length of the island - and back!  In between you will experience beautiful vistas, tremendous views of the Pacific Ocean, see a bison or two and experience some of the sports great volunteers and aid stations.

name: Aztlan XC Classic
description:
Aztlan XC Classic was established in 1976. It has been long due and now we welcome you back. This time, those who have competed at this event are now well into their 50s. You are now coaches, mentors, teachers, parents and even grandparents. Bring your family, team or if you're still challenging yourself then sign up and let’s celebrate our success.

This event exclusively benefits Aztlan Athletics Foundation (AAF). For details about the subsidized running camps, scholarships, and complimentary registrations visit AztlanAthleticsFoundation.org.

name: Back to the Future: 88 MPH Dash 5K, 10K & Half
description:
Back to the Future: 88 MPH Dash 5K, 10K & Half

October 17, 2026 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Get ready to rev up your DeLorean and hit 88 MPH! This race celebrates the iconic Back to the Future trilogy, with a special nod to Back to the Future Day—October 21—the 2015 date Marty McFly and Doc Brown traveled to the future in Back to the Future Part II.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you're a time-traveling teen or a mad scientist, this race lets you channel your inner McFly and dash through time with style.

Choose your challenge:

  • 88 MPH Sprint 5K⚡ Perfect for those looking to make a quick getaway from 1985.
  • Twin Pines 10K 🌲 A tribute to the mall where it all began—before the pine trees were history.
  • Enchantment Under the Run Half Marathon 🎶 Dance through time and space in this nostalgic long-distance challenge.
  • The Multiverse Flux Capacitor Challenge (Virtual) 🌀 Can't make it in person? Join us virtually and complete any distance to earn your medal.

Expect time-traveling tunes, futuristic photo ops, and plenty of 80s nostalgia. Costumes encouraged—think puffer vests, lab coats, and hoverboards!



Parody Disclaimer
This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 80s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: Bad Bass
description:
Rising up from the depths of Lake Chabot, the Bad Bass (a strangely kilt-wearing, bagpipe-playing Scottish bass with teeth) shows itself once again on July 18th 2026! Why is he Scottish? What is he doing in Castro Valley? How can he play bagpipes with his fin? We have no idea how to answer those questions. Why is he so bad-to-the-fishbone? Maybe he just knows how awesome the trails of Lake Chabot really are!

Whatever the Bad Bass is doing here, we hope you'll join us at the beautiful Lake Chabot Marina in Castro Valley for the scenic Bad Bass 5K, 10K or Half Marathon!

name: Badwater 267 VR
description:
BADWATER: It’s a frame of mind, a global family of horizon-chasers, and a statement to the world about priorities and preconceived notions of what is possible. Badwater is a way of life! Are you ready to kick off the New Year with an authentic, original Badwater experience?

AdventureCORPS® – the organizers of the iconic worldwide series of Badwater® races – are pleased to offer the BADWATER 267 VR in which competitors virtually and sequentially traverse the routes of all three Badwater® races – the 51-mile Badwater Cape Fear, the 81-mile Badwater Salton Sea, and the 135-mile Badwater 135 – for a total of 267 miles, or 430km. These three events comprise the legendary Badwater Ultra Cup - and Badwater 267 VR! Start off the New Year with this new challenge and lay the ultimate foundation for your best year yet!

During this challenge, you will complete 267 miles (430km) during the month of January. You have 31 days to complete 267 miles and you can do them anywhere you want, including indoors. There is also a multi-sport division for those who want to combine different sports (including cycling swimming, paddle sports, cross-country and downhill skiing, skateboarding, and more; see below.) Participation is mostly* based on the “honor system,” but there is a highly recommended - and very popular - Private Strava Club to bring everyone together. You can also sync your Strava account with your RunSignUp page so that all your activities automatically post here to RunSignUp.

* All participants in the top ten on the leaderboard - at any point during the whole month - MUST provide a high level of transparency. Additionally, ALL runs completed on a treadmill must be verified with a photo of the screen at the conclusion of the run. (Measuring distances on a treadmill with a non-synced GPS watch has proven to be an issue in the past.)

Go at your own pace, as often or as long as you want, wherever you live, anywhere on the planet! 

Guidelines:

• Running Division: You must complete all 267 miles on foot: This includes Walking, Hiking, Snowshoeing, and Treadmill, whether indoors or outdoors, covering 267 miles (430km) in 31 days. This is the Running Division, in which ONLY these bipedal activities may be counted. Also Note: In the Strava app, always log any of these activities as "Running" so that they appear on the club leaderboard.

NOTE: Elliptical is NOT allowed in the Running Division. 

• Multi-Sport division: MANY sports may be included: running, cycling, and swimming, and ALSO: All outdoor paddle and rowing sports*, plus ice-skating, rollerblading, skateboarding, and cross-country skiing are also allowed in the multi-sport category, and all they all count one-for-one. Others have a mileage conversion to "equate" them with running:

• Cycling: 3 miles cycling = 1 mile running. If you are cycling indoors, please make it realistic: Indoor bike rides are capped at an average speed of no more than 16MPH / 25.75KPH.

• Swimming: 1 mile swimming = 2 miles running.

• Elliptical: you must go 2 miles - with some intensity, NOT in the easiest setting - to log 1 mile in the RunSignUp system. (Elliptical is only allowed in the Multi-Sport division, NOT in the Running division.)

• Indoor rowing or paddling: you must go 1.5 miles - with some intensity, NOT in the easiest setting - to log 1 mile in the RunSignUp system. 

• Strength training: 1 hour of strength training equates to 4 miles of running.

• Yoga and other types of fitness classes count as 3 miles for a one-hour class.

• Downhill skiing or snowboarding: 1150 feet of vert = one mile, thus 10,000 feet of vert equals the 8.67-mile daily requirement. (A total of 307,050 for 267 miles!)

SWAG & AWARDS:

Unless they opt for "No Swag," participants will receive a BADWATER 267 VR tech shirt, BADWATER buff, and BADWATER sunglasses in a custom Badwater box. For those who log the necessary miles within the RunSignUp system, a BADWATER 267 VR Medal will also be awarded. (Medals are not sent just for participating; they are sent to those who cover the distance AND log all the necessary miles with the RunSignUp system.)

ALL of these items will be shipped approximately 45 days after BADWATER 267 VR concludes.

This is not a traditional ultra, nor a run-of-the-mill virtual – Badwater events are NEVER traditional – it’s the BADWATER 267 VR – an authentic and original BADWATER event – and we hope you will join us!

POLICIES:

There are NO refunds after December 30. There are also no credits or transfers.

See the event webpage for all the info.

name: Bagel Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🥯🏃‍♂️ Run for the carbs. Stay for the bagels.

Love running? Love bagels? This one’s for you.

name: Bakersfield Father's Day Run
description:
Celebrate Dad at The Park at River Walk


Start Father’s Day weekend with fresh air, family time, and a fun morning together at the Bakersfield Father’s Day Run.

Join us for our annual celebration honoring all dads with a family-friendly 5K or 2K run/walk at The Park at River Walk. Whether you're racing, walking, or simply making memories together, this event is all about celebrating the important dads and father figures in our lives.

Special kids pricing for ages 9 and under is automatically applied during registration.

name: Barbara Schmidt Millar Women's Triathlon & 5K: Celebrating Life, Empowering Women
description:
T

Refund & Transfer Policy
Thank you for supporting the Barbara Schmidt Millar Women’s Triathlon & 5K. Your registration is a meaningful contribution that helps advance access to cancer treatment, support women’s health initiatives, and fund scholarships for local students pursuing careers in healthcare.

Because this is a fundraising event, all proceeds are committed in advance to these community programs. For this reason, all registrations are considered final and non-refundable. We are unable to offer refunds for any reason, including scheduling conflicts, personal circumstances, weather, or course conditions.

We understand that plans can change. Registration transfers to another eligible participant are permitted and must be completed by the registration deadline, subject to event guidelines and approval.

We are sincerely grateful for your participation and support—your registration fee directly helps make this event’s mission possible and strengthens its impact in the community.

name: Barra of Mendocino Harvest Celebration Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, September 27, 2026 at 11:00am, for a Harvest Celebration 5K run, an exciting annual event at Barra of Mendocino Winery! Experience the charm of this family-owned and organically farmed vineyard, certified annually by CCOF (California Certified Organic Farmers). Want to know more? Click here! After the race concludes, unwind with a post-event glass of wine in the beautiful gardens while soaking in the scenic surroundings. Enjoy a variety of delicious offerings from food trucks and partake in fun lawn games, making it the perfect outing for friends and family. Whether you're planning to run, walk, or simply indulge in the delightful wine and camaraderie, this event promises a truly memorable experience. This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Bayside Saved by the Bell 5K, 10K & Half Marathon
description:
September 19, 2026 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Get ready to dash through time in The Bayside Dash, a 90s high school sitcom-themed race packed with retro vibes, school spirit, and Slater-strength energy.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you’re more Morris or Turtle, this race lets you channel your inner Bayside Tiger and crush your course with a smile.

  • Friends Forever 5K 🎶 Named after Zack Attack’s legendary ballad—because you don’t leave your squad behind on race day.
  • Time Out 10K✋ Inspired by Morris himself—freeze time, catch your breath, and own the course.
  • Hall Pass Half Marathon🎓 Go the distance like you’ve got a free pass to run the school (and the streets of Canoga Park).
  • The Multiverse Transfer Student Challenge (Virtual) 🌀 “Transfer Students” from any timeline can choose any distance and still earn their medal.

Expect high school pep rally energy, ‘Saved by the Bell’ moments, throwback tunes, and surprise “pop quizzes” of encouragement along the course. Costumes encouraged—go full Bayside or show off your best 90s teen energy.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race—fun, fast, and full of nostalgia.

Sign up now. No hall pass required.

 

 

**Parody Disclaimer**  
This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 90s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: Be The Light 5K
description:
Join us to be a part of Santa Clarita's premier night run/walk at the annual Be The Light 5K in Valencia, California. Each year the greater Southern California community of runners and walkers come together to support youths in recovery through the A Light of Hope charity, to show them that we are here for them and together we can make a positive impact on their lives. 

Bring your best night outfit, decked out with lights and colorful glow bands to shine your brightest in this awesome night run/walk. Register today, bring the family, friends, and make a team to bring a light of hope!

Learn more and register at BeTheLight5k.com

name: Bedrock Valley Gravel Ride
description:
2026 ATHLETE GUIDE  CLICK HERE                                       

                                           BEDROCK VALLEY GRAVEL RIDE

A Gravel Ride experience you don't want to miss. Choose your ride experience around Diamond Valley Lake. This is truly a historic ride in an ancient place. This area's heritage begins during the Ice Age where the most concentrated amount of Mastodons once roam the earth. The remains of hundreds of Mastodons and other prehistoric dinosaurs were discovered in the bedrock of where the lake now rests.

BEDROCK VALLEY GRAVEL RIDE is the first Gravel Bike race that takes you around the Lake. Ride Gravel/Mountain/E-Bike

GRAVEL RIDE 36K takes you ONE LOOP around beautiful Diamond Valley Lake. Great for your first Gravel/Off-Road Ride

GRAVEL RIDE 72K takes you TWO LOOPS around beautiful Diamond Valley Lake. Test your skills and make it a double.

GRAVEL ROCK RIDE 108K takes you THREE LOOPS around beautiful Diamond Valley Lake. Find your limits and test your endurance.

GRAVEL YOUTH 10K is a fun and flat fun ride for the spirited rider/beginner. An out and back course that gets you stoked!

NEW! GRAVEL KID'S 3k fun ride. Parents ride with your kids and get them on the dirt. For Kid's 10 and under.

TEAM CHALLENGE enjoy the ride with friends and complete laps as a team in the 72k and 108k.

name: Bedrock Valley Trail Runs
description:
2026 RUNNERS GUIDE CLICK HERE

                                                        BEDROCK VALLEY TRAIL RUNS

The Bedrock Valley Trail Runs is a NEW trail running experience you don't want to miss. We offer something for the whole family to enjoy. Choose from the beautiful  Bedrock Valley Trail Marathon, Trail Half Marathon, 15k, 10k, 5k, Stroller 5k and bring the kids for the the 1 Mile Kid's Fun Run around Diamond Valley Lake. This is truly a historic run in an ancient place. This area's heritage begins during the Ice Age where the most concentrated amount of Mastodons once roam the earth. The remains of hundreds of Mastodons and other prehistoric dinosaurs were discovered in the bedrock of where the lake now rests.

TRAIL MARATHON is a great introduction into trail marathons. A relatively flat loop around the lake ending with some beautiful double track. Ideal for all running levels.

TRAIL HALF MARATHON is a beautiful out and back section along the lake bed and perfect for accomplishing your first half marathon.

15K course challenges the runner with a little of everything: flat, fast, dounle track trail.

10K is a fast out and back with views of the lake.

5K is a fast and flat out and back. Great for a fast run or hike. 

STROLLER TRAIL 5k our first specific stroller only 5k is a beautiful flat 3.1 miles out and back. Enjoy with the little ones.

KID'S 1 MILE FUN RUN is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s medal and other goodies.

GRAVEL RIDE is the first Gravel Bike race that takes you around the Lake. Ride Gravel/Mountain/E-Bike

We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.

name: Bee Sweet Citrus Farm-K
description:
Join the Bee Sweet Citrus and Ag One teams on Saturday, February 13, 2027, for our 2nd annual Farm-K event! This run/walk is a family-friendly event that benefits the next generation of agriculturalists, and we'd love for you to join in on the fun. 

Register for our timed 5k or our 1 Mile Walk in support of the Fresno State Ag One Foundation!

The event takes place at Fresno State's O'Niell Park, and all participants earn an event shirt and a custom finisher's medallion.

name: Beer City Half
description: Beer City Half takes you to great places in California for great racing, beer, and more. Each race includes half-marathon, 10k, 5k distances as well as The Beer Stroll for less-active family and friends. There's also the Beat the Beast Beer Mile, which challenges you to drink 4 beers while staying ahead of a different Beer City Mascot with each race.

name: Beer City Half™ Alameda
description: Join us on Saturday, July 11, 2026 at Radium Runway in Alameda Point for Beer City Half™ Alameda! See the sights, run the coast, and drink the brews that make Alameda a home base for beer lovers. Beer City Festival is a full day of fun. Drink local and dig it!

name: Beginner Sailing August 8/9
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. This is a free California Safety class required for all boat owners 16 years and older. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through https://www.boatus.org/california/.   Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended. The class will be held rain or shine, so please dress accordingly for weather conditions.

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. This is a free California Safety class required for all boat owners 16 years and older. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through https://www.boatus.org/california/.   Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended. The class will be held rain or shine, so please dress accordingly for weather conditions.

name: Besties Run 5K. 10K. Half Marathon , & Kids Dash
description:
📅 Sunday, February 7, 2027
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd

 

✨ Grab your bestie — and get ready for a day filled with movement, laughter, encouragement, and unforgettable memories by the beach. Or come solo and meet new friends who will cheer you on every step of the way.

This isn’t just a run — it’s a celebration of connection, confidence, community, and good vibes. 💖

✨ WHAT’S INCLUDED WITH REGISTRATION:

• CERTIFIED COURSE
• CHIP TIMING
• FINISHER MEDAL
• RACE BIB
• FREE RACE PHOTOS
• LIVE DJ & FINISH LINE PARTY
• VENDORS & GIVEAWAYS
• FOOD & REFRESHMENTS
• SCENIC COASTAL COURSE ALONG THE LONG BEACH BEACH PATH

✨ About the Besties Option — Running is better together!
Our Besties Run entries are specially designed for duos — two registrations bundled together at a special reduced rate so you and your bestie can cross the finish line side-by-side while saving money.

Make this your new Galentine’s tradition. 💕

 

✨ Why We Run Together
This event is all about uplifting one another, building confidence, celebrating friendship, and proving that we can do hard things together.

✨ All Paces. All Abilities. All Welcome.
Runners and walkers are welcome. Whether you’re chasing a PR, walk-jogging with friends, or simply soaking in the beach vibes, you belong here.

✨ Produced by CaliFlow Runs — where community, connection, and high vibes power every mile.

name: Beverly Hills Run of the Stars: 2026
description:
Run for a Cause in Beautiful Beverly Hills!

Lace up and run through the flat, scenic streets of Beverly Hills at this year’s 5K on October 18th! Run on your own or on a team!

The 5K and the Kids 1K both start and end on the grounds, next to bib pick up, at El Rodeo Elementary, 605 Whittier Dr, Beverly Hills, CA 90210. All runners and walkers start together at the start time, you must be at the start line before your race starts.

Park on the streets, watch for no parking signs. BHPD will be towing anyone parked on no parking sides of the street, those are part of the race course.

Course maps and video course tour here.

Can’t make it in person? Join our Virtual Challenge and complete your 5K from anywhere in the world.

We’re also hosting a 1K “Stars of Tomorrow” Kids Race held at the same location right after the 5K- perfect for young runners ready to shine!

 

Running for a Cure

This event proudly supports Not Today Cancer and their mission to find a cure for childhood cancers.

Despite rising childhood cancer rates, only 4% of U.S. federal cancer research funding goes toward pediatric cancers.

When Mason was just 9 years old, he was diagnosed with T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). His treatment relied on chemotherapy drugs that have been used for decades- a painful reminder of how underfunded pediatric cancer research remains.

For two years, Mason and his family lived by the mantra “Not Today, Cancer.” After Mason’s passing, that spirit inspired the creation of the Not Today Cancer Foundation, dedicated to advancing research and offering hope to families like his.

Scientists are closer than ever to finding a cure and your participation helps make that possible.

name: Big Bear Turkey Trot
description:
The 13th Annual Big Bear Turkey Trot
📍 Our new home in the Moonridge Corridor, starting and finishing at Dank Donuts.
🌲 A fresh route including the new Rathbun Creek Trail, and a memorable lap through the Moonridge Zoo 🦓🦙🦅.
🏃 A paved 3-mile run through the pines that’s approachable for everyone!
🎶 Danksgiving Celebration party at the finish line featuring live holiday music and adult beverages 🍹

 
🗓️ Event Schedule

8:00 AM - Registration & check-in opens
9:25 AM - Holiday Warmup Yoga 🧘 with Colin Schour
9:30 AM - 3-Mile Turkey Trot 🦃
10:00 AM - Danksgiving Party 🎶🍩🥂 with live music & adult beverages
10:30 AM - Awards 🏆 & Costume Contest 🎭
 
💸 Registration
Adults: $40
Youth (under 18): $25
Kids Run: Free
Locals: $5 discount with ID at packet pickup
No refunds (rain, shine, or snow—it’s all part of the fun).
 
🎁 Included with Entry:

🎄 A holiday finisher ornament
🧘 A lighthearted yoga warm-up
🎭 A lively costume contest
🥧 Race timing and awards eligibility (elite wave start available for those who's costume is considered worthy). 
🎶🍹 The Danksgiving party at the finish line
 
📦 Packet Pickup

🗓️ Monday, Nov 23 – Wednesday, Nov 25 (4–7 PM): The Yellow Post, 546 Pine Knot Blvd
🦃 Race Morning, Nov 26 (8–9 AM): Dank Donuts, 42612 Moonridge Rd Big Bear Lake, CA
 
 
🙋 FAQs

Strollers & kids? Strollers are welcome, and the kids under 5 are free.
Refunds? Nope. The Turkey Trot happens in any weather.
Local discount? Show ID for $5 off.
What’s included? Ornaments, yoga, pie, costumes, music, and memories.
 
🎤 Closing Note

The Big Bear Turkey Trot has always been about more than miles—it’s a morning of laughter, costumes, pie, and community. This year, we’ll gather in Moonridge, run the trail, visit the zoo, and then celebrate together at Danksgiving. We’ll see you out there. 🦃✨

name: Big Sur River Run
description:
Big Sur River Run is a benefit race for two important Big Sur community organizations, Big Sur Health Center and Big Sur Fire. There are two races, a 10k and 5k. Both courses are all flat, black-top road loops alongside Big Sur River, through Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park's redwood and oak grove campgrounds. The 10k is a certified course. The 5k is a Family Fun Run or Walk. No Bicycles, dogs, strollers, skates, wagons, or other wheeled conveyances (other than wheelchairs) are permitted. Prizes for 10K Race winners and top finishers.

Since 1981 two of Big Sur’s most vital institutions have been supported by the generosity of those who love to run. Most who visit Big Sur revel in the remoteness without taking in the impact it has on emergency services. The local Volunteer Fire Department, Big Sur Fire, and the Big Sur Health Center both rely on donations to provide support for visitors and residents alike. The run’s beneficiaries, Big Sur Fire and the Big Sur Health Center, have never done more to serve and support our community than in recent years. These critical emergency services need our support more than ever and we encourage you to donate to each organization directly. To date over 30,000 runners have joined the cause, supporting these institutions, and basking in the beauty of Big Sur. Will you join us this year?

name: Bike Hut Classic
description:
It's beautiful...it's challenging...it's a bucket-list Bay Area ride through Coastal Redwoods for a great cause! Rally your club members or friends for this annual DIY ride, to be completed on your own from July 3 - 19. 

Set out from the iconic Bike Hut rest stop (a world famous cycling treasure), rolling down Tunitas Creek Road through coastal farms and scenic countryside before starting the ascent through the Redwoods with switchbacks and stunning forest views. Climb 1900 feet in elevation and 8.3 miles to Skyline Boulevard, all while supporting Abundant Grace Coastside Worker! Make it an out-and-back from the top or bottom of Tunitas...or add it to a larger ride from over the hill or up the Coast. 

One hundred percent of proceeds go to Abundant Grace as we hire the homeless community to work at Potrero Nuevo Farm (behind the Bike Hut). The organic produce is donated to low-income families, and participants earn money while giving back to the community.

Registration includes a limited edition t-shirt and entry to our Ride Reception on Saturday, July 25 with ice cream sundaes, podium photos, and live music. Top riders earn prizes and get their name on a plaque inside the Bike Hut, as will the bike club that raises the most funds.

name: Bike The Coast
description:
Experience gorgeous riding along pristine beaches, historic Pacific Coast Highway, iconic beach landmarks and unique, Southern California weather with the annual Bike The Coast Bike Tour.   Select from distances of 25 mile, 50 mile, and 100 mile rides and then come out and ride along with 2000 other enthusiast along some of Southern California's best-known cities and roadways.  When you finish, meet us back at  the Oceanside pier to celebrate with your selection of food options, a lively beer garden, great music and new friends.

This is a truly bucket list event if you are an avid rider who enjoys getting some exercise, having fun, and experience great November weather.  This is a 'rules of the road' ride so come prepared to obey all traffic laws.

name: Bikes & Beers San Diego
description:
Register for California's 14th Annual Bike Ride & Beer Festival 2026! BIKES & BEERS Cycling Event Series is back at ALESMITH BREWING COMPANY for the Best Bike Ride & Beer Event in the business! Ride a 15, 30, or 45-mile route through the beautiful area of San Diego, California followed by a post-ride Beer Festival! Bikes & Beers SAN DIEGO is the area's premier cycling event departing from ALESMITH BREWING COMPANY and traveling the scenic roads of San Diego, CA. All rides feature morning fuel stations, marked routes, GPS turn-by-turn instruction, rest stops, refreshments, ride marshals, and SAG support. Finish back at ALESMITH BREWING COMPANY for a beer festival atmosphere of rewarding craft beers, live music, a charity raffle & much more!

This is a ride for everyone - All riding levels are welcome!


WHAT IS BIKES & BEERS:

  • Pick your ride distance and create a team of friends & family (optional)
  • Mark your calendar for a fun day of cycling and craft beer!
  • Pre Ride:
    • Check in a half hour before your start time
    • We'll provide parking & further ride info in email instructions
    • Enjoy free coffee & fresh pastries
    • Local bike shops offering last-minute tune-ups
  • The Ride:
    • Ride your distance with ride leaders
    • Fully marked routes & GPS turn-by-turn instructions
    • Mechanical support vehicle
    • Rest stops with snacks & refreshments
  • Post Ride: 
    • It's time to enjoy (2) complimentary beers on us!
    • Official co-branded Bikes & Beers Pint Glass for every rider
    • Bikes & Beers high-quality neoprene koozies
    • Enjoy the food trucks, live music, games
    • Check out our Bikes & Beers merch tent & snack stand
    • Live raffle with $2,000+ in prizes!
  • Join & Post your photos on our Facebook Page
    • Keep in touch with your newly made cycling friends!

*Further event information will be communicated in emails after registration and in the days and weeks leading up to event day!


WHAT YOU'LL GET:

  • Official Bikes & Beers X ALESMITH 2026 Pint Glass
  • (2) ALESMITH Craft Beers are ON US!
  • High-Quality Neoprene Beer Koozies
  • Raffle Ticket with a Chance to WIN PRIZES!
  • Collectable Bike Plate - Event Photos!
