description: This is a vendor registration page for the 2025 Folsom Firecracker Run, taking place on Friday, July 4, 2025 in Folsom, CA. Vendor booths are 10' by 10'. Tents, tables, chairs, and tablecloths and other items to be supplied by vendor unless you request tables in your registration. A site map and one-sheet will be emailed out prior to the race.

name: Folsom Firecracker Race
description:
Join us for our 15th Annual Folsom Firecracker on Saturday, 2026, July 4th. This community-oriented event is a fun and healthy way to kick off the 4th of July before your festivities with family and friends.  The 2 Mile, 5K, and 10K races are timed events that travel primarily along the paved paths of the Lake Natoma bike trails and overlook the American River. The Kids Fun Run is a 1/4 Mile non-competitive race for ages 10 and younger. Finishers of all races will receive a  medal upon completion. 


Overall and age group awards are presented in all three timed races. In the 5K and 10K, we have unique special divisions and awards to recognize adaptive athletes, Folsom residents, first responders, active military and veterans, cancer survivors and stroller entrants. Post-race, enjoy complimentary sno-cones, refreshments, and vendor booths. We hope to see you there!

Event Details:

Registration for the 2 Mile, 5K, and 10K includes a race t-shirt, chip timing, eligibility for age group & special division awards (5K/10K), and a finisher's medal. 

Kids Fun Run: The Kids Run will be approximately 1/4 a mile and will be held at 9:00am. Open to kids ages 10 and Under. Entry includes a bib number and finisher medal (race is not timed). A t-shirt may be added to the entry for $5. One parent may run alongside each child in the Kids Run if this makes the child more comfortable (parent does not need to register). Kids who are registered for the 2 Mile or 5K and wish to run the Kids Run in addition need only register for the longer race (will receive only 1 medal/tshirt). 

Youth Discount: A $5 discount is offered for youth participants ages 1 to 17 years for the 2 Mile, 5K and 10K.

Military Discount: We offer a reduced cost entry to all US Military - Active Duty, Veterans and Reserves. Please note that if you register in this category, you will need to show your Military ID card when you pick up your bib.  This discount is available to those who are serving or have served and does not extend to spouses or children. 

Special Divisions: During registration, 5K and 10K entrants will have the chance to enter one of our Special Divisions for your race distance. Special divisions are:

  • Adaptive Athlete (athletes with physical, developmental, and/or intellectual disabilities);
  • US Military - Active Duty/Reserves or Veteran
  • City of Folsom Resident
  • City of Sacramento Resident
  • Strollers

There will be prizes for top finishers in each special division (based on net time) and you will still be ranked in your respective age group if you enter a special division.

Distances

5K, 10K and 2 Mile Courses will be offered. See website for course maps. The 2 Mile is perfect for families, younger participants, and those with strollers or well-behaved dogs. All courses start and finish on Parkshore Drive and travel along the tree-lined Jedidiah Smith Bike trail and offer views of the pristine blue waters of the American River. The 10K has rolling hills. 

Race Day Times

6:30 AM - Registration opens
7:45 AM - 10K Start
7:50 AM - 5K Start
8:00 AM - 2 Mile Start
9:00 AM - Kids Fun Run Start

Arrive one hour prior to your race start to have sufficient time to warm up, use restrooms, park, pick up bib, etc. 

 

Awards and Age Groups: 

Awards will be presented to the top overall male, female, and nonbinary finishers (based on gun time) plus the top three finishers per gender (based on net time) in the following age categories:

5K: 9 and under, 10-12, 13-15, 16-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84, 85-89, and 90+. 
10K: 12 and under, 13-15, 16-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80+
2 Mile: 9 and under, 10-12, 13-15, 16-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+
Kids Run: The kids run will not be timed. All finishers will receive a participation medal. 

Overall winners will also receive their age group prize. Unclaimed awards are not mailed. 

Special Division prizes: The top three finishers (broken down by gender) in each special division (Folsom Resident, City of Sacramento Resident, US Military Active Duty/Reserves, US Military Veteran, Adaptive Athlete) will receive a medal. Be sure to check the results on race day before you leave the event to see if you won! 

Packet Pick Up

Packet pick up will be held prior to event day on Friday, July 3 from 3:30-7 pm at Fleet Feet in Folsom (6610 Folsom Auburn Road, Folsom). You may pick up for friends or family members; ID is not required (except for those registering with Military discount). If you cannot pick up on prior to event day, then you may pick up on race morning. Please bring your QR code from your confirmation email with you to check in and receive your race bib.

Parking

Parking (free) is available in the surrounding corporate parks of Parkshore Drive. Please be mindful of no parking signs. Arrive early to find a space.

Participant Confirmation


A confirmation email is sent to each registrant when your online entry is submitted.  A detailed participant confirmation letter will be sent a few days prior to event day.

Event Beneficiaries

 

  • Proceeds from the Folsom Firecracker will support the Neil Reitman Pediatric Burn Institute at Shriners Children's of Northern California and Cancer Champions.

Shriners Children's of Northern California

Your Gift Helps Us Transform Lives

  • When a family comes to Shriners Children’s, we welcome them with open arms — and open hearts.

  • At Shriners Children’s, we are committed to reaching as many children as possible, wherever they may live, and offering them our unique, patient-centered, wrap-around care.

  • Shriners Hospitals for Children® is a fully qualified 501(c)(3) organization. Contributions to Shriners Children's™ are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law (EIN 36-2193608). Shriners Children’s™ is a registered name under which Shriners Hospitals for Children conducts activities.

Cancer Champions


Your generous donation shows those fighting cancer they’re not alone. Every dollar counts, and you'll receive a receipt for your tax-deductible contribution.


At Cancer Champions, we are proud to support those impacted by cancer through a supportive community as well as personalized fitness, nutrition, and mindset guidance. No matter where somebody is on their cancer journey, whether currently undergoing treatment, post-treatment, or if they are a care partner for somebody battling cancer, we will be there. Research has proven time and again that exercise, nutrition, and positive mindset can help improve quality of life for those impacted by cancer.
Your contribution will support those impacted by cancer through community, fitness, nutrition, and mindset resources to help empower them on their cancer journey.  Cancer Champions is a qualified 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization. Tax ID Number 87-1494423.

Volunteer at the Race!


Volunteers are needed on race day to help with tasks such as:

  • Registration (hand out t-shirts, bibs)
  • Course Monitor (direct athletes on the course)
  • Water Station (pass out water & Gatorade on the course)
  • Finish line refreshments, award hand-out, and water
  • Distributing finish line medals
  • Clean up

All race day shifts are relatively short and you will be done well before lunch. That being said, we encourage all volunteers to wear sunscreen, bring a reusable bottle of water, and wear a hat. If you would like to volunteer, either by yourself or with a group, you can sign up online using below link. Please email us with any questions about volunteering here. Groups of 10 or more are eligible for fundraising opportunities.  Volunteers who are not fundraising may receive a coupon code valid for $45 to any remaining 2026 ACOP race of their choice to participate for free. Packet Pick Up volunteers may use the code for this event - all others must use for a future race. Vouchers expire on Sunday 11/22/26. 

We would love to have your help on race day!

Sign up to volunteer HERE.

 

Special Division Detailed Information

Special Divisions are offered for this event for the 5K and 10K. This is an optional category that you may enter in addition to your age group. Those entering a special division will still be eligible for age group awards and will still be ranked and listed in age group results. You may enter only one special division.

  • US Military Special Divisions
  • City of Sacramento residents
  • City of Folsom Residents
  • Strollers
  • Adaptive Athlete Division
    • You may enter this division if you are an athlete with physical, developmental, and/or an intellectual disability. Some examples are: visually impaired, wheelchair athlete, limb difference, developmental/intellectual delayed/disability, modified racing wheelchair ("duo team"), etc.  Rankings will be based on net (chip) time.

Cancer Champions


Your generous donation shows those fighting cancer they’re not alone. Every dollar counts, and you'll receive a receipt for your tax-deductible contribution.

Volunteer at the Race!


Volunteers are needed on race day to help with tasks such as:

  • Registration (hand out t-shirts, bibs)
  • Course Monitor (direct athletes on the course)
  • Water Station (pass out water & Gatorade on the course)
  • Finish line refreshments, award hand-out, and water
  • Distributing finish line medals
  • Clean up

All race day shifts are relatively short and you will be done well before lunch. That being said, we encourage all volunteers to wear sunscreen, bring a reusable bottle of water, and wear a hat. If you would like to volunteer, either by yourself or with a group, you can sign up online using below link. Please email us with any questions about volunteering here. Groups of 10 or more are eligible for fundraising opportunities.  Volunteers who are not fundraising may receive a coupon code valid for $45 to any remaining 2026 ACOP race of their choice to participate for free. Packet Pick Up volunteers may use the code for this event - all others must use for a future race. Vouchers expire on Sunday 11/22/26. 

We would love to have your help on race day!

Special Division Detailed Information

Special Divisions are offered for this event for the 5K and 10K. This is an optional category that you may enter in addition to your age group. Those entering a special division will still be eligible for age group awards and will still be ranked and listed in age group results. You may enter only one special division.

  • US Military Special Divisions
  • City of Sacramento residents
  • City of Folsom Residents
  • Strollers
  • Adaptive Athlete Division
    • You may enter this division if you are an athlete with physical, developmental, and/or an intellectual disability. Some examples are: visually impaired, wheelchair athlete, limb difference, developmental/intellectual delayed/disability, modified racing wheelchair ("duo team"), etc.  Rankings will be based on net (chip) time.

name: Fort Bragg Whale Run and Walk
description:
The 38th Annual Whale Run & Walk for 2026!
Fort Bragg, Ca is a small, picturesque city on the Pacific Ocean, nestled between sandy beaches and the redwood forest. We are the home of the world famous Glass Beach! Every year there is a huge Whale Festival on the 3rd weekend of March, and Saturday morning the Whale Run kicks it off! After the Whale Run there are events all over town, including a craft fair; guided whale viewing; clam chowder, beer and wine tasting, entertainment, and music everywhere. See the www.whalerun.org for more information and interesting facts about whales.

The local Soroptimist clubs have been holding this race for 38 years, with up to 800 runners participating on a beautiful day on the Mendocino Coast. The ocean and trails are as magnificent as ever and we know you will love the views and all the festivities in town on race day. All runners, walkers, and spectators will enjoy breathtaking whitewater ocean views (including whales) along this year’s new course starting at the Noyo Headlands Park (Cypress Street) on the Coastal Trail in Fort Bragg, CA

Here are the events you can sign up for:

  • 5k-- runners will run north and turn around at or near Compass Rose.
  • 5k-- "Fun" Walkers will follow the 5k runner's route. 
  • 10k-- runners dash north past Glass Beach then cross the beautiful Pudding Creek Trestle to the 10K turn around (10K map).
  • 1/2 Marathon--same route as 10k but the turnaround is at MacKerricher State Park.
  • Kiddie run -- 400 meter run in 3 age groups (U5, U7, and U10)

There are multiple race age divisions. Note: under 16 run/walkers may enter any race division for a discounted rate at signup.

DOGS: We love dogs, but the insurance won't let us add them mixed with runners. You are welcome to walk your dog on the trails before and after the race (on leash). There's a dog park by the swim center on Lincoln and Maple, and there's a dog beach at the end of north harbor drive.

FAQ's: Click Here to go to the race website and find answers to commonly asked questions about the race.

name: Foster the Future Run
description:
The 9th Annual Foster The Future 5/10K Run/Walk Beyond Foster Care Wellness Fest is coming to Pasadena, California. Join us for this is a wonderful wellness opportunity to help support Journey House.

Journey House's Mission is to support former foster and probation youth to live fully independent, successful lives.

Founded in 1983, Journey House provides emotional support and guidance, as well as financial aid to help them with the cost of attending college and vocational schools. Journey House’s goal is to create opportunities for advancement in education, economic stability, and a better quality of life for former foster youth.

For more information visit: journeyhouseyouth.org

name: Fourth of July Run Crime Out of Roseville
description:
Can YOU beat the Roseville Police?

We are excited to be continuing our annual tradition of kicking off the 4th of July festivities with our Annual Run Crime Out of Roseville! We are proud that we use the funds from this event to make our community safer for ALL our residents and work closely with other local non-profits and our Roseville Police Department to ensure everyone in our City feels safe. The funds directly go to community education, the management of our anonymous tip software and phone number, and sponsorships for high school students in our community who want to go into the first responder field.

Join us on the 4th of July for our Annual Run Crime Out of Roseville where you can match your speed against the Roseville Police Department in a 5K race! We will also have a 1/4 Mile for the kiddos!

This will be a chipped, in-person event!

name: Freedom Run
description:
Celebrate Independence Day at the Fresno Freedom Run this July 4th as we mark the 250th anniversary of our nation! Start your holiday with a memorable run or walk along an American flag–lined course, surrounded by community spirit and patriotic pride.

The event features a 4-mile run/walk, a 2-mile run/walk, and a fun Kids Run to kick off the morning’s festivities, making it the perfect way for runners, walkers, and families of all ages to participate.

Participants will receive a participant shirt, chip timing, post-race snacks, and a newly designed commemorative finisher medal. Most importantly, your participation helps support Central Valley Honor Flight, an organization dedicated to honoring local World War II, Korean War, and Vietnam War veterans by sending them to Washington, D.C. to visit the memorials built in their honor.

Gather your friends and family and start your Fourth of July with a run that celebrates freedom, community, and those who served.

name: Freedom Run on the Ranch - 20th Anniversary
description:
A Ladera Ranch tradition returns this Fourth of July! Join us for the Freedom Run on the Ranch—a fun, community-first celebration featuring the Kids Firecracker 1K, 5K, and 10K. This year we are celebrating our 20th Anniversary!

Your participation makes a difference: race registration and sponsorship proceeds support local charities, and in 2026 we are proud to support the Jessie Rees Foundation – NEGU. 

Bring the whole family—whether you’re running, walking, or cheering from the sidelines. Enjoy a festive event morning with a breakfast option and sponsor/vendor area, plus plenty of Fourth of July spirit throughout the community. 

Important: Registration prices increase on June 22. Please register early. 

June 28th - Packet Pickup - Snails Pace Mission Viejo - 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM

July 3rd - Packet Pickup - Board & Brew - Ladera Ranch Location 11:00AM -6:00PM

July 4th - Race Day Calendar:

6:00 am Race Registration opens

7:00 am - 10k run starts

8:30 am - 5k run starts

8:00 am - Xclusive breakfast begins

9:45 am - Kids 1k run starts

11:00 am - Event ends

name: Fresno Turkey Trot
description:
Sierra Challenge Express

Presents:

the 27th annual

Fresno Turkey Trot @ Woodward Park

 

For over a quarter of a century, the Fresno running community has come together on Thanksgiving morning to make a difference—supporting those in need throughout our community through generous donations and race registrations. The Fresno Turkey Trot isn’t just a run; it’s a tradition of gratitude, generosity, and good times. This year, your participation helps support the Fresno Mission as they provide meals, shelter, recovery programs, and life-changing services for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. Proceeds also benefit the Coach Ray Knight Youth and Scholarship Programs, helping student-athletes across the Central Valley pursue their academic and athletic dreams.

Kick off your Thanksgiving with purpose! Whether you run the chip-timed 5K or enjoy the untimed 2-Mile Walk, you’ll be part of a festive and meaningful morning. Every participant will receive a long-sleeve Thanksgiving shirt, a commemorative finisher’s medal, and a tasty post-race treat.

name: Frida Fun Run
description:
League of Mexican American Women warmly invites you to be a part of something special—the 5th Annual Frida Fun Run! This beloved event celebrates community, fitness, culture, and is an opportunity to raise scholarship funds for local students.

Since this is our fifth year, we're celebrating our own “Cinco-ñera” marking five years of bringing the central valley community together. Our aim this year is to bolster our scholarship program, increasing the number of scholarships awarded to students. Join us for a day filled with friends, family, fun, and fitness!

Held on Saturday, October 3, 2026, at Fresno City College, the event takes place on a vibrant, picturesque campus in the heart of Fresno. With its lush green spaces, historic buildings, and tree-lined walkways, the setting beautifully reflects the spirit of community and cultural pride.

Join us and help us empower the next generation through education!

About the League of Mexican American Women (LMAW)

Founded in 1973 in Fresno County, the League of Mexican American Women (LMAW) is a grassroots organization dedicated to empowering our community through education, cultural celebration, leadership development, and service. Discover our programs and how you can get involved here.

name: Friday the 13th Night Race -Deranged Turkey Trot: 5K. 10K. Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
This a 2026 Event

🦃 Camp Turkey Terror – Where the Turkeys Fight Back


🌲 Friday the 13th 
5K | 10K | Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
📅 Friday, November 13, 2026
🕓 Check-In begins : 4:00 PM to 6:30 PM
Start Times | Half: 5:00 PM | 10K & 5K: 6:30 PM

 
💀 About the Event
Welcome to Camp Turkey Terror — where the tables have turned and the turkeys are taking revenge. 🦃🔥
It’s Friday the 13th, and under the harvest moon, the woods come alive with feathers, fog, and just a hint of chaos.

Join us for the final chapter in the Camp CaliFlow Trilogy, a fall night of fun, fright, and fearless miles. Whether you’re running from guilt, running for the pie, or just running for the glow, this one’s for you.

Because at Camp Turkey Terror… the turkeys fight back.

 
🌊 What to Expect
USATF-Certified Course 🏁
Professional Chip Timing ⏱️
Free Race-Day Photos by Nina & Dre 📸
Finisher Medals for All Participants 🏅
Overall & Age Group Awards 🥇
3 On-Course Water Stations (one at each turnaround)
Finish-Line Feast & Campfire Festival 🔥
Costume Contest – Pilgrims, Pumpkins & Poultry Welcome 🦃🎃
DJ, Lights & Glow Effects for that signature CaliFlow After-Dark magic
All paces welcome — runners, walkers, and leftovers alike!
 
🌕 Course Info
The course begins beneath the glowing CaliFlow Arcch, tracing the flat, scenic Long Beach path under the light of the harvest moon.

As you make your way through the fog, you’ll pass a few iconic “Camp Turkey Terror” checkpoints:
🔥 The Final Feast Turnaround
🍂 Stuffing Station 13
🥧 Pie or Die Water Stop

Half Marathon: 3 × 4.36-mile loops
10K: 2 × 5K out-and-backs
5K: 1 loop

Each turnaround features a full water station, friendly “camp counselors,” and plenty of autumn spirit to keep you moving before the turkeys catch up.

 
🍁 The Vibe – Totally Camp CaliFlow
Think Thanksgiving meets slasher flick, but with way better lighting and medals you’ll actually want to show off.

Expect glowing campfires, pumpkin decor, moody fog, and more laughs than screams as you cross the finish line at our “Campfire Feast” celebration.

Because at CaliFlow Runs, we don’t fear the chaos — we run through it.
And this time… the turkeys are watching. 👀

✨ Not just a race. Join the movement.

name: Friends of the Park - 5k & 1-mile Sprint
description:
Support North Tahoe Recreation & Parks this Labor day weekend in beautiful Tahoe Vista, CA.  This 5k and 1mile fun run is designed for all abilities and ages.  The run will include a variety of terrain including grass ballfields, paved bike paths, and park trails.  Each participant will receive a North Tahoe hat.  Get the family together this holiday weekend and come on out to the park!  Dogs on leash are welcome in the park.

Picnic Areas will be reserved for participants at the Tahoe Vista Recreation Area beach and swimming area after the race. Refreshments and a recovery zone will be available.  Parking fee included for all participants.

Your participation keeps our park pristine.  Proceeds support the Friends of the Park 501(c)3.

Learn more about the park here: North Tahoe Regional Park

name: Furgiving Run: Turkey Trot 5K, 10K, Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🦃💛 THE GREAT FURGIVING RUN
5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Family 1-Miler • Kids Dash

📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA

Friends. Family. Doggies. Miles. Gratitude.

The Friendsgiving Run is a feel-good coastal race celebrating connection, movement, and the people we choose to show up with. Whether you’re running with friends, family, your kids, your pup, or your run crew, this is a morning made for togetherness and good vibes by the beach.

Run the scenic Long Beach shoreline, enjoy ocean views, and finish with that signature CaliFlow energy that makes every race feel like home.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
Same-Day Registration & Bib Pickup:
🕕 Opens at 6:00 AM

Start Times
⏰ Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
⏰ 5K & 10K + Family 1-Miler: 8:30 AM
⏰ Kids Dash: 9:15 AM

 
🌊 Why You’ll Love This Race
✅ Flat, fast, scenic beach path course
✅ Beginner- and walker-friendly
✅ Strollers welcome
✅ Dogs on leash welcome 🐾
✅ Professional chip timing with accurate results
✅ Overall & age group awards
✅ Free race-day photos
✅ Finisher medals for all participants
✅ Finish-line festival vibes

 
💛 Why CaliFlow Runs
CaliFlow Runs is about more than miles — it’s about community. Our events are inclusive, welcoming, and designed so everyone belongs, no matter your pace or experience level.

Come solo.
Bring your people.
Make new friends.

The Friendsgiving Run is your chance to move together, celebrate gratitude, and start the season on a high note.

name: Gardner Health Services 2026 Día de los Muertos Run-Walk
description:
And......we're back! We're thrilled to announce our 7th Annual Gardner Health Services Día de los Muertos Run-Walk, now featuring a more focused 5K route to make your experience even more vibrant and memorable. Join us on Saturday, October 31, 2026 at 8:30am along the beautiful Guadalupe River Trail in San Jose, CA.

This year, we're streamlining our route to just a 5K to create an even more engaging and energetic event that celebrates life, health, those we love eternally, and the incredible spirit of our community. But, our mission is strong and remains to support children and families who need access to medical care, turning every step into hope and healing.

Get ready for a morning filled with music, entertainment, and a health resource fair that promises fun for the whole family. Together, we'll run, walk, and make a difference!

REGISTRATION INCLUDES

  • Race Entry 
  • Bib and Timing Chip
  • Finisher's Medal
  • Día de los Muertos Tech Shirt

PACKET/BIB PICK-UP

  • Friday, October 30, 2026 | 10:00am - 7:00pm | 1621 Gold St., San Jose, CA 95002
  • Saturday, October 31, 2026 | 7:00am - 7:45am | 1621 Gold St., San Jose, CA 95002

WHAT TO WEAR

Show us your best Día de los Muertos spirit and come in masks, colorful makeup, and costumes. Or, wear the race shirt given at packet pick-up.

LA OFRENDA

Participants are encouraged to bring a photo of a passed loved one, flowers, etc. for our giant ofrenda on display (no glass or open flames).

  • All items should be placed on the ofrenda by 7:30am
  • Photos should be 5″ x 7″ or smaller
  • Please pick up photo/items before leaving venue. All items left at the end of the event will be discarded.

description:
We are so excited to invite you to The Mentoring Club’s 7th Annual Global Run/Walk/Bike fundraiser!

As leaders, we believe we must invest in ourselves intellectually, emotionally, spiritually, and physically. This fun event is about taking care of ourselves and our health, so we can take care of others amid the day-to-day challenges in our lives and the world around us.

Join us as we all “Give Back Lead Forward” in this fun-raising event!

By going virtual, we can participate in this event anytime between July 7, 2026, and August 8, 2026, and be active, be involved, be a part of a community supporting a cause* while enjoying a run or walk or bike any place with a scenic outdoor view, by ourselves or with our family and friends.  

*The Give Back Lead Forward Global Run/Walk/Bike 2026 is a fundraising event to benefit The Mentoring Club. We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization whose mission is to provide a mentoring community for aspiring and seasoned leaders. Anywhere in the world, we help working people find mentors who can guide them develop skills they need to achieve their career and life goals. We believe in marrying aspiring leaders’ potentials and accomplished leaders’ experiences to make the world a better a place. As mentees become leaders, our dream is for them to become mentors to others.

SIGN UP NOW! 

 

REGISTRATION INCLUDES:

  • Printable BIB number to wear on your run/walk/bike day
  • Give Back Lead Forward T-SHIRT or FREE MENTORING SUBSCRIPTION
  • Commemorative participation MEDAL with lanyard
  • Printable Finisher CERTIFICATE
  • A chance to win $100 Amazon Gift Card or Restaurant Gift Card ***
  • FREE SHIPPING to USA address

***See the JOIN OUR PHOTO CONTEST section below for details on how to win.

 

HOW TO JOIN:

STEP 1 – SIGN UP today to join.   

STEP 2 – PRINT your BIB number to wear on the day of your run or walk or bike.

STEP 3 – COMPLETE YOUR DISTANCE whether a 5K (3.1 miles) or 10K (6.2 miles) run or walk or a 15K (9.3 miles) bike any time between July 7, 2026 and AUgust 8, 2026.

STEP 4 – SUBMIT VIRTUAL RESULTS on the RESULTS tab of the Give Back Lead Forward Global Run/Walk/Bike 2026 signup site. You may also opt for "I finished but did not time my run."  Submitting your virtual results is needed if you wish to print your Finisher Certificate.

STEP 5 – POST YOUR PICS on our Facebook page or on the PHOTOS tab of the Give Back Lead Forward Global Run/Walk/Bike 2026 signup site and get a chance to win the "MOST SCENIC PHOTO" and the MOST CREATIVE TEAM PHOTO award with a $100 Amazon Gift Card or Restaurant Gift Card.

STEP 6 – CELEBRATE your accomplishment by printing your Finisher Certificate with your name, event, and time results on it, too.

STEP 7 – RECEIVE a Give Back Lead Forward T-SHIRT and a commemorative MEDAL for bragging rights or FREE MENTORING SUBSCRIPTION!

name: Gold Country Run 10K, 5K and Kids K Presented by Marshall
description:
Welcome to the 10th Annual Gold Country Run (10K, 5K and Kids K) presented by Marshall! 
 
Starting and finishing in the pristine El Dorado Hills Town Center (Town Center), The Gold Country Run will feature a 10K, 5K, and Kids K all presented by Marshall.  This event will showcase what makes El Dorado Hills “one of America’s best places to live” according to CNN: beautiful views of the Sacramento Valley and Sierra Nevadas, interesting landscapes, vibrant shopping and dining, and an active and healthy community nestled in the heart of historic Gold Country. 
 
The race will be a premier running event managed by Sierra Endurance Events and it features a 10K and 5K course that features an initial loop in Town Center followed by and out and back (with a screaming fast finish!) making it a great event for participants and spectators alike!  The event will be followed by a Finisher Fitness Festival presented by Marshall and our other important sponsors. 

The Kids K is a child friendly loop around the pond at Town Center, held during the 5K and 10K events and separate from that course. This event gives kids a fun and safe introduction to what its like to participate in a world class foot race!

The 5K and 10K will start at 7:00 AM, the Kids K will start at 8:00 AM. Please visit our website for all race information!

name: Gold Rush Adventure Challenge: Dawn to Dusk
description:
The Gold Rush Adventure Challenge: Dawn to Dusk is a 12 hour adventure challenge set in one of the most spectacular landscapes run the world: San Francisco Bay Area.

For complete details, visit our website (link)

Starting in the charming small town of Sausalito, teams will navigate by map and compass (no GPS!) through the dramatic terrain of the Marin Headlands, paddle the waters of the San Francisco Bay, and explore the historic trails of Angel Island.

Racers will move through a landscape defined by steep coastal ridges, ocean cliffs, historic military sites, and sweeping views of the Golden Gate Bridge and the skyline of San Francisco.

Teams of 1 to 4 racers will trek, mountain bike, and paddle between checkpoints spread across the course. Each team receives a map and must choose how to navigate the terrain and collect checkpoints within the 12 hour time limit.

A central transition area in Sausalito allows teams to return to race headquarters between disciplines to change gear, regroup, and plan their next leg before heading back out on course.

The race is designed to be approachable for first time adventure racers while still offering meaningful strategy and physical challenge for experienced teams. Navigation is straightforward enough for newcomers to learn the sport while the terrain and route choices reward strong teamwork and efficient movement.

This event will be EPIC!

Race Details

  • Race Length: 12 hours (Dawn to Dusk)
  • Team Size: Solo, 2, 3, or 4 racers
  • Disciplines: Trekking, Mountain Biking, Paddling
  • Race HQ / Transition Area: Sausalito, California
  • Navigation: Map and compass only, NO GPS :)

We’re committed to growing the next generation of adventure racers! Participants ages 18–25 and racers under 18 receive a discount at checkout.

For complete details, visit our website (link)

name: Golden State Trail Run
description:
The Golden State 50K/35K/Half Marathon/10K is our newest, premier summer event, traversing the fabulous trails of Fort Ord National Monument. Each course is newly designed, and different than our winter time Fort Ord Trail Runs, including new trails and more single-track running! Fort Ord National Monument has a vast array of endangered and rare species of plants and animals, some of which are rarely found outside of its boundaries. The botany on this terrain is just as diverse as the animals that roam it. Fort Ord has vegetation ranging from maritime chaparral to grasslands, marshes and gorgeous fields of flowers. The Golden State courses provide a grand tour of Fort Ord and all this former military base has to offer.

Fort Ord National Monument is truly golden in the summer. Runners will be treated to rolling hills, vast fields of wildflowers, and varied terrain, including smooth single-track, sandy hills, and exposed fire roads.

The Golden State 50K/35K/Half Marathon/10K is our newest, premier summer event, traversing the fabulous trails of Fort Ord National Monument. Each course is newly designed, and different than our winter time Fort Ord Trail Runs, including new trails and more single-track running! Fort Ord National Monument has a vast array of endangered and rare species of plants and animals, some of which are rarely found outside of its boundaries. The botany on this terrain is just as diverse as the animals that roam it. Fort Ord has vegetation ranging from maritime chaparral to grasslands, marshes and gorgeous fields of flowers. The Golden State courses provide a grand tour of Fort Ord and all this former military base has to offer.

Fort Ord National Monument is truly golden in the summer. Runners will be treated to rolling hills, vast fields of wildflowers, and varied terrain, including smooth single-track, sandy hills, and exposed fire roads.

name: Goleta Beach Splash & Dash
description:
Join us for the Goleta Beach Splash & Dash! 

This is a low-cost community event designed to promote healthy, social activities at the newly renovated Goleta Beach Park.

Events:

1) Swim/Run (400 meter swim, 5K Run).

2) Swim (800 meter).

3) 5K Run (3.1 miles)

4) Kid's Swim/Run (100m swim, .2.5K Run)

5) Kid's Run (2.5K Run)

 

Events starts at 6:30 PM sharp, so be at the Park (UCSB side) early to pickup timing chip, and bib number.

Bring your own swim cap if you need one.

All events are professionally RFID chip-timed and results will be posted online with 5-year Age Groups and Overall standings.

Parking is FREE!

This is a 8-week event that runs every Tuesday through Jun 23-Aug 11.

Must sign up each week!

 

ONLINE REGISTRATION ONLY!

name: Granite Bay 5K & 10K
description:
New Name, New Trails, Same Community Heart: Welcome to the Granite Bay 5K!
The tradition you love is back—but with a fresh look and more ways to move!

This year, we are thrilled to officially rebrand our annual event as the Granite Bay 5K. While our name has changed, our mission to support the Eureka Union School District remains the heartbeat of every step we take.

Join us for an electric morning of fitness and fun on Sunday, September 13th, 2026! With over 1,000 participants cheering and running together, this is Granite Bay’s premier community event. Whether you're chasing a personal best in the 10K, enjoying a scenic stroll with the family in the 5K, or cheering on the little ones in the ¼-Mile Kids Race, every single step you take directly supports the Eureka Schools Foundation (ESF).

name: GRANITE BAY TURKEY TROT 3K/6K
description:
DESCRIPTION:

6k: Clockwise, then Counter-Clockwise

Thursday, November 26th, 2026

 

Time:

7:30am - 6k

8:00am - 3k

  

Location: 

Wellington Way, in front of

Granite Bay High School,

#1 Grizzly Way,

Granite Bay, CA 95746

GBHS Parking lot, or on the street along Wellington Way

Cost:
$35.00 early bird 07/31/2026-09/30/2026

$45.00 regular 10/01-10/31

$50.00 late 11/01-11/25 

No Race Day Registration! 

No Refunds unless extenuating circumstances (email me a love letter for refund consideration). 

Additional online processing fee 

bib, t-shirt, medal, CHIP timing, post-race snacks, and water and age group awards!

Course will be lightly traffic controlled by CHP and/or PCSO.

11am-6pm

Fieldhaven Feline Center, Lincoln

name: Graniterock River Run
description:
Please join us for the River Run back for a great 6th year in 2026.   A family-friendly event that will be fun for everyone!  You'll be able to run or walk a 5K distance or a 1Mile untimed fun run.

The River Run 2026 is a unique experience that meanders through a working sand and gravel quarry.  The events take you inside the Southside Sand and Gravel Quarry to see the working quarry site, the banks of the San Benito River, specialized equipment that processes the rock, and beautiful natural surroundings.

River Run benefits the YMCA of San Benito County and begins promptly at 8:00 a.m. on Saturday, September 12th 2026. Check in begins at 7:00am.

Pricing is available for individuals or families.  The family pricing option is available for families/groups of 4 or more participants. 

 The event is located the the Graniterock Sand and Gravel Quarry at 5632 Airline Highway, Hollister, CA 95023. Free parking is available at the race site.

name: Green Valley Lake 5k/10k/& Half Marathon
description:
🌲 GREEN VALLEY LAKE 5K / 10K / HALF MARATHON
Saturday, August 1st, 2025
Green Valley Lake, CA (Between Running Springs & Big Bear in the San Bernardino Mountains)

 
🕖 START TIMES
7:00 AM: Early Start Half Marathon (for those expecting to take 3.75+ hours)
7:30 AM: Standard Half Marathon Start
8:30 AM: Mass Start for 5K & 10K
 
🏞 COURSE HIGHLIGHTS
This is a breathtaking mountain race in the heart of the San Bernardino National Forest!

Start with a scenic ¾-mile out-and-back along the lake
Climb gradually up Green Valley Lake Rd and onto a forest service road
Enjoy a 400 ft elevation gain to an overlook at the 5K turnaround
10K and Half Marathon continue along rolling terrain on FS Road 2N13, through pine forests and rocky vistas
Course is part paved (1.5 miles), then transitions to dirt roads and trail
Water & aid stations every 1.5 miles
Get ready for that fresh air, mountain-made, above-the-clouds experience!

 
📍 LOCATION
Green Valley Lake – Just 40 minutes from Redlands, located off Hwy 18 between Lake Arrowhead and Big Bear.

Post-race activities take place in the Downtown Community Garden on Main Street.
Race HQ / Packet Pickup: Black Dog Social Club, 33231 Green Valley Lake Rd.

 
🥇 WHAT YOU GET
Custom, high-quality event t-shirt
Unique, huge finisher medal
Top 3 overall awards per race distance
Age group medals (3 deep in 5-year spans up to 80+)
Chip timing by Itz About Time
🏆 Age Groups:
10 & under, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80+
(Separate overall awards for each race distance.)

 
🏁 AWARDS CEREMONY – COMMUNITY GARDEN
9:15 AM – 5K Awards
9:30 AM – 10K Awards
9:45 AM – Half Marathon Awards
 
🧁 FOOD & FUN
Coffee ,pastries , street tacos, and more available for purchase packet pickup and race morning
Food available for purchase post-race
Live music at the Community Garden post-race
Hang out in a welcoming mountain community with big hometown vibes
 
🎽 PACKET PICKUP
Friday, July 31 3:00 PM – 6:30PM @ Black Dog Social Club
Saturday (Race Day): 6:30 AM – 8:30 AM @ Race Site
 
🏕 STAY THE WEEKEND
Make it a full mountain getaway!

Airbnbs in Green Valley Lake
Green Valley Lake Campground (0.5 miles from race) 
Giant Oaks Lodge, Running Springs (5 miles)
Rentals available at: green-valley-lake.com
 
🌅 FRIDAY NIGHT SUNSET RUN (Optional Add-On)
Friday, August 1 at 7:00 PM – Sunset Trail 5K
A fun, scenic, single-track 3.1-mile warm-up trail run.
💌 Email: carenfasttrack@aol.com to sign up.

 
🚴‍♀️ WANT TO RENT MOUNTAIN OR E-BIKES?
Visit Mountain Life Supply Co.
32855 Hilltop Blvd, Running Springs (past Valero Gas Station on right)

 
🌲 GIVING BACK
Proceeds benefit The Children’s Forest via the Southern California Mountains Foundation, empowering youth to become leaders in environmental stewardship.

Your support helps:

Train young Forest Rangers, Firefighters & Scientists
Maintain trails like The Exploration Trail
Support the Camacho family in memory of their daughter
We also proudly support:

The Green Valley Lake Community Garden (host of our awards)
The Local Museum, providing water support on the course
🙏 Donations welcome – Hit the "DONATE" button at registration!

 
FINAL NOTES
This is a scenic mountain course – come for the run, stay for the views!
A perfect escape from the summer heat and city smog
Come experience the camaraderie and community like no other!

name: Grievances & Gratitude Run – New Year Reset 5K 10K Half Marathon
description:
Grievances & Gratitude Run


Release. Move. Begin Again.

Skip the resolutions. Start the year with intention, movement, and joy.

Grievances & Gratitude is a feel-good New Year run designed to help you exhale, reset, and step into 2026 lighter—surrounded by community, movement, and positive energy. This is about letting go of what no longer serves you and making space for gratitude, clarity, and forward momentum.

You can write down everything you’re ready to release… or just one thing. You can take part in the experience—or simply show up and run. However you choose to participate, this event meets you exactly where you are.

Every participant receives a finisher medal, and the option to take part in our signature Let Go & Affirmation Experience—because new beginnings don’t have to be loud or rigid. Sometimes they just need movement and space to breathe.

 
How It Works
Let Go Before You Go
Before the run, write down anything you’re ready to release—grievances, frustrations, stress, or heavy thoughts. Place them into our “goodbye” containers and symbolically leave that energy behind.

Run Free
Head out on a scenic course and move your body with intention. Run or walk at your own pace, clear your mind, and let each step carry you forward.

Affirmations Await
After crossing the finish line, visit our New Year Mantra Board and select a positive affirmation to guide you into the year ahead. Leave with gratitude, purpose, and renewed energy.

This isn’t just a race—it’s a moment. A reset. A fresh start grounded in movement and community.

 
Why CaliFlow Runs?
CaliFlow Runs creates inclusive, high-energy, community-driven events that celebrate you. Our races are accessible, joyful, and thoughtfully designed to support physical and emotional well-being—without pressure, pretension, or upsells.

✨ Professionally chip-timed
✨ USATF-certified courses
✨ Free race-day photos
✨ No forced shirts. No gimmicks. Just good vibes.

 
Who Can Participate?
Everyone is welcome.
Runners • Walkers • Strollers • First-timers • Seasoned athletes
This event is for anyone ready to move into the new year with intention.

 
Course Information
Our courses are open, meaning you’ll share the path with other runners, walkers, and beachgoers. Please stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path at all times.

✔️ Clearly marked course
✔️ 3 on-course water stations
✔️ Restrooms available along the route
✔️ Friendly staff and volunteers throughout

 
Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent

Start Times:
• Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
• 5K & 10K: 7:30 AM

 
Start Location
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd
Long Beach, CA 90803

 
Parking Information
• Free street parking available
• Metered parking: $2.00 per hour

 
Awards
🏅 Top 3 men and women in each distance receive awards
🎤 Podium ceremony at 9:00 AM

 
Start 2026 grounded, grateful, and moving forward—together.
Come for the run. Stay for the release. Leave lighter.

name: Griffith Park Resolution Run
description:
Celebrate The New Year With Us! Join us for 2027 and help us make it even better! We're giving out some goodies to the first couple registrations so don't miss out and register now! 

Our Half Marathon course is roughly 90% on a trail with the remaining 10% on asphalt. Below is a quick overview of the course.

The start of the course is at Shane's Inspiration in Griffith Park.
Mile 1: Upper Old Zoo Trail
Mile 2: Bill Eckert Trail (Hills with beautiful views!)
Miles 3-5: Mainly downhill on asphalt
Miles 6-8: Rolling Hills (Tetris)
Mile 9: All downhill
Miles 10-13: Quick flat trail to the finish!

Our 12K shares the same start line as the Half Marathon.
Miles 1-3: You will pass through the old Griffith Park Zoo and zoom through some hills
Mile 4: All downhill
Miles 5-7+: Quick flat trail to the finish!

Our 5K is a nice and quick route around the golf course.

15K Relay
Create a team of 3 and each run a 5K loop. Compete in any of our 3 divisions for the relay!
Coed, Male, Female

name: Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K
description:
Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K, an unforgettable race experience celebrated as one of Runner’s World magazine’s 10 Best Races You’ve Never Heard Of in 2024! This iconic event is the perfect opportunity to push yourself, bond with friends, and take in the breathtaking beauty of Griffith Park. With a combination of scenic trails and challenging terrain, you’ll be in for the ride of your life. Whether you’re a seasoned runner or just starting out, join us for a solo run or bring a team for a relay. And with fully-stocked aid stations and an energetic volunteer crew, you’ll have everything you need to crush it. So come on, grab your running shoes, and let’s make this a moment to remember! Register now for a day of adventure, camaraderie, and lasting memories.
One of the largest urban parks in the country, Griffith Park is a 4,300-plus acre slice of runner heaven. The grounds include famous sites like the Abandoned Los Angeles Zoo, the Observatory, and the Hollywood Sign. There’s more than 30 trails totaling around 50 miles for runners and hikers. Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Relay Marathon and get a taste of what the second largest city park has to offer.
  • All participants will receive a premium short sleeve women's or men's cut t-shirt. (Guaranteed shirt size if you register by May 17!)
  • Relay run is chip timed for fast & accurate results.
  • $1500 in Cash prizes for the Open division (Relay only)
  • Trophy/Plaque for the top 3 teams in each recreational division
  • Finisher’s medal for all participants
  • Limited Edition Badges (Relay Only)
  • 3 well supported aid stations with medical staff (2 on course, 1 at start/finish)
  • Food and refreshments at the start/finish area.
  • Music from multiple live DJs
  • Multiple Food Trucks
  • Access to the exclusive GPTMR packet pickup sale and raffle at Fleet Feet Burbank

name: Grill Skills
description: Own your grilling skills by making Butter Steak, BBQ Chicken and Apple Pie. This class will teach you all you need to know about creating the perfect summer cookout for your friends and family.

name: Grizzly Gravel & Century Charity Ride
description: All profit from this event go to fund the Sierra Vista Scenic Byway Association, so it only makes sense that the featured routes of the event spotlight the Scenic Byway. Weather you’re riding the new Gravel routes we added a few year ago, or the classic traditional paved routes of the Century & Metric Road rides, you’ll be experience the beauty, tranquility & adventure of the Sierra National Forest. Obviously the dirt sections of the gravel routes see almost zero vehicles, but the paved route also see very few cars! So wheather you choose the grueling Century with it’s 10,000’ of elevation gain, gorgeous views of Eagles Beak, Globe Rock, or Mile High overlook as you climb up to Beasore Meadows, or if you choose the Gravel Route  it’s 60+ miles 6,000’ of gain up Central Camp Rd through the lush forest, which also climbs to Beasore, you’ll no doubt be treated to expansive views of lakes, numerous granite domes, & many lush meadows. If you want your day to be a bit easier, the paved road riders can do the Metric Century, which climbs the same road as the regular century, but is simply a 22 mile OAB to North Fork, then a CCW loop around Bass Lake. Gravel riders opting for an easier day can follow the main Gravel ride up Central Camp Rd, do a “lollipop loop” merging back onto Central Camp & descend back down to Bass Lake. Or if you're interested in a much easier ride try the 25 mile Loop the Lake ride. There's a challenging ride for everyone! All 5 routes go right past the iconic Bass Lake Millers Landing. There you’re free to stop in for a free beer then the short pedal back into North Fork where you’ll be treated to an include free Post Ride meal & another free beer, yippee!  Although we can’t guarantee great weather, the Weatherman rarley dissapoints on that first Saturday in October! Come on out, let’s play bikes, meet some new friends, & enjoy our beautiful forest. (This ride is by permit of the USFS).

Come on out, let’s play bikes, meet some new friends, & enjoy our beautiful forest. (This ride is by permit of the USFS).

name: Grizzly Gravel & Century Charity Ride
description: All profit from this event go to fund the Sierra Vista Scenic Byway Association, so it only makes sense that the featured routes of the event spotlight the Scenic Byway. Weather you’re riding the new Gravel routes we added a few year ago, or the classic traditional paved routes of the Century & Metric Road rides, you’ll be experience the beauty, tranquility & adventure of the Sierra National Forest. Obviously the dirt sections of the gravel routes see almost zero vehicles, but the paved route also see very few cars! So wheather you choose the grueling Century with it’s 10,000’ of elevation gain, gorgeous views of Eagles Beak, Globe Rock, or Mile High overlook as you climb up to Beasore Meadows, or if you choose the Gravel Route  it’s 60+ miles 6,000’ of gain up Central Camp Rd through the lush forest, which also climbs to Beasore, you’ll no doubt be treated to expansive views of lakes, numerous granite domes, & many lush meadows. If you want your day to be a bit easier, the paved road riders can do the Metric Century, which climbs the same road as the regular century, but is simply a 22 mile OAB to North Fork, then a CCW loop around Bass Lake. Gravel riders opting for an easier day can follow the main Gravel ride up Central Camp Rd, do a “lollipop loop” merging back onto Central Camp & descend back down to Bass Lake. Or if you're interested in a much easier ride try the 25 mile Loop the Lake ride. There's a challenging ride for everyone! All 5 routes go right past the iconic Bass Lake Millers Landing. There you’re free to stop in for a free beer then the short pedal back into North Fork where you’ll be treated to an include free Post Ride meal & another free beer, yippee!  Although we can’t guarantee great weather, the Weatherman rarley dissapoints on that first Saturday in October! Come on out, let’s play bikes, meet some new friends, & enjoy our beautiful forest. (This ride is by permit of the USFS).

name: Half Moon Bay Beach Safety Run
description:
The Half Moon Bay Beach Safety Run will take place on Saturday, September 19 at the Pillar Point Harbor in Half Moon Bay, located at 1 Johnson Pier, Half Moon Bay, CA 94019.

This destination event will host 2 Mile, 5K (3.1 mile) and 10K (6.2 mile) courses that will showcase the beautiful Pacific coastline of Half Moon Bay, Pillar Point Harbor and its docks of colorful fishing boats, ever-present ocean views from the Pillar Point Marsh Trail, and of course the refreshing salty sea breeze. A noncompetitive Kids Fun Run (1/4 Mile) for ages 10 and under will conclude the morning.

2025 Race Results: Link here

The event is organized by and a benefit for the Arunay Foundation, who is committed to reducing beach accidents and coastal drownings by raising awareness and educating people about sneaker waves, rip currents, and other hazardous beach conditions. Their goal is to equip our beaches with “Life Rings” and keep our communities informed about unsafe weather conditions. Learn more about their mission and projects: Click here.

As a community, we cannot make a difference without your support and help.  Together, we can raise awareness and make our beaches safer. All proceeds from this event will be used by the Arunay Foundation to support their programs that improve beach safety.  

The Arunay Foundation was created to transform grief into purpose—raising awareness about the very real dangers of sneaker waves and educating others on beach and ocean safety. Most beachgoers are unaware that sneaker waves on the West Coast claim more lives annually than all other weather-related hazards combined.

The rugged coasts of California, Oregon, and Washington, though breathtakingly beautiful, can be perilous. Arunay's parents didn’t know the risks—what sneaker waves were, how to recognize hazardous conditions, or what life-saving actions to take. They believe that with the right awareness and resources, such losses can be prevented.

Guided by Arunay’s light, their mission is to ensure that a day at the beach always ends with laughter—not loss.

The Arunay Foundation is a registered 501(c)3 nonprofit organization (EIN: 87-3499812). All donations to Arunay Foundation are tax-deductible.

name: Half-Marathon Training for Fun & Fitness
description:
-Registration opens on June 1st and will remain open until August 1st. You need to join Sierra TrailBlazers to participate in the training due to insurance requirements. Your membership is for 1 year AND you will get a discount when signing up for Champion Mine as a member!

-Orientation night will be July 24th @6pm at the Trkac Store, just past Target, in Grass Valley CA.

-Runners will be provided with a 10-week guided training plan designed to help the runner gain confidence and fitness to tackle a half marathon.

-Beginning on July 26th, every Sunday morning will be dedicated to the long run. We will meet at different trailheads to discover scenic routes, have fun, build confidence on the trails, and connect with a community of fellow runners. Refreshments will be provided following the run each Sunday. 

-Learning more about running and techniques on how to best achieve your running goals.

-Ideally, runners interested in training, should be able to comfortably run a 5K and log at least 6 miles a week to begin their half-marathon quest.

-If runners are new to the trails or simply want to increase their distance, this training is perfect in preparation for their first, or 6th half-marathon race and beyond!

-All participants are encouraged to utilize the Sierra TrailBlazers weekly runs to supplement their training with group support.

-Each runner will be given a training plan to follow and adapt to their lives and needs as they train to race and enjoy the Champion Mine Trail Race or any half-marathon during the fall of 2026.

-Train-for-fun code can be used if you and your running buddy sign up at the same time for the Half Marathon training, save $10 for both!

name: Hallo-Thanks-Mas Dash – 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
One race. Three holidays. Endless vibes. Why pick just one when you can run through spooky season, gratitude, and holiday cheer all at once? The stores do it, now it’s our turn. Hallo-Thanks-Mas Dash is the ultimate mashup of fright, feast, and festivity!

Details

Start Location: Embarcadero Marina Park South, San Diego – Google Maps

Parking: Embarcadero Marina Park South offers on-site parking that is $2.50/hour between 10am and 8pm. There is also metered parking in the area.

Event Schedule

6:00am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
6:30am – Half marathon start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:00am – Course closes (3 hours, 30 minutes for the Half)

Out and Back Course

A 5k route is used for each race – route here

More About the Course

Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must be considerate to other park and path users.

On-course support: Courses have water stations along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!

Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.

Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.

Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Reach out to events@hightideruns.com.

name: Halloween Trick or Trot Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎃 👻 Trick or Trot! 👻 🎃
Run in our annual Halloween Run, where healthy fitness meets frightful fun! We'll even give you some free Halloween candy after your run! Find a friend, set a goal, and join this unique 5K, 10K, or 13.1 Half-Marathon run!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: HART PARK AFTER HOURS SERIES
description:
🏁 Hart Park After Hours Series

Part of the RSCR series

Presented by Team Action Dad

Get off work and get after it.

The Hart Park After Hours Series is a 6-week, Thursday night race series in the heart of Bakersfield at Hart Memorial Park. This laid-back but competitive series features alternating weekly events—mountain biking and 5K running—designed for all fitness levels.

Whether you're chasing a podium, building fitness, or just looking for something fun to do after work, this series delivers a fast, social, and family-friendly race environment.

 
📅 Series Schedule (Thursdays)
Sept 3 – MTB
Sept 10 – 5K Run
Sept 17 – MTB
Sept 24 – 5K Run
Oct 1 – MTB
Oct 8 – 5K Run (Finale)
 
⏱️ Start Times
September Events: 6:15 PM
October Events: 6:00 PM
Races start on time. Please arrive early to check in.

 
🚴 MTB Format
Short track style course (approx. 1–2 mile loop)
20 minutes + 1 lap
Beginner to advanced riders welcome
 
🏃 5K Run
Fast, fun 5K course
Mass start
Great for all levels—from first-timers to competitive runners
 
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Who It’s For
Mountain bikers
Runners
Families and kids
Anyone looking for a fun, active Thursday night
 
🏆 Series Info
Points awarded each race
Compete in individual disciplines or both
Overall awards at the final event
 
🎉 The Vibe
This isn’t just a race—it’s a weekly hangout.
Expect music, community, and a fun atmosphere at the start/finish each week.

 
⚠️ Additional Info
Helmets required for MTB
Please bring lights for later season events (especially October)
Limited daylight—events will run on schedule
 
Come out, bring your crew, and make Thursday nights at Hart Park part of your routine.

After work. All out.

name: Harvest Hustle – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
It's the Harvest Hustle, let's boogie! Welcome to our beautiful course at Hansen Dam Recreational Area!

Details

Start Location: Hansen Dam Recreation Area Ranger Station, 11770 Foothill Blvd., Lake View Terrace, CA
Parking: There are multiple free parking lots near the start

Event Schedule

6:30am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Course

5k & 10k – this 5k route is used for the 5k (done once), 10k (done twice)
Half Marathon – this 4.4-mile route is used for the half marathon (done 3 times)

More About the Course: This is an out and back course. Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations along the way.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Email us at events@hightideruns.com

name: Health is Wealth 5K by Panacea Holistic Institute
description:
Health is Wealth 5K & Wellness Expo
Walk • Jog • Run • Move
Sunday, August 16, 2026
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA

You Don't Have To Be A Runner To Belong Here.
Have you been wanting to get healthier?

Looking for a reason to start walking more?

Want to spend a beautiful morning outdoors with friends, family, your dog, or your kids?

The Health is Wealth 5K was created for YOU.

This isn't just a race. It's a celebration of movement, wellness, community, and taking that first step toward a healthier life.

Whether you run, jog, walk, push a stroller, or simply come to enjoy the wellness expo, you'll be welcomed into a supportive and encouraging environment where everyone belongs.

No experience needed.

No pace requirements.

No pressure.

Just movement.

Why This Event Is Different
Most races focus on speed.

Health is Wealth focuses on feeling better.

Our flat, beginner-friendly Long Beach course follows the beautiful coastline and is perfect for first-time participants. Walk the entire 5K, jog a little and walk a little, or run your heart out—the choice is yours.

Bring your family.

Bring your friends.

Bring your dog.

Bring your kids.

Start a new healthy tradition together.

Wellness Expo & Healing Experience
Before and after the 5K, explore our Wellness Expo featuring:

🌿 Holistic Health Practitioners

🧘 Yoga & Movement Demonstrations

💆 Massage & Recovery Services

🥗 Wellness Vendors

✨ Mindfulness & Healing Resources

💚 Community Health Organizations

Learn practical ways to support your health through movement, recovery, nutrition, stress management, and holistic wellness.

Race Day Schedule
🕖 7:00 AM — Check-In & Wellness Expo Opens

🏃 8:00 AM — 5K Walk/Run Begins

🏆 9:00 AM — Awards Ceremony

🕙 10:00 AM — Event Concludes

Every Registration Includes

✅ Finisher Medal
✅ Flat & Fast Coastal 5K Course

✅ Professional Chip Timing

✅ Free Race Photos

✅ Overall & Age Group Awards

✅ Water Station at the Pier

✅ Wellness Expo Access

✅ Dog Friendly

✅ Stroller Friendly

✅ Beginner Friendly

Because Health Isn't About Being Perfect.
It's about showing up.

One walk.

One run.

One healthy choice at a time.

Join us on June 28 and discover why movement truly is medicine.

Health is Wealth.

name: Heart of Cool Trail Run
description:
Are you looking for a fun run for a great cause? If so, HoC 5k, 10k and half marathon is just what you are looking for!  Proceeds from this race support programs funded through Georgetown Divide Ready by 21, Inc. (GDRB21).  It is a nonprofit organization that brings together committed partners who understand youth development and are moving forward to support the youth in our community. We work with many partners throughout the Georgetown Divide and El Dorado county. In addition, a percentage of the funds will also be used to scholarship a child to attend Camp Taylor, a camp specifically designed for youth with heart disease. 

Register by September 30 to receive a HoC shirt with registration.  All half marathon participants receive something new for 2026 (TBD).  Check out our Instagram or Facebook page for a photo of the design, once it is launched.

This is a family friendly event and we highly encourage you to bring the whole family!  We offer a family discount package for immediate family members for the 5k and 10k distance!  If you want to participate in the event without your child, take advantage of our $8 per child - child care for children ages 3 and up!  We will have a post race pancake breakfast. 

The Heart of Cool Trail Run traverses some of the best trails Cool, CA and the Sierra Foothills have to offer.  Run on the same trails as many of the famous local (and world renowned) events such as Western States 100 Mile, Way too Cool 50k, Rio Del Lago 100 Mile, and many more!

To reduce waste and the possibility of littering our trails, this will be a cup free event.  Be sure to bring a cup or water bottle that can be refilled at aid stations.

Packet and bib pick up will be on Race Day.

Registration will be available online until the start of each event!

We can always use volunteers for this event. If you are able to lend a hand during the race, or the day before, please click on the Volunteer tab.

name: Heartfelt Fun & Run
description:
Heartfelt Help Foundation is hosting our fourth annual virtual 5k!  Hike, bike, run, walk, swim or dance!  However you move, move with us and raise needed funds to help heart transplant recipients right here in Northern California pay for the costs associated with transplant that insurance doesn't cover.  This includes our lodging program, providing temporary recovery housing when their doctors require it, their insurance doesn't cover it, and they can't afford it, and our new program, Axel's Helping Hand to help heart transplant patients and their families in Northern California with costs that are non-medical, but patients and families are unable to pay due to loss of income related to their transplant.  This includes overdue rent, car payments, utilities and much more.  We believe that financial stability leads to family stability which ultimately leads to the health of the patient and longevity of their new heart.

HHF ensures Equity and Access for heart transplant recipients despite their personal financial limitations providing what is necessary to facilitate recovery, and helps patients return them home as soon and as strong as possible.  

Join us today wherever you are and let's move to provide help and hope for financially disadvantaged heart transplant patients!

Heartfelt Help Foundation is a 501(c)3 nonprofit organization in good standing.  All donations over and above the event registration fee are fully tax deductible to the extent allowed by law.

Early Registration Bonus!  Register yourself and five friends by August 29th and receive a $20.00 refund!

name: Heroes 4 Hearing 5K
description:
Avoid lines on race day:

Pick Up Your Bib and shirt on Saturday August 16th at Sports Basement from 11am to 1pm.

Place

Shoreline Aquatic Park
200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802



HearAid Foundation presents our 4th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 17th on the water front, behind the aquarium, in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. All participants who register by July 25th are guaranteed to receive a t-shirt, and ALL participants are guaranteed to have lots of fun!

Join us for an exhilarating run through the marina and along the shore with views of the Queen Mary in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the shoreline.

Event Details:

Location: Shoreline Aquatic Park, 200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8:00 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Parking Available a short walk away at the multi-level aquarium parking lot. Fees in the lot are by the hour, click this link for more details.


Course Map: https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6274860286/

Course Description:

The race starts and ends behind the aquarium, next to Pierpont Landing.

5k runners will follow the scenic path around along the marina, through Shoreline Village and out along the jetty where you will have a majestic view of the Queen Mary before heading back to the start.

Water station will be at the entrance to the jetty and you can stop here twice during the run/walk if you need to.

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results will be posted on our website within 12 hours of the race.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff.

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup within 12 hours of the race.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity. 


Who Can Register:

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!
We look forward to seeing you in Long Beach for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

name: Hollywood Sign Run | Hike - 8M | 8K | 5K | Kid
description:
Experience the thrill of the Hollywood Sign Run/Hike in Griffith Park—now featuring a scenic out-and-back course to the Hollywood Sign Viewpoint! Take in sweeping views of Downtown Los Angeles, the Griffith Observatory, and a stunning close-up of the world-famous Hollywood Sign.
Whether you're a seasoned trail runner or a hiking enthusiast, this event offers an unforgettable adventure for all levels. Traverse iconic trails, soak in the natural beauty of the park, and connect with fellow outdoor lovers along the way.
Challenge yourself, take in the views, and be part of an inspiring day in one of L.A.’s most legendary landscapes.
 
All participants receive the following items and perks:
  • Picturesque, scenic, and well marked out and back courses
  • Panoramic views of the Observatory, Downtown Los Angeles, and an up close view of the Hollywood Sign (8M Only)
  • Stunning views of Glendale, DreamWorks Campus, and the Los Angeles River
  • Enjoy unparalleled views of the San Fernando Valley, Warner Bros. Studios, and the Disney Animation Building. Plus a special turn-around at Cathy’s Corner, the iconic film location from the Academy Award-winning movie La La Land.(8K only)
  • Ultra-soft, ultra-comfy premium gender specific short sleeve t-shirt*
  • Unique Finisher’s medal for all participants
  • Special award for Overall and Age Grade Division Winners
  • Prize from our sponsors for overall winners
  • Free Photos (w/ Mt. Lee and the Hollywood Sign, the Observatory, and DTLA, 8M Only)
  • Fast and accurate chip time results
  • Course Aid Stations (1-4) with medical staff
  • Volunteer Support
  • Gear check
  • Finish Line Fruit, Snacks, and Refreshments
  • Flexible deferral and transfer options
 
*Guaranteed T-Shirt Size Deadline is January 5th, Men or Women's cut

name: Hop Skip and Splash 5K Fun Run/Walk
description:
Hop, Skip & Splash 5K Fun Run/Walk

Making Waves for Water Safety in Orange County

Join us on Sunday, October 25, 2026, for the 4th annual Hop, Skip & Splash 5K — a fun, family-friendly beachside fundraiser benefiting swim lessons and water safety education for children throughout Orange County and beyond.

Last year we welcomed 200 participants and raised $30,000 to expand access for local families! 

Your $50 registration covers swim lessons for one child. This is the average cost of 4-8 classes at a local city or county pool. Whether you run, walk, or skip across the finish line, your participation helps save lives by supporting families who lack access to these life-saving resources!

Stay Up to Date and Follow Along

@hopskipsplash5k

Race Details: 

  • Location: Beach parking lot at PCH and Huntington Street
  • Check-in opens at 8:00am (Free coffee provided!)
  • Race starts at 9:00am
  • Scenic coastal course with ocean views

What to Expect:

  • Event T-shirt included with registration 
  • Register by October 4 to guarantee your T-Shirt size
  • Stroller-friendly course
  • Dogs welcome on the boardwalk (not on the sand)
  • This is not a timed race, but 1st-3rd place finishers will receive a prize! 

Post Race Activities:

  • Free pancake breakfast from Huntington Beach Firefighters
  • Live music from Crew-52, our local HB Lifeguard Band
  • Fun activities for kids
  • Raffles
  • Vendor Village
  • Meet real Olympians!

Team Registration: Get $10 off when you grab your friends, family and/or coworkers- it's more fun together! 

  • Teams include 2 or more participants
  • Create or join a team during registration
  • The first team member to register will be reimbursed once another member joins
  • Great for schools, businesses and community groups! 

Virtual Runners: Can't make it in person? You can still be part of the impact! 

  • Complete your 5k wherever you are
  • Optional event T-shirt with shipping available
  • Run, Walk or skip on your own time while supporting water safety!
  • Take a photo and tag us on Instagram @hopskipsplash5k

Parking Information:

  • Enter via PCH and Beach Blvd
  • Parking available on-site in the city lot next to the event ($10-$15)

Sponsorship Opportunities Available
Interested in supporting the event or promoting your organization?
Email info@jasperray.org for details

This event is proudly presented by the Jasper Ray Foundation in partnership with the Orange County Drowning Prevention Coalition.
Together, we’re working to ensure every child in Orange County and beyond has access to life-saving swim lessons and water safety education.

Questions?
Contact us at info@jasperray.org

Jasper Ray Foundation

name: Hope in Every Step 5k
description:
Join us for the Hope in Every Step 5K Run/Walk, a community-driven event dedicated to spreading hope, resilience, and support for those in need. Whether you're a seasoned runner or taking your first steps toward a healthier lifestyle, this event is for everyone!

 

Set against the beautiful trails of Tuolumne River Regional Parkway, participants will run or walk a 3.1-mile course filled with encouragement, camaraderie, and a spirit of togetherness. Every step taken represents strength, perseverance, and the collective power of hope.

 

Proceeds from the event will benefit the Sole Support Sponsorship Program. Gather your friends and family, lace up your running shoes, and be part of a movement that turns every stride into a symbol of hope!
