name: Hot Pink Fun Run - Bubbles & Brews
description:
The Placer Breast Cancer Foundation is thrilled to host the Hot Pink Fun Run again— join us at the Hot Pink Bubbles & Brews Fun Run, offering a 5K, 10K, and 1‑mile option for participants of all levels.

Join us for early packet pickup on September 19 from 10 AM–1 PM, or grab your packet at the Registration booth starting at 7:30 AM on Race Day.

Returning Favorites:
Every participant will enjoy a tech shirt, medal, pancakes, and their choice of a beer or mimosa. Younger runners will receive a kid‑friendly drink.

Not running this year? You can still support the cause and enjoy pancakes and a beverage with a $20 donation.

A huge thank‑you to the Roseville Firefighters and Roseville Firefighters Local 1592, who will once again be cooking up our pancake breakfast.

Our Mission Remains the Same:
All proceeds directly support the Placer Breast Cancer Foundation and our work in breast cancer research, education, and community outreach.

name: Howl at the Moon – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
The moon lit the way — now it's our turn to shine! Come run, walk, or race your heart out at Howl at the Moon, an adventure fueled by full moon energy and summertime vibes. Gather your crew, unleash your inner wolf, and let’s make some noise under the wide open sky!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr, Long Beach
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday

1-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Sunday

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K
description:
Join us for our 9th Doggie Dash - the Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K! Run (or walk) with your pup to help LA Frontrunners raise funds for The Rescue Train & Angel City Pit Bulls!  All the details are below.  Pets are such a vital part of so many of our lives, so come race your heart out or take a stroll, and help us support two organizations whose missions are to care for pets in need and to make sure those who are struggling are able to care for and have their pets in their lives.

Location & Date
The Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K takes place on Saturday, October 31, in Griffith Park. Doggie Dash 5K starts at 8:30.  The start/finish area is the Park Center grassy area in Griffith Park. The 5K is one loop around the golf course and is trail/packed dirt and flat.

Course & Race Info
The start/finish area for Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K is in the Park Center grassy area in Griffith Park (diagonally across from the Griffith Park Visitor Center/Ranger Station). Look for us on the corner before the tennis courts.  This is also the standard Saturday meet-up location for LA Frontrunners.The 5K is one loop around the golf course. If this is your first 5K, 5 kilometers = 3.1 miles. The path is packed dirt and flat.

Start time is 8:30 AM - Pups & Human 5K: The main event is a 5K for pups (on leash) with their human. No solo humans allowed. Our race limit is 100 entries and there is no raceday registration. You can fly as fast as your pup pulls you or leisurely stroll the 5K around the golf course. There will be a water stop (for both you and your pup) about halfway through the 5K.

Doggie Howl-o-ween Costume Contest
Of course there's a costume contest! With prizes!

Beneficiaries
The Rescue Train: The Rescue Train is a unique, no-kill, animal-welfare organization based in Los Angeles. We are a small but mighty group of animal advocates, dedicated to making the world a kinder place for pets and the people who love them.  Since our inception in 2004, we have been recognized for our hard work: we labor in the trenches of our city and county shelters, find solutions to pet overpopulation and fight for the rights of animals. Thanks to our dedicated volunteers, we have saved thousands of animals from suffering and euthanasia.  Click HERE for therescuetrain.org.

Angel City Pit Bulls:  Angel City Pit Bulls takes in dogs (mainly from our local shelters) that fall under the generic term pit bull who demonstrate people-soft, responsive qualities and solid temperaments. Their adorableness and gushy love of people make them fantastic family dogs. We have a wide range of energy levels, so whether you are looking for a running partner or a potential “therapy dog”, we will typically have a dog that will fit the bill.  Click HERE for angelcitypits.org.

Pups & Human 5K Awards

name: Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K
description:
Join us for our 9th Doggie Dash - the Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K! Run (or walk) with your pup to help LA Frontrunners raise funds for The Rescue Train & Angel City Pit Bulls!  All the details are below.  Pets are such a vital part of so many of our lives, so come race your heart out or take a stroll, and help us support two organizations whose missions are to care for pets in need and to make sure those who are struggling are able to care for and have their pets in their lives.

Location & Date
The Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K takes place on Saturday, October 31, in Griffith Park. Doggie Dash 5K starts at 8:30.  The start/finish area is the Park Center grassy area in Griffith Park. The 5K is one loop around the golf course and is trail/packed dirt and flat.

Course & Race Info
The start/finish area for Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K is in the Park Center grassy area in Griffith Park (diagonally across from the Griffith Park Visitor Center/Ranger Station). Look for us on the corner before the tennis courts.  This is also the standard Saturday meet-up location for LA Frontrunners.The 5K is one loop around the golf course. If this is your first 5K, 5 kilometers = 3.1 miles. The path is packed dirt and flat.

Start time is 8:30 AM - Pups & Human 5K: The main event is a 5K for pups (on leash) with their human. No solo humans allowed. Our race limit is 100 entries and there is no raceday registration. You can fly as fast as your pup pulls you or leisurely stroll the 5K around the golf course. There will be a water stop (for both you and your pup) about halfway through the 5K.

Doggie Howl-o-ween Costume Contest
Of course there's a costume contest! With prizes!

Beneficiaries
The Rescue Train: The Rescue Train is a unique, no-kill, animal-welfare organization based in Los Angeles. We are a small but mighty group of animal advocates, dedicated to making the world a kinder place for pets and the people who love them.  Since our inception in 2004, we have been recognized for our hard work: we labor in the trenches of our city and county shelters, find solutions to pet overpopulation and fight for the rights of animals. Thanks to our dedicated volunteers, we have saved thousands of animals from suffering and euthanasia.  Click HERE for therescuetrain.org.

Angel City Pit Bulls:  Angel City Pit Bulls takes in dogs (mainly from our local shelters) that fall under the generic term pit bull who demonstrate people-soft, responsive qualities and solid temperaments. Their adorableness and gushy love of people make them fantastic family dogs. We have a wide range of energy levels, so whether you are looking for a running partner or a potential “therapy dog”, we will typically have a dog that will fit the bill.  Click HERE for angelcitypits.org.

name: HRC Rotary 4th of July 5K Family Fun Run
description:
Our 4th of July tradition! The Rodeo Hercules 4th of July 5K Run/Walk along the San Francisco Bay Trail!

 

Once again, our race is REVERSED this year! It will start July 4th at 9am. We will run/jog/walk the Northern portion of the San Francisco Bay Trail from Parker Ave in Rodeo to The Exchange in Hercules and back.

 

The event will be a chip timed 5K run/walk limited to 250 entrants. Early bird registration is $40 up to May 25th, then $50 up to 8:30 AM July 4th. Kids 5 and under are FREE!

Register by June 20th and your t-shirt size is set.  Register after that date and sized race t-shirts will be passed out during Race Packet pickup on a first-come basis.

Race Packet (bib/shirt) pick-up: Thursday 7/3 at Cafe Tapioca @ the Creekside Center (1581 Sycamore Avenue Hercules, CA) 5:00pm – 7:00pm.  Thursday at event @ 7:30am-8:30am

This years' Rodeo Hercules 4th of July 5K Run/Walk is presented by the Hercules/Rodeo/Crockett Rotary Club.

name: Huffin for the Stuffin- Turkey Trot  5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
🦃 3rd Annual Huffin’ for the Stuffin’


5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash
📅 Saturday, November 14, 2026
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
🥧 Every Turkey Trot deserves a head start!

 

 
🏃‍♀️ Race Overview
Get ready to gobble, wobble, and trot your way down the scenic Long Beach shoreline!
The 2nd Annual Huffin’ for the Stuffin’ is the perfect way to earn your pie early. Choose from the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon and enjoy the ocean views, holiday tunes, and feel-good vibes that’ll have you running with gratitude (and maybe a little gravy).

Whether you’re chasing a PR, trotting with your flock, or just here for the snacks — this race is for every pace, every age, and every turkey-loving runner in between.

 
🎁 What You Get
🏅 Finisher Medal (because you cranberry-lieve you did it!)
📸 Free Race Day Photos
🎶 DJ + Finish Line Festival
🍪 Post-Race Snacks & Treats
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations
⏱ Chip Timing on a USATF-Certified Course
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards

 
🎭 Costume Contest – Bring the Holiday Heat!
Dress to impress the turkeys out of us!


Prize Categories:

Most Creative Costume
Best Group / Family Theme
Funniest Turkey-Inspired Look
Whether you’re rocking a full bird suit, a pilgrim hat, or just festive socks — come strut your stuffin’!

 
🕒 Race Day Schedule
Bib Pick-Up/Runner Check In: 6:00 AM – 7:35 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
⚠️ No late starts — turkeys wait for no one!
 
🚗 Parking & Amenities
🅿️ Free Street Parking
💵 Beach Lot: $2/hour (via Passport app or pay station)
🚻 Restrooms Near Start Line
🚰 Water Stations Every 2 Miles
👶 Stroller & Walker Friendly
🏁 Fully Marked Scenic Course

 
☀️ Weather & Safety
This event is rain or shine — because turkeys don’t quit!
(We’ll only postpone for tsunamis, tidal waves, or a zombie turkey uprising 🧟‍♀️🦃 — you’ll get an email if that happens.)

 
🎉 Join the Flock!
Bring your crew, bring your feathers, and join us for a morning of miles, medals, and major gobbles!
Let’s make this the most festive trot on the coast.

🦃💨 Come Huff for the Stuff and Run for the Pie!

💫 A Quick Note
There are several races that take place in and around our Long Beach course locations — but there’s only one CaliFlow Runs. 🌊 We are not affiliated with any of them.


If you’re looking for an exceptional race experience with professional chip timing, free photos, well-organized staff, and that signature CaliFlow vibe, make sure you see the CaliFlow Runs name or logo before you register.


If it’s not CaliFlow, it’s just an "average"race.. ❤️

name: Hunter's Heart Foundation - A World Beyond Wheels 5K Walk, Run, Ride 2026
description:
HUNTER’S HEART FOUNDATION - A WORLD BEYOND WHEELS 5K

Join us for a fun and meaningful 5k run/walk as we raise critical funds to fight Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD).  DMD is a debilitating genetic disorder that weakens muscles over time. Children with DMD face a daily battle, and research for a cure is ongoing.  This 5k is your chance to make a difference! Portion of the proceeds from the race will benefit CureDuchenne, a non-profit organization dedicated to research and finding a cure for DMD

WHEN: Saturday, September 19, 2026, 10:00 am-1:00 pm

WHERE: Whittier Narrow Recreation Center, 750 S. Santa Anita Ave., South El Monte, CA 91733

How you can support: 

·       Register for the walk 

·       Create your own Champion peer-to- peer group and invite 5 or more people to raise $100 each.  

·       Donate to make a difference

·       Sponsorship available

You will receive Team/Sponsorship recognition showcasing participation on Hunter's Heart Foundation and CureDuchenne website and social media platforms.

Here's why you should participate: It's a great way to get active and have fun! Whether you're a seasoned runner or a casual walker, this event is for everyone.

You'll be making a real difference in the lives of children with DMD. Your participation will help fund critical research and program support.  It's a family-friendly event! Bring your whole crew to cheer you on and enjoy the festivities.  Register today and help us run towards a cure for DMD!!!!

REGISTRATION: 9:00AM

RACE STARTS:   10:00AM

Visit our website at www.hhdmd.org for additional information.

name: Huntington Lake Triathlon, 5k & 10k
description:
What will you find at the Huntington Lake triathlon?

+ Finisher's Medal
+ Event T-Shirt
+ Pancake breakfast
+ Rosa Brother's Chocolate Milk
+ Prizes and Giveaways
+ Complimentary Race Photos

The Huntington Lake Triathlon is a fun and challenging race in an incredible location in Lakeshore, CA near the China Peak Resort. This event features a lake swim in Huntington Lake, a challenging road bike course, and a ‘high altitude’ run, which is part trail and part paved, finishes the race. Each athlete registered for the Huntington Lake Triathlon will receive a custom t-shirt, athlete goody bag, swim cap, post-race meal, and be eligible for raffle prizes and race awards three-deep in each division. Take the weekend and come up and enjoy this fun event with your family.

Note: A USAT membership is required for the Triathlon, (but not the 5k/10k)  If you do not have one, you can purchase one during the registration process.

Parking: There is a $10 vehicle entrance fee.  We recommend car pooling if possible.

Volunteer: Earn a future discounted multisport or free run! Transferable and never expires.

name: HY5 NORCAL HYBRID CLASSIC
description:
NorCal Hybrid Classic

Get ready for an electrifying day of hybrid racing at the NorCal Hybrid Classic where endurance meets functional fitness in the ultimate test of strength, speed, and grit. Athletes will take on a professionally designed hybrid race experience featuring running intervals combined with 8 functional workout zones inspired by the globally recognized HYROX race format. Whether you’re racing solo, doubles, or relay, this event is built for competitors of all fitness levels looking to push their limits and experience the energy of race day competition.

All races will be professionally timed using ankle timing chip technology, with official finish times and running splits recorded and published after the event. Competitors can enter Pro and Age Group divisions across multiple categories including Individual, Doubles, Mixed Doubles, and 4-Person Relay.

To be eligible for prize money, Men and Women competitors must complete the Full Rox division at Pro weights for their gender category.

 

Race Divisions:


Full Rox
8 x 1km Runs
Full HYROX-style workout volume
Designed for experienced hybrid athletes seeking the complete race experience


Half Rox
8 x 500m Runs
Reduced workout volume
Perfect for first-time racers, speed-focused athletes, and those looking for a fast-paced hybrid challenge
 
Full Rox Workout Zones

Zone 1 - 1000m SkiErg
Zone 2 - 50m Sled Push
Zone 3 - 50m Sled Pull
Zone 4 - 80m Burpee Broad Jumps
Zone 5 - 1000m Row
Zone 6 - 200m Farmers Carry
Zone 7 - 100m Sandbag Lunges
Zone 8 - 100 Wall Balls

Half Rox Workout Zones

Zone 1 - 500m SkiErg
Zone 2 - 25m Sled Push
Zone 3 - 25m Sled Pull
Zone 4 - 40m Burpee Broad Jumps
Zone 5 - 500m Row
Zone 6 - 100m Farmers Carry
Zone 7 - 50m Sandbag Lunges
Zone 8 - 50 Wall Balls
 
Category Weights

Individual Pro Men:
Sled Push: 202kg / 445lbs
Sled Pull: 153kg / 337lbs
Farmers Carry: 32kg kettlebells
Sandbag Lunges: 30kg
Wall Ball: 9kg


Individual Pro Women:
Sled Push: 152kg / 335lbs
Sled Pull: 103kg / 227lbs
Farmers Carry: 24kg kettlebells
Sandbag Lunges: 20kg
Wall Ball: 6kg


Individual Open Men:
Sled Push: 152kg / 335lbs
Sled Pull: 103kg / 227lbs
Farmers Carry: 24kg kettlebells
Sandbag Lunges: 20kg
Wall Ball: 6kg


Individual Open Women:
Sled Push: 102kg / 225lbs
Sled Pull: 78kg / 172lbs
Farmers Carry: 16kg kettlebells
Sandbag Lunges: 10kg
Wall Ball: 4kg


Pro Men Doubles:
Same weights as Individual Pro Men
Partners may split reps/work as desired


Pro Women Doubles
Same weights as Individual Pro Women
Partners may split reps/work as desired


Open Men Doubles
Same weights as Individual Open Men
Partners may split reps/work as desired


Open Women Doubles
Same weights as Individual Open Women
Partners may split reps/work as desired
 

Mixed Doubles
Both Men and Women use Open Men weights
Partners may split reps and work however they choose throughout the race


Mixed Doubles Weights
Sled Push: 152kg / 335lbs
Sled Pull: 103kg / 227lbs
Farmers Carry: 24kg kettlebells
Sandbag Lunges: 20kg
Wall Ball: 6kg
 
4-Person Relay
The 4-Person Relay is designed for teams looking to experience the excitement of hybrid racing together. Teams of four athletes will divide the race however they choose, with each athlete completing:

2 Runs
2 Workout Zones
Athletes may strategize and assign zones based on team strengths, making relay racing fast-paced, competitive, and team-oriented from start to finish.

4-Person Relay Weights
Men:
Uses Open Men weightsSled Push: 152kg / 335lbs
Sled Pull: 103kg / 227lbs
Farmers Carry: 24kg kettlebells
Sandbag Lunges: 20kg
Wall Ball: 6kg


Women:
Uses Open Women weightsSled Push: 102kg / 225lbs
Sled Pull: 78kg / 172lbs
Farmers Carry: 16kg kettlebells
Sandbag Lunges: 10kg
Wall Ball: 4kg

Athlete Perks
- Professionally timed race results
- Official running split tracking
- Finisher patches for all participants
- Age Group podium flags for division winners
- High-energy race atmosphere with music, vendors, and community support

Biggest Team Award
Bring your crew and represent your gym. The NorCal Hybrid Classic will feature a Biggest Team Award for the gym or training group with the largest athlete turnout on race day.

name: Hyundai Hope On Wheels 5K and Color Fun Run
description:
The Annual Hyundai Hope On Wheels 5K is BACK—and bigger, brighter, and more impactful than ever! 🎉 Whether you join us in person or run virtually, this is your chance to make every step count in the fight against pediatric cancer while supporting incredible local non-profits right here in our community.

This year, you’ve got three exciting ways to participate:
🏃‍♂️ A certified 5K Run/Walk
🌈 A high-energy Color Fun Run
💻 A flexible Virtual 5K

And here’s the best part—every single registration fuels the mission. Your entry directly supports Hyundai Hope On Wheels, helping fund lifesaving pediatric cancer research, while also giving back to local charities serving the Fountain Valley community.

Race day takes you through the beautiful Fountain Valley Sports Park and the scenic Mile Square Regional Park, creating an unforgettable experience for runners, walkers, and families alike.

All in-person participants will receive:
👕 Official race shirt
🏅 Finisher medal
📸 Finish line photo
🎥 Finish line video
🎪 Access to the post-race expo celebration

So grab your friends, bring your family, and be part of something bigger than a race. Together, we run with purpose—to bring hope, fund research, and help end pediatric cancer.

 

Register for both the 5K Run and the Color Fun Run for only $40 for both races! 

*Discount will be applied at checkout*

 

Register before September 14th (at 12:00am) to guarantee your race-shirt!

 

As an added bonus, the school that has the most registrations will win a free movie night for their organization!

name: I Run They Learn
description:
Join us for community fun and help fundraise for Light of Life Trust. Our Mission is to improve the lives of low-income families in India by providing them with means to become self-sufficient. 

Every dollar you pay for registration, we get 1:1 match.

Agenda:
8.30 am - Prayers, Carnatic Music and Yoga
9.00 am - Run/Walk, Games
11.30 am - Bollywood Dance & Snack for purchase

PARTICIPANTS WILL GET A FREE SWAG

We work in underserved villages in India to educate, empower, and equip children with the tools for a better future. Educating, supporting, and involving parents increases our programs' retention rate and success. With our medical vans, vocational training, agricultural training, arts, and leadership training, we empower rural communities to work for a better future.

In 500 villages of India, we educate children. With a retention rate of 95% we are able to keep children out of child labor, trafficking, and poverty by giving them not just high school but also vocational training or college education. Our program supports them with annual physical and eye exams, leadership training, extra tutoring support, music and arts, plus nutrition. We are empowering them to not only study but they are motivated and excited to come back and serve their community or mentor other children. Many of the children in our programs are either orphans or single parents and all are from very low-income homes.

name: I'm Your Huckleberry 5K (Sponsored by AREC)
description:
We're excited to be hosting another one of our NIGHT races! And this will be our biggest one yet- we've got more spots than ever before! But don't wait- this race WILL sell out as our last races all did. 

Your $20 entry fee will get you this unique "I'm Your Huckleberry" medal and a neat finisher’s bib.

"I'm Your Huckleberry" means "I'm the right person for the job", "I'm the one you're looking for", or "I can handle this."

We KNOW you're the right person for the job of running this race and can absolutely handle this 5k! 

In addition to the finishers medal, we will also have additional medals for the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place male and female to finish. 

If you ran last our Earth Day race back in April (or any of our other races) you know exactly what’s in store! This is an out-and-back course right on the beach boardwalk alongside the sand and surf. The views are absolutely beautiful. We’ll meet right by the Belmont Brewing Company in Long Beach, at the start of Veterans' Pier, and head out on the beach path for a 5k. Bib pickup is between 6 pm and 6:30 pm.

Afterwards, runners will head inside BBC for food, drink, and laughter.

Results will be posted online within 36 hours of the event. This event counts for your Century Club totals, if you're a member of AREC.

RACE BACKGROUND:

This race is in honor of Val Kilmer, who died in April of 2025. The medal itself is a tribute to two of his most iconic movies: Top Gun (1986) where he played Iceman and Tombstone (1993) where he played Doc Holliday. Kilmer made his final film appearance in Top Gun: Maverick (2022), reprising his role from the original film. 

In 2015, Kilmer was diagnosed with throat cancer. A tracheal procedure damaged his vocal cords, leaving him unable to speak easily, and he also underwent chemotherapy and two tracheotomies. He released a memoir, I'm Your Huckleberry: A Memoir, in 2020 and a documentary titled Val the following year, both about his career and health struggles. He died of pneumonia on April 1, 2025, at the age of 65.

Films in which Kilmer appeared grossed more than $3.85 billion worldwide. In 1992, the film critic Roger Ebert remarked, "if there is an award for the most unsung leading man of his generation, Kilmer should get it". It's not quite an award, but on July 23rd, we'll help Kilmer be a little less unsung by honoring him in our "I'm Your Huckleberry 5K" race.

name: Independence Day Classic Event - 42nd Anniversary
description:
ABOUT THE EVENT

Join us on Saturday, July 4th, 2026, as the Santa Clarita Runners and sponsor Heritage Sierra proudly present the 42nd Annual Independence Day Classic— benefiting cross-country programs for the seven area high schools and other local non-profit organizations.

 

RACE INFO

  • Go to https://id5k.scrunners.org for more details.
  • To register, go to https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Newhall/IndependenceDayClassicEvent 
  • No dogs are allowed on the course during race. Bicyclists may not accompany runners.
  • Strollers are allowed for those participating in the run/walk and are required to begin at the back of the start to not impede faster runners.
  • It’s likely to be warm—hydrate! There will be a water station on the 5K course.

 

SHIRTS & GOODIES

  • 5K and Masters Mile Walk participants receive a high-quality technical shirt (100% micro-fiber) and a finisher's medal.
  • Kids K participants will receive a finisher's medal.
  • Pictures for FREE download after the race. (Link to photos will be provided, typically a few days following the race.) 
  • Race expo will be held following the races in the park.
  • Free Kona Ice will be available to all participants following the race during the expo.

 

RACE START TIMES/LOCATION

  • Kids K – Race Time: 7:15am
  • 5K – Race Time: 7:30am
  • Masters Mile Walk – Race Time: 7:35am, immediately following 5K start.

​

LOCATION

Newhall Park
24933 Newhall Avenue
Newhall, CA 91321

 

PACKET PICK-UP INFO

Friday, July 3rd  

  • Time: 3:00-8:00pm
  • Location: Boys & Girls Club of Santa Clarita, 24909 Newhall Avenue, Newhall, CA 91321 (Look for the inflatable arch!)

Saturday, July 4th 

  • Time: 6:00-7:00am for Kids K, 5K and Master's 1 Mile Walk
  • Location: Newhall Multi-Purpose Room, 24923 Newhall Avenue, Newhall, CA 91321 (Look for the inflatable arch!)

Runners are strongly encouraged to pick up their packets on July 3rd if possible.

 

NO Race Day Registration!

 

PARKING AND DROP-OFFS

Parking

  • Friday, July 3rd – Street parking is available for Wednesday’s Packet Pick-Up available near the Boys and Girls Club.
  • Saturday, July 4th – Parking is available but can be difficult with street closures and parade attendees. Ask about parking at Packet Pick-Up for additional recommendations. We suggest that you familiarize yourself with the locations and closures beforehand and also arrive early! 

Drop-Offs

  • Refer to the parking information above. Try to get as close as possible to Newhall Ave and Dalbey Drive for Drop-Offs.

 

COURSE INFORMATION

Kids K – The Kids K is a simple out-and-back course, beginning at the 5K start line on Dalbey Drive. Runners proceed west and turn around just before they reach Orchard Village Road. Dalbey Drive will be completely closed during the race.

5K – The 5K Course is fast, flat, and paved, starting on Dalbey Drive going west and proceeding to the City of Santa Clarita parade route, featuring one of the best cheering sections in SoCal! The turnaround point is in front of the library on Lyons Avenue.                

Masters Mile Walk – The Walk is a flat out-and-back course. The event will begin immediately after the 5K runners depart and will also proceed west on Dalbey Drive, turning left (south) on Orchard Village Road (along the Parade Route) until reaching the halfway point where walkers return to the starting point.

 

AWARDS                                                                                 

Overall and Team Awards

  • Team and Overall Awards will be presented during the expo on race day. Overall and Team Awards will be presented to the top finishers in the following categories.

OVERALL

  • Top male/female 5K finisher

TEAM

  • Fastest 5K (min. 5 runners)    NOTE: Top 5 finisher times will be used for calculating team results.
  • Most Participants across all events

 

Age Group Awards (5K only)

Age Group Awards can be picked up at the SCR tent on race day (near the Race Results tent).  5K AG Awards are based on chip time and will be provided to male and female 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers in the following age categories.

AGE GROUP AWARDS (Male & Female, 3-deep) – 5K:

  • 12 & under
  • 13-18
  • 19-24
  • 25-29
  • 30-34
  • 35-39
  • 40-44
  • 45-49
  • 50-54
  • 55-59
  • 60-64
  • 65-69
  • 70+

 

DEFERRALS, TRANSFERS & REFUNDS

Deferrals

  • The Independence Day Classic does not offer deferrals. However, registration can be transferred to another participant at no cost (see below). Additionally, race insurance can be purchased from RunSignUp at the time of registration.

 

Transfer Your Registration to Someone Else

  • The Independence Day Classic does allow what RunSignup refers to a "Gift Transfer," where the registrant gives their registration to another user, does not receive a refund, and the gift recipient is able to register for free. The Race does not charge a processing fee for "Gifting" a registration to another user.  If you would like to transfer your entry to a new runner using this method, please do so by Thursday July 2nd. 
  • Transfers are initiated from within RunSignup.

 

Refunds

  • The Independence Day Classic does not offer refunds. However, during registration you have the option to purchase race insurance which provides refunds when unforeseen things happen such as injuries.
  • Although consumers purchase through the RunSignup website, insurance provider RegShield is a third-party entity, and all plan-related questions should be directed to FanShield via email at help@fanshield.com.

The 5k race is fun for the whole family or seasoned runners who want to leave their family in the dust.

name: Independence from Hunger Walk / Run
description:
According to the USDA’s most recent food security survey 13.5%, or 18 million, U.S. households face food insecurity, and more than 6 million of those households have children. Summer months present additional challenges. Without nutrition coming from schools, Move for Hunger estimates that 22 million children experience summer hunger every year.

From June 25 to July 31, the campaign will collect in-store and online donations as well as pre-made bags of nonperishable foods at Grocery Outlet’s 540+ locations across the country.

name: Indio Veterans Day 5K & 10K Run/Walk
description:
This Veteran's Day 5K & 10K Run/Walk is to honor and support the brave men and women who served our country. This family-friendly event is great for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities, offering a course through an area of the Empire Polo. Come join us in this event as we celebrate veterans' service and sacrifice. 

Participants will receive a commemorative t-shirt and a portion of the proceeds will benefit Hunter Lopez Memorial Foundation. This event will also feature a pre-race celebration with refreshments, music, and a special ceremony to honor our veterans. Let's come together to run, remember, and show our appreciation for those who have given so much for our freedom. 

Kid’s under the age of 10 are free and veteran’s receive a $25 discount.

name: Intermediate Sailing: August 15/16
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.  

**A minimum of 5 hours of sail time is required post beginner sailing course. 

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential, and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through BoatU.S.. Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended. The course will be held rain or shine, so please dress accordingly for weather conditions.

Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.  

**A minimum of 5 hours of sail time is required post beginner sailing course. 

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential, and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through BoatU.S.. Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended. The course will be held rain or shine, so please dress accordingly for weather conditions.

name: Intro into Sewing
description: Learn the basics of sewing in a fun, beginner‑friendly workshop designed to build confidence and spark creativity. You’ll get hands‑on practice with essential skills like threading a machine, stitching simple seams, and working with fabric.

name: Ironstone Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, March 14, 2027 starting at 10:00am for an exciting annual event that features Ironstone Vineyards. Ironstone Vineyards is a premier Calaveras County destination with Wine Tasting, Dining and Estate Tours. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: 
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: IRVINE 4th of July-Red, White, & Blue 5k & 1 Mile
description:
So Cal’s 4th of July RED, WHITE, & BLUE 5k & 1 Mile

Saturday, July 4, 2026 | 8:30 AM
Irvine Valley College – Lot 5
5500 Irvine Center Dr., Irvine, CA 92618
(Entrance off Jeffrey. All other campus entrances will be closed.)

 
Flat and fast out-and-back course entirely on the Irvine Valley College campus
8:30 AM Mass Start, following a live National Anthem performance
Professional National Anthem singer will kick off the race
Live Fife & Drum Corps will entertain before the race and be available for fun photo ops
(Insider tip: ask them about their running times—they're cross-country athletes under those uniforms, adding authentic talent to this historical tribute!)
Patriotic atmosphere with live music, great selfie moments, and a vibrant community vibe
Bring your best FREEDOM energy and come ready to race, run, jog, or walk this healthy, high-spirited way to start your 4th of July
Custom shirts, huge finisher medals, chip timing, and age group awards
 

Bib & Shirt Pickup
Race Morning Pickup:
Begins at 6:30 AM in Lot 5
– Includes music, a selfie booth, and the awards area
– You may pick up for others; no ID required

Optional Early Packet Pickup:
Friday, July 3 | 2:00–5:00 PM
Location: Manassero Farms at Irvine Valley College (enter off Jeffrey)
33 Irvine Valley, Irvine, CA 92618

Race Day Schedule
6:30 AM– Race Day Registration & Bib/Shirt Pickup Opens
7:00 AM– Live Fife & Drums + Heritage Song Performances
8:00 AM – Diaper Dash (50 yards out & back)
8:05 AM – 1-Mile Fun Run (Can run with kids or as part of the combo option)
8:15 AM – Opening Ceremony + “Born in the USA” Singalong & Warm-Up
8:30 AM – 5K MASS START
9:15 AM – Overall Winners Announced
9:30 AM – Age Division Awards Begin

 

Food & Refreshments
Bring cash for fun food options at the finish line! Here's what to expect:

Specialty coffee drinks from a local coffee vendor
Delicious cookies from Galletina’s
Fresh fruit to refresh post-race
Our FAMOUS Street Tacos and Tamales—a crowd favorite!
You can pre-purchase food vouchers as an add-on during registration.

 
🎖 What’s Included with Registration🎖
Custom 4th of July themed race shirt (front and back design)
Huge 4-inch custom-cast finisher medal
Chip-timed results with a custom race bib
Water and fruit at the finish line
Eligibility for age group and overall awards
 
🏆Awards
Top 3 Male & Female Overall
5K & 1-Mile Age Group Awards (3 deep in 5-year increments):
1–10, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80–84, 85+
 
Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Important Note for Combo Runners (5K + 1-Mile)
If you are running both the 5K and the 1-Mile:

Use only one bib at a time
Stash your unused bib away from the start/finish mats
If doing the 1-Mile Fun Run with your kids, wear your Fun Run bib and leave your 5K bib at the first aid/water station tent near the finish line
Following these steps helps avoid timing issues and ensures your results are accurate. Thank you!


Weather
Rain or shine—the event will go on! Celebrate your freedom and fitness this 4th of July.

 
🚗 Parking
Irvine Valley College requires a $5 parking fee per vehicle
You can purchase online during registration or pay on race day
Display your parking pass on the driver's side dashboard
Entrance allowed only from Jeffrey Road (Irvine Center Dr. entrance will be closed for the course)
Race staging takes place in the southeast corner of Lot 5, between the Manassero Farm Stand and the two-story Performing Arts building. We are the only event on campus that day.

 
Hosted by Caren Ware Events
Professionally chip-timed by Itz About Time
Offering fun, fitness, and community for everybody—and every BODY!

name: Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
description:
Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
Thursday, November 26th, 2026
Thanksgiving Day
Irvine Valley College

THERE IS AN AWESOME CUSTOM CAST FINISHER MEDAL awaiting ALL you!  Choices of designs when you finish. A great race bib.  And the perfect Turkey designed, fun event shirt. 

7:30 am Turkey Feast Combo 1 Mile and 5k

8:00 am 5k Turkey Trot Race   

9:10 am Kids Gobble Wobble Races Start

(DO NOT MISS THESE START TIMES! Plan to arrive early as it takes time to park.

You MUST pass under the start arch by 8:12 .  

Two New Race Choices!  Choose the best race for you and earn a custom finishers medal and slice of fresh pumpkin pie!
Run fast, jog, trot, walk, or enjoy a nice stroll on this flat scenic course.  A scrumptious SLICE OF PIE awaits you at the finish. Along with So Cal's best custom cast finisher medal, you get an awesome shirt and CHIP TIMED.  Get your friends and family together and kick off the holidays together!   Guaranteed to be a picture perfect way to start celebrating THANKSGIVING DAY!

Run up a mini appetite with our family friendly 1 Mile or kick it up a notch with our 5k.  For those who plan to really indulge your can double down and enter our Turkey Feast Combo and run the 1 Mile and the 5k back to back!  This flat, friendly course is walker friendly and stroller ready.  Come out and see why it's become a holiday tradition for thousands of people !

We'll DECK out your Thanksgiving trimmings with:

*. Awesome Custom Cast Medals.
*. Soft Comfy event shirts for all.
*. Tasty pumpkin pie at the finish.
*. Custom Race bibs.
*  Chip timing by Itz About Time. 
*. Division awards for top three male and female in each age division. 5 year age spans from 10 & under to 80 & over!
*. Trophies for top three overall finishers male and female.
*. Holiday Expo to jump start your shopping.

All participants receive a race bib, custom cast medal, event t-shirt, and slice of pie!   5k is chip timed and kid's runs are for fun.  We will start lining the kids up at 9:05 per age group.  All the kids races are on a out and back loop and start and end in the same spot.   The course will be closed and lined with volunteers to direct all kids to the turnaround spot. They can turn early if they want with no penalty if they think it's too far.  One adult per child can run with their participant and the parent does not have to register but will not receive the shirt, medal, bib or pie. 

If you have a child that just wants to ride in a stroller with you on the 5k course, they can do so without registering.  They will not receive a medal, bib, shirt or pie but they can share yours! 

Awards

Professional Chip timing and results for all 5k participants. Age Division awards will be given 3 deep in the following age categories: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, *70-74, *75-79, *80 and over. Yes!  We split the final divisions to celebrate our 70 and over rock star field!  We're happy to celebrate this growing category and look forward to seeing everyone earn their race bling! 

Costume Awards will be given for Best Dressed so come decked out and you may take home a prize! Win as an individual or a group (6 people max)!

Early Packet Pick Up: Optional

Packet Pick up will be held on Wednesday, November 25th from 12 pm to 4pm at Road Runner Sports in Laguna Hills.
24291 Avenida De La Carlota; Suite P-5; Laguna Hills, CA 92653  (plan on this day to being a heavy traffic day, give extra time to arrive)

Pick up your bib and shirt  at packet pick up or on race morning at the race from 6:30am to 7:30am
One person can pick up for others.  No confirmation required.  Just know the last and first name they signed up under. 
Walk up registration accepted at early packet pick and on race day morning.
Shirts and Shirts sizes are not guaranteed for race day late registration.

Race Day Pick Up:

You may pick up your race bib and t-shirt on race day from 6:15 am to 7:30 am. In the quad, in front of the performance arts theater. That's the big two story orange building on the Irvine Valley College campus.

Parking:  Cost is $5.  Entrance is off of Irvine Center and  allowed on Jeffrey .Entrance closed on Irvine Center Drive at 7:55am. It's part of the course).  Only the entrances on Jeffrey stay open during the run . If parking in the solar lot, you will not be able to leave the lot until 9am. You will need to exit off Lasar Way and wait until directed to cross the race course as stragglers will still be coming in.

YOU MUST purchase a  PARKING PASS.  PUT ON YOUR DASH.  THIS CAN BE DONE ONLINE, AT PACKET PICK UP, OR b y buying at the PARKING PASS BOTH at registration on RACE MORNING.  THE CAMPUS PD charge  for every vehicle and look for the passes.  ( This parking fee is required on entering and parking at any local college).

Takes place wind, rain, or shine.

FAQ's
 Are dogs allowed? Due to college's policy, dogs are not allowed on the run course.

name: JINGLE PAWS 5K & ELF DASH
description:
A Holiday Tradition Benefiting Guide Dogs of the Desert

Join us for the annual Jingle Paws 5K, a festive run/walk celebrating the holiday season while supporting the life-changing mission of Guide Dogs of the Desert.

Each registered participant receives a complimentary commemorative race shirt. Participants may also purchase a Santa suit through our event store to add even more holiday spirit to the festivities. Whether you choose to run, walk, or stroll, you'll enjoy a scenic 5K (3.1-mile) course through the beautiful Palm Springs community. Strollers and four-legged friends are welcome, making this a fun-filled event for the entire family.

Young participants can join the excitement with our Elf Dash, a special race designed for children ages 10 and under.

The course begins and ends at Temple Isaiah, located at 332 W. Alejo Road in Palm Springs, and follows a fast, relatively flat route through quiet neighborhood streets adorned with holiday spirit.

 

Event Schedule
Friday, December 11
10:00 AM – 2:00 PM


Packet Pick-Up & Late Registration

Saturday, December 12
7:30 AM
Packet Pick-Up & Race Day Registration

9:00 AM
Jingle Paws 5K Start

10:00 AM
Elf Dash Start

Who Should Attend?
Everyone!

Whether you're an avid runner, casual walker, proud dog parent, stroller-pushing family, or simply someone who loves spreading holiday cheer, Jingle Paws welcomes participants of all ages and abilities. Come dressed in your favorite holiday attire and enjoy a morning filled with festive fun, community spirit, jingling bells, and plenty of holiday magic.

Why We Run
Proceeds from Jingle Paws directly support Guide Dogs of the Desert, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to transforming lives through highly trained service animals.

Guide Dogs of the Desert provides guide dogs at no cost to individuals who are blind or visually impaired, as well as assistance dogs for people living with autism, seizure disorders, PTSD, and other disabilities.

Every registration helps empower greater independence, confidence, and mobility for those we serve.

Registration Information
5K Registration

Early Registration: $45
Race Day Registration: $50

name: Jolly10K
description: Join us for another year of fun in the sun! At the Jolly10k you'll take a 10K or a 5K run or walk, through stunning Los Gatos mountain trails and arrive back at the finish line to enjoy fun, food and fellowship. We have informational booths, a variety of resource tables, CPR training and as always the Los Gatos Fire Dept. joins us for a group photo with the Fire Engine. We definitely have fun, but the reason we gather for the Jolly10k is to create a safe environment to have the difficult conversations about addiction and the deadly epidemic of Fentanyl that has flooded our country and stolen far too many young lives. But together, we can remember our loved ones and share life-saving information on how to prevent the next life lost from being someone in your family.                       Excercise, Information & Education!

name: JP's Backyard Ultra/Hike, The Final Edition
description:
Join us for JP’s Backyard Ultra, a one-of-a-kind ultramarathon and hike set in the scenic trails of Skyline Wilderness Park in Napa, CA. Now in its fourth and final year, this grassroots event is more than just a race, it’s a celebration of life, resilience, and community.

Born from my personal journey with Stage IV mediastinal paraganglioma, JP’s Backyard Ultra is a fundraiser for the Pheo Para Alliance, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 26-1510652) dedicated to empowering patients, families, and medical professionals affected by pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma through education, advocacy, and global support. Learn more at www.pheopara.org.

Whether you're in it for one loop or ten, come run or hike in solidarity, to honor those facing rare diseases, to challenge yourself, and to stand as part of a growing force for good.

~Jonathan Pascual

  • The course features a 3.3 mile loop with 550+ feet of climbing, offering a mix of terrain from steep rocky sections to shaded paths. Scroll down for map below.
  • Participants can choose anywhere from 1 to 10 loops.
  • Runners and hikers alike start at the same time every hour going clockwise on the even hours and counterclockwise on the odd hours. So it doesn't matter if you finish your loop fast or slow because everyone starts again at the same time in the next hour. Those attempting 10 loops should pace themselves for a final race on the 10th loop making 33.3 miles. You can do as many or as few loops as you wish however.
  • Timed Event: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM. Please arrive by 0730 for course description, announcement of run prize categories & fundraising prizes.
  • Aid Station: Main camp has various caloric options and drinks with water only at the bridge and mile 2.3.
  • Food & Beverages: Provided, including lunch for participants and volunteers.
  • Cupless Event: Bring your own water bottle or hydration pack. HYDRAPAK, our Sustainable Racing Partner will provide limited 300 Limited Edition HydraPak Graphic SpeedCups & 8 SpeedFill Pitchers for use at aid stations.
  • Awards:
    • Medals to all registered hikers and runners.
    • Medal & wine (non-alcoholic option for under 21) for top three male and female finishers of the 2, 4, 6, 8 loops.
    • Medal, wine, and trophy for the fastest 10th loop goes to the top three male and female finishers and special Vinerunner 4th place trophy.
    • Medal, wine, and trophy for the fastest cumulative time for 10 loops goes to the top three male and female finishers.
  • Raffle Prizes: buy tickets on day of event to win raffle baskets, gift certificates, and other special prizes. Proceeds benefit the Pheo Para Alliance.
  • Silent Wine Auction: place your bids on exceptional wines generously donated by local Napa Valley wineries, starting at an unbeatable buy-now price. Proceeds benefit the Pheo Para Alliance.
  • Registration "Fee": Donation Link
    • JP's Backyard Ultra has always been a free event. Suggested donation to register starts at $30. 
    • Participants get a medal, a variety of snacks and drinks at the aid station, and lunch.
    • To streamline registration, we are using runsignup.com. 100% of suggested starting donation of $30 goes directly to the Pheo Para Alliance. The processing fee of 6% per $1 of transaction (cart). This fee is charged per transaction, not per individual participant, meaning that if a user registers multiple people to a single cart, the $1 fee is only charged once, lowering the overall cost per person. 
    • If you cannot attend or want to donate beyond the suggested amount, consider giving an additional donation at the donation link.
  • Parking:
    • Do not park at Skyline's main parking lot to avoid parking fee. Parking opens at 0600.
    • Follow signs for "JP's Backyard Ultra Parking" for free parking for registered participants.
  • Childcare: We have volunteers to watch your kids from 0800-1200.
  • Park Rules: No dogs on trails, stay on marked trails, carry out your trash & put in appropriate bins at the main aid station, trails close at sunset.
  • Camp with us: reservations at Skyline's Website: Reserve Camp Site. Mention JP's Backyard Ultra to reserve your spot in our campsite on Friday 9/25 & Saturday 9/26. Camping reservation with vehicles is nearby but will be separate from the tent only camping.

    • JP's Backyard Ultra has always been a free event. Suggested donation to register starts at $30. 
    • Participants get a medal, a variety of snacks and drinks at the aid station, and lunch.
    • To streamline registration, we are using runsignup.com. 100% of suggested starting donation of $30 goes directly to the Pheo Para Alliance. The processing fee of 6% per $1 of transaction (cart). This fee is charged per transaction, not per individual participant, meaning that if a user registers multiple people to a single cart, the $1 fee is only charged once, lowering the overall cost per person. 
    • If you cannot attend or want to donate beyond the suggested amount, consider giving an additional donation at the donation link.
  • Parking:
    • Do not park at Skyline's main parking lot to avoid parking fee. Parking opens at 0600.
    • Follow signs for "JP's Backyard Ultra Parking" for free parking for registered participants.
  • Childcare: We have volunteers to watch your kids from 0800-1200.
  • Park Rules: No dogs on trails, stay on marked trails, carry out your trash & put in appropriate bins at the main aid station, trails close at sunset.
  • Camp with us: reservations at Skyline's Website: Reserve Camp Site. Mention JP's Backyard Ultra to reserve your spot in our campsite on Friday 9/25 & Saturday 9/26. Camping reservation with vehicles is nearby but will be separate from the tent only camping.

name: Judgment Day Half Marathon, 10K & 5K Run/Walk
description:
THE LAST RACE IN OUR SERIES, JUDGMENT DAY...ONE OF THE BEST COURSES IN THE VALLEY!

HALF MARATHON DESCRIPTION:

A VERY SCENIC COURSE. IT STARTS & FINISHES AT THE HISTORIC SAM LYNN BALLPARK. YOU WILL RUN OUT THE BACK GATE TO THE PAVED KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL (EAST) INTO THE PANORAMA VISTA PRESERVE (DIRT TRAILS) FOR A 3.5 MILE LOOP, AND THEN BACK ONTO THE KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL TO CHINA GRADE ROAD.  RUNNERS WILL TURN RIGHT ONTO THE ALFRED HARRELL HWY/CHINA GRADE LOOP (CLOSED ROAD) - YES THAT'S A CHALLENGING 1 MILE CLIMB UP TO THE PANORAMA BLUFFS, BUT EVERYONE LOVES IT, AND JUDGMENT DAY WOULDN'T BE THE SAME WITHOUT IT! ONCE AT THE TOP, YOU WILL CONTINUE THROUGH PANORAMA PARK ALONG THE BLUFFS WITH AWESOME VISTA VIEWS, BEFORE SWEEPING BACK DOWN (CLOSED MANOR STREET EXIT) TO THE PAVED RUNNING TRAIL ALONG THE KERN RIVER, AND FINISHING BACK INSIDE THE BALLPARK. 

10K COURSE DESCRIPTION:

OUR 10K WAS INTRODUCED IN 2025, AND IT DID NOT DISSAPPOINT!

YOU WILL START WITH THE HALF MARATHON RUNNERS, STARTING INSIDE THE HISTORIC SAM LYNN BALLPARK, AND RUNNING OUT THE BACK GATE TO THE PAVED KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL (EAST). AT MILE 2.8, THERE WILL BE "SPLIT" WHERE THE HALF MARATHON GOES LEFT, AND THE 10K COURSE GOES RIGHT, AND UP THE 0.40 MILE DIRT TRAIL, ABOUT 190' ELEVATION GAIN (STRAVA CALLS IT BLUFF HILL). ONCE AT THE TOP, YOU WILL JOIN THE PANAROMA PAVED TRAIL, AND CONTINUE THROUGH PANORAMA PARK ALONG THE BLUFFS WITH AWESOME VISTA VIEWS, BEFORE SWEEPING BACK DOWN (CLOSED MANOR STREET EXIT) TO THE PAVED RUNNING TRAIL ALONG THE KERN RIVER, AND FINISHING BACK INSIDE THE BALLPARK. 

THESE COURSES HAVE EVERYTHING! START/FINISH INSIDE THE BALLPARK ON GRASS, PAVED TRAILS, DIRT TRAILS, PAVED (CLOSED) ROADS, AN UPHILL, A DOWNHILL, AND LOTS OF FUN!!  

5K COURSE DESCRIPTION:

START & FINISH FROM INSIDE SAM LYNN BALLPARK, IT'S AN OUT & BACK, ALL ON THE KERN RIVER (PAVED) TRAIL. IT IS FAST & FLAT!!

name: July 4th Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Run Free. Run Proud.
Celebrate America’s independence with the July 4th Freedom Run — where every stride honors liberty, courage, and the spirit of freedom.
Whether you walk, jog, or race your heart out, come together to move for what unites us all.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Whether you walk, jog, or race your heart out, come together to move for what unites us all.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:

- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs

No hassle of picking up packets required!

You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.

Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race!

name: Jurassic Jaunt – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
Embark on a prehistoric adventure at the Jurassic Jaunt and feel the thrill of the chase and let out your inner T-Rex!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
4-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up at Sports Basement Long Beach 2100 N Bellflower, LB, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route 
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

We will have tent set up west of the Finish Line for spectators to watch you run. See map at the bottom of this email. We do not have shade or seating in the festival area for them.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located on course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Fountain Valley. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Justin Garza Memorial Run
description:
Join Us for the Justin Garza Memorial Run!

Lace up your running shoes and be part of a meaningful event honoring the life, legacy, and lasting impact of Justin Garza. Hosted by the Justin Garza High School Athletics Department, this special 2-mile run will take place on the campus of Justin Garza High School, with the course starting and finishing near the Administration Building.

Whether you're a student, alumni, community member, or supporter, this event is more than just a run—it's a celebration of perseverance, unity, and the spirit of Coach Garza.

🎽 All participants will receive:

  • Finisher's Medal
  • Custom Justin Garza Memorial Run T-shirt
  • Delicious breakfast prepared by the school’s very own Chef Bueno

Additional breakfasts for friends and family are available for purchase.

Come run, walk, or cheer—and help us keep the spirit of Justin Garza alive through fitness, food, and fellowship.

name: Karhu Demo Run X Fleet Feet Agoura Hills
description:
Join Fleet Feet Agoura Hills and Karhu for a fun community 5K demo run!

This is your chance to experience Karhu's unique ride and innovative running technology while enjoying an easy, social run with fellow runners and walkers. Whether you're training for your next race, getting in some extra miles, or simply looking for a fun way to stay active, this event is for you.

Our 5K route is open to all paces and mileage levels, making it perfect for runners, joggers, and walkers alike. Come test out a pair of Karhu shoes, meet other members of the local running community, and enjoy a fun evening on the roads and trails.

No matter your pace or experience level, everyone is welcome. We look forward to seeing you there!

name: Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run
description:
Get ready to join the fun as we roll out the Second Annual Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run - a fun and scenic adventure along the empty Kaweah Lake Bottom! After an incredible sold-out inaugural race (two weeks early!), we're thrilled to welcome back our runners for another unforgettable day on the trails.

Enjoy breathtaking views, perfect fall weather (God willing), and a friendly community atmosphere as you take on either the 5K or 10K course. Whether you're chasing a new PR or just out to enjoy nature with friends, this event is all about having fun, great company, and a little bit of post-race celebration!

Delicious post-race food, music, and fellowship await at the finish line - all while supporting a good cause. Spots will be limited again this year, so mark your calendar. This year will be even better than last year.

Proceeds to benefit St. Anthony Retreat & Conference Center. St. Anthony is a peaceful and naturally beautiful setting for individual and group retreats, as well as both religious and secular conferences and gatherings. St. Anthony Retreat Center provides meeting space, dining and overnight accommodations for up to 100 guests. name: Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run
description:
Get ready to join the fun as we roll out the Second Annual Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run - a fun and scenic adventure along the empty Kaweah Lake Bottom! After an incredible sold-out inaugural race (two weeks early!), we're thrilled to welcome back our runners for another unforgettable day on the trails.

Enjoy breathtaking views, perfect fall weather (God willing), and a friendly community atmosphere as you take on either the 5K or 10K course. Whether you're chasing a new PR or just out to enjoy nature with friends, this event is all about having fun, great company, and a little bit of post-race celebration!

name: KCF Calabasas 5K Run
description:
The Kevin Cordasco Foundation and the City of Calabasas are bringing back the Calabasas 5K Classic on September 28, 2025!

The Kevin Cordasco Foundation: Something Yellow is celebrating over 10 years of honoring and supporting the Heroes of Childhood Cancer. The Heroes are comprised of everyone affected by this challenging disease - including not only the children and young adults fighting their battles, but also their families, doctors and nurses that care for them, and the scientists who are pursuing better treatments and researching breakthroughs to find a cure. As a grassroots organization founded in Calabasas, California, we continue to pursue Kevin’s dream of turning the world into one large community to help the heroes continue to fight.

Proceeds go to the Kevin Cordasco Foundation.

name: Kern Cancer Run/Walk and Festival 2026
description:
Gather your friends, family and coworkers and join us for the 2026 Kern Cancer Run/Walk and Festival at - Riverwalk Park in Bakersfield!

This exciting challenge allows you to raise funds and awareness for those battling cancer all while having fun!  

100% of the funds will benefit the Kern County Cancer Foundation to assist local patients with medical bills related to cancer treatment as well as assist children with cancer who must travel for treatment.  For more information on our programs and services visit us at www.kerncountycancerfoundation.org

This is our 13th Annual KERN CANCER RUN/WALK and FESTIVAL EVENT and we couldn't do it without you!

  • It will be held Saturday, September 12th from 8am - 1pm at Riverwalk Park in Bakersfield, CA. 
  • Early registration is $10, then the cost goes up to $20 after March 31, 2026.
  • Children registration is $10 ages 3-11.
  • Kern County Cancer Run/Walk T-Shirts can be purchased for $20 with a deadline of 8/30/2026.
  • Survivors are FREE and there will be a special designated area for them. (Even if you're on treatment, you're a SURVIVOR)

 

 

This race will be timed for all registered runners and awards will be given.  Top fundraising teams and individual will also receive awards.

We are trying to raise as much funds as possible for Kern County cancer patients who need financial assistance and transportation during treatment.  

Some T-shirts will be available for sale at the event.  Donations are always welcome.

*PLEASE BE MINDFUL OF THOSE AROUND YOU, ESPECIALLY THE DELICATE IMMUNE SYSTEMS OF THE CANCER SURVIVORS ATTENDING THE EVENT. **
If you are experiencing symptoms of an illness or have been around someone who has been recently diagnosed please stay home...we can wait to see you next year. We follow CDC Guidelines which can be found when you click the link below.
Link to Isolation and Precautions for People with virus | CDC www.cdc.gov 

Thank you! - Kern Cancer Run/Walk and Festival Committee

name: Kids Survival Skills
description:
Have you always wanted to learn how to respond in a medical emergency while in the outdoors? 

Well, this is your chance to be trained to assess, treat and provide care to someone with an injury outside.

This class is for beginners ages 7-12, no experience is needed.

Class provides supplies and a medical responder bag to take home with you. Surprise fire and snacks too!

name: Kids Walk
description:
The Kids Walk is back this September in honor of Childhood Cancer Awareness Month.

Join us for a month-long awareness walk as we come together to support children battling cancer and the families who stand beside them. Participate in person or virtually from anywhere—because every step, no matter where you are, makes a difference.

Register today and pledge to walk at least 1 mile in support of childhood cancer awareness.

Go for Gold. Stand for Hope.

Walk in honor of the courageous fighters and the families navigating the unimaginable every day.

Our goal is to raise $50,000 to continue providing critical support to the hundreds of families who rely on the programs offered by the Childhood Cancer Foundation of Southern California.

100% of donations directly fund family support programs.

For the safety and comfort of all participants, no dogs or pets are allowed at the in-person event. We appreciate your understanding as we work to create a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

name: Kiwanis River Run
description:
🌊 Kiwanis River Run – A Race with Purpose and a View!

Lace up your shoes and hit the trail for one of the Central Valley’s most scenic and feel-good races of the year! Join us for the 5th Annual Kiwanis River Run — where the beautiful San Joaquin River meets community spirit, outdoor fun, and a fantastic cause: supporting the Pediatric Trauma – Injury Prevention Program at Valley Children’s Hospital.

🎉 FOUR Distances – Something for Everyone!

     ✔️ 10K Trail Run – Scenic river trail!
     ✔️ 5K Run/Walk – Perfect for all fitness levels
     ✔️ 2-Mile Fun Run/Walk – Timed but low-key (no placement awards)
     ✔️ Kids’ 1/4 Mile Fun Run – Open to ages 10 & under (non-timed)

description:

Whether you're running for a PR, running for fun, or walking, there's no better way to start the Thanksgiving holiday! Costumes are encouraged!

name: La Dolce Vita: Romantic Sunset Gondola Cruise
description:
Glide through the Coronado canals aboard a charming gondola as the sky melts into golden sunset hues. Watch the sunset on this 50-minute gondola cruise with a glass of wine and chocolate to snack on. Perfect for couples looking for a romantic and dreamy evening. For ages 21+ only. 

Each Gondola fits 3 couples per boat. Please be aware that each boat will be shared by 3 couples per boat.

Please plan on arriving at 6:30 pm for check in. Boat departures at 7 pm. 

Participants will receive wine and snacks for 2.

name: La Jolla Cove Swim
description:
Iconic Open Water Swim held in La Jolla, California the first Sunday after Labor almost every year since 1916. 

There are four swim events available on race day. 

  • 250 Meter kids race "Garibaldi Grommets"
  • 1 Mile "Sea Lions"
  • 3 Mile "Leopard Sharks"
  • 4 Mile "Whole Enchilada" Swimmers compete in both the 1 mile & 3 mile events  - there is about an hour between the 2 swims.

All swimmers receive an event t-shirt. All finishers receive a finisher's medal. There are Age Group Medals awarded that follow U.S. Masters Swimming age brackets. For the kids race it is by individual year. 8 year olds will only be competing with 8 years etc up through 12 years of age.

name: La Jolla Half Marathon, 10K, & 5K
description:
Imagine miles of sun-drenched coast, an inviting ocean, and perfect weather pretty much anytime of the year, and you’ll understand why the La Jolla Half Marathon, our San Diego 10K, and La Jolla Shores 5K are some of San Diego California’s most picturesque running races. 

From start to finish these races offer runners a chance to experience the coast like never before. Discover the views from the summit of Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve as you listen to the sound of the ocean lapping the shore to help you keep pace.

Whether you want to run your first half marathon, step up from our 5K to our 10K, or run your first 5K, no matter which race you choose, you’ll have gorgeous views from Del Mar to the La Jolla Shores.

Packet Pickup

FRIDAY, MAY 14, 2027: 9:00AM - 7:00PM

LOCATION: Scripps Park in La Jolla Cove across the street from La Jolla Cove Suites hotel

Refer A Friend... Earn Money

We love our runners and we love our runners that talk about our race! We want to reward runners that get their friends and family to register. Refer 4 friends and earn a $20 refund back from your 5K registration. Refer 4 friends and earn a $30 refund back from your 10K registration. Refer 4 friends and earn a $40 refund back from your half marathon registration. Keep referring friends and run for free! You'll receive a referral link to share after registration. If you've already registered, you should have received an email with your code or it's in your registration confirmation!

name: LA Kings 5K
description:
The annual LA Kings 5K will take on Saturday, September 12, 2026 with both in-person and virtual options.

Please see below for details related to early check-in and race day for the in-person race.

EARLY CHECK IN 

  • Date: Friday, September 11, 2026
  • Details to follow

RACE DAY

  • Date: Saturday, September 12
  • Location: Riviera Village - S. Redondo Beach
  • Timing:
    • 6:30am - Check in begins
    • 7:40am - Opening Ceremony
    • 8:00am - 5K begins
    • 8:45am - Awards Ceremony
    • Address: S. Catalina St. at Vista Del Mar
    • Parking: Self-park in the area
  • Other Information:
    • There will be a water station on the course and at the finish line.
    • There is NO bag check. So leave your valuable in the care or take what you want with you!
    • The top male and female finisher in each age category will receive a prize. Winners are encouraged to stay for the Awards Ceremony at 8:45am to claim their prize.

name: La Palma Fitness Run for Fun
description:
Kick off your 4th of July with energy, excitement, and a whole lot of fun! 

Join us on Saturday, July 4th for the annual Fitness Run for Fun, featuring a 5K Run/Walk and 10K Run—perfect for all ages and fitness levels. Whether you’re chasing a personal best or making memories with family and friends, this is your chance to celebrate Independence Day in the most active way possible!

Enjoy a scenic course through the community and score some awesome perks along the way:

🏅 Finisher medal
👕 Exclusive race shirt
📸  A finisher photo and video to capture your moment!


Spots fill fast—don’t wait! Be part of this high-energy holiday tradition and start your 4th of July feeling accomplished and inspired.

👉 Register now and run, walk, and celebrate with us!

Don’t forget: Register by June 19th to guarantee your shirt size!

 

The Yankee Doodle Dash invites kids ages 2 to 12 to join the Independence Day fun! Young runners will race to the finish line and enjoy a fun, active experience. Registration includes a finisher medal and race bib, making it a great way to celebrate the holiday. Sign up today and let the little ones be part of the excitement!

 

Pancake Breakfast:

Kick off July 4th with the La Palma Kiwanis Club’s Annual Pancake Breakfast! Enjoy a delicious $10 breakfast, with proceeds supporting community programs and student scholarships. Don’t miss this tasty tradition!

 

Race Shirt Sizes:

Unisex Small – XXL and Youth Medium.

Additional shirt $12
