name: Move4Life's Half-Marathon
description:
🔥 Sacramento… are you ready to MOVE? 🔥

This summer, Move4Life is bringing the heat to California with a race experience that’s bigger than just miles—it’s about energy, purpose, and community.

📅 August 29, 2026
📍 Sacramento, CA

Whether you’re chasing a PR, walking with friends, or just showing up for something meaningful—we’ve got a lane for you:

🏃‍♂️ Half Marathon (13.1 miles) – For the grinders, the goal-setters, the “I came to conquer” crowd
🏃 10K – Fast, fierce, and just the right amount of challenge
🏃‍♀️ 5K – Fun, electric, and perfect for all levels
🚶 2-Mile Walk – Bring the family, bring the vibes, bring the smiles

But let’s be real—this isn’t just a race.

This is music pumping at the start line.
This is strangers turning into teammates mid-run.
This is that moment when your legs say “stop” but your purpose says “GO.”

💥 Every step you take helps Move4Life continue building healthier communities through fitness, access, and opportunity.

💥 Every finish line crossed is a statement: we show up, we move, we give back.

Expect:
✔️ Scenic Sacramento routes
✔️ High-energy atmosphere from start to finish
✔️ Medals, memories, and that “I did THAT” feeling
✔️ A community that’s bigger than the race itself

Disabled Veterans: use the code 'DAVFREE' for $0 registration fees.

Students & Active Duty Military: click HERE for deep discounted registration fees!

So the real question is…
👉 Are you walking it, jogging it, or dominating it?

Let’s go, Sacramento. Let’s Move4Life. 💪🔥

name: MPSF Open Water Championships - Masters/Open 5 Kilometer and 1 Kilometer Open Water Swim
description:
The 3rd MPSF Open Water Swimming Championships will be contested Saturday, October 18, 2025 at Marine Stadium in Long Beach, Calif.  Be a part of the third intercollegiate conference championship in open water swimming.  

The MPSF Championships in OWS could potentially lead to an NCAA Championship in the sport.  Open water swimming has been in the Olympics since 2008.  Alumni from institutions eligible for MPSF membership in OWS have participated in every one of these Olympic competitions and have medaled in both the men’s and women’s events.  The Marine Stadium will host Rowing and Canoeing during the 2028 Olympic Games.  Long Beach will also host the Open Water Swimming and eight other sports events for the 2028 Olympic Games.  

The Open 5 Kilometer and 1 Kilometer Open Water Swim participants are encouraged to affiliate with the MPSF member institution that they swam collegiately for, currently attend or graduated from.  Don't forget to wear your team colors.

Additional race information can be found athttps://mpsports.org/tournaments/?id=49

name: MPSF Open Water Championships - Masters/Open 5 Kilometer and 1 Kilometer Open Water Swim
description:
The 3rd MPSF Open Water Swimming Championships will be contested Saturday, October 18, 2025 at Marine Stadium in Long Beach, Calif.  Be a part of the third intercollegiate conference championship in open water swimming.  

The MPSF Championships in OWS could potentially lead to an NCAA Championship in the sport.  Open water swimming has been in the Olympics since 2008.  Alumni from institutions eligible for MPSF membership in OWS have participated in every one of these Olympic competitions and have medaled in both the men’s and women’s events.  The Marine Stadium will host Rowing and Canoeing during the 2028 Olympic Games.  Long Beach will also host the Open Water Swimming and eight other sports events for the 2028 Olympic Games.  

The Open 5 Kilometer and 1 Kilometer Open Water Swim participants are encouraged to affiliate with the MPSF member institution that they swam collegiately for, currently attend or graduated from.  Don't forget to wear your team colors.

Additional race information can be found athttps://mpsports.org/tournaments/?id=49

name: MWR Liberty: Comic Con Volunteer Interest List 2026
description:
**PLEASE READ VOLUNTEER EVENT DESCRIPTION BEFORE REGISTERING FOR OUR INTEREST LIST. 

Take part in the opportunity to volunteer at the 2026 International Comic Con Convention in sunny San Diego! Volunteers will volunteer for a 3- hour shift and, when their shift is over, be able to enjoy the convention for free! Assignments and Volunteer Times are still to be determined at a later date closer to the event. Cosplay is encouraged! 😎

 

VOLUNTEER RESTRICTIONS:

**THIS MWR LIBERTY VOLUNTEER INTEREST PAGE IS OPEN TO ACTIVE DUTY E1-E6 ONLY**

**ALL ACTIVE DUTY E1-E6 PATRONS ARE LIMITED TO SELECTING ONE CONVENTION DAY TO VOLUNTEER. PICK THE DAY YOU PREFER (Thursday, July 23rd, Friday, July 24th, Saturday, July 25th, OR Sunday, July 26th). MAKE SURE TO PUT IN YOUR LEAVE IF YOU HAVE A WORK CONFLICT.**

RSU CONFIRMATION EMAIL:

DISCLAIMER: This registration page serves as a volunteer interest list and is the FIRST STEP towards officially joining our MWR Liberty Special Volunteer group. Registering on this page does not guarantee that you will volunteer with us. You will need to reply to future email correspondence to confirm your availability.

FUTURE COMMUNICATION:

MWR Liberty communication with volunteers will mainly occur via email (so please provide the best email address at registration). In mid-June (around 6/19), all signups will be contacted by email and be asked to confirm attendance. Keep an eye out for this email. There will be a deadline to respond and if we don't hear back, we will offer your spot to someone on the waitlist. This is a hard deadline. You are responsible for checking your email and responding accordingly. 

COMIC CON MEMBER ID:

During registration you will be asked to enter your Comic Con Member ID. If you don't already have one, please create a Comic Con Member ID, at www.comic-con.org. Please note that your Comic Con Member ID is case-sensitive (spacing and lowercase versus uppercase, matters). Please be sure to input your exact Comic Con member ID as it appears on your Comic Con Portal. If we have issues looking up your Comic Con Member ID, you will be contacted. 

TRANSPORTATION:

MWR Transportation is provided and highly recommended due to high vehicle congestion in downtown for the Convention. Please select your preferred pick-up location during registration. There are two available pick-up locations: The Recyard (NBSD) and VADM Martin Liberty (NASNI). Alternatively, you may choose to coordinate your own transportation to the convention. 

WAITLIST:

Registration will fill up quickly. If we reach volunteer capacity, please email us below to be added to the waitlist.

name: Nail the Rail Half Marathon, 10K & 5K
description:
Join us for a stroll along the Sacramento Rail Trail.  A converted Southern Pacific Railroad track that starts at the base of Shasta Dam and runs for over 11 miles.

Enjoy a the view along the Sacramento River/Keswick Lake in the cool of the morning.  Trail is very flat and fast.

Field is limited to 500.

Races include a half marathon, 10K and 5K.

Finisher awards to Half marathoners.  Awards 3 deep in age groups, plus overall awards.

Start/Finish will be from the Chappie OHV area at the base of Shasta Dam.  Once you cross Shasta Dam you will follow the road down to the OHV area.

Race day registration and packet pickup opens at 7am at OHV area.

Packet pickup and registration on Friday the 23rd from 11am to 3pm at Redding Fleet Feet Store at 1376 Hilltop Dr.

Start times:

Half Marathon - 8am

5K & 10K - 8:15am

Cutoff time of 3hrs 15 minutes for half-marathon.

name: Napa Half Marathon
description:
The Napa Half Marathon is nestled up in the rolling hills of east Napa. Scenic, rustic and winding roads will take you from the start at Skyline Park through the vineyard lined neighborhoods in a charming countryside setting. Locals come out to cheer you on while curious deer are commonly seen along the course! Finishers of the Half Marathon will be greeted with a bottle of Napa Valley wine and all race finishers will receive a custom medal. The race is hosted by Athletic Feat and is professionally chip timed by SVE Timing. The Half Marathon starts at 7:30am. (Participants must be at least 12 years old on race day.)

A fun distance for those who enjoy shorter races! The quarter marathon (about 6.55 miles) will follow the half marathon route on the first of its two loops. Then it will return to Skyline Park. Finishers will receive a medal and a bottle of wine. The quarter marathon will start with the Half, at 7:30am.

name: National Chocolate Day: Run for Chocolates 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🍫🏃‍♀️ Ready, Set, Chocolate! 🏃‍♂️🍫
Join Us for the Sweetest Run of the Year – The Chocolate Run!
Lace up your running shoes and bring your sweet tooth—because this isn’t your average race.
It’s a deliciously fun event for all ages and fitness levels!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Navy Ten-Miler
description:
Run with Honor. Endure with Courage. Finish with Commitment.

The Navy Ten-Miler brings together athletes, service members, veterans, and civilians to honor the Navy’s core values of Honor, Courage, and Commitment. Whether you're a seasoned runner or searching for your next challenge, this is your call to RUN NAVY.

Navy Races are more than a finish line. They celebrate the strength, resilience, and unity of our community. Proceeds benefit Navy Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) programs that enhance the lives of Sailors and their families.

Key Benefits:

  • Support Navy personnel and families
  • Run along San Diego’s iconic waterfront
  • Experience naval history and patriotism
  • Connect with the veteran and civilian running community
  • Be part of a race with purpose and impact

Who Can Participate?

Everyone is welcome. Whether you are active duty, a veteran, a military family member, or a civilian who wants to support a meaningful cause, Navy Race events are open to all fitness levels.

Join a race with purpose.

#RunNAVY

name: Nelson Family Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Saturday, April 17, 2027 at 10:00am for a super fun annual event that features the amazing hospitality and scenery of Nelson Family Vineyards! For 70 years the Nelson family has farmed the land they live on, with the traditions of farming passed on to four generations. Through many seasons of tending and harvest, Nelson Family Vineyards has embraced the truth that great wines are born in the vineyard. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: 
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Never Say Die Run 5K. 10K. Half Marathon An 80s Adventure Movie Inspired Race
description:
🏴‍☠️ Never Say Die Run
5K • 10K • Half Marathon
An 80s Nostalgia Adventure Run
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
📅 October 4th 
⏰ Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
⏰ 5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM

For the goonies, misfits, rebels, and runners

Some adventures never die.

Grab your crew and head to the Long Beach coastline for a retro-inspired morning packed with treasure hunt vibes, beachside miles, nostalgic energy, epic medals, and CaliFlow fun. This isn’t just a race — it’s an adventure.

This special event benefits Santa Ana Hamster Rescue, helping provide care, education, and loving homes for rescued hamsters. Because even the smallest creatures deserve heroes.

Whether you’re taking on the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon, your miles will help support tiny lives that need big hearts.

 
🏁 What You’ll Get
✔️ Professional chip timing
✔️ Free race-day photos
✔️ 3 on-course water stations
✔️ Finisher medals for all participants
✔️ Overall & age group awards
✔️ Retro adventure-themed fun
✔️ Finish line party & DJ
✔️ Scenic beach path course
✔️ Hamster care education on-site
✔️ Adoptable hamsters ready to meet you

 
This is a beginner-friendly, stroller-friendly, and dog-friendly out-and-back course along the beautiful Long Beach coastline with ocean views and nonstop good vibes.

So gather your crew, lace up your shoes, and get ready for a nostalgic coastal adventure you won’t forget.

Because the adventure starts at the starting line.

🏴‍☠️ Misfits welcome.

name: New Year's Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎉 Start Your Year on the Right Foot! 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️
Join the New Year's Run - New Beginnings Starts Today!
Kick off the new year with energy, excitement, and a community of runners ready to chase their goals. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just starting out, this run is for YOU!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Join the New Year's Run - New Beginnings Starts Today!
Kick off the new year with energy, excitement, and a community of runners ready to chase their goals. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just starting out, this run is for YOU!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Next Play Virtual 5k
description:
Join us for the inaugural Next Play Virtual 5K and take part in a movement that goes beyond the finish line. This event is more than a run. It’s an opportunity to invest in the future of youth in Kern County.

Participants can run, walk, or jog from anywhere, at any pace. Whether you're chasing a personal best or simply showing support, every mile completed helps provide access to sports, mentorship, and development opportunities for young athletes in our community.

Together, we’re building the next generation - one step at a time.

name: NIGHT NATION RUN - SACRAMENTO
description:
The Night Nation Run is the World’s first Running Music Festival the ultimate blend of a Music Festival and a Fun Run. Experience a music filled course with Live DJs, Bubble Zones, Light Shows, Neon, and Black Lights! Cross the finish line into an Epic Main Stage After Party featuring Top Headliner DJs!

To date, over 2 MILLION people across the World have become a member of the Night Nation™!

The Night Nation Run is proud to support Stand Up To Cancer (SU2C) as their official charity. Stand Up To Cancer (SU2C) is a groundbreaking initiative created to accelerate innovative cancer research that will get new therapies to patients quickly and save lives now.

Celebrate Life. Celebrate friends and family. Celebrate Music. Run with the Night Nation™!

REGISTRATION INCLUDES:

  • Night Nation T-shirt (Premium & VIP Registration)
  • Race Bib
  • Glow Necklace
  • Free Giveaways
  • Pre and Post Race Concerts
  • Admission into the Night Nation after party
  • The best night of your life!

name: Night of the Running Dead 5K, 10K, 1 Miler, Half Marathon SummerWeen Series by Califlow Runs
description:
🧟‍♂️ Night of the Running Dead
5K • 10K • 1 Miler • Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA
📅 Saturday Night • August 29
🕓 Check-In & Registration: 4:00 PM
🏁 Start Times | Half: 5:00 PM | 5K & 10K: 6:30 PM | 1 Miler: 6:45 PM

 
💀 About the Event
When the sun goes down… they rise.

Welcome to Night of the Running Dead—a pulse-pounding, after-dark race where the beach path transforms into a haunting playground of glowing lights, eerie energy, and undead vibes.

Whether you’re running for time, running for fun, or just trying to survive the night… this is one event you won’t forget.

Costumes are highly encouraged—zombies, survivors, or anything straight out of your favorite horror scene.

 
🌊 What to Expect
✔️ Flat, fast beach path course
✔️ Professional chip timing ⏱️
✔️ Instant ChronoTrack results (within minutes)
✔️ Free race-day photos — no upsells, ever 📸
✔️ Finisher medals for all participants 🏅
✔️ Overall & age group awards
✔️ Multiple on-course water stations 💧
✔️ DJ, lights & eerie after-dark atmosphere 🎶
✔️ Costume contest — zombies, creepers & creatures 🧟‍♀️
✔️ Runners, walkers, and all survival paces welcome

 
  🧿 The Vibe – After Dark Survival Mode
At CaliFlow Runs, we don’t do ordinary races…

This is where:
🧟 The undead roam
🔥 The music pulses
🌙 The night comes alive
👟 And you run straight through it

No pressure. No judgment. Just adrenaline, community, and a little chaos under the stars.

 
✨ Run the night. Join the undead. Survive the course.

name: Nike X Fleet Feet Demo Run
description:
Join us for a fun evening with Nike as they bring out the all-new Pegasus 42 for runners to test during a casual 5K run! Whether you're a longtime Pegasus fan or curious to see what's new, this is a great opportunity to put the latest version through its paces.

Nike will also be bringing fun giveaways, and a few lucky participants will have their drinks covered by Nike after the run!

The event will take place at Naughty Pine Brewing Company, making it the perfect chance to connect with the local running community and enjoy a post-run beverage.

Please note: This event is 21+ only. No children will be permitted, as the event is being hosted at a brewery.

We can't wait to see you there! Lace up, test out the Pegasus 42, and join us for a great night of running, giveaways, and community.

name: Nixon 5K for Title IX
description:
Celebrate the women and girls in your life in this family-friendly event to commemorate the achievements of Title IX, the landmark equality legislation signed by President Nixon fifty-three years ago.

Bring your family, friends, sports teams and community groups to the NIXON 5K FOR TITLE IX and run (or walk) this moderate course following Yorba Linda’s El Cajon Trail. Athletes are encouraged to wear their favorite team gear supporting female sports! This is accessible for runners of all levels; strollers are welcome and dogs are allowed. Following the race, guests are invited to stop by the vendor fair in the Library parking lot!

name: No Foolin' Foot Race
description:
NOTE: Pre-registration for the kids race is now closed. Children may sign up on race morning, though shirts and medals are not guaranteed. 

Race morning registration closes at 9 promptly.

Explore San Carlos' outstanding trail system as a runner in the fourth annual No Foolin' Foot Race! There's something for everyone with four challenging events through Big Canyon, Eaton and Pulgas Ridge. 

  • 1K (~350ft of climbing) - Perfect for adventurous kids age 5-10

  • 5k (~530ft of climbing)

  • 10k (~1,500ft of climbing)

  • Long Course NEW this year! (15K with ~2,300ft of climbing)

Consider yourself warned: This race is no joke! Our courses are technical, grueling and loads of fun.

We will be hosting course previews on Sunday, March 8 (5K and 10K routes) and Saturday, March 28 (5K and 15K routes) in partnership with A Runner's Mind and Brooks. RSVP on Strava, and join our Strava Club for updates.

Start and Finish Festival at Crestview Park. Professional timing; Tech-Ts and free runner photos for all participants; Awards in multiple categories. 

All proceeds benefit maintenance and improvement of San Carlos open space trails. 

Presented by Kaiser Permanente in partnership with the Parks and Recreation Foundation of San Carlos and the City of San Carlos.

Start Times

name: North County Turkey Trot
description:
Get ready for the 3rd Annual North County Turkey Trot!

Start your Thanksgiving with a fun, active morning in the community. The 5K race begins at 7:30 AM, followed by the Kids 1K Fun Run at 8:45 AM.

This event is a great way to get moving, connect with neighbors, and kick off your Thanksgiving celebration on the right foot. All proceeds benefit Active Kids Alliance, which provides scholarships to children in need so they can participate in sports. Active Kids Alliance has already supported more than 80 families in need, and with your support, they can continue helping even more.

We look forward to seeing you bright and early on Thanksgiving morning. It’s the best way to start your day!

name: Northgate Market 5K
description:
It’s Back — The Annual Northgate Market 5K!
We’re thrilled to welcome you to this beloved community tradition, benefiting the Familia González Reynoso Foundation. This incredible organization supports higher education, human services, schools, orphanages, scholarships, and grants that change lives.

Come join the fun at Angel Stadium, where you’ll get the unforgettable chance to run on the field and see yourself on the Jumbo-Tron — all while enjoying a vibrant Día de los Muertos theme.

Every race entry includes:

  • Commemorative race shirt
  • Finisher medal
  • Finish line photos & video
  • Access to the post-race expo

Come run, celebrate, and make a difference — together, we can support those in need while creating memories that last a lifetime!

Register before September 30th (at 12:00am) to guarantee your race-shirt size!

name: Noyo Headlands Race
description:
Join us on Saturday, August 8, 2026 for the 10th annual Noyo Headlands Race. This year we'll have a half marathon, 10K run, 5k run, 5k fun walk, and half-mile kids' run along the stunning coastal trail in Fort Bragg, CA. Enjoy some of the most remarkable scenery Northern California has to offer and have a great time running with your friends! The oceanfront trail consists of asphalt and soft track, is fairly flat, well maintained, and commonly used by runners year-round.

This race benefits Mendocino Land Trust in its mission to conserve and restore habitat, scenic areas and working lands while also providing public access to beautiful places in and around Mendocino County.

name: NURSES ROCK Run/Walk
description:
We are so grateful for the incredible support, energy, and love shared at this year’s event. Thank you for helping us bring our community together in celebration of nurses — we look forward to seeing everyone again on May 15, 2027!

Join the Nurses Rock Run-Walk 5K/10K & BONNIE CHALLENGE and help support the next generation of nurses!

Nurses care for us during some of life’s most important moments, and now it’s our turn to give back. Join Bonnie Fang Foundation in supporting aspiring nurses through scholarships, community support, and awareness for the ongoing nursing shortage that impacts us all.

Whether you participate in person or virtually, you’ll be part of an inspiring community coming together to celebrate, honor, and support nurses and future healthcare heroes.

Whether you run or walk — solo, with friends, family, coworkers, or a team — every step helps make a meaningful impact for the future of nursing.

Your participation and support help us continue empowering nursing students while shining a constant spotlight on the importance of nurses in our communities every single day.

They are our heroes… and by joining us, you become part of theirs.

Register today and help us continue making a lasting impact for future nurses! 💜


*START GETTING YOUR GROUPS TOGETHER! AWARDS FOR OUR TOP 3 LARGEST GROUPS!

 
Directions to Frank G. Bonelli Park
120 Via Verde, San Dimas, CA 91773

Bonelli Park is located on the Northeast corner of the 10 and 57 Freeways in San Dimas, CA.

From San Diego, 5 north to 57 north, cross over the 10 freeway and exit Via Verde Dr.
From Redondo Beach, etc. 10 East to 57 North and Exit Via Verde
From Pasadena-210 to 57 and exit Via Verde
From the East-10 to 57 North and exit Via Verde

Take the Via Verde Dr. Exit off of the 57 Freeway. Head East, down into the park. After entering through the gate, take the second left into the parking lot, additional parking is further east on Via Verde.

*Please note that there is a separate parking fee of $15 for Bonelli Regional Park

name: Oakland Tech 5km/1 mile Race/Run/Walk Fundraiser
description:
Support Oakland Tech Students and Programs
Join us for a 5K trail race or 1-mile fun run/walk in beautiful Joaquin Miller Park on November 2, 2025 (end of Daylight savings time.) The course winds through towering redwoods and offers both a scenic stroll for casual participants and a challenging route for competitive runners.

This event is a fundraiser for the Oakland Tech PTSA, which provides invaluable funding for student programs and activities. Every dollar makes a difference for our students. The PTSA supports the Oakland Tech Cross Country team by covering costs for meet entry fees, training equipment, nutrition, and travel — all essential for helping our runners perform at their best.

Oakland Tech Cross Country athletes have a proud tradition of success, with varsity cross country teams winning the Oakland League Championship for three of the past four years. Your participation helps continue this tradition of excellence.

Sign up for the race or make a tax-deductible donation to show your support for Oakland Tech students.

Bib pick-up: Saturday, October 31, 2pm-4pm @ Transports or Sunday, November 1rd, 8:30am @Joaquin Miller Meadow

Date: November 1, 2026

  • 1 mile Fun Run/Walk Race Start: 9:00 am
  • 5 km Trail Race Start: 9:30 am

Can't run but want to support us? Donations are tax-deductible. Tax ID: 94-6174624

name: Oakley's Star-Spangled Color Run
description:
Get ready to celebrate at Oakley’s Star-Spangled Color Run! This fun-filled patriotic event is all about community, laughter, and patriotic spirit. Participants will be showered in vibrant red, white, and blue as they make their way through the course—no pressure, no set distance, just pure enjoyment at your own pace.

Dress in your best patriotic gear and join friends, family, and neighbors for music, movement, and celebration. Whether you walk, jog, or dance your way through, this event is designed for all ages and fitness levels. Come for the color, stay for the fun, and make unforgettable Independence Day memories!

Date: Friday, July 3
Race Start: 7:00 PM
Location: Beaumont Sports Park, 1692 Beaumont Avenue. 
Course: A 1-mile loop around the Sports Park walking path 

Finale: At 7:45 PM, gather at the DJ booth for a massive color toss to celebrate the fun!

Packet Pickup

Pre-registered participants may pick up their race bag June 30 - July 2 at the Albert A. Chatigny Sr. Community Recreation Center. Day of pickup will begin at 4:00 p.m. on July 3 at the Sports Park.

Registration: $15 per person (includes event t-shirt!)

name: Oceanside Pier Swim  - 2026
description:
The 97th Annual Oceanside Pier Swim is set to take place on September 7, 2026, continuing a cherished tradition that began in 1929. Swimmers of all ages are invited to participate in this one-mile swim around the iconic Oceanside Pier, the longest wooden pier on the West Coast. 

Hosted by local organization, Oceanside Masters Swim Club, the club hopes to grow Oceanside Aquatics and community from youth to adulthood. Proceeds from the swim will benefit youth swim programs, high school swim teams, adult swim teams and our local first responders.

name: Oktoberfest 5K
description:
Prost! 🍺 Put on your Lederhosen and join us for the Crow and Wolf Oktoberfest 5K—a high-energy celebration of running, community, and craft beer at one of the Central Valley’s most unique Breweries. 

This festive 5K winds through the scenic Clovis Trails while starting and finishing right at the grounds of Crow and Wolf Brewing Co., combining a fun, approachable course with the lively spirit of Oktoberfest. Whether you’re chasing a PR or just here for the party, this event delivers the perfect mix of fitness and fun.

🎉 What to Expect:

A flat, fast, and beginner-friendly 5K course

High-energy Oktoberfest vibes with music and cheering

A one-of-a-kind stein-themed finisher medal

Custom race shirt with bold Oktoberfest flair

Post-race celebration featuring beer, food, and community

🍻 The Best Part?

Your finish line reward includes a well-earned beer for all participants (21+) with non-alcoholic options available as well. Stick around after the race to enjoy music, food, and a great Oktoberfest experience.

👟 Who Should Join?

Runners, walkers, Beer lovers, and anyone looking for a memorable event—costumes encouraged! Dirndls, lederhosen, and festive gear will fit right in.

Raise a glass, hit the course, and celebrate in style at the Crow and Wolf Oktoberfest 5K—where every mile ends with a cheers 🍻

name: Oktoberfest Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🥨 Lace up, get festive, and earn your Oktoberfest celebration the best way possible — by running for it!

Our delightful 'Oktoberfest Fun Run' is back with a dash of Bavarian spirit. Join this race that's brimming with Gemütlichkeit (friendliness) and fun! 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

🥨 Lace up, get festive, and earn your Oktoberfest celebration the best way possible — by running for it!

Our delightful 'Oktoberfest Fun Run' is back with a dash of Bavarian spirit. Join this race that's brimming with Gemütlichkeit (friendliness) and fun! 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Once Upon a Run
description: 🎉🌅 Join me on my birthday weekend for a magical morning of fun! We're combining a little run/walk, sunrise stretching, crafting, and tasty snacks to support the Lupus Society of Illinois and kick off training for the Chicago Marathon 2026. Our theme is "Once Upon a Run," so come dressed as your favorite fairy tale character! Whether you're a prince, princess, troll, witch, or even an enchanted frog—everyone is welcome to join this whimsical adventure! Let’s make memories and spread some joy while making a difference together. Can't wait to see you there!✨🏃‍♀️🧚‍♂️🍰

name: One Love Run – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
One love, one heart, one run 🌞🎶🏃‍♂️ The One Love Run is calling! Come run, walk, or vibe your way along the course surrounded by music, sunshine, and smiles. 🌴💛 Let’s celebrate unity, good energy, and the simple joy of moving together. One love, every step of the way. 🌊👟

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr, Long Beach
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday

1-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Sunday

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: ONETrack International Summer 5K
description: Join us for a 5K Run/Walk benefiting ONETrack International, a nonprofit dedicated to ending the Global Orphan Crisis through family reunification and in-home care programs around the world. All proceeds go directly toward ONETrack's Transition to Home programs which keep orphaned and vulnerable children with extended family rather than in institutional orphanages— funding education, healthcare, and caretaker support for families in need. Lace up, bring your friends, and help us give every child the chance to grow up in a family. Whether you run, jog, or walk the course, every step and every dollar makes a difference.

name: Open Water Swim Clinics
description:
Invest in yourself and improve your open water swimming skills for a safer and more rewarding swim experience. 

We want you to be prepared too and we want open water swimming to be something you embrace versus something you fear if you are a new swimmer . These clinics are good for you if: 

  • You're a good swimmer but don't have open water experience or you haven't been in the water for awhile,.
  • You're just rusty on your OWS and racing skills
  • You're looking for tips and pointers to improve your stroke and technique in open water.
  • Swimmers who are new to open water swimming in lakes or ocean venues.
  • New triathletes who are trying out a new sport even if you're a good pool swimmer.
  • Triathletes and swimmers who haven't been in the water for awhile.
  • Open water swimmers looking to improve skills and gain more comfort in the water.

We are segmenting our clinics into two clinics depending on your open water skills and comfort level.  However, swimmers of all abilities are welcome to any of the clinics but the first one is specifically targeted to new open water swimmers.  If you've got more experience and just want to swim you are more than welcome - just be prepared to share your experience and expertise with the newer swimmers!

Clinics are starting in June this year with one clinics on June27 and one on July 25.  That gives you time between the clinics to practice. 

Clinic #1 - Basic Open Water Skills - June 27 (Saturday)

We will start the season on June 29 with an introduction to open water swimming for people who have no or limited experience with swimming in open water, or swimmers who are rusty in their skills.  This clinic will talk about gear, water and swim conditions, gaining a comfort level in open water, and having an experience with the basics of entry, exit, sighting, breathing, etc.   No experience in open water or ocean is necessary to participate but you should be able to swim 100 yards with a focus on freestyle. Starting earlier will give you an opportunity to fully develop your open water skills before you get to your first starting line of the year.  You'll meet new swim buddies, have opportunities to seek out additional coaching and open water workouts.  You'll also be more comfortable in subsequent clinics. This clinic will be limited to only 25 participants to enhance smaller group coaching.

Clinic #2 - More Open Water Skills and Practice Sessions - July 25 (Saturday)

This clinic is a continuation of the beginning clinic and will focus on intermediate skills.  If you have open water skills and would like to improve them and  prior  experience in open water but you're not quite comfortable and need to improve your skills, you've not been in the water for awhile, or you started with the earlier clinic and want to continue improving your swim, and swim some longer distances away from the shoreline.   This is an opportunity to improve your skills for sighting, group swimming and drafting, race entry and exit, fine tuning for your stroke and gear.

Most people attend both clinics if they can because it's an opportunity to build new skills or fine-tune your existing open water skills. 

You can select to register for the swim clinics individually as clinic 1 and 2, or both clinics.   Clinics are $50 for each for the two clinics. There is a 10% discount for registering for both. 

 

All clinics are USA Triathlon sanctioned clinics and a one-day license or annual membership is required for participation. Because these clinic are taught by USA Triathlon certified coaches you only need to purchase one USAT one-day membership for both clinics if you are not already a member. Additionally, the one day membership can be deducted from a future purchase of an annual membership in 2026.  If you are already an annual member you will not need to pay for the additional one day membership license.

All Open Water Sessions  will meet at Cowell Beach in Santa Cruz.  You will receive specific email instructions and directions as well as gear lists before each clinic session.

name: OPTIMIST CLUB OF CORONADO                    2ND ANNUAL CROWN CITY                 SUMMER FITNESS CHALLENGE
description:
HAVE FUN, BE FIT, HELP YOUTH!

From July 4th through Labor Day, participants will log the amount of time each selected activity is performed, from a large list of activities available, via a Submit Activity web page -- biking, walking, running, tennis, swimming, and more.   The goals are to enhance physical fitness, build community spirit, have fun, and support the youth of Coronado.  Hours-per-week targets are:  Bronze: 1 hr; Silver: 2 hr; Gold: 3 hr; Diamond: 4 hr.   An awards celebration will be held the Saturday morning after Labor Day, 9AM at Spreckels Park. Coronado, CA    Teams encouraged.  Perfect event for dispersed family participation. Hosted by the Optimist Club of Coronado, CA.

name: OVERNIGHT CAMPING TRIP
description:
Join us on a low-key, easy getaway at San Onofre State Beach—just one night to relax, hang out, and get outside without committing to a full weekend. This trip will feature an instructor-led surf lesson. Wetsuits and boards provided. Please know that surfing is not mandatory for this trip but recommended if you want to try something new.

📍San Onofre State Beach --San Mateo Campground

San Onofre State Beach at a Glimpse: 

With more than three miles of shoreline, the park attracts visitors year-round for world-class surfing, swimming, sunbathing, and sweeping 
ocean views. An iconic surf destination since the 1930s, this stretch of coastline has played a pivotal role in shaping California’s surf culture. It is also the ancestral home of the Acjachemen (Juaneño) people and lies on leased land within U.S. Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton.

What else to expect:

This trip includes your camping gear (tent, sleeping bag, sleeping pad, headlamp), transportation, dinner and light breakfast. Optional surfing lesson (wetsuit and surfboard). Must be a confident swimmer.

name: Pacific Christian Center Run for Freedom
description:
We are excited to announce that on Saturday, October 3, 2026, Pacific Christian Center will be hosting our 3rd annual “Run for Freedom” a 5k Run/Walk at Waller Park to benefit Project Rescue.

 

Project Rescue is a dedicated non-profit organization committed to rescuing and restoring survivors of sexual slavery, exploitation, and human trafficking. Since its inception in 1997, Project Rescue has been on the front lines, providing compassionate intervention and holistic support to women and children in need. Through a network of global partners, they offer comprehensive care that addresses the physical, emotional, and spiritual needs of survivors, empowering them to reclaim their lives and build hopeful futures.

name: Pacific Coast Triathlon
description:
The Pacific Coast Triathlon invites athletes of all ages and abilities — from first-timers to seasoned competitors — to experience one of Southern California’s most scenic and celebrated races at the stunning Crystal Cove State Beach.

Start your day with a refreshing open-water swim in the Pacific Ocean right at Crystal Cove State Beach. Full lifeguard support and typically comfortable wave conditions make this leg welcoming for every level. Choose the Sprint (½ mile / ~750 m) or Olympic (1,500 m).

Next, tackle the bike on a fully closed, rolling course along the iconic Pacific Coast Highway. Enjoy sweeping ocean views as you ride two loops for the Sprint (12 miles) or four loops for the Olympic (40K / ~24.8 miles).

The run winds along the gorgeous Crystal Cove Trail and paths, with panoramic ocean views on one side and Pacific Coast Highway on the other. You’ll pass through the historic beach cottages, and — when tides allow — enjoy a memorable stretch right along the sand before climbing back up for an unforgettable oceanfront finish. Sprint runners cover 3 miles; Olympic athletes run 6.2 miles (10K), with aid stations every mile.

Additional race options include Sprint & Olympic Duathlon, Aquabike, Relay teams (male, female, or co-ed), and a 5K Beach and Trail Run.

This USAT-sanctioned event is part of the popular OC Tri Series and proudly supports local non-profits. Every finisher receives a custom medal (plus official race shirt and other great swag). Expect a festive beachside atmosphere with post-race food, awards ceremony, vendor village, and plenty of cheering spectators.

Whether you’re chasing a personal record or simply soaking in the beauty of the California coast, the Pacific Coast Triathlon delivers the perfect mix of challenge, scenery, and community.

The run winds along the gorgeous Crystal Cove Trail and paths, with panoramic ocean views on one side and Pacific Coast Highway on the other. You’ll pass through the historic beach cottages, and — when tides allow — enjoy a memorable stretch right along the sand before climbing back up for an unforgettable oceanfront finish. Sprint runners cover 3 miles; Olympic athletes run 6.2 miles (10K), with aid stations every mile.

Additional race options include Sprint & Olympic Duathlon, Aquabike, Relay teams (male, female, or co-ed), and a 5K Beach and Trail Run.

This USAT-sanctioned event is part of the popular OC Tri Series and proudly supports local non-profits. Every finisher receives a custom medal (plus official race shirt and other great swag). Expect a festive beachside atmosphere with post-race food, awards ceremony, vendor village, and plenty of cheering spectators.

Whether you’re chasing a personal record or simply soaking in the beauty of the California coast, the Pacific Coast Triathlon delivers the perfect mix of challenge, scenery, and community.

name: Palm Springs Health Run & Wellness Expo
description:
The Palm Springs Health Run & Wellness Festival has now become one of the largest events of its kind in Southern California and follows a spectacularly beautiful path in and around Ruth Hardy Park with picture perfect views of the San Jacinto Mountain Range. Hot, hip and fun is how describe the desert oasis of Palm Springs.

This USA Track and Field certified 10K and 5K event has caught the attention of serious runners and nationally recognized health and wellness speakers.

The Expo has grown substantially since its inception and now has over 100 vendors showcasing the latest in nutrition and exercise techniques, KESQ News Channel 3 Food Challenge, LifeStream Blood Bank Drive, rock climbing wall, walk on water and Aerial performers.

Not only is the event a way for health conscious individuals and families to come together, but it has now become a major fundraiser.

name: Palm Springs Pride 5K Run & Walk
description:
Kick off Palm Springs Pride Weekend with the Palm Springs Pride 5K Run & Walk, a vibrant celebration of movement, visibility, and community. All ages and abilities are welcome from seasoned runners to joyful strollers. Hosted by Palm Springs Front Runners & Walkers, this event fuels vital support for local LGBTQ+ organizations. Every step you take helps us raise more for our beneficiaries and strengthen the community we love.

Last year's Pride 5K sold out fast—all 1,200 spots were claimed before Packet Pick Up Day, and nearly 1,200 participants filled the course with joy, color, and community spirit. This year is expected to sell out even sooner. Secure your spot now and be part of this uplifting tradition.

🏳️‍🌈 Our Partnership with Palm Springs Pride

We are honored to be an Official Event of Greater Palm Springs Pride 2026. This partnership reflects our shared commitment to visibility, inclusion, and community support throughout the Coachella Valley.

Full event details are available on https://palmspringspriderun.com/.

name: Palm Springs Tram Road Challenge
description: Take on the Challenge! At the Palm Springs Tram Road Challenge, you'll climb almost 2,000 feet from the desert to the mountains in just 3.7 miles! You'll start at the intersection of Tram Way and Highway 111, with stunning views of the San Jacinto Mountains in front of you and the Coachella Valley behind. Choose to run your way up or take it easy for a nice uphill walk. No matter how you get there, when you reach the finish line, you'll enjoy a post-race festival with food, drink, booths, entertainment and awards for the winners. All participants receive a stylish finisher medal, cool race t-shirt, tasty post-race food and drink, and a bus ride back down the hill!! Awards for the top three in each age group will be given out to those registered in the Awards Eligible category, but everyone will be professionally timed! Sign up today and get ready to take on the challenge of a lifetime!

name: Palm Springs WILD TURKEY TROT 5K
description:
Make room for that extra piece of pie by completing the Palm Springs Wild Turkey Trot in iconic Palm Springs, California on Thanksgiving morning. This is a fast and flat certified course where world records are meant to be broken! Start and finish downtown, in perfect racing weather, on beautiful Palm Canyon.
WE PROMISE YOU MORE BLING THAN ANY OF THE OTHER DESERT TURKEY DAY RACES!

All participants receive a long sleeved tech t-shirt, finisher medal, free finisher photo download, turkey knee-hi socks and a wild turkey beanie! A portion of your entry supports the Mizell Center's Meals on Wheels Program, providing food for homebound seniors as well as other important local causes. This race is brought to you by the Palm Springs Marathon Runners with a reputation of awesome themed races supporting local charities!

name: Palo Alto Weekly Moonlight Run & Walk
description:
42nd Annual Palo Alto Weekly Moonlight Run & Walk | Friday, September 25, 2026

A benefit event for local nonprofits supporting both kids and families and local independent journalism. Register today to support your local nonprofits.

Start Times

  • 5:30 p.m. — Venue, sponsor booths and registration open
  • 7:00 p.m. ⁠— 5K Walk
  • 8:15 p.m. — 10K Run
  • 8:30 p.m. — 5K Run

Water Stops

  • 5K — at mid-point
  • 10K — at miles 2 and 4.5

Course Maps: View on MapMyRun.com:

  • 5K course map
  • 10K course map

Results & Awards

Medals for first-, second- and third-place finishers in each division will be handed out on race night after all races have finished.

Virtual Option Available

This year's Palo Alto Weekly Moonlight Run & Walk will be offered in person and virtually! For more details on the virtual option, click the "Virtual Participation" option when registering.
 

General Information

No Refunds

As a charity event, we are not able to give refunds. However, if your plans change, you may transfer your registration to a friend or family member. The deadline to gift your entry to a friend or family member is September 17th. To do so, follow these steps: (1) log in to your Runsignup account (or click on "manage my entry" on your confirmation email) (2) within your account, navigate to your race entry/manage registration (3) select 'transfer to another runner' and fill in the required info of the recipient (first name, last name, email address). There is both a written and video tutorial for this process posted here.

Changing Your Race Distance

If after registering, you would like to change your race distance (e.g. from the 10K Run to the 5K Run), you may make this adjustment within your Runsignup account. To do so, follow these steps: (1) log in to your runsignup account (or click on "manage my entry" on your confirmation email) (2) within your account, navigate to your race entry / manage registration (3) select 'Transfer to Another Event" and then select the new event. There is both a written and video tutorial for this process posted here.

The deadline to make adjustments is September 29th at 11:59 pm. After this time, adjustments must be made on race night at the Problems and Solutions / Information tent. 

Moonlight Run Shirts

Each registration completed before October 1st includes a free long-sleeve Moonlight Run shirt (while supplies last) and race bib, both of which can be picked up at check-in on the day of the event. Shirt sizes and availability are not guaranteed, and we encourage you to arrive early on race night for the best selection. 

What’s changed for 2025?

No half marathon: Due to construction along the route, the half marathon will not be held this year. We recommend trying the 10K instead. The half marathon will return in 2026 once construction is complete.

Updated race start times: We’ve made a few small adjustments to start times for 2025.
7:00 PM – 5K Walk (unchanged)
8:15 PM – 10K Run (previously 8:25 PM)
8:30 PM – 5K Run (previously 8:15 PM)

The 10K course has been updated this year. View the new map HERE.

NEW: Visit our merch booth!
Stop by the merch booth to purchase:
-Moonlight Run posters
-Moonlight Run t-shirts
-Tote bags
-Stickers
-Memberships to Palo Alto Online (and any of our other publications)
All proceeds support local journalism.

Reminder: No cash is accepted on site. Please bring a card or mobile payment.

Safety Protocol

Headlamps are highly recommended for all runs.

Parking and Logistics

Race check-in, sponsor and race headquarters booths, first aid and food/water are on the infield of the Baylands Athletic Center, located at the end of Geng Rd.

We recommend arriving at least an hour before your event. Police and volunteers will direct you to parking in nearby business lots off Embarcadero Rd. and E. Bayshore Rd. Please do not park in the Stanford Eye Clinic lot.

Limited checking of small personal bags & backpacks is available.

name: Park to Playa 10K
description:
Babes of Wellness is a Los Angeles–based wellness studio rooted in movement, community, and health. What began as a space for women and femmes to show up as they are has grown into a citywide collective for inclusive fitness experiences that honor both the body and the land we move through—a practice as old as the trails themselves. Babes of Wellness believes that movement is not about performance, it's about connection, consistency, and reclaiming wellness as something communal and accessible.

Park to Playa reflects that ethos. This 10K is more than a race, it's a shared journey across Los Angeles, inviting runners to experience the city through breath, rhythm, and collective momentum. By bringing people together on the trail, Babes of Wellness creates space to move with intention, celebrate the cultural heritage of this land, and remind us that running, like wellness itself, is powerful and meant to be shared.

name: Patagonia Salmon Run 5K
description:
Patagonia is excited to announce the 30th Annual Salmon Run, to be held November 15, 2026.

This year marks the 30th Annual running of the salmon and we are going to make it better than ever. As a reminder, this race always sells out, so make sure you get your registration in.

We will be deciding this year's race beneficiary as we get closer to the race and will update here! 

Additionally, we want the Salmon Run to be a Zero-Waste-Event to mitigate sending anything to the waste stream that doesn't have to. We will send out details on how to prepare for this closer to the day of the race, but plan to bring your own water bottle and coffee mug.

Ventura, CA 93001

THERE WILL NOT BE DAY-OF REGISTRATION FOR THE SALMON RUN. ALL PARTICIPANTS MUST REGISTER ONLINE, WHICH CLOSES AT NOON ON MONDAY, NOVEMBER 10th OR WHEN THE RACE SELLS OUT

name: Paws On Patrol 5k
description:
Join us on Saturday, October 3, 2026, for an unforgettable experience at the historic Castle Air Museum in Atwater, California. Lace up your running shoes and bring the whole family for a one-of-a-kind event that combines community spirit, superhero fun, and support for those who serve and protect.

Whether you're chasing a new personal record in the 5K, enjoying the 2K Run/Walk with friends, or cheering from the sidelines, every participant becomes part of a mission that extends far beyond the finish line.

Your registration helps support multiple local agencies dedicated to protecting our communities, including efforts to provide protective K9 vests for law enforcement working dogs. These courageous four-legged officers put themselves in harm's way every day, and together we can help ensure they have the equipment they need to stay safe.

🏃‍♀️ Run fast.
🚶 Walk proud.
🐕 Support our K9 heroes.
❤️ Strengthen our community.

Experience a unique course set against the backdrop of historic aircraft and aviation history at Castle Air Museum, all while making a real impact on the lives of those who serve others.

Because heroes come in all sizes—some even have four paws.

Join the pack. Be the difference.

name: PB&J Fuel Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Smooth vibes. Sweet energy. Bold moves. 🥜🍓


PB&J Fuel Run is all about a combo that just works. Mix your pace, spread the fun, and stick with it all the way to the finish. No stress, no expectations, just miles that feel good and a finish that feels even better. Run it your way, enjoy every step, and fuel your finish with good energy and great company. Let’s make this run unforgettable. 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️✨

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

The officers photo along with the agency they worked for and their “End of watch” date will be displayed at their mile marker.

name: Peach Festival 5k/10k
description:
On Saturday, July 18th at 8am, the Yuba-Sutter Training Zone will host the 2026 Peach Festival 5k/10k. All proceeds from this race will benefit Live Well Yuba Sutter.

COURSE: Starts in front of Yuba Sutter Training Zone (830 J St, Marysville, CA) and runs over the 5th Street Bridge & back.

Online registration will close Friday, July 17th at 8:00pm. If you miss online registration, you will be able to register day of, register early to save!!

Race bibs can be picked up on Friday, July 17th at the Training Zone from noon to 8:00pm or on race day.

RACE DAY REGISTRATION: Begins at 7:15 am at Training Zone in Marysville, 10k will start at 8am and 5k to follow at 8:15am.

AWARDS: Medals will be presented to the first 3 male and female finishers in each division: 9 & under, 10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60 & older.
