name: Pier to Cove Swim - La Jolla, CA
description:
Swim 1.5 miles from Scripps Pier to La Jolla Cove. This is an organized and timed event with awards to the top finishers.  It is an open water event and the conditions and temperature add to the challenge.  San Diego Lifeguards will oversee the safety of all participants.  At the finish, you will be greeted by LJCSC volunteers, breakfast provided by Duke's of La Jolla, awards for regulation top finishers, awards for regulation age group winners, and participant swag. 

EVENT INFORMATION

Registration 7:30-8:30 AM at La Jolla Shores

NOTE: Registration Location: La Jolla Shores Beach, Kellogg Park, North End
(North side of parking lot; near north end bathrooms; setup on grass). Swimmers will walk from there to the Pier, about ¼ mile away.

The swim will start on the north side of Scripps Pier at 9:00 AM.

Swimmer safety is our first priority. San Diego Lifeguards will watch over swimmers from a boat, jet skis, and paddleboards.

"Beach" REGISTRATION and PRE-REGISTERED CHECK-IN is 7:30 - 8:30 AM

NOTE: REGISTRATION LOCATION:
LA JOLLA SHORES KELLOGG PARK NORTH END
(North end of main parking lot)

There is a large free parking lot at the registration area and parking is plentiful, especially if you arrive early. You can also carpool, UBER, LYFT, or have someone drop you off.

If you need a ride from La Jolla Cove to Registration , we will offer limited, free shuttle service from the Cove starting at 7:15 AM until around 8:15 AM. Shuttle service is not guaranteed, especially if you arrive late.

Restroom facilities are available next to the registration area at the North end of the Shores.

Restrooms and showers (cold) are also available at La Jolla Cove.

Swimmers may leave their swim bags at registration with event volunteers, and the bags will be taken to La Jolla Cove where you can pick them up at the end of your swim. They will be watched, but do not leave valuable or fragile items in bags.
*The La Jolla Cove Swim Club is not responsible for loss.

Electronic Timing will be provided.

*There is a 90 minute time limit for this swim. After 90 minutes, lifeguards will remove any remaining swimmers from the water.

Registration Categories:

"Regulation" is according to USMS rules. Neoprene swim caps are acceptable.

“Non-Regulation”: Swimmers may wear wetsuits, rash guards, fins, or masks and snorkels, etc.

Awards to the 1st place Overall male and female “Regulation” swimmers.
Awards to the 1st place "Regulation" male and female finishers in each age group.

We encourage young swimmers, but safety is our prime concern. Parental approval is required for swimmers younger than 18. The recommended minimum age for this swim is 16. Younger swimmers will be considered if they have an acceptable swimming resume. Approval is at the discretion of the Event Director.

Prior to registering swimmers younger than 18, please send an email to lajollacoveswimclub@gmail.com and include a list of their open water swimming experience. Approval will be at the discretion of the event director. If approved, the swimmer may register on-line.

Registration is capped at 325 swimmers and event swag will be guaranteed for registered swimmers. Day of the event beach registrations may be approved the the Race Director. Please contact in advance.

This event is for experienced ocean swimmers who are prepared for a swim of 1.5 miles in open ocean, “rough water” conditions. The San Diego City Lifeguards will provide safety support, but we cannot guarantee the safety of swimmers, especially for those who are unprepared.

name: Pincushion Hill Climb
description:
1 mile. Straight up. This will be a chip timed hill climb starting at the San Joaquin River Trailhead in the South Finegold picnic area (Millerton Lk SRA; end of Sky Harbor Rd) and finishing at the top of Pincushion Mountain. There will be a special prize for the Top 3 Male and Female finishers, age groups winners will receive awards as well as Clydesdale/Athena division winners. All runners will receive a custom finisher award and event shirt. 

Pincushion Hill Climb: Mountain Goat Edition! The Mountain Goat race is for those who like to go the extra mile or miles. Your first run up will be timed and scored for the regular event then you have until 12pm (4hrs total) to complete as many trips up to Pincushion Peak as possible. Your first trip down you must take the long way (just over 1.5 miles) after that you may descend the same route you take to the top. You must complete at least 2 trips to the top in order to be considered a Mountain Goat. You will receive a special finishers award and the top Male & Female runners will receive an additional award.

name: Pink on Parade
description:
JOIN US for Pink on Parade on Saturday, October 24!


What is Pink on Parade?


Pink on Parade is Riverside's 14th annual Breast Cancer Awareness walk, a family-friendly (and pet-friendly!) walk with two routes. Choose to walk Mt. Rubidoux, a 5k endeavor representing the cancer journey, or the Family Fun walk, a 1.7k route that encircles the park. Prepare for a day filled with joy and laughter with your friends, family, co-workers as we celebrate our survivors, honor those we have lost, and support our local cancer resource center, The Pink Ribbon Place.

Event Details

Saturday, October 24, 2024 | 7:30am -12:00pm

5000 Tequesquite Ave Riverside, CA 92506

Activities

Expo/Family Activities 

Enjoy a perfect day filled with fun family activities! Be sure to experience the vendor expo, kids zone and assortment of food and drink options. Consider packing a picnic blanket for lunch at the park!

Survivor Pavilion 

An exclusive pavilion curated for cancer survivors with activities designed to promote wellness and self-care.

Classic Car Show

A throwback experience! See import and domestic
classic cars from the 1940s to the 1980s.

Stretch & Warm Up 

Get pumped up and ready to walk from head to toe!

Team Prizes Announcements

You worked hard to build your team, fundraise, and raise awareness— now it’s time for the official count! Join us as we congratulate this year’s outstanding winners of the Most Money Raised and the Team Spirit Awards.

Follow us on Instagram at @thepinkribbonplace for more details

100% of the proceeds from our walk goes towards the programs of The Pink Ribbon Place, a program of Riverside Community Health Foundation a 501(c)(3) charity, tax ID 23-7276444. Now that is something to be proud of!

name: Pinoy Runners Norcal 7K / .7M Fun Run
description:
Pinoy Runners Norcal 7K / .7M Fun Run

(Formerly Pinoy Runners Brgy. Bay Area Fun Run 5k/10k)


🎉Celebrating our 3rd Year

🇵🇭 About the Event

Our goal has always been to:

Bring together Filipino runners and friends
Promote health and fitness
Celebrate Filipino pride
Give back to the community
For the second straight year, we continue that tradition at beautiful Sierra Point in Brisbane, CA.

A portion of race proceeds and optional donations will support charities both locally and in the Philippines.

🏃 Race Options
7K Run
Perfect for runners looking for a fun, flat, scenic course.

0.7 Mile Fun Walk
Great for kids, families, beginners, and casual walkers.

Why 7K and 0.7 mile?
We were inspired by the nearby Filipina-owned landmark, 7 Mile House Restaurant. 

📍 Course Information
Both courses are:

Flat
Scenic
Out-and-back routes
Schedule
🕘 0.7 Mile Fun Walk starts at 9:00 AM
 🕤 7K Run starts at 9:30 AM

The 7K course will be a single out-and-back route this year (unlike last year’s double out-and-back due to construction).

You may register for:

Either race individually
OR both races

🏅 Awards & Swag
7K Awards
Awards will be given to the:

Top 3 Overall Male Finishers
Top 3 Overall Female Finishers
0.7 Mile Fun Walk
This event is non-competitive and will not have awards.

Finisher Medals
🏅 All participants in both events will receive a finisher medal.

Race Shirts
👕 Registered participants ages 14+ will receive a race shirt.

⚠️ IMPORTANT:
 Register by August 1, 2026 to guarantee your shirt size. 

👧 Youth Registration (Ages 13 & Under)
Youth participants receive heavily discounted registration.

Because of the reduced rate:

Shirts are NOT included for ages 13 and under
Extra shirts may be available for purchase after the race while supplies last
 

🎟️ Raffle
After the races, stick around for our raffle beginning at approximately 10:30 AM.

Raffle Details
Participants ages 14+ receive 1 raffle ticket with registration
Additional raffle tickets will be available for purchase
⚠️ Must be present to win.
 Prizes cannot be claimed by someone else on your behalf

❤️ Giving Back
Race proceeds will benefit charities and community causes.
Partner organizations and beneficiaries will be announced later.

 

VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITIES: 

Interested in helping with set up, course. marshaling, aid stations, check in and clean up?

VOLUNTEER SIGN UP HERE!!!

Thank you for helping!!

name: Pirate 5K Booty Run
description:
Arrrrg ye mates! Join us for the 12th Annual Pirate Booty Run! Run or walk our 5k where Pirates are poised and waiting for you along the course!

Beware of Scallywags along the music lined course.  Participants receive a Finisher Pirate Medallion, event shirt and a chance at the Pirates Treasure Chest.  Dress in your best pirate garb and run for the booty.  Walkers and strollers welcome.   2nd race in the Cal Classic Runner of the Year Series!

Special pricing for kids 9 and under - Discount given automatically during registration.

name: Pirates Plunder –  5K, 10K, 10-miler, and Half Marathon
description:
Ahoy, runners! Set sail for Pirates Plunder, a beachside run where miles meet treasure, costumes are encouraged, and every finisher earns their share of the fun. Come ready to run, walk, plunder, and celebrate by the shore.

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1-3:00pm – Bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

This is an out and back course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location.

Our courses are not closed, so there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The course never goes off the beach path.

On-Course Support

A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: Results and photos are posted on RunSignup the day of the race as they are available, check back here in the evening! An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Sthe San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Ask our Chatbot or head to the FAQ page of the site

name: PLAYTRI - IRONMAN 70.3 LA QUINTA
description:
PLAYTRI - OFFICIAL TRIATHLON STORE OF IRONMAN 

We bring our expert in-house mechanics and triathletes to IRONMAN® Events and offer the highest quality rentals, repair and maintenance services for you and your bike. From race ready tunes up to complete overhaul packages, we'll keep you riding and racing smooth on the road! We are a full-service shop available onsite to take care of additional services leading up to and on race day.

name: Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

 PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options on Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race, check out the bib pick up tab for the latest.


LOCATION/PARKING 
The event staging area is located at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (7300 E La Palma, Anaheim Hills, CA 92807), just past the softball fields near the 5k/10k start line. 

Parking is available inside Yorba Regional Park. Payment of $5 per car may be required Enter the park off La Palma from eastbound or westbound lanes starting at 6:00 AM until approximately 6:45 AM, when the eastbound lanes along the park will be closed for the start of the 10k race. Thereafter, access to the park will be via westbound La Palma only when the course is clear of runners. 

Additional parking is available in the following areas: 1) Paved/gravel lots adjacent to softball fields at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (very limited capacity); 2) residential areas directly across from the park; 3) residential areas west of Fairmont Blvd off Hondo Dr; and 3) on the street and in church parking lots off of the Fairmont Connector between Esperanza and Fairmont Blvd. 

We expect heavy traffic on race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

RACE DAY SCHEDULE - Subject to change, please check the event website in November for final details
6:00 AM - Late registration/packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
8:00 AM - 5k start
8:40 AM - 5k & 10k overall winners announced* 
9:00 AM - Kids 1k fun run & 100ish-yd tot trot (tot trot first, followed by 1k) 

* Age group winners will not be formally announced; runners can claim their medals at the awards table shortly after they finish. The top three overall participants are based on gun time, the first to cross the finish is the winner, and age group awards are based on chip time.

Get ready for an unforgettable day of fitness, fun, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you at the starting line! 🏃‍♀️🥳🏆

name: Polar Bear Run 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🐻‍❄️ Polar Bear Run
5K • 10K • Half Marathon
📍 Long Beach, CA
📅 January 18, 2026

Brace yourself for crisp air, cool miles, and that brrr-but-worth-it January energy. The Polar Bear Run is a winter tradition for runners who don’t hibernate — they layer up, show up, and earn their miles the cold way. ❄️

 

Cold mornings. Clear skies. Strong strides. This is winter running at its best.

 
❄️ What’s Included
✔ Professional Chip Timing for accurate results
📸 Free Race Photos – download and share your frosty finish
🎖️ Finisher Medal for All Participants
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards
💧 Three On-Course Water Stations
🎉 Finish Line Party with music and high vibes

 
🧤 Who Can Participate?
All are welcome — runners, walkers, stroller athletes, and all paces.
Whether you’re chasing a PR or just chasing warmth at the finish line, this run is for you.

 
🕒 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
Bib Pick-Up/ Same Day Registration:
6:00 AM – 7:30 AM
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent

Start Times:
🏁 Half Marathon – 7:00 AM
🏁 5K & 10K – 7:30 AM

 
📍 Start Location
5400 E Ocean Blvd
Long Beach, CA 90803

 
🚗 Parking
• Free street parking available
• Beach lot parking available for $2.00 per hour (pay at machines)

 
🏆 Awards
Top 3 Overall Men & Women in each distance

🎤 Podium Ceremonies:
Overall Winners : 9:15 AM

name: POMONA 5K & 10K
description:
Join us for the 10th Annual Pomona 5K & 10K on Saturday, October 17, 2026

The Pomona 5K/10K celebrates its 10th anniversary on Saturday, October 17, 2026. Take the chance to be a part of this historic milestone. With an average of 700 running participants and over 500 spectators in Downtown Pomona to cheer on all the runners, this event is a premier community event in the City of Pomona with a broad reach.


Visit the Health & Wellness Resource Fair from 8:00am through 12:00pm

In conjunction with the Pomona 5K & 10K, we are also hosting the Health & Wellness Resource Fair at Shaun Diamond Plaza throughout the race and after. If you are not participating in the race, or if you finish early, please visit the booths at our Health & Wellness Resource Fair. We  created this complimentary event to highlight our community partners, provide accessible health services and promote wellness for resident of all ages. Visit the Health & Wellness Fair for information on what's happening in the community, free health screenings, wellness education, and direct connections to valuable healthcare and support services.


Our Background

The Pomona 5K was born in 2016, with the vision of creating a community-driven running event in the heart of Downtown Pomona. The Pomona 5K is a partnership between Pomona Valley Runners, a local running group, and various community organizations including God’s Pantry, a community-based nonprofit organization. This event has been coordinated by a core group of dedicated community leaders from Pomona who volunteer their time to put on this event from the ground up.

 

SCHEDULE

FRIDAY, October 16, 2026 | Location TBD
  • 6:00 PM- 8:00 PM            |            Registration & Packet Pick Up / Check-In


SATURDAY, October 17, 2026 - RACE DAY | Shaun Diamond Plaza
  • 6:30AM                              |          Registration
  • 7:00 AM                             |          Welcome 
  • 7:10 AM                             |          Toddler Trot
  • 7:20 AM                             |          Warm-up
  • 7:30 AM                             |          5K START (Combo runners will start with and complete their 5K distance prior to the 10K start.  You will                                                                                then start with and complete your 10K distance.)
  • 8:30 AM                             |          10K START
  • 10:00 AM                           |          Division Winners
  • 8:00AM - 12:00PM           |          Health & Wellness Fair

description:
Join us for the 10th Annual Pomona 5K & 10K on Saturday, October 17, 2026

The Pomona 5K/10K celebrates its 10th anniversary on Saturday, October 17, 2026. Take the chance to be a part of this historic milestone. With an average of 700 running participants and over 500 spectators in Downtown Pomona to cheer on all the runners, this event is a premier community event in the City of Pomona with a broad reach.


Visit the Health & Wellness Resource Fair from 8:00am through 12:00pm

If you are not participating in the race, or if you finish early, please visit the booths at our Health & Wellness Resource Fair. We  created this complimentary event to highlight our community partners, provide accessible health services and promote wellness for resident of all ages. Visit the Health & Wellness Fair for information on what's happening in the community, free health screenings, wellness education, and direct connections to valuable healthcare and support services.

name: Popsicle Dash - Free Community Event - 5K by Califlow Runs
description:
Free Community Event • 5K
📍 5100 E Ocean Blvd, Granada Beach (Rosie’s Dog Beach), Long Beach, CA 90803

Get ready for good energy, ocean breezes, and a little bit of Long Beach weirdness.

Popsicle Dash is not just a run — it’s a whole mood. This free 5K community event celebrates movement, sunshine, and the laid-back, colorful spirit of Long Beach. Walk, jog, or run — all paces welcome.

FREE Popsicles at the finish line

 
🏁 Event Perks
🌊 Flat, fast beach path with ocean views
🏅 Finisher medals for all participants
🍧 Popsicles at the finish line
📷 Free race photos
🍼 Stroller- and walker-friendly


 
🔥 🏖 “Most Extra Costume Contest”  🏖 🔥


Any costume. Any vibe. You choose.

Show up in your wildest, weirdest, most over-the-top look. Think:
🏄‍♂️ Hawaiian shirts & beach party vibes
🌈 Neon retro fits
🦩 Flamingos, inflatables, or totally random accessories
🎶 90s LBC throwback looks

🏆 Winners crowned post-run — plus ultimate bragging rights for being the most extra.

 
📍 Check-In & Start Time
🕕 Check-In Opens: 5:00 PM
📍 5100 E Ocean blvd Long Beach, CA 90803 (Granada Beach)
🏁 5K Start:6:30PM

 
🚗 Parking Information
✅ Free street parking available
🅿️ Beach lot parking: $2.00 per hour (pay at the machine)

 
🫶 Safety First
We prioritize participant safety at every event:
💧 Water stations on course
🚑 Medical staff  at the finish

 
🎉 Ready to Run, Chill & Cool Off?
Bring your friends, your family, your pup, and your best summer energy.
Run the miles. Earn the popsicle.

name: Pre Reg 2027 Heroes 4 Hearing 5K
description:
This is the registration page for 2027 - if you are looking for info on the Aug 16th 2026- please go to 

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/FountainValley/Heroes4Hearing

 

Place

Shoreline Aquatic Park
200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

HearAid Foundation presents our 6th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 15th, 2027 in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. 

Join us for an exhilarating run along the marina and water front in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the sea.

Event Details:

Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Course Description:

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results will be posted on our website within 12 hours of the race.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff .

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup within 2 hours of the race.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity. 


Who Can Register:

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!

We look forward to seeing you adjacent to the aquarium for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

name: Pre Registration 2027 - Beverly Hills Run of the Stars
description:
This is the page for the 2027 event! (If you are looking for the event held on Oct 18th, 2026, please click here https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/BeverlyHills/STARS5K) 

 

Lace up and run through the flat, scenic streets of Beverly Hills at this year’s 5K on October 17th, 2027!

 

Run or Walk on your own or on a team!

Can’t make it in person? Join our Virtual Challenge and complete your 5K from anywhere in the world.

We’re also hosting a 1K “Stars of Tomorrow” Kids Race held at the same location right after the 5K- perfect for young runners ready to shine! (Note: All ages are welcome to participate in the 5k but only those under-10 can registers for the 1k.)

 

This event supports NOT TODAY CANCER and their mission to find a CURE for devastating childhood cancers. 
 
Despite childhood cancer rates being on the rise, a desperately small amount of US Federal Funding for Cancer Research goes to children. 
 
When Mason was 9 years old he was diagnosed with T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).  His cancer was treated with chemotherapies that have been in use for decades, because there is a devastating lack of funding for new treatments with better outcomes!  
For two years, Mason and his family used the slogan “Not Today Cancer'“ as their mantra and when he died from the disease, the journey continued and this local non-profit was founded in Mason's honor. Scientists are close to a cure to help children like Mason and you can help! 
 
NOT TODAY CANCER 

 

Packet Pick Up, where you can get your shirt and bib, on Saturday, the day before the race. Time and Location TBD. 

If you are having someone else pick up your bib, shirt, and bag, they will need two things. A printed copy of your ID and a printed signed copy of the waiver. You can download and print the waiver here.  No bibs will be given out without this. The lawyers and our insurance company require us to be strict on this, sorry for the inconvenience.

If you are unable to join us the day before, you can pick up your bib and shirt on race day in the festival area but get there early and be prepared to wait in line on race day.
*Reminder: Please wear your bib on the front of your clothes so that your photos can be tagged and so we know you are with the event.*

DAY OF RACE INFO: https://www.nottodaycancer.care/ntc-run

RACE PARKING:  TBD

Race Day Schedule:

TBD

name: Pre-Registration 2027 Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Please visit https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Anaheim/PlymouthRocknRun to sign up for the 2026 Plymouth Rock n Run or to view results or photos. This site is only for 2027 early registration. 

All information on this page and in your confirmation email are subject to change. Do not assume this is correct. Check the event website at https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Anaheim/PlymouthRocknRun the week of the event and then again the day before the event to confirm the details. You will also get an email with event details that week. Check your junk folder if you don't see it. That email and the website supersede what is written here and supersedes what you get in your confirmation email. 

Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details that we have at the moment:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options are planned for the Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race day. Check out the bib pick up tab for the latest details as they are confirmed and follow us on social media for the fastest updates.


LOCATION/PARKING 
The event staging area is located at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (7300 E La Palma, Anaheim Hills, CA 92807), just past the softball fields near the 5k/10k start line. 

Parking is available inside Yorba Regional Park. Payment of $5 per car may be required Enter the park off La Palma from eastbound or westbound lanes starting at 6:00 AM until approximately 6:45 AM, when the eastbound lanes along the park will be closed for the start of the 10k race. Thereafter, access to the park will be via westbound La Palma only when the course is clear of runners. 

Additional parking is available in the following areas: 1) Paved/gravel lots adjacent to softball fields at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (very limited capacity); 2) residential areas directly across from the park; 3) residential areas west of Fairmont Blvd off Hondo Dr; and 3) on the street and in church parking lots off of the Fairmont Connector between Esperanza and Fairmont Blvd. 

We expect heavy traffic on race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

PRELIMINARY RACE DAY SCHEDULE - SUBJECT TO CHANGE
6:00 AM - Late registration/packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
8:00 AM - 5k start
8:40 AM - 5k & 10k overall winners announced* 
9:00 AM - Kids 1k fun run & 100ish-yd tot trot (tot trot first, followed by 1k) 

* Age group winners will not be formally announced; runners can claim their medals at the awards table shortly after they finish. The top three overall participants are based on gun time, the first to cross the finish is the winner, and age group awards are based on chip time.

Get ready for an unforgettable day of fitness, fun, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you at the starting line! 🏃‍♀️🥳🏆

Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details that we have at the moment:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options are planned for the Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race day. Check out the bib pick up tab for the latest details as they are confirmed and follow us on social media for the fastest updates.


LOCATION/PARKING 
The event staging area is located at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (7300 E La Palma, Anaheim Hills, CA 92807), just past the softball fields near the 5k/10k start line. 

Parking is available inside Yorba Regional Park. Payment of $5 per car may be required Enter the park off La Palma from eastbound or westbound lanes starting at 6:00 AM until approximately 6:45 AM, when the eastbound lanes along the park will be closed for the start of the 10k race. Thereafter, access to the park will be via westbound La Palma only when the course is clear of runners. 

Additional parking is available in the following areas: 1) Paved/gravel lots adjacent to softball fields at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (very limited capacity); 2) residential areas directly across from the park; 3) residential areas west of Fairmont Blvd off Hondo Dr; and 3) on the street and in church parking lots off of the Fairmont Connector between Esperanza and Fairmont Blvd. 

We expect heavy traffic on race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

PRELIMINARY RACE DAY SCHEDULE - SUBJECT TO CHANGE
6:00 AM - Late registration/packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
8:00 AM - 5k start
8:40 AM - 5k & 10k overall winners announced* 
9:00 AM - Kids 1k fun run & 100ish-yd tot trot (tot trot first, followed by 1k) 

* Age group winners will not be formally announced; runners can claim their medals at the awards table shortly after they finish. The top three overall participants are based on gun time, the first to cross the finish is the winner, and age group awards are based on chip time.

Get ready for an unforgettable day of fitness, fun, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you at the starting line! 🏃‍♀️🥳🏆

name: Pre-Registration Screenland 5K 2028
description:
This is only the Early Registration page for the 2028 event, please go to

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/CulverCity/Screenland5K  or https://www.screenland5k.com for more information about our event on February 28, 2027 and to sign up.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our start studded Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.

All participants will receive commemorative bib, official time, medal and shirt and on course support and entertainment, entrance into the post race party and free downloadable event photos among many other perks.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the 5K at Screenland and then either the 5K or the 13K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run in August at Dockweiler Beach .  If you missed Screenland in the spring, you can start the challenge at BRA Run in August and finish it at Screenland the following year.

We update the list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K  at www.BRArunLA.com.

description:

Say what again? Join us for a Tarantino-inspired race experience that brings cult-classic energy to the streets of Canoga Park. Whether you're running for redemption, milkshakes, or the Gold Watch, this is your chance to bring your cinematic swagger to the start line.

All finishers will receive:

  • Custom race bib
  • Signature themed medal
  • Free downloadable finisher photos

name: Race for Rescues
description:
🐾 Run. Walk. Make Miles Matter.

Join the Race for Rescues Virtual Challenge—where every mile you log helps give rescue animals at the Pasadena Humane a second chance at life.
This isn’t just a run or walk… it’s a purpose-driven movement.
Choose your challenge:
50 Miles or 100 Miles
Complete your miles on your schedule, at your own pace—whether you're hitting the road, trails, treadmill, or neighborhood sidewalks. Every step you take makes an impact!
 

📅 Starts July 11, 2026

 

🎽 Your $49 Entry Includes:

🏅 AWESOME Finisher’s Medal
🎒 Miles That Matter Hiking Backpack
📊 Live Leaderboard + Mileage Tracking
📱 RaceJoy App Access (optional)
🎯 Milestone Stories from Pasadena Humane
🔢 Digital Bib Number + Finisher Certificate
📦 FREE U.S. Shipping
🐾 Donation to Pasadena Humane 

 

🐾✨ PAWS FOR A CAUSE

We’re incredibly proud to partner with the Pasadena Humane for the second year in a row—and continue supporting the life-changing work they do for animals in need.
From rescuing abandoned and injured pets to providing critical medical care, shelter, and rehabilitation, their team shows up every single day with compassion and heart. In times of crisis—like wildfires—they go even further, taking in and caring for hundreds of displaced animals when they need it most.
This isn’t just what they do… it’s who they are.
And when you join this challenge, you become part of that mission.

name: Race Thru the Redwoods
description:
*Sign up and take advantage of early bird pricing from Mother's Day through Father's Day only! 

The Race Thru The Redwoods starts and finishes at Roaring Camp Railroads in Felton, California.  The majority of the 10K race occurs under the majestic redwoods of Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park.  The Felton Business and Community Association and many local volunteers help manage and administer the race.

We are very excited to continue this race back for another year; with all that has gone on over this year and last, it is nice to do something that brings back fond memories and reminds us how lucky we are to be able to race, run, walk, or jog in such a lovely place. My wife and I fell in love under these trees at this race in 2013.

The race is open to anyone: runners, walkers, strollers, and joggers.

The 10k will take place on August 16th at 8:30 am.  Before the 10k, we will start the Kids Race at 8 am.  After the race, we are also delighted to host the PANCAKE breakfast sponsored by the Zayante Fire Department. Pancake Breakfast is included in your race fee. Non-participants can still enjoy a late brunch for a $10.00 fee.

If you'd like to share a picture or video of your run/walk with us.  We will create an album of all race pictures and share it via the RttRW website.

https://www.facebook.com/racethrutheredwoods 

This year has all the traditional course features that make the RttRW a local favorite and destination race.

10k Route: https://www.strava.com/routes/3257857005510265448

Kids 1 Mile: https://www.strava.com/routes/3260069223760673672 (2 laps)

Race Thru the Redwoods is more than a run through one of the most beautiful places in the Santa Cruz Mountains — it is also the Felton Business & Community Association’s biggest annual fundraiser. Proceeds from the race help support the many free community events and traditions we are proud to bring to Felton throughout the year. Every registration helps keep these events alive, welcoming, and accessible to our neighbors, families, and visitors. Thank you for running with us, supporting our town, and helping us continue to create moments that bring the Felton community together.

name: Race To Slow The Pace
description:
The sixth annual Race to Slow the Pace 5K & 10K, presented in partnership with the John and Jeani Ferrari Family Foundation, to be held at Bokisch Vineyards in Lodi, CA is a trail run to connect people with nature, the environment and family farms that feed them, while furthering California Farmland Trust’s mission. Our goal is to foster a connection to the land and why we must slow the pace of development and protect farmland. Runners will weave their way through the scenic vineyard at Bokisch while taking in the vines, the habitat, and the value of open space that farmland provides. Your participation of the run connects you to the local community and demonstrates your support of agriculture.  This is a family, stroller and pet-friendly event designed to get you out into the beauty of Lodi and a working vineyard.

 

Course: This is a trail run course that includes navigating uneven, dirt terrain with slight hills through a working vineyard.

 

Fees: Individual in-person participation, either 5k or 10k will include a custom race bib, finisher medal, paella brunch, glass of wine (for participants over 21 years old), and signature race swag.

$65 Early Bird Registration fee (until June 30)
$70 Regular Registration fee (July 1 through September 12)
$75 Race Day fee

 

Awards

  • Overall winners by gender
  • Overall master winners (50+) by gender
  • Age-category winners by gender
    • 18 years and under
    • 19-29
    • 30-39
    • 40-49
    • 50-59
    • 60-69
    • 70+

 

We are seeking volunteers to help on Race Day. If you would like to volunteer, please click the Volunteer button in the header menu.  There is no charge to volunteer and all volunteers will receive race swag.

 

Race Day Schedule
7:00 am - Check-in and race day registration opens
8:30 am - Starting time for all 5k / 10k runners and walkers
Brunch and Awards Ceremony

name: Race2Unravel
description:
Join us in Gilroy, California on Saturday, August 22, 2026, for the Race2Unravel — a powerful day of ACTION in the fight against childhood cancer.

This inspiring community event features a 5K, 10K, and our new 5K Ruck Division — because every step forward fuels critical pediatric cancer research. Whether you run, ruck, sponsor, or donate, you are helping fund innovative research and honoring the children who inspire us: those still fighting, those we’ve lost, and the future we refuse to give up on.

And for our youngest supporters, we've added a few different options. They can participate in the main runs (5K Youth Ages 7–17 or 10K Youth Ages 9-17) or the Kids Fun Run (Ages 2–12) that consists of one lap around the park (just over ¼ mile). Parents are welcome to walk or run alongside their child for the Kids Fun Run but all those participating in the 5K or 10K must be registered. These are great opportunities for children to get involved and feel the spirit of the day. 

Move with purpose. Show up with heart. Race2Unravel...until there is a cure!

 

About Rucking: 
Rucking is a physical activity that involves walking with a weighted backpack, often referred to as a ruck. It combines the benefits of strength training and cardio, making it an effective workout for building endurance and muscle. Weight requirements are 30 lbs for men and 20 lbs for women, and rucksacks will be weighed prior to the start.


About the Course: 
The route begins at Christmas Hill Park (Ranch Side) and winds through parts of the Uvas Creek Levee Park Preserve, following the Uvas Creek Levee Trail. The course is mainly flat and fully paved, offering a scenic run through one of Gilroy’s most beautiful natural areas.

To ensure a smooth and confident experience for all participants, there will be prominent course signage and clearly marked turnaround points. 

 

 

IMPORTANT DETAILS: 

  • Registration Deadline for T-shirt is July 31st
  • No Pets Allowed
  • This is a Cupless Race - Please bring your own water bottle. 
  • Strollers are allowed but please start toward the back and give the right of way on the narrower portions of the course. 
  • Regular Registration Ends Friday, August 21st @ 3pm; Same day registration available until 7:30AM sharp on Saturday, August 22nd. 
  • Medals will be presented to the top three male and top three female finishers in the 5K, 5K Youth, 10K, 10K Youth and 5K Ruck divisions. Participants in the Kids Fun Run will also receive a commemorative medal.

To ensure a smooth and confident experience for all participants, there will be prominent course signage and clearly marked turnaround points. 

 

 

IMPORTANT DETAILS: 

  • Registration Deadline for T-shirt is July 31st
  • No Pets Allowed
  • This is a Cupless Race - Please bring your own water bottle. 
  • Strollers are allowed but please start toward the back and give the right of way on the narrower portions of the course. 
  • Regular Registration Ends Friday, August 21st @ 3pm; Same day registration available until 7:30AM sharp on Saturday, August 22nd. 
  • Medals will be presented to the top three male and top three female finishers in the 5K, 5K Youth, 10K, 10K Youth and 5K Ruck divisions. Participants in the Kids Fun Run will also receive a commemorative medal.

name: Raz'N Health Fitness Festival
description: Walkers & kids welcome for the 5K! Last year was such a success, we are doing it again! Castle Air Force Base is no stranger to a 5K/10K run but this race includes a run through Castle Air Museum. Once again, participants will have the opportunity to run amongst the many incredible aircraft of museum including fighter jets, bombers, and aircraft of all shapes and sizes. Directly following the run we will be a vendor village and open taps at the Tarmac Tap Room. Our goal is to connect the population of the central valley with health and wellness services. Together we can improve our community, together we can Raz' some hell with the goal of Raz'N Health for not only ourselves but for our entire community.

name: Reading Buddies
description: Share your favorite story with your new furry reading friends: therapy dogs! Kids will strengthen their reading skills while bonding with pets in a confidence-boosting and fun environment, guaranteed for some tail-wagging fun! Reading aloud reduces stress, strengthens memory and fluency, and builds a robust vocabulary. Open to kids ages 3-8.

name: Red, White & Blue Race
description:
Welcome to the first Red, White & Blue Race! This event benefits Code 3 Mind Health, Inc.  We are a local non-profit that provides mind health services for first responders.  

This course is along the scenic coastal trail in Fort Bragg California.  The event begins at the south coastal trail (Noyo Headlands Park) and continues north with the 5k turnaround being near the compass rose.  If you participate in the 10k run, you will continue north past historic Glass Beach, and across the Pudding Creek Trestle onto the historic Mackerricher Haul Road with the turn around being near the "silver gate" entrance.  For the half-marathon participants, the course continues along the Haul Road, through Mackerricher State Park and turning around just before the entrance to Ten Mile State Preserve.  This course is ocean front, with epic views every step of the way!  For those of you that have participated in races in this area before, it will look very much like the Whale Run course!

All runners will get a tee shirt - choice of long sleeve or short sleeve
End of race will have fruit/water and coffee.


Coffee will be available for entire event.


Finisher medals will be given to all who complete the 1/2 marathon
Medals for 1, 2, and 3 place for all age categories (copy age categories from Whale Run)
Award baskets for 1st male and female finisher in each race (1/2, 10k, 5K), filled with local goodies!


All kiddie competitors get a finisher price, but awards will be given to the first three to finish.

name: Red, White, and Run – 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
Cue the fireworks! Red, White, and Run is blasting off to celebrate America's birthday in style! Dash, jog, or stroll through a course packed with patriotic spirit, festive surprises, and plenty of star-spangled fun. Whether you're racing for a personal best or just soaking in the celebration, this is your chance to move, groove, and honor the land of the free with every step!

Race Details

Start Location: Pierpoint Landing at Shoreline Park, 200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon starts
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
Half: This route is run three times — Half route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located on course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Redding Breakfast Lions Turtle Bay Run 2026
description:
Runners in this years  half marathon  will run along the Sacramento River and will be crossing three bridges: the Sundial Bridge, the Ribbon Bridge and the Diestelhorst Bridge. The runners will start out crossing the Turtle Bay Sundial Bridge, and go north on paved paths in park surroundings most of the way, until they reach the Ribbon Bridge where they cross the Sacramento River and go south until they reach Middle Creek trail, which is an out and back (2 miles), with a return to the River Trail. Once back on the River Trail the runners cross back on the Diestelhorst Bridge to the north side of the river. The runners then continue back to the Sundial Bridge where they cross back to the south side and the Start / Finish.

In addition to the half marathon there is a 10 K, which also goes along the Sacramento River, just less distance; and a 2 mile run / walk for younger and older, who do not want the longer distances. Having the multiple distance options makes it a very family friendly event.

The half marathon and the 10 K have been certified with the American Track and Field Association. For those of you who need a certified distance, this is another good reason to run this particular race.

A couple of years back we added electronic timing, through individual tracking on each runner's race bib.  Since everybody liked it, this will continue for all runners at any distance.

This year's race will maintain acknowledgement of  age division winners in 5 year increments starting at “under 15 years of age” . For the two mile run there will be three additional divisions starting at 5 years and under.

If you are a sponsor of the race you will get one free entry into the division of your choice. If you would like to become a sponsor please complete a sponsor form which can be found on our website at https://reddingbreakfastlionsclub.com/events-2/turtle-bay-run/

Swag bag and packet pick up will be at Fleet Feet, 1376 Hilltop Drive , Redding California, 96003 on Saturday October 3rd from 12 until 2 pm, or at the start / finish area on October 4th from 7:00 am until 8:30 am.

We will have the ability to enter school teams this year, where students can be entered by their school / coach at the cost of $10.00 for any distance. This is only for high school or younger and  no shirt is included. Please contact us on our website for a sign up form at: https://reddingbreakfastlionsclub.com/events-2/turtle-bay-run/

Forms and money must be in our hands by September 25th 2026 for student entries.

PLEASE NOTE : IF YOU SIGN UP AFTER September 11th 2026, YOU MAY NOT GET A SHIRT

name: Redlands Turkey Trot
description:
Thanksgiving Day 5K run and Kids 1K run in beautiful Redlands, CA.

The race course will start at the intersection of University St. and Brockton Ave. (near University of Redlands Ted Runner Stadium) and weave through the streets in and around the University of Redlands. 

ALL PARTICIPANTS THAT REGISTER ON OR AFTER WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 26 ARE NOT GUARANTEED A T-SHIRT.

name: Redondo Beach Swim the Avenues
description:
We are excited to announce that the 8th Annual Redondo Beach Swim the Avenues is returning to the coastal waters of Redondo Beach, California. The event date is September 13th, 2026. There will be a 1.2-mile ocean swim as well as a half mile ocean swim. There will be a wet-suit and non-wet suit category. In honor and remembrance of former Redondo Beach Mayor Bill Brand a portion of proceeds will benefit South Bay Park Land Conservancy.

Additionally, Swim the Avenues is proud to continue its partnership with One with the Ocean and their Play in the Waves program. This initiative is instrumental in providing inner-city youth with the opportunity to experience and enjoy the beach.

Swim the Avenues is delighted to become a part of the Southern Pacific Masters Swimming Open Water Series. If you are registered to USMS/SPMS, you are eligible to earn points for your race. Be sure to check USMS on your entry. At the end of the season, a high point winner will be awarded. See the SPMS website for details!

name: Reentry Resource Center’s Rise Up and Run 5K
description:
The County of Santa Clara Reentry Resource Center and its partners are hosting a 5K run/walk to raise money to support the immediate needs of justice-involved people (clothing, food, hygiene, transportation, etc.). The in-person 5K will take place on Saturday, October 17th at Hellyer County Park with a race start time of 9:00AM. Participants who choose the virtual option can run or walk the race on the day and time of their choice between October 17, 2026, and October 31, 2026. Runners will receive a Rise Up and Run race shirt and medal. 

Packet pickup information will be coming soon.  

Help support this effort by registering for the race, sponsoring other participants to run or donating to buy new clothes for those reentering our community from jail or prison. Many of these individuals have no clean clothes in which to start their reentry journey.  

Here are some ways you can help:

  • Register and run the race!
  • Sponsor a race registration for an individual or a family.
  • Donate monetarily to buy new clothes for individuals released from custody.
  • Buy or donate new clothes for reentry clients leaving custody.

Every day at the County of Santa Clara Reentry Resource Center we see clients ready to make dramatic changes in their lives. But having a felony record can be almost as restrictive as being incarcerated. Access to jobs, housing, and other opportunities becomes incredibly limited due to employment and housing restrictions and social stigma. 

Yet despite these challenges, we see clients determined to clear those hurdles. They are taking college credit classes, working their way up from minimum wage jobs to management positions and union apprenticeships and some are entering peer mentoring and counseling professions to help those who are following in their footsteps. 

You can help support individuals who are just starting this journey to change their lives and share their talents with our community. Each person you help to rise up makes our community stronger. 

If you would like more information about the County of Santa Clara Reentry Resource Center, please visit www.sccreentry.org or email Juan Guevara at juan.guevara@ceo.sccgov.org

 

We look forward to partnering with you for social change.

name: Reyes Adobe Days "RAD" 5K
description:
Join us on Sunday, October 4, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. for the RAD Run - Reyes Adobe Days 5K.  The race will take place on a (previously certified) flat and fast course, starting and ending at the Whizin's Market Square, 28914 Roadside Dr, Agoura Hills, CA 91301  

Custom medals awarded for 1st, 2nd and 3rd place age group winners.  Age groups: 13 & Under, 14-19, 20-29 30-39,40-49,50-59,60-69,70 & over

Kids mile at 9:45 a.m.  Medals awarded to all kids mile finishers. 

Not only will participants have the opportunity to test their speed and endurance, but they will also be supporting a great cause. A percentage of the proceeds from the race will benefit the Malibu/Lost Hills Search and Rescue Team . 

Don't miss out on this exciting event that combines fitness, philanthropy, and community spirit. Register now and be a part of something RAD!

Bonus!  Every participant will receive TWO tickets to an upcoming show at The Canyon Club 

PACKET PICKUP : FLEET FEET AGOURA HILLS

30125 Agoura Rd. Agoura Hills , CA

SATURDAY, OCTOBER 3 , 10:00 A.M. - 2:00 P.M.

name: Ride Santa Barbara 100
description:
Ride Santa Barbara returns for its 15th year!

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

All courses start along the beach and follow the beautiful Santa Barbara beachfront before turning inland to experience all Santa Barbara has to offer. Cyclists will wind through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country; experience the rolling foothills lined with citrus and avocado orchards and climb some of the most famous mountains in the country, all while experiencing some of the most beautiful views in southern California.

 

All cyclists will receive:

  • Official 2026 RideSB100 t-shirt
  • Official 2026 RideSB100 water bottle
  • Official RideSB100 drawstring bag with sponsor goodies
  • Fully supported aid stations
  • Mechanical support
  • Finish Line Festival with lots of food and beer
  • All Gibraltar Challenge finishers will receive a coin at the top of the hill.
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile

  • Over 9,700′ of climbing | Start Time: 7:00 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Tackle a challenging ride that begins at Chase Palm Park, rolls through Carpinteria, and continues into the scenic Lake Casitas region. Climb Toro Canyon and Ladera Lane before testing your legs on the Gibraltar Climb Challenge, a timed 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and over 2,500 ft of elevation gain. Descend, then join the 100KM Coastal Route along Cathedral Oaks through Isla Vista and past UCSB, finishing back at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100-mile/


100 KM + Climb 

  • Over 6,600 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s most stunning terrain, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Tackle the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and the steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then test your mettle on the Gibraltar Climb: a 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and a 2,551 ft elevation gain. After summiting Gibraltar, descend via the technical Painted Cave route, continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community, and return to a well-earned finish at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-climb/

 

100 KM Coastal Route 

  • 4,000 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for intermediate to experienced cyclists only
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s finest scenery, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Challenge yourself on the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then descend toward the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. From there, ride west through Isla Vista, take in breathtaking coastal views at Goleta Beach, pass the University of California, Santa Barbara, and finish back at Chase Palm Park.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-coastal/

 

34 miles 

  • Over 2,200 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 8:30 AM
  • Beginner to intermediate level cyclists 
  • Enjoy a stunning start along the coastline from Chase Palm Park before heading inland to San Ysidro Road. Tackle a gentle ascent on Mountain Drive (max 5.1% grade), then roll past the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. Continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community and finish back at Chase Palm Park. Perfect for those seeking Santa Barbara’s natural charm with just the right amount of challenge.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/34-mile/

*Event details and courses are subject to change. 

 

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Refund Policy

All entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may do a one-time entry transfer to another event, person or year for $15.

For more information, visit our website ridesb100.com or e-mail our team at info@ridesb100.com.

 

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter! 

Subscribe to our e-newsletter! 📧

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Refund Policy

All entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may do a one-time entry transfer to another event, person or year for $15.

name: Ride the Point
description:
Ride the hidden, unridden, and forbidden San Diego to support pancreatic cancer research! 

Cycle through scenic areas of San Diego on November 8th to support pancreatic cancer research in the 12th Annual Jim Krause Memorial Charity Cycling Ride the Point. The ride starts and ends at Liberty Station and includes exclusive routes through Point Loma, Ocean Beach, Mission Bay La Jolla, Torrey Pines, and Sorrento Valley. This ride takes participants through historic neighborhoods and past some of the most scenic areas of San Diego, some that are only open once a year for this event. The event has volunteers along the route, SAG, and five fully stocked rest stops to support the riders.   

Ride the Point has three distances to accommodate diverse levels of cycling experience. The 5-mile Family Fun Ride is a relatively flat course on bike paths along beautiful San Diego Bay and is perfect for cruisers, beginning riders, challenged athletes, and families. The 25 and Metric Century are street rides with exclusive routes and challenging climbs around scenic San Diego. This is a boutique ride limited to 600 riders to ensure an unforgettable experience. The public is invited to the free healthy lifestyle expo at Oggi’s in Liberty Station from 9 am until 2 pm with local vendors, music, and refreshments.

name: Ridge Creek Run Club 12 Hour Ultra
description:
Challenge yourself on one of the most unique ultra-running courses in the Central Valley! The Ridge Creek 12-Hour Ultra takes place at the beautiful Ridge Creek Dinuba Golf Club, featuring a scenic 3-mile loop winding through rolling fairways, cart paths, lakes, and picturesque golf course views. Surrounded by the Sierra foothills and orchards of the Valley, Ridge Creek offers a peaceful yet challenging setting for runners of all abilities.

Whether you're chasing your first ultra distance, aiming for a personal best, or seeing just how many miles you can accumulate in 12 hours, this event is designed for you. Complete as many 3-mile loops as you can before time expires. A fully stocked aid station located near the start/finish area will keep you fueled and hydrated throughout the day, while friends and family enjoy easy access to cheer you on lap after lap.

The course combines gentle rolling terrain with beautiful scenery, creating an enjoyable loop that remains engaging from the first mile to the last. Every lap brings you back through the event hub where you'll find aid, encouragement, and the camaraderie that makes ultra running special.

Whether your goal is 15 miles, 30 miles, 50K, 50 miles, or beyond, the Ridge Creek 12-Hour Ultra is your opportunity to test your limits in a welcoming atmosphere and unforgettable venue.

Event Highlights

  • 12-hour timed ultra
  • Scenic 3-mile loop course
  • Individual ultra-running challenge
  • Fully stocked aid station
  • Real-time lap and mileage tracking
  • Finisher award for all participants
  • Special awards for top male and female mileage totals
  • Beautiful golf course setting with rolling terrain and lake views

Come experience the beauty of Ridge Creek, the support of the ultra-running community, and the satisfaction of seeing just how far you can go in 12 hours.

name: Rim Nordic XC MTB Race Series #1
description:
XC MTB Racing for 2026. 

XC MTB Racing for 2026 ......... July 19, July 26, Aug 16, Aug 30             
All races for 2026 are on Sundays. We will count 3 of 4  races for overall award, with a minimum of 2 events attended & you must attend the finals on Aug. 30th. (NO double points for series finals).

XC MTB Racing for 2026 ......... July 19, July 26, Aug 16, Aug 30             
All races for 2026 are on Sundays. We will count 3 of 4  races for overall award, with a minimum of 2 events attended & you must attend the finals on Aug. 30th. (NO double points for series finals).

PRE-riding will be available on Saturdays, prior to each race, with the “course of the day” to be marked the weekend before each race. Reminder, NO pre-riding on race days. Warm up at Snow Valley’s parking lot at the east end before the race (or follow signage if posted)

Don’t forget….each race is an individual event for awards.

We will have some food options, but are hoping our racers will support Snow Valley's concessions for allowing us to use their parking lot.  OR bring your own & picnic in base area. 

For up to date information visit the event's website at https://rimnordic.com/rim-nordic-xc-mountain-bike-racing

All races for 2026 are on Sundays. We will count 3 of 4  races for overall award, with a minimum of 2 events attended & you must attend the finals on Aug. 30th. (NO double points for series finals).

PRE-riding will be available on Saturdays, prior to each race, with the “course of the day” to be marked the weekend before each race. Reminder, NO pre-riding on race days. Warm up at Snow Valley’s parking lot at the east end before the race (or follow signage if posted)

Don’t forget….each race is an individual event for awards.

We will have some food options, but are hoping our racers will support Snow Valley's concessions for allowing us to use their parking lot.  OR bring your own & picnic in base area. 

 For up to date information visit the event's website at https://rimnordic.com/rim-nordic-xc-mountain-bike-racing

name: Ring Out the Old – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
Join us for the celebratory Ring out the Old race and let's kick 2026 to the curb together!

Race Details

Location: Woodley Park, 6076 Woodley Ave, Encino, CA
Parking: Free parking in the lot; more is available on Woodley Ave

Event Schedule

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10k)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Courses (rain routes)

5k route: Runners do one loops around the lake – route here
10k route: Runners do two loops around the lake with a little extra – route here
Half Marathon: Route is around the park, done twice and then one of the 10k route loops – route here

More about the Course
The race routes go across the grass, under the road through a tunnel, and enter the Lake Balboa Park area. Route will be finalized week of race, rain-pending

Our courses are on open paths so please be considerate of other park users!

On-Course Support
Multiple water stations are located along the routes. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and other snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk and runner turn signs

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, San Diego, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

name: Riverbank Run for the Cheese (50th Anniversary Run)
description:
7:45AM--1 Mile – Flat loop around neighborhood

8:15AM-- 5K—Gently rolling residential tree-lined course   

8:15AM-- 10K—Gently rolling residential streets, two loop course   (90 minute cut off time to finish)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               

Walkers/baby strollers welcome on the 5K course. Please, NO walkers on the 10K course. Baby strollers welcome in 10K if you’re running.

Online registration closes October 6th at 4pm. In person registration will be open Friday October 9th at packet pick up at the Riverbank Galaxy Theatre from 4pm to 6:30pm and race day 6:15am until 7:50am.

name: Riverpark 5K Summer Series
description:
Join us for the 3rd Annual Riverpark 5K Summer Series!  This is a run/walk event with the entire course located on a bike path and sidewalk within the neighborhood.  The starting and ending point is located at Windrow Park.  Each race is limited to first 150 registrants!

Choose to participate with us for 1, 2, 3, or all 4 weeks!  Plus, there is a discount for registering for all 4 races (full series)!  100% of the proceeds go toward Rio Mesa Cross Country and Track teams.

 

Dates:

The 2026 series will span 4 weeks beginning with a special 4th of July 5K Race and continuing each following Thursday:

  • Week 1: 7/4/26 (9 am start)
  • Week 2: 7/9/26 (6 pm start)
  • Week 3: 7/16/26 (6 pm start)
  • Week 4: 7/23/26 (6 pm start)

Each week will also have a Free Kids 1K Race (ages 7 and under) 15 minutes before the official 5K race (8:45 am on July 4th and 5:45 pm July 9th, 16th, and 23rd).

 

Awards: 

  • 5K: As this is a series, awards will be given to the top 3 in each age category at the conclusion of Week 4 (7/23) at Windrow Park.
  • 1K (Kids):  Each finisher in the Kids 1K races receives a finisher medal!  

 

T-Shirts:

T-Shirts will be for sale at the event, online for $20, or receive a FREE T-shirt by registering for the full 4-week series.

 

Course Map:

Course map is located here.

 

Check-In & Bib Pickup:

  • 7/4: 8:00 am in the park
  • 7/9, 7/16, 7/23: 5:00 pm in the park

 

Series Points and Age Groups for the Riverpark 5K:

Age Group Points are given based on what place you get in your age group each week (please note age is based on your age on the last day of the series).  If you don't place in the top 9 in your age group, you get 1 point for participating each week.

 

Age groups: 1-12, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

 

Points:

1st Place - 10 Points

2nd Place - 8 Points

3rd Place - 7 Points

4th Place - 6 Points

5th Place - 5 Points

6th Place - 4 Points

7th Place - 3 Points

8th Place - 2 Points

9th or greater Place - 1 Point

 

Contact:

For all inquiries, please email rapidorunning@gmail.com
