name: Roasted Run 5K
description:
Roasted Run 5K ☕🔥
Get Roasted. Then Get Running.

This is not your typical 5K.

Roasted Run is where running meets coffee culture - a high-energy, feel-good morning designed for runners, walkers, first-timers, and anyone who just wants to have a great time.

Start your day with a scenic 5K, then cross the finish line into a coffee-fueled celebration with music, good vibes, and a community that doesn’t take itself too seriously.

✨ What makes Roasted Run different:

A fun, approachable 5K - run it, jog it, or walk it
Fresh coffee waiting for you at the finish ☕
Live music + post-run hangout vibes
High-energy atmosphere without the pressure
Perfect for friends, couples, and groups
Whether you’re chasing a PR or just showing up for the coffee, Roasted Run is built to be memorable, social, and something you’ll want to come back to.

So grab your crew, lace up your shoes, and get ready to start your morning the right way.

☕ Run first. Coffee after. Vibes always.

name: Rock & Run
description:
You're Invited to join us for Rock & Run 2026 on Roctober 11!

October 11, 2026
Rock and Run describes the unique experience that awaits you as you meander through a 125 year-old, environmentally responsible, operational hard rock quarry. This is a 10K Run or 5K Walk/Run as you have never imagined. See the working quarry face, the ancient granite deposit, the massive equipment that processes it, and the natural surroundings, as you take the challenge of the Rock and Run with an Open House immediately following. This event will benefit Aromas School.

Race Number pickup will open at 7:00am and the race will start at 8:00am.   Please plan on arriving on time to pick up your number before the race so that we can start on time.  

Online registration will close at 6:00pm on Saturday, October 11.

name: Rock to Pier Bus Trip
description:
Sierra Challenge Express welcomes you to register for its annual bus trip to the 2026 Brian Waterbury Memorial Rock to Pier Fun Run and Rock’n Around the Pier Half Marathon! 

-- Registration is on a first-come, first-serve basis, and there are a total of 40 available seats --

 

Important Information

 

Requirements

  • The bus trip is reserved for Sierra Challenge Club Members ONLY. Fortunately, membership to the Sierra Challenge Express club is inexpensive, and it is easy to register: https://runsignup.com/Club/CA/Fresno/SierraChallengeExpressRunningClub

  • Lunch and light snacks will be provided

  • Registration for the Brian Waterbury Memorial Rock to Pier Fun Run and Rock’n Around the Pier Half Marathon is required, as registered runners are prioritized for the bus trip (registration is first come, first served). As the event date approaches, the event directors may be permit SCE club members who wish to be a race spectator register for the event on a first-come, first serve basis

  • Members must indicate team "Sierra Challenge Express" when registering for the race.

  • Must be 13 years or older. Minors must be accompanied by a guardian.

  • No Pets

 

Race Day Logistics: Pick-up

 
Pick-up Location:

Fleet Feet Fresno
9447 N Fort Washington Rd #106
Fresno 93730
 

The bus will arrive at 4am for passenger loading. The bus will be leaving Fleet Feet promptly at 4:30am.
 

There will be one additional pick-up point:


Pick-up Location:

Chevron Station
25 S 19 ½ Ave
Lemoore 93245
 
It is approximately a 45-50 minute drive from Fleet Feet Fresno to the Chevron Station. Therefore, we ask that if you plan to be picked up in Lemoore, you arrive at 5am, as the bus will leave no later than 5:20am.
 

** Additionally, if you plan to be picked up at Lemoore, please contact the club at SierraChallengeExpressClub@gmail.com, so that our bus directors can be in contact with you the morning of the trip**

 

Race Day Logistics: 2026 Schedule

  • 4am - Bus arrives at Fleet Feet

  • 4:30am - Bus departs Fleet Feet (Promptly!)

  • 5:20am - Bus departs Lemoore Chevron station (Promptly!)

  • 7:30am - Bus arrives at Morro Rock

  • 8:00 am - Races (10k and half) Start

  • 3pm - Depart Morro Bay

 

Race Day Logistics: Additional Information

  • We highly recommend bringing an extra set of clothes, including shoes (The Rock to Pier website itself states, “This event is held on the beach – you will get wet”). These extra items can be left on the bus, but we ask that you be mindful of not leaving anything valuable unattended

             

  • Lunch is tentatively set to be provided by Harbor Hut in Morro Bay. Sierra Challenge Express will be footing the lunch bill. As such, we will be providing a curated menu. If you have any food allergies or intolerances, let us know ASAP at SierraChallengeExpressClub@gmail.com, so we can plan for accommodations accordingly.

 

Registration

  • Become an SCE Member - Click Here
  • Register for Rock to Pier - Click Here
  • Sign Up for the Bus Here - Click Here

name: RPV's Run For Myles
description:
Experience an unforgettable adventure along a picturesque road course with breathtaking views of the majestic Pacific Ocean. This nonprofit event starts and finishes at the Point Vicente Interpretive Center in Rancho Palos Verdes, CA, and directly benefits the preservation of the city's beautiful trails.

Participants are invited to enhance their impact by becoming individual fundraisers or by creating fundraising teams.

Bib pick up will be on Friday, January 29th, time and location TBD. Also available on race day starting at 7am. Pick up your bib on Friday to avoid lines.

If you are having someone else pick up your bib, shirt and bag, they will need two things:

1. A copy of your ID (printed on paper or on their phone)
2. A printed signed copy of the waiver. You can download and print the waiver from this link

If you are picking up your own bib, you only need to bring your ID, you can sign the waiver in person.

No bibs will be given out without ID and a signed waiver. The lawyers and our insurance company require us to be strict on this, sorry for the inconvenience.

Parking is available at two locations:

Point Vicente Interpretive Center (Until 7AM ONLY)

31501 Palos Verdes Dr W
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275

Rancho Palos Verdes City Hall

30940 Hawthorne Boulevard
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
(*Shuttles will transport participants from City Hall to and from the Point Vicente Interpretive Center.)

The event kicks off at 7 AM with registration open to the public for check-in. At 7:45 AM, announcements are made, and a warm-up session takes place to prepare participants. The 10K race begins promptly at 8 AM, followed by the 5K race at 8:15 AM. At 9:45 AM, the Kids’ Fun Run race takes place. Afterward, at 10:15 AM, there are announcements and awards to recognize outstanding participants.

name: Ruff Run California
description:
Join Us here for our annual obstacle run designed for people and their pups! Over 20 obstacles and growing every year- this course will test your training, your bond and your willingness to just let loose and have great time! This 20 acre course is more than just getting dirty!!! Our obstacles range from mud and water to thinking and strategy to test your bond with your pup!! Are you a team??Every year we add more challenges!  After party with music, games and vendors! Come spend the day in the beautiful high desert at 4200 ft above sea level! 

Follow our Facebook page Ruff Run California for all the info and details as well as pics from the last event!

name: Run by the Sea
description:
Run by the Sea returns to lovely Wilder Ranch State Park on Sunday, October 4th! This unique Half Marathon, 12K run, and 4K run/walk meanders along the gorgeous coastal bluffs of California's Central Coast in Santa Cruz and consists mostly of flat, packed dirt trails. Participants will enjoy scenic coastal views while passing along the bluffs and Wilder Ranch park trails. Get ready to take in the natural beauty of the Monterey Bay, the serene flats of Wilder Ranch's meadows, and maybe even catch a glimpse of some dolphins - no other race is quite like it!

Now in its 10th year, Run by the Sea is organized by the Santa Cruz Track Club and benefits the track club's youth program, Bike Santa Cruz County, and Santa Cruz Mountain Trail Stewards.

name: RUN FOR ASL 5K
description: Join us for the RUN FOR ASL 5K at Ballona Creek! This community-driven event brings people together through fitness, inclusion, and ASL awareness. Starting at Syd Kronenthal Park, participants will run along the scenic Ballona Creek path while supporting a mission focused on connection, education, and Deaf community outreach. Whether you run, walk, or cheer from the sidelines, this event is about movement with purpose and creating a more inclusive community for all.

name: Run for Austin's Lungs
description:
Run for Austin’s Lungs is a family-friendly 5K walk/run held in honor of baby Austin, who is bravely battling chronic lung disease. Join us to celebrate his first birthday, raise awareness of his Chronic Lung disease, and support his ongoing medical care. Every step taken helps give Austin the breath of a brighter future.

The entire registration fee (minus the $4 processing fee) goes directly to Austin’s care. After you register, the site will ask if you’d like to make an additional donation—this can simply be left at $0, meaning your total charge will be $54 for race registration.

If you’d prefer to support Austin without registering for the race, you can do so by selecting the Donate button instead of Sign Up.

name: Run for Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎀 Join the Fight: Breast Cancer Run! 🎀
Lace up and make a difference at our annual Breast Cancer Run! Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 
Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

🎀 Join the Fight: Breast Cancer Run! 🎀
Lace up and make a difference at our annual Breast Cancer Run! Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 
Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Get ready for a sweet race! Gather your friends and lace up for our Donut Run, where you’ll run a beautiful course and be greeted at the Finish Line with... donuts🍩! Enjoy a fun-filled day of running, laughter, and Community. 

Don’t miss out on the chance to indulge in your favorite donuts while making unforgettable memories. 

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: RUN FOR FREEDOM
description:
Join the Movement and break some chains. This is more than just a race—it's a chance to make a lasting impact in the fight against human trafficking.

Lace up for something bigger than a finish line.
Whether you're running, walking, or cheering from the sidelines, the EDEN 5K/10K is more than a race—it's a movement. The Run for Freedom helps raise funds and awareness to support anti-trafficking organizations. Your participation fuels change, provides resources, and empowers those on the frontlines to continue to bring hope to survivors.

Tentative schedule of the day

6:00-7:00 a.m. Vendor set-up

7:00-8:30 a.m. Registration/packet pick up

8:15 a.m. Warm Up

8:30 a.m. Speakers

9:00 am 5K/10k Run/Walk

11:00-11:30 Post race speaker program

7 a.m.-12.30 p.m. Vendor Expo & Entertainment

Scenic Lakeside 5k Course

Our 5K course takes you along a beautiful lakeside road at Bonelli Regional Park, with views of sparkling Puddingstone Lake and rolling hills all around. The route features a mix of flat stretches and a few gentle inclines to keep things fun and challenging.

As you run, you’ll be surrounded by mountain backdrops, lush greenery, and open skies—perfect for an energizing morning on the move. Bonelli Park is a favorite spot for local runners, cyclists, and nature lovers, and you’ll see why: the course combines scenic beauty with a welcoming, race-day atmosphere.

Whether you’re walking, jogging, or aiming for a personal record, this course offers a little bit of everything—lake views, shady sections, rolling terrain, and plenty of inspiration.

Scenic Lakeside 10k Course

Our 10K course begins on the same scenic lakeside road as the 5K, letting you take in the sparkling waters of Puddingstone Lake and the mountain views that make Bonelli Park so special.

At the halfway point, the course branches off to bring you onto park trails and rolling hills, adding a little more adventure and challenge. You’ll experience a blend of paved paths, natural terrain, and inclines that keep things exciting while still being very runnable.

With the combination of lake views, shaded sections, open trails, and mountain backdrops, the 10K is a rewarding course for both seasoned runners and those looking to push themselves a bit further.

Come ready for a mix of beauty and challenge—the 10K at Bonelli Park offers an unforgettable run surrounded by nature.

 

Registration Includes:
Race bib
Event shirt
Finisher’s medal

 

RAIN OR SHINE and NO REFUNDS

name: Run for Hope
description:
The Sierra Cascades Run for Hope is a meaningful community event created to bring people together in support, remembrance, and hope. This run represents every stage of the cancer journey-those currently in treatment, showing extraordinary courage each day; the survivors whose strength inspires others; the loved ones who remain forever part of our lives; and the families and caregivers who stand beside them through it all.

On this day participants don’t just show up to run or walk. They show up for someone.…for a Friend…for a Parent…for a Child…for Themselves. Each step becomes more than movement-it becomes a symbol of support, strength, and unity. 

Run for Hope creates a space where the community comes together to lift one another, share encouragement, and stand side by side in a way that reminds every person they are not alone in their journey.

With distances welcoming both runners and walkers of all ages and abilities, this event is open to everyone who wants to be a part of something meaningful. Because Run for Hope is not defined by finish times, but by the people, stories, and hearts that move together.

This is Sierra Cascades Run for Hope. A Run with purpose, a community united, a day that reminds us all what Hope looks like in motion.

name: Run for Life
description:
🌟 2026 Run For Life – Porterville 🌟

Join the Exchange Club of Porterville for the Annual Run For Life at Granite Hills High School—an event that brings our community together in hope, remembrance, and support.

Proceeds from this meaningful event benefit the Roger S. Good Cancer Treatment Center at Sierra View Medical Center, helping fund vital programs such as cancer support groups, annual prostate screenings, survivor celebrations, health fairs, community outreach initiatives, and essential educational resources for patients and families.

This event is more than a run—it’s a tribute. Together, we honor the strength of those currently battling cancer and remember the lives of those we’ve lost.

 

💜 2026 Honorees 💜

This year, we proudly recognize and honor:

Gail Grasmick
Maria Pedraza
Lino Padilla Sr.
Dr. Joe Santos
 

🏃‍♀️ Event Highlights

Kick off the morning with an energizing warm-up led by Ashlei Esparza, owner and personal trainer at Optimal Training Health & Fitness.

As participants cross the finish line, the celebration continues with pancakes and refreshing beverages provided by the Porterville Runners Club and Friends of Run For Life.

 

🎽 Registration Includes

Short-sleeve event t-shirt*
Finisher’s medal*
 

🏆 Awards

Awards will be given to the Top 3 Male and Female finishers in both the run and walk in the following age groups:

1–12, 13–19, 20–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60–69, 70–79, 80+

 

🏅 Special awards will also be presented to the 1st Overall Male and Female Finishers

 

❤️ Be Part of Something Bigger

Whether you’re running, walking, cheering from the sidelines, or simply soaking in the atmosphere, Run For Life is a powerful reminder of what a community can do when it comes together.

 

👉 This is more than an event—it’s a community movement of hope, strength, and support.

 

*T-shirts and finisher medals are guaranteed for participants registered by August 20th. Registrations after this date will be subject to availability.

name: Run for Roots: Heard It Through the Grapevine
description:
Building Community Together

🍇 Heard It Through the Grapevine… Fresno Is Running Like a Raisin! 🍇

Highway City Community Development (HCCD) invites you to the 2nd Annual Run for Roots 5K – “Heard It Through the Grapevine” Edition, where runners, walkers, families, and costumed raisins come together to celebrate West Fresno’s community, culture, and agricultural legacy.

This year’s race honors our area’s deep roots in agriculture—and a fun piece of Fresno history. Participants are encouraged to dress as raisins or “Raisin Eaters,” inspired by Fresno’s first professional baseball team from 1906. Set against the iconic vineyards of Kearney Park, this run is playful, meaningful, and uniquely Fresno.

Whether you’re chasing a personal best, walking with friends, or racing in full raisin costume, Run for Roots is about more than the finish line—it’s about celebrating who we are and where we come from.

Why We Run (It’s Bigger Than the Finish Line)

Since 1998, HCCD has been planting seeds of opportunity and cultivating resident leadership right here in West Fresno and the West of 99 / Central Unified area.

In 2025 alone, HCCD:

  • Served 10,000+ community members through classes, workshops, outreach and community events
  • Supported nearly 1,000 families during moments of crisis
  • Expanded access to food assistance, care navigation, education, housing advocacy, health resources, arts & culture, and community development

Your participation helps sustain a place where community, culture, agriculture, and families can grow—together.

*Note the race will occur rain or shine.

name: RUN FOR THE HEALTH OF IT
description:
REGISTRATION OPENS AT 6:45 AM 

LINE-UP AT STARTING LINE 7:45 AM

BOTH RACE EVENTS STARTS AT 8:00 AM

 

Welcome to the 5th annual RUN FOR THE HEALTH OF IT presented by the Grandview Foundation at the beautiful watershed park, Hamamongna, near Pasadena.

 

The Grandview Foundation has been a part of your community for over 50 years, providing residential and outpatient treatment and recovery support. When physical exercise is included in treatment, we have seen a tremendous increase in recovery. This event is being offered to help raise awareness about our organization and the connection between Physical and Mental Health.

 

We welcome serious runners, exercise enthusiasts, and families and friends who want to challenge themselves in this fun outdoor event.

 

ALL AGES are welcome to RUN or WALK to the finish line to support the essential work and services provided by the Grandview Foundation.

 

Let's run together for Health and a Better Life.

Welcome to the 5th annual RUN FOR THE HEALTH OF IT presented by the Grandview Foundation at the beautiful watershed park, Hamamongna, near Pasadena.

 

The Grandview Foundation has been a part of your community for over 50 years, providing residential and outpatient treatment and recovery support. When physical exercise is included in treatment, we have seen a tremendous increase in recovery. This event is being offered to help raise awareness about our organization and the connection between Physical and Mental Health.

 

We welcome serious runners, exercise enthusiasts, and families and friends who want to challenge themselves in this fun outdoor event.

 

ALL AGES are welcome to RUN or WALK to the finish line to support the essential work and services provided by the Grandview Foundation.

 

Let's run together for Health and a Better Life.

name: Run In The New Year 5k/10K/Half Marathon
description:
It's SoCal's HEALTHIEST LIVE PARTY!  LIVE BAND at  the START/FINISH and  the course! It's YOUR NEW YEAR'S CELEBRATION. WITH New Year's BLING!

Friday, Jan. 1, 2027

  • 8:30 am Half Marathon Start

  • 8:40 am Kid's Dash

  • 9:00 am 5k/10K Mass Start

Early Packet Pick-Up: We encourage you to pick up the day prior

    • TBD

    • Packet pick-up is optional, so if you cannot make it- don't worry. Packets can be picked up on race day starting at 7 am in LOT 25. The gates to the STATE PARK open at 7am.

Write a New Year resolution on the back of your bib and RUN, JOG, or WALK it into the new year. 

The course is the flat and fast, paved, wide State Park path, watching and listening to the surf.! Whether an avid runner, jogger, first-timer, or walker, we are the something for every BODY & EVERYBODY best-themed race! Bring family and friends, or just yourself and shoes! Let's get 2024 off and  RUNNING. 

  Entry comes with a Run In The New Year CUSTOM 5K/10K T-Shirt

  Special LONG SLEEVE DESIGN T-shirt for Half Marathon Finishers

  And, a huge CUSTOM CAST finisher medal to all! HUGE!!

Make it a Post-race 5K/10K resolution party ( New Year's Beanies will be for sale at the t-shirt table.)

GEAR CHECK is available, if needed, at the Caren Ware Events BOOTH.  Put your bib number on a tag and pin to your gear.  

Professionally CHIP timed event by ITZ ABOUT TIME. Age division awards galore!

Entrance to Bolsa Chica State Park.

The event is in the farthest western lot- Lot 25, closest to Warner & PCH, but to enter the park use the following address: 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy.

Race Day Schedule:

  • 6:00 am: Gates Open
  • 7:00 am: Race Day Packet Pick-Up Begins (Lot 25)
  • 8:00 am Half Marathon Start for those that will take more than 3 hours and 45 minutes to finish
  • 8:30 am: Half Marathon Start (Must cross the starting arch by 8:05 am)
  • 8:40 am: Kid’s Dash
  • 9:00am: 5K/10K Mass Start (Must cross the starting arch by 9:05 am)
  • 9:40am: 5K Awards Ceremony begins.
  • 10:00 am 10K awards
  • 10:30 announcing of overall Half marathon awards

8:30 am start for HALF MARATHON.  You have until 8:35 to pass under the arch.  9:00am start for 5k/10K.  You have until 9:05 am to pass under the arch.  All 5k/10K must start before the lead half marathoner finishes.   YOUR START TIME does not start until you cross under the arch. Fastest runners in the front, and those looking to place in their age group division. Wear your bib on the front.  Make sure you run the distance on your bib or exchange it for the correct one of your choice at the Solutions/Late registration table if you decide to change races.

SPECIAL PANCAKE BREAKFAST!!!! You can add pancakes to your registration on the last page...

Visit the Speciality Coffee Booth, Fresh baked cookies (GALLETINAS BOOTH),  fresh cut fruits,  and street tacos and tamales will be there.

Awards:

There are “In It To Win It” age categories 3 deep with 5 year age spans: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84 and 85 & over.

Course

Flat and fast, or slow and easy, make it the pace you want it. This 5K/10K course runs along the beach bike path at Bolsa Chica, Huntington Beach State Beach. Families can bring strollers but agree to use at their own risk.  Half Marathon Course: Flat, fast, perfect for PRs or training for your next marathon.  It is (2)Two loops of the 10k so you get plenty of aid stations, entertainment, and spectator friendly!! Aid Station Every 1.5 Miles

  • Water/Gatorade
  • Chargel/ Bananas  

FLAT!!! Great for first-time Half Marathoners or those wanting to PR!
Half Marathon Spectators - you can be at the finish line to see runners start then walk about 50 ft towards the runners to see them go on their second loop.

Restrooms:

Restrooms on RACE DAY: are located at each end of the parking lot.  A set by Sea Legs (east) and a set near  Warner Blvd on the west end of the parking lot.

name: Run In The New Year 5k/10K/Half Marathon
description:
It's SoCal's HEALTHIEST LIVE PARTY!  LIVE BAND at  the START/FINISH and  the course! It's YOUR NEW YEAR'S CELEBRATION. WITH New Year's BLING!

Friday, Jan. 1, 2027

  • 8:30 am Half Marathon Start

  • 8:40 am Kid's Dash

  • 9:00 am 5k/10K Mass Start

Early Packet Pick-Up: We encourage you to pick up the day prior

    • TBD

    • Packet pick-up is optional, so if you cannot make it- don't worry. Packets can be picked up on race day starting at 7 am in LOT 25. The gates to the STATE PARK open at 7am.

Write a New Year resolution on the back of your bib and RUN, JOG, or WALK it into the new year. 

The course is the flat and fast, paved, wide State Park path, watching and listening to the surf.! Whether an avid runner, jogger, first-timer, or walker, we are the something for every BODY & EVERYBODY best-themed race! Bring family and friends, or just yourself and shoes! Let's get 2024 off and  RUNNING. 

  Entry comes with a Run In The New Year CUSTOM 5K/10K T-Shirt

  Special LONG SLEEVE DESIGN T-shirt for Half Marathon Finishers

  And, a huge CUSTOM CAST finisher medal to all! HUGE!!

Make it a Post-race 5K/10K resolution party ( New Year's Beanies will be for sale at the t-shirt table.)

GEAR CHECK is available, if needed, at the Caren Ware Events BOOTH.  Put your bib number on a tag and pin to your gear.  

Professionally CHIP timed event by ITZ ABOUT TIME. Age division awards galore!

Entrance to Bolsa Chica State Park.

The event is in the farthest western lot- Lot 25, closest to Warner & PCH, but to enter the park use the following address: 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy.

  • 6:00 am: Gates Open
  • 7:00 am: Race Day Packet Pick-Up Begins (Lot 25)

  • 8:30 am: Half Marathon Start (Must cross the starting arch by 8:05 am)
  • 8:40 am: Kid’s Dash
  • 9:00am: 5K/10K Mass Start (Must cross the starting arch by 9:05 am)
  • 9:40am: 5K Awards Ceremony begins.
  • 10:00 am 10K awards
  • 10:30 announcing of overall Half marathon awards

8:30 am start for HALF MARATHON.  You have until 8:35 to pass under the arch.  9:00am start for 5k/10K.  You have until 9:05 am to pass under the arch.  All 5k/10K must start before the lead half marathoner finishes.   YOUR START TIME does not start until you cross under the arch. Fastest runners in the front, and those looking to place in their age group division. Flat and fast, or slow and easy, make it the pace you want it. This 5K/10K course runs along the beach bike path at Bolsa Chica, Huntington Beach State Beach. name: Run Juneteenth Day 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
On Juneteenth, we remember resilience, honor progress, and run toward a brighter future.
Join the Juneteenth Day Run — an event that celebrates freedom, community, and the unbreakable human spirit.
Let’s make every mile matter.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM

Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/

- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal!

description:

Registration: Will be available until 11:30pm on July 3rd. No race day registration is available.

name: Run Like Leo - 2025 Virtual Event
description:
8.17 Miles to send high schoolers on life-changing travel abroad programs 💪🏻 Move with Purpose, Empower Our Youth

This August, join the Live Like Leo Foundation for our annual 8.17 Miles Virtual Challenge, honoring Leo’s birthday on 8/17/25. From August 1–18, 2025, walk, jog, or run your way to supporting life-changing experiences for junior high school students.

🏃‍♀️ Move your way — anywhere, anytime.
Complete 8.17 miles at your pace — indoors or outside, solo or with friends. For the overachievers...Go the extra distance and aim for 17+ miles!

🌍 Why We Move
Every mile helps raise funds to send deserving students on transformative international travel programs. These journeys build confidence, expand worldviews, and inspire the next generation of global citizens and leaders.

🎽 Get our exclusive event t-shirt with registration 
Please register to receive our exclusive event t-shirt (sketching of Leo woven into design, drawn by his cousin Sonali), show your support in style!

📱 ➡️ Share your progress and tag us with #RunLikeLeo @livelikeleofoundation to spread the word and inspire others to get involved.

Whether you’re moving for fitness, fun, or the cause, your steps make a real difference in a young person’s future.

👉🏻 Ready to move for a mission?
Sign up to participate or support by donating at www.livelikeleo.org/donate.

❤️ Stay tuned for details on in-person “Last Mile” meetups in Lafayette and Santa Cruz, California as we come together in remembrance and celebration of Leo’s life and legacy.

name: Run the Robie (100 Mile relay )
description:
Run With Us (Open to Everyone)

Run Fast… or Pretend Like You Are
100 Miles. 100 Runners. One Community.


Be part of Auburn history.

We’re bringing together 100 relay runners for a 100-mile community relay on the trails where it all began  Auburn, California.

Only 100 official relay spots are available.

But everyone can still join the movement.

 
Choose Your Challenge

Option 1: Official 100-Mile Relay
100 runners. 1 mile each. 100 spots only.

Be one of the official relay runners carrying the baton for one mile on Auburn trails.

Includes:


Relay experience
Commemorative shirt
Community celebration
A chance to be part of the official record attempt

Spots available: 100 total * must run a mile under 10 minutes , the route is 70% up hill with 130 ft of elevation ( plese be honest)


Not one of the 100 relay runners?

 

100 Miles in 25 Days Challenge
Open to everyone. Any pace. Anywhere.

Run, walk, or hike 100 miles in 25 days and earn your finish.

Includes:


100-mile finisher buckle
Community challenge experience
Your name as part of the movement


Register for the 25-Day Challenge

 
Who Can Join?

Fast runners.
Slow runners.
Walkers.
Hikers.
Legends.
Beginners.
People pretending like they’re fast.

This is for everyone who wants to show up.

 
The Mission


This is more than a relay.

It’s 100 miles of community, grit, laughter, history, and Auburn trail magic.

Run Fast… or Pretend Like You Are.
 
 
 * Pick up your buckle on Thursday 25th at the finish like of the relay ( join the party and run the last mile with us )

name: Run Through the Pines | 5K and 10K
description:
This will be the 47th Run Through the Pines

Save the date and please follow us on our Run Through the Pines Facebook and Instagram page.

The Run Through the Pines is a destination run and a San Bernardino, Rim Mountain Community Event. It is one of the longest "running" runs in Southern California (the first one was in 1979). It features a 10K and 5K run (or walk) around Lake Gregory and through a pine tree forest.  Runners (and walkers) can enjoy a semi-paved course at a 4,720-foot elevation, which makes it a perfect little challenge for mountain locals and especially our friends from down the hill. Race day staging is at the San Moritz Lodge “Meadow” area near the Lake Gregory Company bait and tackle shop. We encourage participants of all levels, children in strollers, pets on a leash, and especially teams/groups.

Lake Gregory is located in Crestline, a charming little town filled with one-of-a-kind shops and restaurants. We encourage all runners to stay the weekend and enjoy the town.

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org. 

Featured Events:

10K

5K

 

Registration

We prefer all participants pre-register online for a quicker check-in on the day of the run. Participants may also register on the day of the run. Same-day registration will be open onsite from 6:30 am on August 8.

Registration Dates & Fees: 

Until April 30 - $40 per participant 

May 1 - August 7 - $50 per participant 

Same Day Registration (August 8) - $60 per participant 

Run T-shirts are not included in registration fee. T-shirts are $20 per shirt. 

Timing & Awards 

RFID CHIP TIMED by ITZ ABOUT TIME  Top three overall trophies and age division awards 3 deep in the following categories: 10 & under, 11-14, 15-19. 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80 plus. 

Tentative Schedule of Run Day

6:30 AM     Check-in / Same day Registration

8:00 AM    10K Start

8:30 AM 5K Start

9:30 AM    Awards

Additional Features:

Music, water, post refreshments. 

Sponsors  

The Run Through the Pines is a mountain community event hosted by the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District and the Lake Gregory Company. The run relies on sponsors and/or local businesses and organizations to enhance the runner's experience on race day. If you would like more information on how to become a sponsor, please call the Park District Office, (909) 337-7275. 

Volunteers 

We love our volunteers and honestly, the event couldn't happen without them! We are currently looking for Registration and Race Kit Pick-up volunteers, Water Station Volunteers, Start/Finish Line Volunteers, and lots of course marshals to ensure a safe and fun event for everyone. Contact the Park District Office if you would like to volunteer. 

Parking

Parking is offered onsite at the San Moritz Lodge and in Lake Gregory parking lots. Please do not park directly in the Crest Forest Senior Citizens parking area or near their building, you will be towed. 

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org.

description:
🎉 Get ready to celebrate Cinco de Mayo with a fiesta like no other! Join us on Saturday, May 1, 2027, in beautiful Long Beach for a high-energy race experience filled with ocean views, music, community, and nonstop good vibes. Whether you’re taking on the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon, this event is designed for runners and walkers of all levels.

🌴 Come Run the Vibe — Long Beach Style!

📍 Start Line: 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA
(Click the address above in registration to open Google Maps.)

📅 Date: Saturday, May 1, 2027

Get ready to experience Long Beach like never before. Run, Fiesta, Repeat isn’t just a race — it’s a celebration of movement, culture, sunshine, and the CaliFlow community.

This scenic beachfront course takes you along the Long Beach beach path with gorgeous ocean views, palm trees, fresh air, and a fun high-vibe atmosphere from start to finish. Whether you’re chasing a PR or simply soaking in the experience, this race is all about enjoying the miles.

🌟 WHAT’S INCLUDED WITH REGISTRATION:
✔ USATF Certified Course
✔ Professional Chip Timing
✔ Live Results Within Minutes
✔ Finisher Medal
✔ Overall & Age Group Awards
✔ Race Bib
✔ Free Race Day Photos
✔ Live DJ & Finish Line Party
✔ Vendors & Giveaways
✔ Water & Electrolyte Stations
✔ Scenic Coastal Beachfront Course
✔ Stroller & Walker Friendly
✔ Fully Marked Course

⏰ Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:

📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent near the start line

HALF MARATHON
🕠 Bib Pick-Up: 5:30 AM – 6:15 AM
🏁 Start Time: 6:15 AM
✨ Early Start Option at 6:00 AM available by request
🎯 Course closes at 9:30 AM

10K & 5K
🕠 Regitration Open 6:00 AM
🏁 Start Time:

8:00 AM 5K 10K

✔ Aid stations at turnaround points
✔ Friendly on-course staff and volunteers

Public parking is available throughout the area near the beach path and marina lots. We recommend arriving early for the closest parking options.

☀️ Safety, Weather & Vibes:
✔ Low morning foot traffic
✔ Smooth beachfront running path
✔ Professional race staff on course
✔ Rain or shine event
✔ High vibes only

Whether you’re showing up for a fast finish, beachside fun, or simply the love of running, this race is your excuse to celebrate movement and community in true CaliFlow style.

Come run Long Beach with us and experience the energy that makes CaliFlow Runs different. 🌊✨

name: Run4Recovery 5K Run/Walk
description:
Run4Recovery 5K Run/Walk raises awareness and funding to support recovering alcoholics and addicts by providing Sober Living Scholarships—offering shelter, stability, and nourishment to those most vulnerable to relapse.

Through the Puente House Foundation (a 501(c)(3) non-profit), we provide safe housing for individuals who may be dealing with homelessness or are escaping environments filled with drug use and violence.

For many, this scholarship is the difference between life and death. It offers a path to reunite with family, rejoin society, and embrace a pro-recovery lifestyle.

name: Runnin' To The Rig
description:
Embrace the BHS Legacy and Join us for our 2nd Runnin' To The Rig 5k Run/Walk!

Saturday, February 21st - Shot Gun Start at 8:30am and Check-in at 7:30am

Runners Start on Morrow Field / Walkers Start on Griffith Field Stadium / Embrace the Legacy Tour meets at the Water Tower near the concessions stand at Griffith Field.

Day of Race Registration 7am - 8am at Check-In Desk at Table on Morrow Field.  Cost is $40/pp

We invite you to participate with us in this FUNdraising endeavor to build community and raise funds. Our 5k course is designed as a nostalgic run/walk throughout our historic campus ending near the famous football tunnel in Griffith Stadium.   Our 2K walk will meander around campus and even through some of the buildings.  The Walk will start after the Run.  Medals given to all finishers!          

Race T-shirts can be purchased during registration for an extra fee if you pre-register  by February 4th.

Plan to hang around after the race for pictures and selfies on historic Griffith Field. 

Don't wait, come join the fun! We are grateful for your support of Bakersfield High School. Go Blue! Once a Driller, Always a Driller!

 

Bib & T-shirt Pickup

You can pick up your race packet and t-shirt at the stadium parking lot near Griffith Stadium.

Fri. Feb. 20,  3:30-6 pm
Sat. Feb. 21,  7-8 am

description:
Embrace the BHS Legacy and Join us for our 2nd Runnin' To The Rig 5k Run/Walk!

Saturday, February 21st - Shot Gun Start at 8:30am and Check-in at 7:30am

Runners Start on Morrow Field / Walkers Start on Griffith Field Stadium / Embrace the Legacy Tour meets at the Water Tower near the concessions stand at Griffith Field.

Day of Race Registration 7am - 8am at Check-In Desk at Table on Morrow Field.  Cost is $40/pp

We invite you to participate with us in this FUNdraising endeavor to build community and raise funds. Our 5k course is designed as a nostalgic run/walk throughout our historic campus ending near the famous football tunnel in Griffith Stadium.   Our 2K walk will meander around campus and even through some of the buildings.  The Walk will start after the Run.  Medals given to all finishers!          

Race T-shirts can be purchased during registration for an extra fee if you pre-register  by February 4th.

Plan to hang around after the race for pictures and selfies on historic Griffith Field. 

Don't wait, come join the fun! We are grateful for your support of Bakersfield High School. Go Blue! Once a Driller, Always a Driller!

 

Bib & T-shirt Pickup

You can pick up your race packet and t-shirt at the stadium parking lot near Griffith Stadium.

Fri. Feb. 20,  3:30-6 pm
Sat. Feb. 21,  7-8 am

name: Running For Warriors
description:
Join us for the First Annual Veterans Freedom Shows and Events, Run For Warriors 5k Run

Veterans Freedom Shows and Events, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting veteran-focused causes.

Our mission is simple but impactful: to provide financial assistance to organizations that honor and serve our nation’s veterans, including Central Valley Honor Flight and Wreaths Across America. we also have our own events such as WXO( Warrior Expeditions and Off-Road).

For more information on our events please visit our website. 

www.veteransfreedomshowsandevents.com

name: Running Is For The Birds - 5K, 10K, Kids Run - Earth Day Celebration
description:
Amigos De Bolsa Chica, in conjunction with Bolsa Chica State Beach is hosting a run/walk/beach cleanup for Earth Day! 
🌎 Run for the Birds, Run for the Planet, Run for Earth Day
At a local 5K/10K near you!
Join us on Saturday, April 25, 2026, at Bolsa Chica State Beach — where every step makes a difference.
Run and walk along the beach on a flat, fast, and paved course with stunning ocean views.
🎉 FREE BEACH PARKING before 8:00 AM — races start sharp!
Race Day Schedule:
  • Same Day Registration/Runner Check-In: Opens 7:00 AM
  • Warm-Up & Announcements: 7:50 AM
  • 5K, 10K Start: 8:00 AM
  • Kids Dash: 9:00 AM
  • Overall and Age Group Awards: 9:15 AM
  •  
    🏃‍♀️ Race Options:
    Plover Dash 5K
    Brown Pelican 10K
    Fuzzy Feathers Fun Run (for the kiddos)
    5K Plogging (picking up litter while jogging)
    10K Plogging
    Beach Clean Up with State Beach staff
     
    🧢 What You Get:
    All registered participants in the 5K, 10K, and Plogging events receive:
🏅 Custom Commemorative Medal – designed exclusively for this Earth Day event
👕 Limited-Edition Race Shirt – beautifully designed by a local artist and featuring a new Bolsa Chica bird each year. These collectible commemorative shirts are more than swag — they’re wearable art that celebrates the spirit of the wetlands.
📸 Free Race Day Photos – downloadable & shareable with no hidden costs
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards
⏱️ Professional Chip Timing – results synced to Athlinks
🎪 Finish Line Festival – vendors, product samples, music & local community vibes
 
✅ FREE Beach Parking (arrive early!)
🚲 Bike Valet available near the start line
🎒 Gear Check Available
Fuzzy Feathers Kids Run participants receive commemorative medals & special prizes.
 
✨ Bonus Highlights:
🌿 Environmental Impact – Proceeds benefit environmental education & leadership programs through Amigos de Bolsa Chica (501c3), protecting California’s coastal biodiversity.
♻️ Plogging Categories – Run and help clean the beach as you go!
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Community Connection – Family-friendly, walker-welcoming, and volunteer-powered
🔬 Interactive Expo – Explore Bolsa Chica wetlands up close with microscopes, wildlife exhibits, and hands-on learning hosted by Amigos.
 
Celebrate Earth Day with purpose — and make your miles matter.
🌎💚 Sign up today, lock in your shirt size, and let’s run wild for a better planet.

name: RunThrough San Francisco at Crissy Field 5k, 100k & Half Marathon
description: Run along the stunning Crissy Field waterfront taking in views of the iconic Golden Gate Bridge. This flat, fast course offers a breathtaking backdrop of the bay, Marin Headlands, and Alcatraz. Whether you choose the 5K, 10K, or half marathon, the RunThrough San Francisco at Crissy Field is perfect for both those taking on their first 5k and seasoned runners searching for a PR. A truly unforgettable San Francisco running experience!

name: RunThrough USA Long Beach 5k,10k & Half Marathon Race
description:
Join us for the RunThrough USA Long Breach 5k,10k & Half Marathon Race Weekend 
on Saturday 14th February and Sunday 24th October 2026

This popular running location in LA is perfect for not only quick times but some of the most spectacular coastline in the USA!

5k, 10k, and half marathon race from Shoreline Aquatic Park in Long Beach, California. The half marathon, 5k and 10k will take place on Saturday October 24.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including excellent warm coffee and free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

description:
Ryan’s Ranch Run is a community-driven 5K, 10K, and Kids Mile hosted at the breathtaking Thousand Hills Ranch in Pismo Beach—Ryan Teixeira’s family ranch and the heart of his legacy. This unique event blends scenic running routes with a meaningful mission, raising funds for Central Coast Athletics Foundation (CCAF) and 17 Strong, an organization founded in Ryan’s honor to provide Victory Trips to young adults battling life-threatening illness.

Runners and walkers of all ages take on a mixed-terrain course with rolling hills and the spirit of community all around. Race day begins with the inspiring 17 Strong Victory Lap, followed by the Kids Mile and the 5K/10K races. After crossing the finish line, participants enjoy a lively festival with live music, local vendors, delicious food, raffle prizes, and family-friendly fun.

Ryan’s Ranch Run isn’t just a race—it’s a celebration of resilience, community, and giving back. Each step supports two impactful nonprofits and helps continue Ryan’s legacy of strength, joy, and living life to the fullest.

 

Race Day Celebration
Race day begins with one of the most inspiring traditions of Ryan’s Ranch Run—the 17 Strong Victory Lap. Before the races begin, we will honor past and present 17 Strong Victory Trip Recipients as they take a celebratory lap around the lawn in front of the barn. Join us with cowbells, cheers, and applause as we celebrate their strength, courage, and victories.

  • Victory Lap 8:45 AM
  • Kids Mile Start: 9:00 AM
  • 5K & 10K Start: 9:30 AM
     

5K Race
The Ryan’s Ranch Run 5K offers a unique opportunity to experience the beauty of Thousand Hills Ranch while supporting two incredible causes. The race begins and ends at the historic barn and features a scenic mix of paved roads and dirt ranch roads.  

The 5K and 10K runners start together and follow the same course for the first three miles. Participants will head out along ranch roads toward the fields, loop through the cattle grazing areas, and enjoy expansive views of the rolling hills and working ranch landscape. After exiting the fields, runners return toward the barn. At the final turn, 5K participants continue straight to the finish line at the barn, where friends, family, and festival activities await

The course includes:

  • Mixed dirt and paved surfaces that are stroller friendly
  • Scenic loop through the ranch fields
  • Water station located on the course
  • Course support from volunteer mountain bike club monitoring runners
  • Top 17 overall winners (5K & 10K) win a official RRR Cowboy Hat
  • Overall top male and female will win a special prize awarded at the conclusion of the races

 
10K Race
The 10K provides an extended ranch experience for runners looking for a longer challenge while enjoying the same beautiful scenery.

The race begins alongside the 5K at the barn and follows the same route through the ranch fields for the first three miles. After returning toward the barn, 10K runners split from the 5K course and continue deeper into the ranch. The 10K combines beautiful scenery, ranch charm, and a rewarding challenge that makes it one of the most unique races on California’s Central Coast.

The second half of the course follows a scenic ranch road out-and-back section featuring:

  • Rolling ranch views
  • Additional mileage through Thousand Hills Ranch
  • A dedicated turnaround water station
  • Course support from volunteer mountain bike club riders
  • Top 17 overall winners (5K & 10K) win a official RRR Cowboy Hat
  • Overall top male and female will win a special prize awarded at the conclusion of the races

After reaching the turnaround point, runners return along the ranch road to finish back at the barn.

Kids Mile
The Kids Mile is designed to be a fun and memorable experience for young runners of all ages.

The race starts and finishes at the barn on an all-paved course. Kids will follow one of the race’s favorite traditions—a lead cyclist dressed as a steer mascot—as they make their way around the course.

Features include:

  • Fully paved route
  • Safe, family-friendly course
  • Stroller friendly- Feel free to stroll along with your child if needed.
  • Start and finish at the barn
  • Lead “Steer” biker guiding participants
  • Top 17 boys & girls win a special cowboy hat
  • Overall top boy and girl to finish will win a special prize! 

Whether they run, jog, walk, or have a parent alongside them, the Kids Mile is all about fun, confidence, and creating lasting memories.

Team Competition -Gather your friends, family, coworkers, school, club, or organization and compete for team awards at Ryan’s Ranch Run! Teams can be formed and all team members can register under that assigned team. Create a team, share the referral registration to earn money back on your registration.  Team must be 10 or more registered racers in the 5K and 10K. 

Team Awards

1. Largest Team Award -Awarded to the team with the most registered participants.

2. Most Spirited Team Award- Awarded to the team that shows the most enthusiasm, creativity, team spirit, and event participation.

3. Fastest 5K Team Award- Awarded to the fastest 5K team based on the combined times of the team’s top five finishers.

4. Fastest 10K Team Award- Awarded to the fastest 10K team based on the combined times of the team’s top five finishers.

How Team Scoring Works

Must register as a Team to qualify for the Team Awards. For the Fastest Team competitions, the top 5 runners from each team will score. The team with the lowest combined time wins. Team must be 10 or more registered racers in the 5K and 10K. 

Awards - Prizes and recognition will be awarded to all four winning teams.

Stay for the Festival After crossing the finish line, stick around for the Ryan’s Ranch Run Festival featuring:

  • Live music
  • Food for purchase by Hoagies 
  • Local vendors
  • Raffle prizes
  • Community celebration

Come run, celebrate, and help support 17 Strong and the Central Coast Athletics Foundation while honoring the legacy of Ryan Teixeira.

name: San Bernardino County Employee 5K Run/Walk
description:
Join us for a free 5K run/walk for San Bernardino County employees and their families, followed by an employee picnic starting at 10:00 a.m. Be sure to register by May 15 to guarantee your 5K T-shirt.

Early bib pickup will be available in the HR Lobby (175 West 5th Street, 1st Floor, San Bernardino, CA 92415) on June 23 and June 25 from 11:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

Event Details:

Check-in: Begins at 7:00 AM for those who have not picked up their bib and T-shirt. 
Race Start Time: 8:00 AM  
Raffle and Announcement of 5K Winners: After the race on the main stage at approximately 10:20 AM.

name: San Clemente Ocean Festival
description:
San Clemente Ocean Festival is a volunteer organization, dedicated to the promotion and support of ocean safety, the environment and the community by providing a quality athletic venue and enjoyable family event. The San Clemente Ocean Festival utilizes a a "One Fee - All Events Entry". Participants pay one fee and are entitled to enter any of the events listed for that entry. Entry includes commemorative SCOF tee, SCOF swim cap and competitors kit.

Saturday July 18

International Lifeguard Competition (All Events) - includes Surf Race, Rescue Relay, Surf Ski Race, International Ironman, NDA Dory Races #1 & #2, Paddleboard Rescue Relay, Paddleboard Sprint, Landline Rescue Relay.

Junior Lifeguard Competition (All Events) - includes Beach Flags, Surf Race, Run-Swim-Run, Paddleboard Race

Separate Saturday entry events:

Dolphin Dash (kid's running race)

Pier Bowl Surf Classic (open & age-group surfing event)

Sunday July 19

Beach Events (All Events) - includes 5K Beach Run, Biathlon (Swim 1K, Run 5K), Open Ocean Paddle, One Mile Ocean Swim, Run-Swim-Run, SUP Sprint, Splash & Dash Relay

Separate Sunday entry event:

5K Beach Run,

Grom's Rule Surf Contest (kid's age-group surf event including 7 & under "Push-in Division)

name: San Diego 50 & Trail Runs
description:
SAN DIEGO 50M | TRAIL MARATHON | RELAY | HALF MARATHON | SUMMIT CHASE 10M | VALLEY 5M | STROLLER 5K | KID'S 1 MILE

                       

The San Diego 50M is a great introduction into ultra marathons or your first 50M distance, ideal for all running levels.

The San Diego Trail Marathon is a staple in the trail marathon events. Enjoy a fast trail while getting to summit its high point of Raptor Ridge. 

San Diego Trail Marathon Relay is a new format to our classic Trail Marathon. Run 13.1 before passing off to your team mate to run the last 13.1 miles finishing at our Official Finish Line. * Note there will not be a shuttle. Easy Pick Up Drop Offs available at the Piedras Parking Trail Head Parking Lot.

The San Diego Trail Heavy Half Marathon is a beautiful courses for exploring new trails and accomplishing race goals as it gives you just that little more than a half marathon.

NEW Summit Chase 10M conquer and claim the CROWN on the fast out and back course up to the top of Raptor Ridge. The fastest time out and back claims the crown.

NEW Valley 5M our flat 5 plus mile event gives you a introduction distance and amazing valley views.

NEW Stroller Trail 5k our flat 5k (3.1 Mile)  event gives you a super flat course to get out with your little ones and enjoy the day.

The Elevated Youth 1 Mile is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s shirt/medal 

                                                           Whether you sprint, run, walk, jog, or hike this event you do not want to miss.

                                             We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.

name: San Diego 5K SCADaddle for Research
description:
OUR CAUSE

Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection (SCAD) is a little-known and poorly understood cause of a heart attack. Most patients are young, healthy, and active women who do not have the typical risk factors of heart disease. Although less common, it can affect men too. SCAD can reoccur and can be fatal. Research is needed to identify the cause(s) and the best treatment options.

SCAD is the #1 cause of heart attacks in women under age 50, pregnant women & new moms.

 


SCADaddle

Our timed 5K run/walk takes place on the south side of Crown Point Park in San Diego on Mission Bay. Enjoy the course along the bay on the bay side walkway.  Free Parking.

Awards will be given to the overall winner male and female. Medals/recognition will be given to 2nd and 3rd place males/females overall and to the top three males/females for age groups: 11 and under, 12-15, 16-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69 and 70 and up.

Register by August 15, 2026, to guarantee this year's t-shirt.

Relax after the 5K and enjoy:

Refreshments - Custom made to order ACAI Bowl by Alohana Acai Bowls                                                                                                                           

Face Painting 

Vendors


Fun for all while supporting a great cause - research!

 

FUNDRAISING AWARDS

Raise at least $1,000 and you will automatically be refunded your registration fee of $45.00.   Start today!!!

 

A Fundraising page will be automatically added during registration; however, you are not required to fundraise, but it would be greatly appreciated if you do.

name: San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon
description:
The San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon is an award-winning loop course along some of the best of San Diego’s coastline. Experience beautiful beaches to picturesque bays, you’ll run past SeaWorld, Belmont Park, Mission Beach, Pacific Beach, and Sail Bay — the best of San Diego in one unforgettable course.

With only 165 feet of total elevation gain, this is one of California’s flattest and fastest half marathons — perfect for chasing a PR or enjoying the ultimate destination race in San Diego.

Register today and join us on April 10, 2027.

name: San Diego Holiday Half Marathon & 5K
description: The San Diego Holiday Half Marathon is a fast 13.1-mile course that starts on Penasquitos Drive in front of the Hotel Karlan (formerly, the Doubletree Golf Resort) then travels SW along Carmel Mountain Rd (your only ‘real’ hill at mile 1.5), along the 56 bike path and finishes at the beautiful Torrey Pines State Beach (pictured above!). The race includes a 711-foot net elevation drop along the “rolling” downhill bike path, which also makes it a personal best candidate. This popular winter half has been a sell-out event every year. Get your end-of-the-year PR!!!

name: San Diego MLK 5K Walk / Fun Run
description:
RESULTS:  Timed Race Results

Walk, jog or run!  Join us on Harbor Dr. to celebrate MLK weekend in a healthy fashion with a scenic Embarcadero experience!  This 5K Walk / Fun Run celebrates the legacy of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and his dream to improve the equal participation of all in healthcare, education and workforce development.  We're inspired to help move our community toward a more healthy way of living.  What better way to do that than with the objective of completing a 5k.  Bring your family and friends (human and furry) to the Embarcadero and get moving with us!  See you at the starting line! 

 

We hope to inspire those who have never taken part in a 5K walk / run, to participate.  This event promotes health, fitness, and a general sense of well-being through a fun and engaging manner.

 

"School" option with age based pricing intended to be free for school age kids is active.  

 

We encourage you to post your photos on Social Media with #SDMLK5k.  

 

Registration includes the following. 

  • Official 5K walk / fun run Shirt.
  • Medal
  • Runners Bib
  • Chip race timing

 

5K details:

  • Start Line Location: 1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Start Time: 9:00AM
  • Finish Line Location:  (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Scenic 3.1-mile course down Harbor Dr., crossing into Seaport Village continuing along the harbor coastline and looping around back to the start.  
  • Timing offered.

 

1 Mile Cruiser Walk / Run:

  • Start Line Location: 1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Start Time: 9:00AM
  • Finish Line Location:  1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Scenic 1-mile course down Harbor Dr., crossing into Seaport Village to loop around back to the start.
  • No timing.

 

Virtual participation:  (Anytime & Anyplace!)

For participants who can’t make it to the site but still want to participate and benefit the San Diego Alpha Foundation (501c3)!  Please sign up with the virtual option.  Complete your distance anytime & anyplace during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.  Your race shirt and medal will be mailed to you within 2 weeks of the event date.  

For submission of your results, email them to roger@fusiontiming.com.

 

Race packet pickup:

  • Date:   Fri. 1/15
  • Time:  3pm - 8pm
  • Place:  TBD.

You can also pick up the day of the 5k onsite during check in.  

 
Sponsorship Opportunities:  Please visit us here.-->MLK Weekend Sponsorship Info.

 

San Diego Alpha Foundation is a 501(c)(3) organization.  EIN 46-3297383.  We support the Zeta Sigma Lambda Chapter of Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. in fostering brotherhood, promoting academic excellence, & providing unparalleled service to the community.

name: San Diego Neighborhood Cruise Run
description:
Get ready, San Diego! We invite you to join us for our inaugural event in one of San Diego’s beautiful park. Cruise along the lake, feel the cool ocean breeze, and soak in the scenery as you run, jog, or walk with our community. This is more than a race—it’s a celebration of movement, connection, and good vibes.

🏁 San Diego Neighborhood Run/Walk 
📍 De Anza Cove Park
3000 N Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109

With a lowrider-inspired theme and a welcoming atmosphere, this event brings together fitness, culture, and community. Friends and families are encouraged to come out and enjoy the day—everyone is welcome!

Whether you’re a seasoned runner, casual jogger, walker, or cheering from the sidelines, there’s a place for you here. 

Come cruise the course and celebrate in-style.🔥 Lowrider fans—this one’s for you! Cross the finish line strong. We cant wait to see you.

Packet Includes 💖

Registration Entree / Medal

🗓️ Event Details

⏰ 6:30 AM – Registration Opens
🏃‍♂️ 7:30 AM – 10K Starts
🏃‍♀️ 8:00 AM – 5K Starts
🏆 8:45 AM – Awards Ceremony (First,Second,Third F/M Per Distance) 
⏱️ 10:00 AM – Event Closes

🗺️ Course Instructions

5K:
• Out-and-back course
• Complete the route 1 time (1X)

10K:
• Follows the same 5K route
• Complete the course 2 times (2X)

Please follow all course signage and volunteer directions for a safe and smooth race experience.

⏱️📸 Timing, Results & Photos

• This event is gun-timed
• Race bibs are not chip-timed

name: San Diego Trail Running Film Festival
description:
Presented by Runners For Public Lands, the Trail Running Film Festival is coming to San Diego! 

Join your fellow runners for a night celebrating all things Trail, highlighting the joy, beauty and challenges of running wild places. See seven different short films that showcase the fun, community, and strife that comes from choosing dirt. 

Proceeds for this event will go to Runners For Public Lands.

name: San Joaquin River Trail 10k/25k/50k
description:
Come out and run some of the best trails in the valley along Millerton Lake and the San Joaquin River. 

More info at: www.SanJoaquinRunning.com

Start/Finish: At the S. Finegold Pinic Area, located at the end of Sky Harbour Road in Friant, CA. Sky Harbor Road is located on the West side of Table Mountain Casino off of Millerton Rd. in Friant, Ca. Take Sky Harbor Rd North for approx. 6 miles and it will dead end at the South Finegold Picnic Area where parking is located. 

Start times: 50k – 0630am  •  25k – 0700am  •  10k – 0730am 

Packet Pickup/Check in: Race day at the Start/Finish area. Please arrive arrive early to get your bib, check in and hit the bathroom. NO RACE DAY ENTRIES.

Race Day Check In: 0540-0620am for 50k runners  •  0600-0655am for 25k runners •  0640-0725am for 25k runners <br /><br />

Pacers: Allowed for the 50k at Mile 16 (SJR Gorge/Aid Station #3&4)

Official cutoff for the Finish line will be 5:30pm 

Lodging: If you're traveling from out of town the nearest places to stay will be in Clovis, CA and Fresno, CA.

Camping: Camping is available on the North side of Millerton Lake and also near the 50k turnaround at the San Joaquin River Gorge Mgmt area, each is about a 30 min drive from the Start/Finish. No camping is available at the Start/Finish.

Refunds/Transfer: No refunds after 09/01/2024. Bib transfers are allowed until 10/01/2024.

Crew access: Crew access at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area near the Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground-Mile 14.5 for 50k 

Aid Stations: Aid stations will be almost every 5 miles along the course. They will have water, sports drink, gels, fruit, snacks and basic first aid. 

Drop Bags: Need to be marked "Drop bags" with bib# conspicuously written on it. They will be at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area, Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground.

name: San Lorenzo River Trail Run
description:
Run through 300 foot tall, 1500 year-old Coastal Redwoods, lush stream canyons, open meadows, pine and oak forests, and high dry chaparral-covered ridges. The Half Marathon, 30K, Marathon, and 50K events cross the San Lorenzo River (shown above) multiple times! 
(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

This surf camping trip blends beginner‑friendly surf sessions with classic beachside camping, giving participants the chance to learn new skills, relax outdoors, and enjoy time with friends and family. Includes dinner and a light breakfast.

Must be able to swim if taking surfing lessons.

name: Sandman Tri
description:
The Sandman Triathlon is one of Santa Cruz County’s oldest triathlons, having held its inaugural race in 1985, in the infancy of the sport.

The Sandman is a fundraiser for:

  • the local State Parks,
  • Lifeguard operations,
  • the Junior Lifeguard program.
    Proceeds help fund scholarships for underprivileged kids so they can receive high-quality water safety education.

The Sandman Triathlon is a USAT-sanctioned event.

name: Santa Barbara County 11th Annual Organ Donation Celebration Walk and BBQ
description:
Join us for a free community event! 

Bring your family and friends for a meaningful day as we come together to support organ donation and transplantation. Help raise awareness about the importance of registering as an organ donor on by joining us on September 19, 2026 from 2:00pm-5:00pm.

Register by September 10, 2026, to receive a free commemorative t-shirt!

Event Details:

Location: Leadbetter Beach
Walk Route: To Stearns Wharf and back (approx. 2 miles round trip)
Parking: Local city parking available for just $2.00

Sponsorship and exhibitor opportunities available; see the "Become a Sponsor" tab above.

Let’s walk together for a cause that saves lives. We hope to see you there!

name: Santa Beer Run & Kids Elf Run
description:
SANTA BEER RUN

Run. Sip. Give back. Join us Saturday, December 29th in Exeter for the Santa Beer Run! Costumes encouraged – good times guaranteed!

How It Works:

The race begins with drinking a 12-oz beer (provided by The Stag Saloon) at the start line.

- Lap 1: Run ¼ mile around Downtown Exeter.
- Lap 2: Drink a 12-oz beer at Bell Craft Brew Co., then run another ¼ mile.
- Lap 3: Drink a 12-oz beer at The Rock Yard Tavern, then run another ¼ mile.
- Lap 4: Finish with a 12-oz beer at Bell Craft Brew Co., then run the final ¼ mile.

After the fourth beer and fourth lap, cross the finish line to complete the beer mile and earn ultimate holiday bragging rights!

Race Options:

- Individual Beer Mile: One runner completes all four beers and all four laps.
- Relay Beer Mile (4 person relay): Divide the beers and laps among teammates. Each teammate drinks one beer and runs one lap before tagging the next runner.

Prizes:

The top three individual men and women, as well as the fastest four-person relay team will recieive an one-of-a-kind trophy! Also, prizes will be awarded to the "Best Dressed Participant" and "Best Dressed Relay Team"!

Participants MUST be 21+ years of age to participate in the Beer Run

Elf Run

Get ready for a holly jolly dash through Downtown Exeter at the Elf Run — a festive kids fun run packed with holiday magic, smiles, and Christmas cheer. Young runners are encouraged to dress up in their favorite holiday costumes as they race through age-based distances made just for kids.

Registration Includes:
- Official Elf Run race bib
- Participant medal
- Photo opportunities with Mr. & Mrs. Claus
- Optional add-on Elf Run kids shirt

Race Packet Pickup:

Exeter, CA 93221

Saturday, December 29th (8:00-9:00am)
