name: Santa Claus For A Cause 5K/10K
description:
Santa Claus with a Cause 5K/10K
📅 Saturday, December 12th, 2026
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25, Huntington Beach, CA

Get ready for the ultimate Santa celebration at Bolsa Chica State Beach!
This isn’t just a race, it’s a full-blown Christmas experience.

You’ll run along the beach surrounded by falling snow, live carolers, festive music, and holiday cheer. Every runner receives their choice of a full Santa suit, cozy Santa beanie, or custom-designed race shirt, plus one of the biggest, most festive finisher Santa medal designed to double as a Christmas ornament.

And the best part? This race GIVES BACK. Proceeds from the event help gift staple goods, schooling, and hope to villages in Africa and Nepal, as well as supporting local health initiatives.

 
🎄 Race Day Fun & Schedule
Arrive early and soak up the holiday spirit. There’s so much happening before the race even starts!

6:30 – 8:15 AM: Registration and bib pick-up open at Lot 25. Walk-up registrations are welcome, so bring your friends!

7:00 – 9:00 AM: The REAL Santa 🎅 will be on-site for festive selfie photos (use hashtag #carenwareevents or tag us caren.ware.events). Lil Dickens Carolers will be singing, and snow will be falling to set the perfect holiday mood.

8:00 AM: Kids take center stage with the Ho Ho Ho Dashes (200m, 400m, ½ mile, and 1 mile). Cheer on the little elves as they dash through the holiday magic!

8:15 AM Holiday Costume Contest

8:20 AM: Warm up with the Penguin Macarena! Everyone is invited to join in. Best Costume and Best Christmas Spirit awards are given out here, so come dressed to impress.

8:30 AM: MASS START for the 5K & 10K! Your official time begins when you cross under the start arch, but you must cross by 8:40 AM to be officially timed.

9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony

9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony

11:00 AM - Expo Festivities End

 
🎁 What’s Included
Your registration comes packed with holiday cheer! Every participant receives chip-timed results for the 5K or 10K, so you can track your performance. You’ll also get to choose your festive swag, whether you want to run in a full Santa suit, stay cozy in a Santa beanie, or sport a custom-designed Santa race shirt.

When you cross the finish line, you’ll receive one of the biggest custom Santa-at-the-beach medal that doubles as a Christmas ornament to hang proudly on your tree.

Throughout the morning, enjoy a lively holiday atmosphere with falling snow, live carolers, games, and photo ops with the REAL Santa. Prizes will be awarded for Best Christmas Spirit, Best Costume, and even Best Dressed Doggie, so bring your creativity and holiday cheer.

And don’t leave hungry, we’ll have food vendors on-site serving tamales, tacos, specialty coffee, cookies, fresh fruit and more. Plan on enjoying breakfast by the beach with us after your run!

And for the competitors, we have three-deep age division awards in five-year increments — from ages 1-10 all the way through 85+.

 
📅 Early Packet Pick-Up- Optional
Race Day Pick-Up: 6:30 – 8:15 AM at Lot 25
Early Pick-Up: TBD
(No ID required, and you may pick up for others.)
 
🚗 Parking & Drop-Off
Bolsa Chica State Beach Lot 25 parking is $15 per vehicle (cash or state park pass recommended). The main gate opens at 6:00 AM — use the main entrance only.

Drop-off is available at the corner of Warner & PCH. Free public parking is also available in Sunset Beach (behind Jack in the Box) if you’d like to walk in.

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 

 
🎥 More Than Just a Race
Santa Claus with a Cause is the race that GIFTS BACK. Your participation helps provide staple goods, education, and training to those in need around the world.

📺 Watch our global giving journey: YouTube: Caren.Ware.Events
📚 Visit the Caren Ware booth on race day for book signings of Finding Fit — an inspiring story about running through life’s challenges.

 
💡 Register today, join the celebration, and make this holiday season unforgettable, for you AND for others.

name: Santa Cruz Track Club Cross Country Challenge
description: 4.15 mile, 2-loop cross country race on the fire roads of the upper UC - Santa Cruz campus. This race is part of the Pacific Association-USATF cross country Grand Prix series. The race starts and finishes at the open meadow above the UCSC Firestation on Chinquapin Road. Registration opens at 8 AM alongside the fire road above the small parking lot above the Firestation. Womens race 9AM, Mens Masters 9:45AM, Mens Open 10:30AM Limited parking at the Crown College parking lot. Additional parking is at the East Remote Parking Lot on Hagar Drive. Allow extra time - parking is limited and the additional parking is close to one mile away from registration. Parking violations are strictly enforced!

name: Santa Cruz Trail Run
description:
Giant redwoods dominate the landscape in our Santa Cruz Trail Run. Aside from coiling single-track that opens up to expansive roads and paths–and even sand–participants will enjoy the ocean breezes pouring in from the Santa Cruz coast. This race delivers everything from river crossings to high ridges with aid stations every 5-6 miles for refueling before tackling the next beautiful, albeit strenuous, section. This is a perfect race for family and friends to attend. They can cheer, enjoy Henry Cowell park, and consume post-race food fit for a trail running king or queen!

Park Information: Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park

Start Times:
30K – 8:30 AM
Half – 8:45 AM
10K – 9:00 AM

Check-In & Bib Pickup:
Race Morning: 7:30 AM – 9:00 AM

Time Limit: There is a 6 hour time limit for the race. All runners must be off the course by 2:30 PM.

Capacity: The Santa Cruz Trail Run has a capacity of 330 runners, across all distances.

Parking:  Parking at Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park is $10.00. There is limited parking along Highway 9 outside of the park. To save some money, we recommend you carpool from Felton (minutes away from the park) or Santa Cruz.

Directions:
Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park
101 North Big Trees Park Road, Felton, CA 95018
Click for Directions

Timing:  All races are professionally chip timed, utilizing MyLaps and Race Director, ensuring your time is captured as accurately as possible. Disposable chips are attached to back of each bib number.

Post Race:  We offer a broad selection of sweet and salty snacks, as well as fresh fruit and a diverse line up of pre-packaged food options (chips, cakes, jerkey, etc.).

Dog Policy:  Sorry, no dogs are allowed within Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park.

name: Santa Cruz Triathlon
description:
The Santa Cruz Triathlon is a popular, scenic, non-profit race offering Sprint and International (Olympic) distances, plus relays, aquabike, and an aquathlon option, known for its coastal course along West Cliff Drive and along Highway 1. Its an ocean swim around the iconic Santa Cruz Wharf, a spacious transition area on a soccer field, then riding out along West Cliff and Highway 1 to the quaint town of Davenport and back. Then finish with a beautiful run along West Cliff and finish on Cowells Beach. 

This is great for beginners and veterans alike, with proceeds funding local high school and college athletics in Santa Cruz County. It's a long-running event that donates significantly to youth sports, featuring a sheltered ocean swim and largely closed-course bike and run, creating a fun, community-focused event.

name: Santa To The Sea 1/2 Marathon, 1/4 Marathon & 5K
description:
Santa to the Sea is a nonprofit event born out of a desire to give back to the community. What started in 2003 as a toy drive to celebrate the relocation of the world’s largest Santa Claus from Carpinteria to Oxnard, has grown into a robust running event, toy drive, and community fundraiser. Santa to the Sea includes a half marathon, a Quarter Marathon plus a 5K run and 1K kids fun run. The Santa to the Sea Scholarship Fund partners with Gene Haas and Oxnard College Foundation to award $500 scholarships to local high school students and adults continuing their education at Oxnard College. 

Santa to the Sea offers families not only a weekend of fun, but also an opportunity to give back to those in need, just in time for the holiday season. The nonprofit event helps collect toys for underprivileged children throughout Ventura County while raising scholarship money for students at Oxnard College.

The Half Marathon gets underway at the giant Santa located along the Interstate Highway 101 (2801 Ventura Boulevard) and continues through the strawberry fields of Oxnard before heading to historic downtown Oxnard (where the Quarter Marathon starts) and ending at Marine Emporium Landing (where the 5k and kids 1k start and finish) in picturesque Channel Islands Harbor. There, visitors can enjoy the Finish Line Festival filled with a full day of activities including kids play area, a Santa’s Village, costume contests, food booths and live entertainment.

The Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, Quarter Marathon and 5k, is based in the coastal com­mu­nity of Oxnard, CA., and just 40 min­utes north of Los Angeles. Combine your athletic pursuits with a seaside weekend getaway during the annual Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, 1/4 marathon, 5K run and 1k kids fun run taking place the second Sunday every December.

description:
Santa to the Sea is a nonprofit event born out of a desire to give back to the community. What started in 2003 as a toy drive to celebrate the relocation of the world’s largest Santa Claus from Carpinteria to Oxnard, has grown into a robust running event, toy drive, and community fundraiser. Santa to the Sea includes a half marathon, a Quarter Marathon plus a 5K run and 1K kids fun run. The Santa to the Sea Scholarship Fund partners with Gene Haas and Oxnard College Foundation to award $500 scholarships to local high school students and adults continuing their education at Oxnard College. 

Santa to the Sea offers families not only a weekend of fun, but also an opportunity to give back to those in need, just in time for the holiday season. The nonprofit event helps collect toys for underprivileged children throughout Ventura County while raising scholarship money for students at Oxnard College.

The Half Marathon gets underway at the giant Santa located along the Interstate Highway 101 (2801 Ventura Boulevard) and continues through the strawberry fields of Oxnard before heading to historic downtown Oxnard (where the Quarter Marathon starts) and ending at Marine Emporium Landing (where the 5k and kids 1k start and finish) in picturesque Channel Islands Harbor. There, visitors can enjoy the Finish Line Festival filled with a full day of activities including kids play area, a Santa’s Village, costume contests, food booths and live entertainment.

The Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, Quarter Marathon and 5k, is based in the coastal com­mu­nity of Oxnard, CA., and just 40 min­utes north of Los Angeles. Combine your athletic pursuits with a seaside weekend getaway during the annual Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, 1/4 marathon, 5K run and 1k kids fun run taking place the second Sunday every December.

name: SAR Wild Run
description:
Adventure Meets Purpose in the Sierra


Escape the Valley heat and head to the mountains for one of the most unique race experiences in California.

The Search & Rescue Run is a mountain adventure and fundraiser supporting the Fresno County Sheriff’s Search & Rescue Team. Set near Dinkey Creek Road on the south side of Shaver Lake, runners and hikers will experience scenic meadows, towering pines, cool streams, and beautiful Sierra trails at 5,400 feet elevation.

Choose your adventure:

  • Trail Half Marathon

  • 10K Trail Run

  • 5K Wild Run

  • 2 Mile Family Hike

Whether you're chasing a challenge, hiking with family, or simply enjoying a weekend in the mountains, this event delivers an unforgettable experience.

name: SCAD Research Inc. - Donation
description:
Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection (SCAD) is a little-known and often misunderstood cause of heart attacks. Most patients are young, healthy, active women who have none of the typical risk factors for heart disease. Although less common, SCAD can affect men as well. It can recur—and it can be fatal. More research is urgently needed to identify the causes and determine the most effective treatments.

SCAD is the #1 cause of heart attacks in women under age 50, including pregnant women and new mothers.

This holiday season, we invite you to support this vital work. Your contribution helps fund research that brings us closer to answers, improved treatments, and lives saved.

Be part of our Giving Tuesday campaign!
SCAD Research, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Your donation is tax-deductible.

name: Scarecrow 2.0
description:
🎃 Join Us for Exeter’s 5th Annual Scarecrow 2.0! 🏃‍♀️🍂

What better way to welcome the cooler weather than with a fun run through beautiful Exeter? Starting at Exeter City Park, the course winds through our charming downtown—right alongside the scarecrows!

Bring the whole family and enjoy a morning of running, free food, live music, and small-town fun. Races take place Saturday, November 15, 2025—you won’t want to miss it!

🥐 Svenhards for the whole family!
Each finisher will receive a Svenhard's danish! Did you know Svenhard's is based in Exeter, CA?

Amenities:

Finisher Medal
FREE Race Photos
FREE Svenhards Danish
Scarecrow 2.0 T-Shirt
Chip Timing and Finisher Certificate
FREE drinks
Costume Contest
Live DJ and Music in the Park
Age Group Awards
All male and female finishers will receive an award. Ages: 0-12, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

A portion of funds from Scarecrow 2.0 along with your donations will be donated to the Boys & Girls Clubs of the Sequoias. Their Club serves more than 3,200 youth in Tulare County each year. Membership gives a young person access to nationally-recognized programs and a safe and positive environment to learn and grow.

Our Major Sponsor: Thrasher Masonry

name: SCREAMER RUN 2025
description:
AdaptiSport, Bakersfield's first and only fully accessible wellness center for adults with disabilities set to open in late 2025/early 2026, is thrilled to announce our first annual SCREAMER RUN on the evening of Saturday, October 4, 2025. All are encouraged to join us for this fright-filled event on the main campus of CSU Bakersfield. Help us bring awareness to AdaptiSport and raise critical funds to bring this project to fruition and ensure a bright, healthy future for ALL members of our beloved community! A small portion of proceeds will go to the CSUB Students with Disabilities program. 

Join us at sundown on Saturday, October 4th and be prepared to RUN FOR YOUR LIFE in our 5K, 10K, or Kids Treat or Treat Run (approximately 1 mile). Whether you are a competitive runner or just down for a scary good time, you don't want to miss out on this one-of-a-kind experience. The first annual SCREAMER RUN will feature fright-filled race routes, competitive awards, music, food, raffle prizes, vendor fair, a beer garden, event swag, a special kids' zone, a TEAM COMPETITION, and more. 

This event will be held at California State University of Bakersfield 9001 Stockdale Hwy, Bakersfield Ca 93309.  Start/finish will be at alumni park located in Don Hart East Dr. in between Stockdale Hwy and Kroll Way.

name: Screenland 5K
description:
5k Starts at 9:00 am.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our star-studded 11th Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.  This year's costume contest theme is "Love and Romance."

All participants will receive a commemorative bib, official time, medal, shirt, on-course support and entertainment, entrance into the post-race party, and free downloadable event photos.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the Screenland 5K and then either the 5K or the 15K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run on August 24, 2025 at Dockweiler Beach.  If you missed Screenland in 2024, you can start the challenge at Screenland in March and finish it at BRA Run in August.

We will be publishing a list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K in 2025, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K at www.BRArunLA.com.

name: SD HipHop 5k
description:
SD HipHop 5K Run/Walk

October 18, 2026

Gather the family to come out and celebrate a fun and festive run/walk at the 7th Annual SD HipHop 5k. And we our proud to announce that we are also offering a virtual challenge.You can run, cycle, walk, swim or roll a certain distance in one day or a couple of days to equal  3.1 miles. Anyone of any ability can participate and it can be completed at any location, at your own pace. Please note that the Virtual Challenge event will not be an officially timed event.

Onsite registration will start at 6:00 am and will close at 7:45 am. The race will start promptly at 8:00 am. Runners and walkers are encouraged to bring their lounge chairs and canopies to attend the festival after the 5k Run/Walk.

Packet pickup location and time: Please find our Hip Hop 5K booth at 1655 Euclid Ave, San Diego, CA 92105 anytime between 10:30AM-3:00PM. 

 

Please note that registration fees are non-refundable. Additional race information can be found at www.sdhiphop5k.com

We also have sponsorship opportunities available. Please fill out the Sponsor form at www.sdhiphop5k.com. 

*This is a family-friendly and kid-friendly event. *T-shirts are give-aways and are given away to registrants until we run out

name: Seaport Village 5K
description:
Seaport Village 5k -SDGirls Run Fundraiser

Join SDGirls Run for the Seaport Village 5K, a scenic waterfront race in the heart of downtown San Diego! This community-powered 5K welcomes runners and walkers of all paces and ages to come together for movement, connection, and a great cause.

Participants will enjoy a beautiful route through Seaport Village with views of the bay, live energy, and a supportive atmosphere. Whether you’re racing for a PR or just here for the vibes, we can’t wait to run with you!

name: Season of the Witch 5K 10K by Califlow Runs
description:

5K & 10K • Long Beach

📍 Location:
5000 E Ocean Blvd
Granada Beach, Long Beach, CA

🖤 Season of the Witch Run
5K & 10K • Long Beach

Spooky season starts early in Long Beach.

Step into the Season of the Witch Run, a magical 5K & 10K experience where movement meets mysticism and the coastline becomes your coven. Witches, warlocks, mystics, and magical beings of all kinds are invited to lace up, costume up, and run into fall with us.

Set against the ocean backdrop at Granada Beach, this is more than a race — it’s a ritual.

Before the miles begin, gather for our Witch Warm-Up Ritual, a guided movement flow designed to awaken your body, focus your energy, and set your intention. Because how you start matters.

As the sun rises, we take off together — capes flowing, brooms flying, spells activated — for a scenic, flat, and fast coastal run that’s welcoming to runners, joggers, and walkers alike.

After you cross the finish line, the magic continues.

Stay for our Spellbound Stretch Cool Down, a grounding yoga session by the ocean to help your body recover, release, and restore. Then explore our Witchy Fair & Finish Line Festival, featuring psychic and tarot readers, crystals, mystical vendors, music, and some of the most epic photo ops of the season.

🧙‍♀️ Costumes are highly encouraged, and we’ll be awarding our Best Witch / Warlock Costume — so bring the drama, the sparkle, or the spooky glam.

5K • 10K • Half Marathon

📅 Sunday, September 13

Sweater or bikini?
Iced coffee or pumpkin spice?
It’s California — we’re officially in a state of seasonal confusion.

The Seasonal Confusion Run celebrates that weird in-between moment when summer won’t let go, fall is pretending to arrive, and the weather absolutely refuses to cooperate. Come run the coast in whatever makes sense to you — hoodie, tank top, or beachwear encouraged.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
• Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
• 5K & 10K: 7:30 AM

Opens at 6:00 AM

Flat, fast, scenic beach path course
Beginner- and walker-friendly
Strollers welcome
Dogs on leash welcome 🐾
Professional chip timing
Free race-day photos
Overall & age group awards
Finish line festival vibes
 
🍔 Post-Race Perk
Run first, refuel after.

Life doesn’t wait for perfect conditions — and neither do we.

name: Shadow of the Giants 50k & 20k Run
description:
Event Information:

37th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k-June 5th,2027
Experience the Magic of the Sierra National Forest
Join us for the 36th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k, an unforgettable race through the scenic and historic trails of the Sierra National Forest. 

Time Limit for 50k: 8 hours - 9hours with an Early Start

Important Notice: Pets are not allowed on the trail, so please leave your furry friends at home.

No Transfers or deferrals after May 1st, 2027 No exceptions.

Pre-Race Accommodations and Dinner
For those interested, we are offering the option to stay onsite the night before the race on Friday, June 4th at Camp Green Meadows in the dorms. Additionally, join us for our traditional pre-race lasagna dinner on Friday, June 4th at approximately 5:45 PM in the Green Meadows Dining Hall.

Race Day Schedule
50k Start Time: 7:00 AM
20k Start Time: 7:15 AM
Early Starts Available: 6:00 AM (Early starters are not eligible for overall awards, they are eligible for Age Group Awards)

Course Information
Detailed course maps and updates will be provided, closer to the race day

Aid Stations: Located roughly 5-7 miles apart, our aid stations will be well-stocked with food, Gels, Electrolyte drink, water, Coca-Cola, ginger ale, and a variety of sweet and salty snacks.

Guidelines:

No pacers.
No dogs.

Poles are permitted.
Fun and smiles are mandatory!

Post-Race Celebration
After the race, you’re invited to hang out at Green Meadows to cheer on fellow runners. Post-race food and beverages will be provided in the Dining Hall. Bring a chair, a pop-up tent or umbrella, and enjoy the camaraderie.

BIB Pickup

When: Friday, June 4th
Time: 3:00 PM - 5:30 PM
Where: Camp Green Meadows Outdoor School in Fish Camp, CA, in the Cafeteria
Race Day Bib Pick-Up:

When: Saturday, June 5th
Time: 5:40 AM - 6:45 AM
Where: Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadow Outdoor School
Note: No pets or dogs are allowed on the Green Meadows Campus, except for service animals.

Staying at Camp Green Meadows
Arrival: Do not arrive before 1:15 PM on Friday, June 4th
Check-In: Begins at 1:30 PM in the Cafeteria. Bunks are first-come, first-served. No check-ins after 8:00 PM.
What to Bring: Bedding, pillow, sleeping bag/blankets
Shared Space Etiquette: Respect others and keep noise levels down. Quiet time starts at 9:00 PM.
Facilities: Showers and restrooms available onsite.
Trash: All trash must be removed before departure.
Camping: Tent camping is not allowed on campus. There is dispersed camping in the area. 
Parking: Large or oversized vehicles like RVs are not permitted on campus. You may park on nearby Forest Service Roads.

Pre-Race Dinner
If you’ve purchased a ticket for our pre-race dinner, it will start around 5:45 PM - 6:00 PM in the Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadows. The dinner will include lasagna, salad, bread, and drinks. No additional tickets will be sold as meals are prepared based on pre-orders.

Parking Guidelines
Do Not Block Roadways: Ensure clear access in and out of Green Meadows.
Parking Locations: Once the parking lot at Green Meadows is full, you may park on the shoulder of the camp entrance or on the dirt road shoulder just before the camp entrance. Do not block roadways.
Alternative Parking: You may park off Jackson Road near the final turn down onto the single track that leads to the finish line. It’s a pleasant half-mile walk from there with no parking issues.
Changing Distances
You may switch to the 20k distance at any time up until race day. Changes can be made at bib pick-up or at the timing tent at the start/finish area.

Course Cutoff
The cutoff time for completing the 50k course is 3:00 PM. Early starters (6:00 AM start) have until 3:00 PM to finish, giving them a total of 9 hours.

Start Times for Saturday, June 5th, 2027
50k & 20k Early Start: 6:00 AM (Please be self-sufficient until Aid Station #2)
50k Regular Start: 7:00 AM
20k Start: 7:15 AM

Shadow of the Giants 50k is operated under special use permit with the Sierra National Forest.

San Joaquin Running events are open to all participants. We are committed to providing an inclusive environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability.

name: Shark Attack 5K & 1 Mile Run
description:
Get ready for an exhilarating race that combines the excitement of a 5k or 1-mile run with the support of a vibrant community! Whether you're a seasoned racer or a first-timer, get set to experience an electrifying event in a stunning setting, surrounded by an awesome crowd of fellow runners!

 

Race Details

 

Arrival

  • CHECK IN:  6:00 a.m. Registration will remain open on race day from 6:00 a.m. through 7:00 a.m.
  • OPENING CEREMONY: 7:15 a.m.

 

Parking

  • FREE PARKING located inside Green River Golf course (1 Main entrance to Golf Course)
  • Please park in the upper parking lot section (See address below)

 

Course Description

Experience the picturesque landscapes of the Green River Golf Course at the Shark Attack 5k! This flat, fast course features conditions ideal for pushing your limits and setting personal records.

 

MILE 1 -Start off with a fast first mile on a mostly paved pathway running parallel to pristine fairways. 

MILE 2 -The second mile offers a mixture of both paved roads and dirt trails. 

MILE 3 -The final stretch is near and will certainly allow you to finish your strongest. 

FINISH LINE - As you cross the finish line you’ll be welcomed into a grand celebration area where you’ll receive your medal and be greeted by fans, fellow participants, and a live DJ! Then enjoy a lively post-race atmosphere with music, snacks, and vendor booths. 

 

What to Expect on Race Day

 
  • All Finishers Will Receive Medals
  • Fun Community Event
  • Abundant High-fives and cheering as Santiago's Cross Country Superstars cheer you on along the course.
  • Scenic, flat, and fast route
  • Receive a Dri- FIT shirt if registration is received by 10/15

 

Have a Team or Group?


Representing your school, work, church, running group, etc.? Register as a group to get a discount. Here's how it works:

Minimum of 10 participants required to receive $5 off discount per participant. Once 10th person registered, everyone will be issued a $5 refund.

Register under a team or group: https://runsignup.com/RaceGroups/135500

name: Sharsheret West Coast Dash
description:
On Sunday, October 25, 2026, Sharsheret will gather hundreds of thrivers, caregivers, friends and supporters on the beach for our 5th Annual West Coast Dash in support of our breast and ovarian cancer work. Our run/walk will include a 5K Race, 10K Race, Family Fun Race, Virtual Race and Event Festival. Contributions excluding the value of race entry tickets are tax-deductible.

Schedule for Race Day, Sunday, October 25 (schedule subject to change)

6:00am – Parking Lots Open – First 200 cars will receive a free parking pass. Parking is $13. Please have cash available to expedite process.

7:00am – Registration and Festival Opens (Recommended 5K/10K arrival time)   

7:20am – Minyan 

8:00am – Welcome and Opening ceremony. 

8:20am - Warm Up and Walk to Start Line for 5K/10K

8:30am - 10K Start (Recommended Family Fun Race arrival time)

- 10K Race Course Map https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6202657963/ 

- 5K Race Course Map https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6202686184 

8:40am - 5K Start

9:25am – Family Fun Race Warm Up and Walk to Start Line for Family Fun Race

9:35am - Family Fun Race Start

- 1K Family Fun Race Course Map https://www.strava.com/routes/3401592517811740622  

10:00am – Awards Ceremony

BEACH CLEAN UP
Help us leave Dockweiler Beach cleaner than we found it! Join Shemesh Farms for a group beach clean up directly following the Dash.

Directions
12000 Vista Del Mar
Dockweiler Beach
Playa Del Rey, CA 90293

Waze and Apple Maps may misdirect you. Please follow the instructions below.
Freeway Route from 405N and 405S: Take the 105 Imperial Hwy past LAX towards the beach. Beach entry is at the end of Imperial Hwy where it passes Vista Del Mar.
City Streets from North: Take Pershing Drive south (NOTE ** Vista Del Mar will be closed North of Imperial Highway on race morning) until it hits Imperial Hwy. Make a right into the beach entry.
City Streets from South: Take Vista Del Mar north until it hits Imperial Hwy. Make a left into the beach entry.

Parking
Free parking: The first 200 cars will receive a free parking pass. Parking is $13 per car. Please have cash available to expedite process.
When you arrive: Please let the parking attendant know that you are with the event and be prepared with cash. The line to pay and park will get backed up so please arrive early.
Lots for parking: After you pay turn right and follow the road. There are three parking lots. We recommend parking in the 2nd lot. The 2nd lot is a 5 minute walk to the race start line and festival.
There is very limited parking in the 3rd lot and it is reserved for volunteers and those who require wheelchairs or other special needs. All race distances end in the 3rd and last lot. There is no exit from the 3rd lot while the event is going on. Anyone parked in the third lot will have to wait to leave until all races are complete. No vehicles will be able to leave the third lot before 10am.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Celebrate our Race Grand Marshals! 

Healthcare Hero

Dr. Debra Mund is a Diagnostic Radiologist and Breast Imaging Specialist at Providence Saint John’s Health Center, where she has practiced since 2005, and serves as adjunct faculty at the Saint John’s Cancer Institute. She and her husband, Scott, live in Beverlywood and are the proud parents of four children and grandparents to three grandchildren. A longtime supporter of Sharsheret, Dr. Mund joined the West Region Advisory Committee in 2022 after many years of speaking in educational roles, and she also serves on the Board of Trustees for Genesis, an educational foundation. She is dedicated to combining her passion for health, education, and community service in her professional and volunteer work.

Community Hero

Lisa and Josh Hofheimer will be recognized on race day for their inspiring efforts on behalf of the Sharsheret, cancer, and Los Angeles communities.

Lisa is a private foundation consultant and serves as Executive Director of the Lee Liberman Foundation, which supports nonprofits working to bolster social cohesion and counter polarization. She previously served as Finance Director of the Rosenthal Charitable Trust in Los Angeles and began her career in investment banking, executing private placements for institutions investing in emerging markets.

Josh is a partner in Sidley Austin LLP’s Technology and Life Sciences Transactions practice, a member of the firm’s Global Life Sciences Leadership Council, and co-leader of Sidley’s Global Agribusiness and Food industry group. Previously, Josh served as CEO and Managing Director of Hexima Limited (ASX:HXL), Australia’s first publicly listed ag-biotech company, and throughout his career has been an advocate for women’s rights and women’s health.

Diagnosed with breast cancer as a young mom of two in 2002, Lisa met Sharsheret’s founder, Rochelle Shoretz A”H, in the first year of the organization and volunteered as one of the first peer supporters for other women who were diagnosed. Lisa served as the founding Co-Chair of Sharsheret’s California Community Advisory Committee when Sharsheret opened on the West Coast in 2016. Drawing from their own experience as a survivor and caregiver, Lisa and Josh have served as innovative leaders and trusted advisors for Sharsheret locally and nationally over the past 24 years.

Young Leaders Award

Close friends Adena Frenkel and Nessia Gottlieb are passionate community builders and longtime supporters of Sharsheret. name: Signal Hill Rotary Mutt Run 1K & 5K
description:
FINDING HOMES - ONE DOG AT A TIME

2026 Event Photos

5K Course

1K Course

Run or walk at your pace with or without your dog.  The event starts at the Granada Launch Ramp (Rosie's Dog Beach) at 5000 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803 and the course follows along the scenic Long Beach shoreline.

Race packet pick up is at the starting line on race day.  Please arrive by 7:30 am to allow sufficient time before the race.

EVENTS

  • 5K Runner-only (humans only) race starts at 8:30 am
  • 5K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:30 am
  • 1K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:45 am

DOGGIE DO'S and DON'T'S

  • All breeds of dogs welcome, not just mutts
  • Dogs must be leashed and stay on the pedestrian path at all times
  • Dogs must be non-aggressive with people and dogs

FUN INCLUSIONS AND POST-RACE EVENTS

  • Adoption event by the Long Beach Animal Care Services at the finish line and post-race festival
  • High quality race t-shirt for 1K and 5K participants
  • Finisher medal for all participants
  • Awards for top three 5K finishers

WHY WE RUN

  • 70% of proceeds will support the Long Beach Animal Care Services
  • 30% of the proceeds will go toward the community project fund at Signal Hill Rotary

name: Signarama Firecracker 5K
description:
Kick-off 4th of July with this fun, festive patriotic event!

It’s the Signarama Firecracker 5K on the morning of July 4th at Turtle Bay Exploration Park.

This is a great way to celebrate our community, family, and America!

The fun starts at 8 AM with a Red, White and Blue opening ceremony featuring the Pledge of Allegiance and the Star-Spangled Banner.

A Little Sparkler’s ¼ mile Run/Walk

Followed by a Flag Lined Course TIMED 5K Fun Run, walk, or stroll
Limited edition commemorative t-shirt
Medals for all the Little Sparkler’s Run/Walkers
Great Music with local resident DJ
Medals are given out for patriotic outfits/groups

NOTE: Registration INCLUDES Pancake Breakfast,  1 per racer.   Below you may purchase breakfast tickets for non-racing family members & friends.

So, this 4th of July before you fire up the BBQ and watch the fireworks show, gather all your friends and family and celebrate America at the Signarama Firecracker 5K!

name: Silicon Valley Mini Kids Triathlon
description:
The Silicon Valley Mini Kids Triathlon is specifically for kids aged 4 through 6, and parents can help their kids during the race. 

The race will be in the beautiful and recently opened Kathleen MacDonald High School. The swim will be in the pool, and the run will be on the sidewalk closed to the public.  The bike course will be on a closed road. There should be plenty of parking, the bike course has easy spectator viewing, and the whole event will be more compact.

Triathlon

For kids 4 - 6 years old (parents can help during the race from the swim to the finish line; if the parents decide to help the kid, it will be part of the race the whole time).

description:

Let’s Make This Year’s PRIDE 5K/10K Bigger & Better!

name: Silicon Valley Santa Run
description:
Join us for the 15th Annual Silicon Valley Santa Run, benefiting Christmas in the Park! 

This 5K Run/Walk is holiday fun for the whole family. You can dress up as your favorite holiday character or tradition, then make your way through San Jose for a festive afternoon celebrating the most wonderful time of the year! The flat, fast course begins on Santa Clara St. and concludes at Christmas in the Park, where you can enjoy the decorations and booths with your friends and family.

Silicon Valley Santa Run offers a 5K run/walk or a Kids Reindeer Dash. Both events are available in person or virtually. All 5K participants will receive our holiday-themed long sleeve tech shirt, ornament-style finisher medal, and race bib with timing chip. Kids Reindeer Dash participants will receive a festive short-sleeved t-shirt, an ornament-style finisher medal, a race bib, and milk and cookies at the finish line.

name: Silver Moon Race: Kings River
description:
The Silver Moon Race is where runners of all levels come to chase big goals and have an unforgettable adventure chasing miles under the full moon and stars. Elevate your running and endurance on a gorgeous course through Central California’s orchards and vineyards along the Kings River. Your challenge, your pace, your night.

Whether you’re stepping up from half marathons or diving into the world of ultras, or going for your first 100-mile buckle, this race gives you the perfect environment to push your endurance and discover what you’re capable of.

Timed on the weekend closest to the full moon, the race begins at sunset and carries you through a night lit by moonlight and stars into the sunrise on the horizon. It’s a uniquely magical experience that keeps runners coming back year after year.

  • Beginner Friendly > 12K, 20K, or 40K
  • Ultra Challenges > 6, 12, 24-Hours, or 100-Miles
  • Run with Friends > Relay Teams
  • Worry Free > Fully supported overnight experience
  • Full Moon > Camping Experience

RACES

Choose the challenge that fits your journey—12K, 20K, 40K distances, or 6, 12, 24-hour time categories, or go for the ultimate endurance challenge of 100 miles in 30-hours, run it solo or with friends in a 2, 3, or 4‑person team relay. Running through a beautiful farm setting along the Kings River on a fast, scenic 2.5‑mile loop designed for flow, comfort, and confidence.

Whether you’re a first-time runner, a seasoned ultra runner, or just looking to have a great time outdoors with awesome people, the Silver Moon Race has something to match your fitness level and goals. Prepare for a one-of-a-kind race experience!

FIND YOUR RACE
 

RELAY EXPERIENCE

Take on the challenge solo or team up with your crew for a relay race that turns into a full‑blown adventure. Teams of 2, 3, or 4 rotate through laps and chase a shared goal—whether you’re chasing a set distance or stacking as many laps as you can before the clock hits zero. It’s the perfect blend of teamwork, strategy, and unforgettable race‑day vibes with good friends.

Camp, Cheer, Repeat

When you’re not on the course, you’re right in the heart of the action at your camp. Set up your home base on the course, cheer on your teammates, grab food, relax, and cheer on runners. The off‑course moments become part of the fun—laughing with friends, swapping stories, and gearing up for your next lap. 

Why Teams Love It
  • Shared accomplishment > every lap adds to something bigger.

name: Simi 250 5k
description:
Simi 250 5K Run – A Community Celebration

Join us for the official Simi 250 5K, a fun and spirited community run celebrating America’s 250th birthday and the heart of our Simi Valley community.

Whether you’re a seasoned runner, a casual jogger, or simply looking for a great way to start your Independence Day festivities, the Simi 250 5K is designed to bring people of all ages and abilities together for a morning of energy, connection, and celebration.

The course follows the beautiful Arroyo Simi Greenway, offering a scenic and accessible route that welcomes runners, walkers, families, and friends alike. Along the way you’ll experience the excitement of race day, the encouragement of fellow participants, and the pride of being part of a historic national milestone.

This event is about more than just the finish line. It’s about celebrating community, honoring the spirit of independence, and kicking off a day of festivities across Simi Valley.

Come run, walk, cheer, and celebrate with us.

Be part of the moment.
Be part of the community.
Be part of the Simi 250.

Date: July 3, 7:30am

Distance: 5K (3.1 miles)

Location: Simi Valley, California

All ages and abilities welcome.

name: Sixth Annual A-7 Corsair II Memorial 5K Run/Walk (Virtual)
description:
The first flight of the A-7 Corsair II took place 26 September 1965.  The airframe would go on to serve in every major conflict from Vietnam to Desert Storm. Utilized by the US Navy, US Air Force, US Air National Guard, Portuguese Air Force, Thai Air Force, and Hellenic Air Force, the Corsair II was finally retired from service in 2014.  To commemorate this aircraft's storied history and the sacrifice of those service members who flew and maintained the airframe throughout its 51 year history, the A-7 Corsair II Association (www.corsair2.us) is hosting its sixth annual virtual 5K run/walk. Funds raised from this event will be used to support the Association's goals including scholarships for America’s youth for various programs focusing on science, technology, engineering, mathematics, critical thinking, and of course, aviation. ✈️

A portion of the registration is tax deductible. If you have any questions, please contact the race director at A7C2RaceDirector@gmail.com.

As a virtual event, you'll be running on your own or with your own group, completing a 5K run or walk, or any other activity you deem comparable to a 5K run or walk.  If you run or walk, you should record your time(s), and then post your time results on this site under "Results".  If you'd like to provide photo's of your individual efforts, we would love to post them to our results site and on our Facebook Event. If you do provide photos you are agreeing to the use of your photo for this purpose.

Early Bird Registration from 30 Mar - 31 May 2026 will save you $5.00 for registration - $40.00.  As of 1 June registration will rise to the normal $45.00 - so sign up early!

name: SIXTO MALDONADO, JR. MEMORIAL RUN
description:
💙🏃‍♂️ Run With Purpose. Walk With Honor. Remember A Hero. 🏃‍♀️💙


Join us this fall for the Officer Sixto Maldonado, Jr. Memorial 10K Run, 5K Run & 2-Mile Walk, a meaningful community event dedicated to honoring the life, service, and sacrifice of Officer Sixto Maldonado, Jr.

🚔 On August 19, 1975, Officer Maldonado made the ultimate sacrifice while serving the City of Firebaugh. Nearly 50 years later, his courage, dedication, and commitment to protecting our community continue to inspire us.

This event is more than a race. It is a chance for family, friends, neighbors, and supporters to come together to ensure Officer Maldonado’s legacy lives on.

🎓 Every step you take will make a difference. Proceeds from this memorial event will fund scholarships for graduating seniors from Firebaugh High School who are pursuing higher education, helping empower the next generation to chase their dreams and build brighter futures.

🏃 Choose Your Challenge:

🏅 10K Run
🏅 5K Run
🚶 2-Mile Community Walk

Whether you are racing toward a personal best, walking in remembrance, volunteering your time, or simply showing your support, you are part of something bigger.

💙 Honor the Badge. Remember the Sacrifice. Invest in Our Youth. 💙

Join us as we run, walk, and remember Officer Sixto Maldonado, Jr. His watch may have ended, but his legacy continues through all of us.

name: Sloth Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🦥🏃‍♂️ The Sloth Run – Slow Is the New Fast! 🏃‍♀️🦥

Tired of high-speed races and intense competition? Us too.
Welcome to the Sloth Run, where the pace is slow, the vibes are chill, and everyone's a winner (eventually).

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)

name: Smokey Bear Run
description:
Please join us at beautiful Bass Lake, California on Saturday, September 19, 2026 for the Smokey Bear Run / Walk. This year's event proceeds will go back to our local community. This year, we are celebrating the 39th year of the race.

The courses run on Road 222, which edges Bass Lake. Slightly rolling hills and pristine views of Bass Lake are in store for 10k and 2 Mile participants!

 

GROUP PRICING AVAILABLE UNTIL 7/31!

Register your group of 4 for a special discounted rate! Once inside registration, simply use the "Multi-Person Pricing" drop down to secure a great price!

The courses run on Road 222, which edges Bass Lake. Slightly rolling hills and pristine views of Bass Lake are in store for 10k and 2 Mile participants!

 

GROUP PRICING AVAILABLE UNTIL 7/31!

Register your group of 4 for a special discounted rate! Once inside registration, simply use the "Multi-Person Pricing" drop down to secure a great price!

name: SOCAL River Marathon - 26.2 - 13.1 - 10K - 5K
description:
The SOCAL River Marathon has four distances. Full Marathon, Half Marathon, 10K and 5K. 

This is a fun course in Southern California. This course runs on the Santa Ana River Trail from Yorba Linda to Huntington Beach State Park. This route truly spans Southern California from the dryer desert land to areas near Disneyland to the Beach. The course is primarily flat and straight but has a gradual downhill slant following the river to the ocean. This route is two years ago was cleaned up from homeless tents and is not fenced in nightly.

name: SoCal XC Running Camp 2026
description:
SoCal XC running Camp is a five day cross country camp for male and female high school students. Located at Lake Hemet Camping Grounds, this is a tent camping experience for high school students who enjoy outdoor camping and who want to improve as runners. Participants attend camp from July 20 to July 24, 2026 to take part in training sessions, group games, activities, and compete in a 2 mile time trial on Thursday, July 23. Trophies are awarded to the top three boys and girls in each time trial as well as to the fastest athlete in each grade level (9th-12th).

SoCal Cross Country Camp is not affiliated with any public school. It is a private event which is open to any high school student of any running experience who wants to improve his or her abilities as a distance runner.

name: SoCal's Pirate's 5k/10k Run/Walk
description:
The SoCal Pirate’s 5K/10K
Long Beach Shoreline Park

SATURDAY, June 20, 2026
8:00 AM MASS START for both the 5K & 10K
Kid’s Dash: 7:45 AM

Be part of the largest pirate gathering atmosphere in Southern California! Ships ahoy! The pirates have landed in Long Beach! Shoreline Park offers a SHIP Filled scenic area for an even bigger pirate invasion.

The Pirate’s Run is themed throughout the course, complete with hidden treasures along the way. Make it a party or come to race fast, this is a FLAT & FAST paved beach course with incredible ocean views.

 
LOCATION
Long Beach Shoreline Park
212 Golden Shore
Long Beach, CA 90802

 
PARKING
Parking is available at the Aquarium/Queensway Bay Parking Garage located at:

99 Aquarium Way
Long Beach, CA 90802

The parking structure is conveniently located across from the Aquarium of the Pacific and within walking distance of the race venue.

For current parking rates and additional parking information, visit:
ParkLB Waterfront Parking Information

 
COURSE
A beautiful paved course with ocean views! Flat, fast, and wide enough for strollers, walkers, and dogs on leashes (please stay to the right).

 
EVERY PARTICIPANT RECEIVES
The BEST EVER custom-designed Pirate-themed FINISHER MEDAL
Pirate-themed event T-shirt
Custom race bib
Flat, fast course — CHIP TIMED by Itz About Time
Age division awards every 5-year age group (top 3 in each division up to 85+)
Dress pirate-themed or come in your running gear
Trophies for top 3 overall male/female finishers
Awards for top 3 BEST-DRESSED pirate-themed outfits
You won’t want to miss THE Pirate’s Party Race. GET MOTIVATED!
ARGH! Walk the plank, it’s a pirate invasion!

 
AWARDS
Top 3 Male/Female Overall Awards

“In It To Win It” age divisions (3 deep) for both the 5K and 10K:

1–10, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80–84, 85+

 
EARLY RACE PACKET PICK-UP
Sports Basement Long Beach
2100 N Bellflower Blvd
Long Beach, CA 90815

Friday, June 19, 2026
3:00 PM – 7:00 PM

 
RACE DAY SCHEDULE
7:00 AM – 8:00 AM: Registration OPEN. Shirts and bibs available for race-day pickup. Captain Jack LIVE entertainment
7:45 AM: Start for Pirate’s 1-Mile Race & Little Pirate’s Kid’s Dash
8:00 AM: Mass Start of 10K Run and 5K Run/Walk
9:00 AM: 5K Awards followed by 10K Awards
  
WHAT’S HAPPENING ON STAGE
7:00 AM – 8:00 AM
Jack Sparrow pirate demos, fencing, and crowd entertainment

7:30 AM
Jack Sparrow starts the Pirate’s 1-Mile Race & Little Pirate’s Kid’s Dash

7:30 AM – 8:00 AM
Pirate music and a high-energy pirate warm-up led by Jack Sparrow

7:55 AM
Mass crowd picture with banner & Caren Ware announcement about race proceeds and charitable impact

8:00 AM START | 9:00 AM AWARDS
Take selfies at the selfie booth and with Jack Sparrow, and remember to tag:
#carenwareevents

 
Caren Ware adopted a village in Nepal near Everest Base Camp while running the Everest Marathon at 18,000 feet. Proceeds from the races benefit many of the needs she encountered while running remote marathons on every continent.

Be sure to check out the newly released book FINDING FIT! Signed copies will be available for purchase at the race.

 
FAQ
Pets
Not an easy course for pets.

Strollers
Families may bring strollers but do so at their own risk. Please stay to the right.

Important Notes
Only registered participants wearing a visible race bib will receive a finisher medal.
This course is shared with the public. Please be aware of cyclists, walkers, and other runners using the path.
Race takes place rain, shine, or shipwreck!
Ahoy mateys, let’s run!

name: SoCal's Sunset Trick or Trot 5k/10K - Halloween Race
description:
🎃 SoCal’s Sunset Trick or Trot 5K/10K

📅 Saturday, October 24th, 2026 | 🕔 5:00 PM (NOTE TIME. INTO the SUNSET
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25
🌅 Featuring a TRUNK-or-TREAT EXPO that begins at 3pm

 
🕯️ A Spooky New Twist on a Fall Favorite!
Formerly known as the FIT FALL Halloween Harvest 5K/10K, our traditional morning run is now even more magical as an evening event! 🌙

Get ready to run (or trot!) into the sunset with beach views, Halloween fun, and festive activities for the whole family. Introducing the SoCal’s Sunset Trick or Trot 5K/10K—a coastal celebration where fitness meets fall!

 
🎉 What to Expect:
👟 5K & 10K Sunset Run
🎃 Trunk-or-Treat Expo
📸 Selfie Stations, Games & Giveaways
🏅 Custom Reversible Finisher Medal
👕 Fall-Themed Event Shirt
🧛 Costume Contests & Awards
🧃 Street Tacos, Aguas Frescas, Specialty Coffee, Cookies & More!
 
🕒 Race Day Schedule:
2:00 PM – Trunk-or-Treat Car Setup
3:00 PM – Registration & Packet Pickup Opens
4:30 PM – Kids Races Begin
5:00 PM – Mass Start for 5K & 10K
5:45 PM – 5K Awards Ceremony
6:00 PM – 10K Awards Ceremony

🎟️ All bibs, shirts, and trick-or-treat bags will be available starting at 3:00 PM at the Trunk-or-Treat Expo. No early day pickup.

 
🚗 Trunk-or-Treat Expo
Want to be part of the Halloween magic? Decorate your trunk and hand out goodies!

Trunkers will receive 1 free race entry for a Caren Ware Event Race!

Questions? Email carenfasttrack@aol.com cc: info@kourseevents.com

 
🏁 Registration Includes:
RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time
Fall-Themed Custom Shirt
Unique Reversible Finisher Medal
Trick-or-Treat Bag
Entry into Costume & Team Contests
Eligibility for Age Group & Overall Awards
 
🏆 Awards & Divisions:
Top 3 in each 5-year age division (ages 1–80+)
Top 3 Overall Male & Female Finishers
Best Halloween Costume
Best Uniform-Themed Costume

Awards for Oldest & Youngest Finishers
 
🐾 Pet & Stroller Friendly
Leashed pets welcome (max 5 ft leash)
Strollers allowed — please start near the back
🔖 Only registered participants with a bib receive medals.
 
🌊 The Course:
Flat, fast, paved, and scenic
Ocean views all the way!
Start/Finish in Lot 25 – Bolsa Chica State Beach


🚘 Parking Options:

Park in Sunset Beach and walk in
OR enter via Bolsa Chica State Beach Main Gate ($15 Entrance Fee)
 
🧡 Part of the Winter Series!
Complete 3 of the following Caren Ware Events to earn a 4th medal—FREE!

Sunset Trick or Trot
Thanksgiving Day Races
Santa Claus with a Cause
Run in the New Year
Because we LOVE FITTING it all together! 🎖️

 
🌧️ Rain or Shine – We Run!
Ready to trot into fall?
Register today and bring your spooky spirit, running shoes, and Halloween flair!

name: SoCal's Tiki Beach 5K & 10K Run/Walk
description:
🌺 Welcome to SO CAL's BIGGEST & BEST POLYNESIAN PARTY RACE! 🌺

Since 2014,  Tiki Beach 5K/10K has been a vibrant tradition on the beach, a chance to run, celebrate, and enjoy island-inspired music, food, and community. It's your end of the summer BEACH PARTY RUN!

🏖️ Experience the energy of the beach with live Polynesian drummers and dancers, bringing authentic rhythm and movement to your run. This isn’t just a race, t’s a festive send-off to summer! Coconuts, palm trees, grass skirts, and the TAPUA PRODUCTION drummers and dancers make this the BEST BEACH BASH, healthy RUNNER's Party!

🎽 Every participant receives a custom Polynesian-style race shirt and one of our signature Tiki finisher medals, a collectible highlight for your race journey. Have enough shirts?  Choose a custom beach towel while supplies last, or add to your collection by getting BOTH for only an additional $20.

🍍 Post-Race Fun: Enjoy coconut and Island inspired pancakes offered by IVC Circle K and Kiwanis of Irvine, specialty coffee, tasty street tacos , Bar b que sandwiches, fresh baked cookies, Hawaiian shaved ice, and Nekter Juice (available for purchase. You make pay with cash, credit card, or pre buy food vouchers) while you explore the expo area and capture those perfect beachside selfies. It's a FOOD FEAST while watching authentic Polynesian drummers and dancers. Support the causes.  KID'S READ will be giving out free books for those that purchase Kiwanis pancakes.  BIG J's So Cal Bar B Que will be offering mini sliders, or full bar b que lunches to eat, take home, or remain at the beach for a picnic!

 
Course:

Flat, scenic, out-and-back along the paved beach path with ocean views. Run fast or take it easy, the waves will be your soundtrack.
Timing: RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time

Awards:

Top 3 male & female overall (5K & 10K)
Age group awards in 5-year divisions (up to 80+)
Special recognition for those completing 3+ Caren Ware Events this year
 
Schedule
6:30 AM – Vendor & Volunteer Check-in
7:00–8:30 AM – Registration & Packet Pick-Up (race-day available)

7:30 -8:30 Am LIVE POLYNESIAN dancers and drummers/ Tupua Productions/ An active EXPO

8:15 AM – Kid’s Dash & 1-Mile Fun Run
8:30 AM – 10K & 5K Start
9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony
9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony
6:30–10:00 AM – Polynesian-Inspired Expo Open
 
Early Packet Pick-Up
Saturday, Sept. 26 10am to 1PM  (Note: Earlier so we have afternoon time to set up the race) 
Sports Basement, 10800 Kalama River Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
(You may also pick up race morning at the start line.)
 
Parking
Bolsa Chica State Beach, Lot 25 — $15 State Park fee (bring exact cash for faster processing)
Public parking available in Sunset Beach (walking required into park)
 

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 
🌊 Whether you’re racing for a PR or jogging with friends, Tiki Beach is your lively, healthy way to wrap up the summer. Come for the run, stay for the rhythm, community, and celebration.

💙 A portion of proceeds supports Caren Ware Events’ global outreach projects, including families in the Himalayas and local community programs.

name: SPACEROCK Trail Race
description:
OUT-OF-THIS-WORLD TRAIL RUNNING


SPACEROCK: the final trail running frontier.
These are the voyages of trail runners around the world.
Your mission: to explore strange new trails, to seek out new life and new experiences, to boldly run where no one has run before.


Experience the exotic trails and sights of the world-famous Vasquez Rocks Natural Park in Southern California. Known as the backdrop from popular TV shows and movies including Star Trek, The Flintstones, Battlestar Galactica, Planet of the Apes, and many of our favorite classic westerns films. Now get a spectacular experience running the trails at the SPACEROCK Trail Race!

Learn more at and register at: SPACEROCKTrailRace.com

name: Splash Dash 5k (& Dry Run 5k) at Wild Rivers in Irvine
description:
The WILD RIVERS SPLASH DASH 5K 
SUNDAY, AUGUST 23, 2026 plus a kid's DUCKY DASH

 

A 'cool' Run.  Chose SPLASH DASH 5k (if you want to get to plunge through the wild river before the finish line.) Or run the DRY RUN 5k (if preference is to not get wet)

It's your 'coolest' summer run/walk running race. With the coolest race BLING!  Choice of a custom event BEACH TOWEL or a custom event t-shirt, and a huge custom FINISHER MEDAL for all participants. 

Plus the chance to win Awesome Age divisions medal awards. 

A SUPER FUN event.  Make it competitive, or choose to cruise it and have great fun! The last 600 yards of the SPLASH DASH you get to 'DASH' through the lazy river in 2 1/2 feet of water, going with the current!

name: Spooky Shuffle – 5k, 10k, Half Marathon
description:
It's Halloween! Let's celebrate together, dress up in costume, and eat candy!

Race Details
Location: Woodley Park, 6076 Woodley Ave, Encino, CA
Parking: Free parking in the lot; more is available on Woodley Ave


Event Schedule
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Courses
5k route: Runners do one loop – route here
10k route: Runners do two loops - route here
Half Marathon: Runners do two loops plus the 10k route – route here

More about the Course
The race routes go across the grass, under the road through a tunnel, and enter the park. The 5k loops the lake and returns. The 10k and half head to the other side of the park, going under the bridge, and then journey back along a different path.

Our courses are on open paths so please be considerate of other park users!

On-Course Support
Multiple water stations are located along the routes. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and other snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk and runner turn signs

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

name: Stars and Stripes 5K
description:
Come for the run and stay for the parade!

The Concord Police Association is once again bringing the Stars and Stripes 5K to celebrate Independence Day as part of the Concord July 4 festivities.

The race will include special medals for all finishers, custom age group medals for 5-year age group divisions, and more.  This event will also include a free run for kids 10 and under.

A portion of race proceeds will benefit Ainsley's Angels and their mission to provide race chairs to disabled persons, making them able to participate and engage with their communities at events like this.

name: Stars, Stripes & Strides 5K
description:
Ignite your Independence Day spirit with On Track Running, Simi Valley’s neighborhood running shoes & lifestyle store, for our second annual Stars, Stripes, and Strides 5k! On Track Running and PUMA are teaming up to bring our community a festive run followed by fun for everyone!

Come join a pre-race shakeout with On Track and PUMA the day before the race! Get the chance to demo NEW PUMA shoes on our flat and fast 5k course. Followed by a BBQ, this is a star-spangled get together you don't want to miss!

The race will held on July 4th, starting at 8:00 am at 4590 Ish Drive in Simi Valley, with a complimentary pancake breakfast to refuel you afterwards.

FREE race shirts and medals for the first 200 registered participants and age group awards for finishers.

Our top male, female, and senior finishers will be rewarded with FREE PUMA shoes! In addition, 2 lucky registrants will win a pair of raffled PUMA shoes!

 

On site registration will be available at packet pickup on Friday, July 3, at On Track, from 1-5 pm. Additionally, you can register race day morning, on site, from 6:30-7:15 am.

 

On Track is excited to sponsor Simi Valley’s premier 4th of July 5k race, and hope you’ll join us for a morning filled with family fun!

Be sure to follow us on Instagram @OTRunning and on Strava as well. Can’t wait to see you all there!

name: STEM Girls RUN the World
description:
Exciting updates about our 2026 event COMING SOON! Registration opens September 30, 2026.

STEM Girls Run the World is Project Scientist’s annual virtual fundraising event. Participants from across the continental U.S. can run or walk 5K anytime between October 1 and November 8 (National STEM Day). Every dollar raised fuels our mission to provide high-quality, hands-on STEAM education to girls nationwide—at no cost to families. Sign-up as an individual or join one of our Corporate teams! 

What will you receive as a participant?

Individuals – $35 

Digital bib, Access to special prize opportunities, & Running and wellness SWAG

Corporate Team Members – $45 

Digital bibs, Running and wellness SWAG, Access to special prize opportunities, & Recruitment materials to help grow your team including a co-branded registration page and dedicated recognition on Project Scientists’s social media and website.

Want to start a corporate team? Fill out our interest form and a member of our team will be in touch to help you get set up.

Why Support STEM Girls Run the World?

  • Support Girls’ Dreams: Help fund cutting-edge STEAM education programs that inspire young girls to reach their full potential.
  • Bridge the Gender Gap in STEM: Your participation empowers the next generation of innovators and changemakers.
  • Feel Good While Doing Good: Join a nationwide community working toward equity in STEM—while having fun and staying active.
  • Win Special Prizes: All participants will be eligible to win prizes for best run and walk times and highest number of referrals categories.

name: Step Up for Moms: Carry the Light Global Relay
description:
Welcome to the Carry the Light Global Virtual Relay!

Created by the AFE Foundation, this event unites participants worldwide to raise awareness of Amniotic Fluid Embolism (AFE), connect through movement and storytelling, and help fund research and education that advance our mission and support the AFE community.

 

Follow these simple steps to join:
1. Register for yourself or start a team and invite others to join in the fun.
2. Set up a personal or team fundraiser
3. Pass the baton

Registration Costs:
$40 Adult 
$20 Child

name: Steps4SMILEs 5k/10k Charity Race
description:
VISIT "Event Info" FOR INFORMATION ON BASIC vs. DELUXE PACKAGES!!!

Join us at 9:00 AM on Saturday, August 22nd, 2026 for this 4th annual 5K/10K race! All proceeds benefit Second Harvest!!! There will be amazing music, raffles, awards, SMILES, and maybe even your favorite running influencers....

Race Day Logistics
The start line and finish line will be located inside Baylands, with more details to be emailed closer to the event (999 E Caribbean Dr, Sunnyvale, CA 94089). Please arrive around 8:30 am for check-in. We recommend you arrive earlier than that to be able to park somewhere as there is one entrance to the park that may get congested closer to race time. Please keep in mind it costs 6$ to park inside of the park. When you arrive, you will have some time to visit our sponsors' and partners' booths.  Roughly 15 min later, we will start the 5K and 10K as well. After you complete your race, if you purchased a deluxe deal, you can pick up your medal and your swag bag. Confirmation of these details will be sent out the night before race day. 

 

 

SMILE is a group of high school student-athletes looking to use their love of running to put a smile on as many faces as possible. Standing for, Supporting Malnourished Individuals Looking for Equity, we believe that by bringing a community together, there is no issue that can’t be solved. We strive to gather our community for our charitable 5k/10k race and raise money for one of the most prevalent problems in society today: hunger and food insecurity. By providing racers with the chance to set new personal records, or just enjoy a morning run with friends and family, and raising money to support less fortunate people in the process, we hope our event leaves everyone with a big smile. 

SPECIAL DEALS: 

If you are a family of 3 or more, each registrant can get a $5 discount on any package.

If you are a team of 10 or more, each registrant can get a $10 discount on any package.

If you are able to start a Fundraiser and raise more than $100, then your registration fee will be waived! 

If you make 5 referrals, you are eligible for a $20 registration refund!

Note: Unfortunately, as a charity organization, we are currently unable to waive the RunSignup fee. Sorry for the inconvenience.

name: Stride for Hope: Breast Cancer Awareness Walk & Wellness Event
description:
Join us for the 2026 Breast Cancer Awareness Walk—a powerful community event bringing Kings County together in support, remembrance, and hope. Walk alongside survivors, honor loved ones, and stand with families impacted by breast cancer.

Enjoy a morning filled with inspiration, community connection, speakers, and local vendors—all united for a meaningful cause.

Together, we walk stronger. 💗

name: Strides in Recovery Beach Fun Run
description:
Join us in supporting sobriety one stride at a time. Enjoy a four mile one-way run/walk, mostly along the beach bike path, from Valley Park in Hermosa Beach to an AA meeting (starting at 10am) in the sand in Redondo Beach. No medals. No chip timing. No swag. And no fees! 

This free community-building event is hosted by Strides in Recovery. We are a local nonprofit which helps newly sober individuals grow physically, emotionally and mentally stronger so they can do their best at the hard work of recovery. We achieve these results by coaching people in Los Angeles County addiction treatment programs to complete events ranging from 5Ks to full marathons.

name: Strollin' for the Colon
description:
Hope & Healing: Ureña Family Colon Cancer Awareness 5K Run & Walk.

Join us in a powerful journey of hope, resilience, and community support as we raise awareness for colorectal cancer and honor the incredible strength of the Ureña family.

This race is more than just a run – it's a testament to survival, love, and the ongoing fight against colorectal cancer. Our event celebrates two remarkable stories of courage: Joel Ureña: A stage 3b Colorectal Cancer survivor who has been in remission since 2026 and Karina Ureña, his daughter, currently battling Stage IV Colorectal Cancer.

By participating, you're not just running or walking – you're standing in solidarity with those fighting this challenging disease, raising critical awareness, and supporting ongoing research and treatment.

Together, we can make a difference. Together, we can spread hope.

name: Stronger Families Safer Kids 5K
description:
Welcome to our 8th annual Stronger Families Safer Kids 5K Run/Walk

As the Designated Child Abuse Prevention Council of Ventura County, our 5K promotes our mission of creating safe, healthy peaceful families.

The Partnership is a collaborative non-profit organization with over 20 years of experience providing interagency coordination, networking, advocacy, public awareness & education to prevent child abuse, neglect, and family violence across the lifespan. We believe in strengthening families through early care and education.

Thank you for participating in such a great event that tremendously helps build stronger communities and helps prevent child abuse. See you there!

name: Sugar Daddy Race
description:
WELCOME TO THE SUGAR DADDY RACE!

Celebrate Father's Day by kicking off the weekend with an awesome race taking you on a scenic tour through the beautiful Santa Clarita Valley in a Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, or Kids race.

Get your PR on our fast, almost flat course on paved paseo trails. Created to bring runners together for a great race experience as you finish across the historic Iron Horse bridge into the finish line to earn our epic Sugar Daddy Race bling, plus receive yummy Ben & Jerry's ice cream to help cool you down from your awesome run! 

Learn more below or register today to secure your spot at the start line!

FAST COURSE
Runners get to enjoy the best of Santa Clarita's awesome paths and paseos taking runners on a spectacular tour around the Santa Clarita Valley on a very fast course. 
 
HISTORIC BRIDGE
All runners get to make the final push into finish line to run across the historic 120-year old Iron Horse bridge, making for a landmark race finish.
 
FAMILY FUN
The Sugar Daddy Race is for everyone, runners, walkers, hikers, there is even a Kids Fun Run for the little ones to get active and healthy to experience a race.
 
SWEET FINISH
In addition to earning an awesome medal, Sugar Daddy finishers will get a special ice cream treat to help cool them off after finishing the race.

Learn more at >> SugarDaddyRace.com

name: Summer Breeze
description:
What makes this such a popular race? Is it the refreshing cool breezes?  The flat course?  The race shirt?  The finisher medal? The custom age group medals?  It's probably the incredible Brazen running community...and the 'It's It' ice cream sandwiches at the finish!


Find out for yourself at our 16th Annual Summer Breeze races.Everybody will enjoy a flat, easy bayside trail that rarely strays more than a few feet from water.  Perfect for setting a personal record or a nice cruise along the bay.

Hikers/walkers are always welcome!

name: Summer Luau Run 5K & 10k
description:
Join us for the Summer Luau Run 5K & 10K (July 11,2026) a vibrant summer celebration of fitness, community and good vibes! Set against a beautiful outdoor course, this event blends the energy of race day with a relaxed luau-inspired atmosphere perfect for runners, joggers, walkers, and families of all ages. 

Participants will enjoy a scenic run, upbeat music, festive summer touches, and a welcoming environment that celebrates movement and togetherness.

Whether you're chasing a PR, enjoying a fun run with friends, or soaking up the summer energy, the Summer Luau Run is all about running strong, feeling good, and celebrating miles. 

Come run, walk, or jog your way into summer - we can't wait to celebrate with you !

🌺 Tropical attire encouraged! Break out your florals, leis, and island vibes.

🌺 Best-dressed runners may be featured on social media! 

 

What is included with registration

🌺 Every finisher will receive a custom Summer Luau Run finisher medal

🌺Exclusive Summer Luau Run race shirt. (T-shirts are guaranteed for participants registered by June 20, 2026. Sizes are first-come, first-served after that date.)

🌺Race Bib

🌺Chip timed race

🌺Post Race Refreshments

🌺Age Group Awards 

🌺Free finisher pictures

 

Race Day Schedule: 

  • 6:30–7:45 am Check-in & Packet Pickup
  • 7:45am  - 10k start
  • 8:00am  5K start
  • 9:00 am award ceremony 

Course Information

  • The 5K course will be around the golf course (all flat course) look at the picture below. The 10K courses will be around the golf course + further out and back. 

Parking and Arrival Info

  • Free parking is available within Griffith Park. Participants are encouraged to arrive early to allow time for parking, check-in, and warm-up.

 

📣 Social & Updates

  • Follow us on social media for updates, announcements, and sneak peeks of the medal and shirt design.
  • 📷 Instagram: @pinklacesraces

name: Summer Series - Race #8
description:
The Summer Series is where it all started and to this  day continues to be the staple of the Quick n’ Dirty vibe. You can expect a fun, fast, and challenging series of races that keeps you tuned up, doesn’t break your wallet, and in most cases, gets you home in time for dinner. However, we will have food vendors on site if you want to kick back, relax, and grab a bite to eat at the race.

Race Day Schedule:

  • Check-in opens at 4:00pm
  • Kids race starts at 5:00pm
  • Race starts at 6:00pm

WHERE:

  • Lake Hodges Boat Ramp: 20175 Lake Drive, Escondido, CA GOOGLE MAPS
  • This address takes you to the gate of the parking lot. Proceed through the gate and follow the road to the boat ramp parking lot

SERIES INFORMATION:

  • The series will consist of 8 races
  • There will be two throw outs. Meaning you must race 6 of the 8 races in order to be qualify for the Series Overall awards. With that, only your top 6 races will be counted.

name: Summer Solstice Run : 5K.10K. Half Marathon –by Califlow Runs
description:
🌞 SUMMER SOLSTICE  RUN: 5K. 10K. Half Marathon – LONG BEACH 🌊✨


“Run the Longest Day, Shine the Brightest Way!”

Celebrate the longest day of the year with an electrifying glow run along the scenic Long Beach coastline! As the sun rises, the party begins—race under the golden hues of sunrise. Whether you’re running the 5K.10K or half marathon, this is your chance to embrace the solstice spirit with a vibrant community of runners.

💛 Race Location: 5400 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach, CA 90803

 
📍 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
📅 Race Day Check-In
🕕 6:00 AM - | Location: Race Ready Athletics Tent near the start line

🏁 Race Start
🕡 7:00 AM Half Marathon

🕡   5K & 10K - 8:00 AM

 
🚗 Parking Information
✅ Street Parking: Free 
✅ Beach Lot: $2.00 per hour

 
🏆 Awards & Recognition


Cross the finish line and glow with pride! All finishers receive a medal
🥇 The Top 3 male & female finishers in each distance will receive special medals to commemorate their glowing achievement.

 
🔥 Why Join the Summer Solstice Run?
🌅 Scenic Course: Run along the stunning Long Beach coastline, soaking in ocean views, palm trees, and sunset vibes.

🎉Professional Chip Timing, Finisher medals for all, overall and age group awards.

🎶 Post-Race Celebration: The party doesn’t stop at the finish line! Dance under the summer night sky with music, refreshments, and fun photo ops.

☀️ Embrace the Solstice Spirit: This isn’t just a run—it’s a celebration of light, life, and the joy of movement!

 
🔥 Get ready to vibe, and celebrate the arrival of summer! 🔥

 

🌴 LET THE SUMMER BEGIN! 🌞✨
