name: SuperHero - Runbelievable - 5K. 10K. Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🦸‍♀️ Runbelievable – Superhero Run
5K • 10K • Half Marathon • 1 Miler • Kids Dash

📅 Saturday, June 6, 2027
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach 90803

Caped crusaders, everyday heroes, and speedsters — it’s your time to show up and show out. 💥
Throw on your cape, bring the energy, and hit the Long Beach shoreline for a morning packed with movement, community, and straight-up superhero vibes.

 

 🏁 Race Day Schedule
• 6:00 AM – Same Day Registration & Runner Check-In Opens
• 7:00 AM – Half Marathon Start
• 8:00 AM – 5K & 10K Start
• 9:00 AM – 1 Miler Start
• 9:30 AM – Kids Dash

 
✨ What to Expect
🦸‍♂️ Wear a Cape! Costumes HIGHLY encouraged
🏅 Finisher Medals for ALL participants
🎖️ Special Kids Medal for Kids Dash finishers
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards
📸 Free Race Day Photos
⏱️ Professional Chip Timing
🚰 3 On-Course Water Stations
👟 Beginner & Walker Friendly
🌊 Flat, Fast, Scenic Beach Path Course
🎶 Finish Line Festival Vibes

 
🎉 Bonus Fun
🎭 Costume Contest – Best Dressed Superheroes
🎟️ Raffles + Giveaways at the Finish Line

 
This isn’t just a race… it’s your origin story.
Show up. Suit up. Let’s run it. 🦸‍♀️💥

name: Support Blue Fresno
description:
Run. Walk. Support.

Join us for our annual Support Blue Run — a powerful community event uniting the Central Valley in visible support of the men and women in law enforcement.

When you participate, you’re doing more than running a race. You’re investing in the mission of the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy — committed to being First to Serve, providing spiritual and emotional support to first responders and the community during crisis, tragedy, and critical incidents.

Why Support Blue Matters

The Support Blue campaign exists to:
🤝 Strengthen trust and connection between law enforcement and the community
💙 Provide a meaningful way for families, businesses, and individuals to visibly show their support
👮‍♂️ Create positive engagement opportunities between the community and officers
🙏 Fund the programs and resources that allow the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy to respond when the call comes

Every registration helps ensure chaplains can show up at hospitals, death notifications, critical incidents, and community crises throughout the year.

Event Details

🏃 10K Run    🏃 5K Run    🚶 2-Mile Walk
Whether you're a competitive runner, walking with family, or representing your department or business, there is a place for you at the start line.

More Than a Race

Support Blue Run is a celebration of community:

  • First responder displays
  • Family-friendly atmosphere
  • Vendor booths
  • Finisher medals
  • Coffee, donuts, and connection

It’s a day where Fresno stands together.

Be Part of Something Bigger

When you run Support Blue, you help the Chaplaincy continue to be present in the hardest moments — supporting officers, firefighters, victims, and families across our Valley.

We invite you to lace up, show up, and stand with those who serve.

name: SURF CITY RUN
description:
Join us for the Huntington Beach Surf City Run 5K!


The Surf City Run 5K in Huntington Beach takes place along the historic route of Main Street and Pacific Coast Highway.  Come out and enjoy an 'All-American' start to this terrific Holiday by running along our parade route and seeing the famous pier and beautiful Pacific Ocean before a gentle sloping return to Worthy Park for the finish.

description: Create your own coastal‑inspired masterpiece with a hands‑on surfboard art workshop. name: Swim the Bear
description:
Dive in to this incredible Open Water Swim Race on Big Bear Lake!

Join us as we bring a new discipline of endurance sports to Big Bear Lake. Swim the Bear is part of Big Bear’s Paddlefest. This year featuring both 1.2 and 2.4 mile races held back to back. The course starts on the sand at Swim Beach, head out to the tip of Eagle Point, and then returns for an exit onto the grass at Ski Beach Park. 2 Laps for the longer distance!  

Registration includes: Race SWAG, Finishers Medal, and Awards Eligibility

Cash Prize for Overall Male and Female winners.
Age Group Winners Awards - Junior (<18), Open, Masters (40+)
Average water temperature in August is 70 degrees.
Wetsuits are allowed but not eligible for awards.

name: Taco The Town 5K & 10K
description:
Welcome to the 5th Annual Taco The Town 5K & 10K! 🌮

Do you like tacos? We do too! We’ve wondered why all races don’t have tacos at the finish line… so we created a run just to put them there! Every finisher will receive THREE (3) FREE TACO from a truck of yours at the event. You can get them all at one truck or spread them out. The choice is yours!

I mean, does ANYONE NOT like tacos?

In addition to tacos, we are happy to mention that some of our local breweries will be present to give out beer samples to all of our finishers as well! Because we all know that tacos go great with a good beer. 🍺

Why?

Well to be honest, I feel like there aren’t enough 5Ks and 10Ks offered in our city. Most runners I know head to the bay or Sacramento to do those events… but that does nothing for OUR city. So introducing the Taco The Town 5K & 10K event! The only run/walk where there’s tacos at the finish line.  
I’ve partnered with Five Window Beer Co. and taco trucks like Don Rafas to bring you FREE TACOS AND BEER for anyone that completes their 5K or 10K!

This will be an in person event with a semi-closed course taking place in North Stockton. The event will also have timing chips built-in for those avid runners that wish to see their times.

Great, FUN, running event you were waiting for! 2ND ANNUAL MICHE 5K RUN & 2 MILE WALK!! Join us at this friendly and unique event where all 5K participants (21 and over) get a MICHELADA at the finish line! Good running event you don't want to miss this Summer!

WE HAVE ADDED A 2 MILE SPEED WALK! TOP 5 MALE/FEMALE GET AWARDS! 

 A few reasons to join our event:

  • Dri fit SHIRTS (MUST BE REGISTERED BY SUN, JUNE 15TH)
  • Unique finishing MEDAL
  • MICHE BEER MUG for ALL participants (Must register before SUN, JUNE 1ST)
  • Free TACOS for all participants
  • Mexican "AGUAS FRESCAS"
  • MICHELADA for all participants
  • Unique AGE GROUP AWARDS! 
  • EXTRA MEDAL for all participants (Reyes Running Series)
  • $200 CASH TO TEAM WITH MOST PARTICIPANTS.
  • Central Valley Runner of the Year Series event
  • LIVE BANDA MUSIC!! BANDA SINALOENSE Pura Cajeta!
  • Chipped timed event
  • ATHENA (women +185lbs) and CLYDESDALE (men +225lbs) age group awards 
  • Great running course
  • EXTRA MEDAL FOR THOSE DOING REYES RACING SERIES!
  • KIDS RACES (400m, 200m, 100m, 50m, 10m)
  • DJ/music, Fun dance competition...FUN!

 IF YOU REGISTERED BY JUNE 15TH, YOU WILL GET A GUARANTEED SHIRT! We'll have some extra shirts, but no guarantee you'll get one if you register after June 15th. 

NO AGE GROUPS AWARDS WILL BE MAILED! PLEASE COLLECT AGE GROUP AWARDS ON RACE DAY. 

BIB PICK UP:

Friday, June 26th-  4:30-6:30pm @ Fresno  Fleet Feet Store 

Race Day, Sat, June 27th- 5:45-6:45am @ Shinzen Group Activity Area

name: Take Me to Your Pizza : Alien Dash 5K. 10K. Half Marathon Sponsored by Domino's Pizza
description:
👽🍕 TAKE ME TO YOUR PIZZA
Alien Dash • 5K • 10K • Half Marathon

📅 Sunday, September 27
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

Run. Slice. Beam us up.

Celebrate National Pepperoni Pizza Day the CaliFlow way — with coastal miles, alien sightings, and a finish line that delivers exactly what you’re thinking about: pizza.

The Take Me to Your Pizza Alien Dash is a playful, out-of-this-world race experience where running meets ridiculous fun. Whether you’re chasing a PR, running for vibes, or just here for the post-race carbs, this is one event you knead on your calendar.

Expect ocean views, UFO-level energy, and a finish line party that’s equal parts weird, welcoming, and wildly fun.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule

Same Day Registration
Bib Pick-Up & Runner Check-In
🕕 6:00 AM

Start Times
🛸 Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
🍕 5K & 10K: 8:00 AM
👽  Family 1-Miler: 9:00 AM

👽 Kids Dash: 9:30 AM

 
🏃‍♀️ Race Options
Half Marathon — 13.1 miles of pepperoni-powered glory
10K & 5K — saucy distances with coastal views
Kids Dash & Family 1-Miler — fun for the whole galaxy
 
🌊 Why You’ll Love This Run
✅ Flat, fast, scenic beach path
✅ Beginner- and walker-friendly
✅ Strollers welcome
✅ Dogs on leash welcome 🐾
✅ Professional chip timing with accurate results
✅ Overall & age group awards
✅ Free race-day photos
✅ Finisher medals for all distances (yes, pizza-themed)
✅ Finish line festival vibes with music and fun

 
🍕 Finish Line Fuel
You earned it.

Celebrate with a post-race pizza party featuring hot cheese and pepperoni slices at the finish line — because carbs hit different after miles.

Bonus points for:
🎭 Alien + Pizza Costume Contest
👽 UFO sightings along the course
📸 Photo ops that are truly out of this world

 
💛 Why CaliFlow Runs
We believe running should be fun, inclusive, and a little weird (in the best way). Our races welcome every pace, every story, and every reason you show up — whether that’s fitness, community, or pizza.

Fast or fun.
Serious or silly.
Earthling or alien.

Take Me to Your Pizza is your invitation to run happy, laugh loud, and refuel properly.

name: Teal Steps Ovarian Cancer Walk
description:
Join us for the 11th annual Teal Steps Walk to benefit the Ovarian Cancer Alliance of San Diego.

Enjoy the 2-mile walk/stroll, out-and-back along Coronado’s bayfront and view the stunning San Diego’s skyline, passing ships, and much more.

After the walk, enjoy refreshments, entertainment, raffle and vendor booths.

Registered participants each receive an event T-shirt featuring a new design for 2026 and a raffle ticket.

Virtual option available for those that can't attend the Walk in person. 

Add your 4-legged friend to your registration and you'll receive a special bandana that your doggie can sport at the walk. 

 

Become a Team Captain and Form your Team!

Team captains are key to the success of our event. Captains recruit participants, communicate with team members and distribute materials including walk bib numbers and shirts to their team members.

 

Team Incentives

  • Teams with 20+ registered members by 9/4/26 will have their team name printed on the back of their shirts!
  • Teams with 50+ registered members by 9/4/26 will get their team name on their shirts PLUS the use of a 10’ x 10’ pop-up, 8' table and two chairs as a meeting area on walk-day!
  • Teams of any size are encouraged to create a theme and show their spirit at the event! Get creative with matching socks, tutus, hats, sashes, signs, etc.  Now go get creative!

 

Post-Walk Raffle

Each walker will be given one complimentary raffle ticket with their event materials and additional tickets will be available for purchase during the event for $1 each or an arm’s length for $10. All tickets must be turned in at the Ovarian Cancer Alliance Raffle booth to be eligible for the raffle. The raffle winners will be announced beginning at 9:10 a.m. from the main stage and all winners must be present to win.

 

Why We Walk

We walk to raise much-needed funds to support the community outreach programs of the Ovarian Cancer Alliance of San Diego. These outreach programs are aimed at raising awareness of ovarian cancer, the most lethal gynecologic cancer. Currently, there is no screening test for the early detection of ovarian cancer, and the overall 5-year survival rate is only 45%. However, when detected early, the survival rate is over 90%! Funds raised at this event will be used to support education and outreach to the general public, civic groups, organizations and medical healthcare providers throughout San Diego County.  In addition to supporting our primary educational outreach program HEAR , we are continuing our successful program to provide financial support to Medical Fellows at UCSD School of Medicine with an emphasis on gynecological oncology.

These outreach programs are aimed at raising awareness of ovarian cancer, the most lethal gynecologic cancer. Currently, there is no screening test for the early detection of ovarian cancer, and the overall 5-year survival rate is only 45%. However, when detected early, the survival rate is over 90%! Funds raised at this event will be used to support education and outreach to the general public, civic groups, organizations and medical healthcare providers throughout San Diego County.  In addition to supporting our primary educational outreach program HEAR , we are continuing our successful program to provide financial support to Medical Fellows at UCSD School of Medicine with an emphasis on gynecological oncology.

name: Teal Steps Ovarian Cancer Walk
description:
Join us for the 11th annual Teal Steps Walk to benefit the Ovarian Cancer Alliance of San Diego.

Enjoy the 2-mile walk/stroll, out-and-back along Coronado’s bayfront and view the stunning San Diego’s skyline, passing ships, and much more.

After the walk, enjoy refreshments, entertainment, raffle and vendor booths.

Registered participants each receive an event T-shirt featuring a new design for 2026 and a raffle ticket.

Virtual option available for those that can't attend the Walk in person. 

Add your 4-legged friend to your registration and you'll receive a special bandana that your doggie can sport at the walk. 

 

Become a Team Captain and Form your Team!

Team captains are key to the success of our event. Captains recruit participants, communicate with team members and distribute materials including walk bib numbers and shirts to their team members.

 

Team Incentives

  • Teams with 20+ registered members by 9/4/26 will have their team name printed on the back of their shirts!
  • Teams with 50+ registered members by 9/4/26 will get their team name on their shirts PLUS the use of a 10’ x 10’ pop-up, 8' table and two chairs as a meeting area on walk-day!
  • Teams of any size are encouraged to create a theme and show their spirit at the event! Get creative with matching socks, tutus, hats, sashes, signs, etc.  Now go get creative!

 

Post-Walk Raffle

Each walker will be given one complimentary raffle ticket with their event materials and additional tickets will be available for purchase during the event for $1 each or an arm’s length for $10. All tickets must be turned in at the Ovarian Cancer Alliance Raffle booth to be eligible for the raffle. The raffle winners will be announced beginning at 9:10 a.m. from the main stage and all winners must be present to win.

name: Temecula Turkey Trot & Food Drive 2025
description:

It's that time again...Let's get our HUFFING & PUFFING on before we get our stuffing on!

name: Thanksgiving Gobble Trot Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Get Ready to Wobble Before You Gobble! 🦃

Join us for the annual Thanksgiving Gobble Trot! Before you dive into the turkey and stuffing, enjoy the holiday with your family, friends, and fellow runners. 🏃‍♂️💨

It’s the perfect way to burn calories and make lasting memories to balance out the big feast, before and after!
Don’t wait—spots fill up faster than the Thanksgiving table! 🍽️✨

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

It’s the perfect way to burn calories and make lasting memories to balance out the big feast, before and after!
Don’t wait—spots fill up faster than the Thanksgiving table! 🍽️✨

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: The 41st Annual Newark Mile 4k (2026)
description:
CXC4L is proud to announce that we will be hosting the Newark Mile again in 2026. The race will take place along its traditional 2.5 mile (4km) course along the Newark Days parade route (see course map below for more detail). We are pleased to be hosting the 41st running of this local Newark favorite in partnership with the Newark Days Celebration!

After the race, stick around to enjoy the rest of the Newark Days such as carnival rides, parade, live entertainment, food festival, beer & wine pavilion, car show, and an arts & crafts fair.

name: The Aloha Run
description:
Join us for a morning full of tropical vibes, fitness, and fun at the Aloha Run!

Whether you're a seasoned runner or just looking to enjoy a brisk walk with family and friends, the Aloha Run is the perfect way to welcome fall with a splash of island spirit. Don your best Hawaiian shirts, leis, or grass skirts and head to the scenic Old Town Clovis Trail for a run/walk event you won't forget!

Registration Includes:

  • Custom Aloha Run T-shirt

  • Finisher medal

  • Awards for top finishers in the competitive category

  • Entry into our post-run raffle

  • Tropical treats and refreshments at the finish line!

Why Join Us?

  • Celebrate health, community, and Hawaiian spirit

  • Perfect for competitive runners and casual runners/walkers

All ages, all abilities, all welcome!

Ready to Run or Walk?
Register today – spots fill up fast!

Let the island breeze guide your stride. We’ll see you at the starting line—Aloha style!

name: The Auburn Mile
description:
Kick off Auburn's 4th of July Parade with a 1-Mile Community Run!

Before the parade rolls through the heart of Auburn, the streets open to runners and walkers of all ages for a festive, community-centered running and walking experience.

The Auburn Mile, presented by Auburn Running Company, begins in downtown Auburn and follows the full parade route, finishing back at the Downtown Square. It’s a true one-mile race, whether you’re chasing a personal best or simply showing up to celebrate the Fourth with movement.

This event is unique in that parade spectators will be supporting and encouraging you the whole way!  And, you'll be kicking off the parade with your feet!

And if you like to dress for the Fourth of July, this is your moment!

What to expect:

  • A one-mile course on closed parade streets
  • A supportive and encouraging course and crowd-lined route
  • Chip timing
  • Race shirt (for those registered on or before June 1, 2026)

name: The Dad Wave 5K
description:
Join us for the Dad Wave 5K & 3K Family Run — a powerful, community-centered event celebrating fatherhood, connection, and the strength it takes to show up every day.

Hosted at Aptos High School, this unique track-based event invites runners, walkers, families, and supporters of all ages to come together for a morning of movement, meaning, and community. Whether you're running the 5K, walking the family-friendly 3K, or cheering from the stands, you’re part of something bigger.

Fatherhood is filled with incredible highs, but it can also come with quiet challenges that often go unseen. Dad Wave 5K exists to remind every father that he doesn’t have to navigate those waves alone.

Proceeds from this event benefit The Circle Family Center and MENtors, supporting programs that provide education, connection, and mental health support for fathers and families in our community.

 

Why We Run...

To celebrate the dads who show up with love, strength, and presence
To create space for connection, community, and support
To raise awareness around the emotional journey of fatherhood

 

What to Expect...

A fun stadium atmosphere
Family-friendly activities and community vendors
Music, cheering, and a powerful finish line experience
A chance to be part of a growing movement of support for fathers
To support local programs that uplift families

 

Our Message...

No dad should face the waves of fatherhood alone.
Let’s show up, move together, and build a wave of support that reaches far beyond race day.

name: The Great American Race
description:
Celebrating 250 Years of America!

Join California Classic Events as we celebrate the 250th Anniversary of the United States of America at the 6th Annual Great American Race!

This isn't just another Fourth of July run; it's a once-in-a-generation celebration honoring America's Semiquincentennial, marking 250 years since the signing of the Declaration of Independence.

Gather your friends, family, and running crew and kick off Independence Day the Classic way with a patriotic 5K, 10K, Kids Race, and Costume Contest at Visalia's beautiful Riverway Sports Park.

Experience an American flag-lined course, festive race-day atmosphere, patriotic music, and a community united in celebration, movement, and freedom.

We are one when we run.

name: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival
description: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival includes four different runs during the first weekend in May annually. The weekend of running begins at the OC Fair and Event Center on Saturday morning with the award winning Hoag Kids Run the OC when nearly 9,000 kids from over 150 Orange County schools participate. The afternoon kicks off with the CELEBRATE OC Festival with local sports teams, craft brews and some of Orange County's iconic brands and live music all day. Later in the day on Saturday, the OC 5K takes place with a fun, flat tour of the OC Fairgrounds and nearby Orange Coast College followed by the Celebrate OC Finish Festival. Sunday morning begins early in Newport Beach. The exceptional OC Marathon & Half Marathon course is a blend of chic coastal scenery, tranquil nature and sophisticated arts and shopping which equal the best of OC. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and cruise down historic PCH through the seaside village of Corona del Mar. Run above pristine wetlands of Upper Newport, the Arts District and shopping mecca of South Coast Plaza in the "Heart of the OC" to the supportive cheers of residents in the many diverse neighborhoods and finish with a huge party at the Sunday Celebrate Finish Festival at the OC Fair and Event Center.

Run above pristine wetlands of Upper Newport, the Arts District and shopping mecca of South Coast Plaza in the "Heart of the OC" to the supportive cheers of residents in the many diverse neighborhoods and finish with a huge party at the Sunday Celebrate Finish Festival at the OC Fair and Event Center.

name: The Honey Badger Half (& 10K/5K)
description:
The Badger's race RETURNS to China Camp State Park in Santa Venetia, CA! If the LIVE option doesn't work for you, we're supporting VIRTUAL as well. We'll be happy to ship your swag and you can participate wherever you are! 

Where: China Camp State Park in Santa Venetia, CA.
When: Sun, 9/13- 9:15AM-1:00PM 
Course Maps: 5K Course Map, 10K Course Map, Half Marathon Course Map.

*NOTE-The half marathon is a STOUT challenge. We would NOT recommend the half marathon if you've never covered this distance before and/or you are not doing any kind of trail running currently.

The Swag:

All participants receive...

  • An epic, trail run at China Camp State Park (assuming you're not participating virtually)
  • An AWESOME race woodallion AND lifestyle tee
  • A custom Honey Badger beer sampler stein.
  • An awesome post race goodie bag & post race snacks/beverages including Jambar, Bellwether Farms Yogurt, and more!
  • Access to the post race BREWFEST sponsored by Standard Deviant Brewing.

Pre-Race Bib & Shirt Pickup:

-Sat, 9/12 from 12-4PM at A Runner's Mind SF (3575 Sacramento St).

A friend/family member can pickup your bib/shirt for you if they furnish proof of your registration. We will also support race morning bib pickup between 7:30-9AM at the race start/finish area.

PLEASE NOTE WE CANNOT SUPPORT REFUNDS, TRANSFERS, AND/OR CREDITS.

In the event of race cancellation due to wildfires, hazardous air quality, hazardous weather conditions, natural disasters, COVID and/or other global pandemics, or any 'act of God' (force majeure) that is beyond our control, we cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or credits. Please note this has only happened ONCE due to COVID in 2020, but anything is possible. Please make sure you are comfortable with these potential risks before you sign up. 

In the event of race cancellation due to any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result. 

We also cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or race credits if you get injured in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if your schedule changes in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if a work trip comes up that makes it impossible for you to attend on race day, and/or any other professional or personal matter that arises making it difficult for you to attend in person on race day.

In the event of any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to said participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result.

name: The Iron Office Health And Fitness Expo
description:
Welcome to The Iron Office Health and Fitness Expo at The Two Cities Marathon! This year's Expo will be held on Friday, October 30th, from 2:00PM to 6:00pm AND Saturday, October 31st, from 9AM-2PM at The Well Community Church(325 Nees Ave, Clovis, CA 93611)

The 2025 Iron Office Health and Fitness Expo will host thousands of health and fitness enthusiasts. Exhibitor booths are an inexpensive marketing method of getting your product and services to an active and fitness minded community.  All booths are 10' x 10' and complete with pipe and drape, which includes one 8' table with table cloth and 2 chairs.  Multiple booths are discounted and are available on a first come basis. We will try to accommodate you with the booth space you choose.

OUTSIDE BOOTHS DO NOT INCLUDE TABLES, CHAIRS, OR CANOPIES. VENDORS MUST PROVIDE THEIR OWN.



The Two Cities Marathon reserves the right to refuse a vendor a booth for any reason including for selling or promoting alcohol, tobacco or other drug or related paraphernalia.  All booth sales will be reviewed and if not approved will be refunded, less processing fee.

 

Vendor Schedule:

Friday 10/30 10AM-1PM- Vendor Load-In  

Friday 10/30 2PM-6PM Expo

Saturday 10/31 9AM-2PM Expo

Saturday 10/31 2PM-4PM Vendor Load-Out

name: The Jingle Bell Dash Kids Dash, 1 Miler, 5K, 10K and Half Marathon & Santa Paws Doggie Run
description:
The Jingle Bell Run – A Holiday Race by the Beach!
📍 5000 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach, CA 90803
📅 December 20, 2026
🏃 5K | 10K | Half Marathon|  Kids Dash| 

Get ready to dash into the holiday season with the Jingle Bell Dash! Set against the breathtaking backdrop of Granada Beach- Long Beach, this festive race brings holiday cheer, coastal vibes, and plenty of jingle bells to go around! Whether you're here to race, celebrate, or just enjoy the holiday magic, this event is guaranteed to fill your spirit with joy!

 
🎄 What’s Included?
✅ Festive Finisher Medal – A custom-designed holiday medal for all participants!
✅ Chip-Timed Event – Accurate timing for all runners.
✅ Age Division Awards – Celebrate your race-day victory!
✅ Top 3 Overall Male & Female Awards – For each race distance.

✅ Free Downloadable Race Photos

✅ Finish Line Festival with DJ

✅ Pictures with Santa Clause

 
🎅 More Than Just a Race – Holiday Fun for All!


🎭 Costume Contest – Show Off Your Holiday Spirit!
Dress up as Santa, an elf, a reindeer, or even the Grinch! The most creative and festive costumes will win special prizes!

🔔 Jingle Bell Dash Challenge!
Every runner will receive jingle bells for their shoes! The challenge? Be the jolliest runner on the course! The runner who jingles the loudest wins a prize!

📸 Santa’s Photo Booth & Holiday Fun Zone!
Snap a picture with Santa, enjoy festive treats, and soak in the holiday magic at our post-race Holiday Fun Zone!

🎶 Live DJ Playing Holiday Jams!
Stay after the race for a coastal holiday party with music, games, and fun for the whole family!

 
🎟 Same Day Registration & Packet Pick-Up


Registration/Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 
🏁  Half Marathon Start 7:00 AM
🏃‍♂️ 5K & 10K Start: 8:30 AM

 

🚨 Important: No late starts. Arrive early to ensure you’re ready to run!

 
🚗 Parking Information
✅ Street Parking is FREE - Beach Lot os $2.00 per hour

 
🎅 Weather & Safety
❄️ Rain or Shine Event!
☀️ Expect cool coastal breezes – perfect for a winter run!
🌀 In case of extreme weather (Santa getting stuck in the sandstorm, a gingerbread house collapse, or a rogue reindeer invasion), updates will be sent via email & social media.

 
🎁 Spread the Cheer!
📲 Tag us with #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured!
🎟 Tune in on Fridays for #FreeEntryFriday—answer fun questions to win a free race entry!

 
Don’t miss out on the most festive beachside run of the season! Sign up today and jingle all the way to the finish line! 🎅🏃‍♀️🎄

name: The Krampus Cross Country 5K, 10K, or Naughty Nine Miler (LIVE or VIRTUAL)!
description:
Hide. RUN! Krampus is KOMING!

You have not run far enough. Nor have you run fast enough. Krampus is displeased. Pay penance to Krampus on Sun, 12/6/26 in San Francisco (or virtually from 12/4/26-12/7/26) and avoid incurring the wrath of Krampus!

  • Where: Ecology Trail Head @ the end of Barnard Avenue, San Francisco, CA, 94129 (or ANYWHERE for Virtual)
  • When: Sunday, 12/6/26. The 10K starts at 8AM. The 5K starts at 8:05AM. The Naughty Nine Miler starts at 8:10AM.
  • Course Maps:  Naughty Nine Miler Course Map, 10K Course Map, & 5K Course Map

The Swag:

All participants (Live or Virtual) receive...

  • An AWESOME race woodallion from Aravaipa Artwork
  • A SWEET Krampus lifestyle tee
  • A Krampus beer sampler stein 
  • Pre-race  bib & shirt pickup and BREWFEST at A Runner's Mind (3575 Sacramento St) on Friday, 12/4 from 4-8PM!
  • Post run beverages (bubbly water & soft drinks) & pre-packaged snacks including Jambar and Bellwether Farms yogurt.

Pre-Race Bib & Shirt Pickup (& BREWFEST) at A Runner's Mind SF on Fri, 12/4 from 5-8PM!

All Krampus runners are cordially invited to a festive pre-race BREWFEST with brews from Standard Deviant Brewing and a bib/shirt pickup event at A Runner's Mind SF (3575 Sacramento St) on Fri, 12/4 between 5-8PM! 

*NOTE-If you cannot attend this event, you can claim your bib/shirt on race morning between 6:30-8AM.

PLEASE NOTE WE CANNOT SUPPORT REFUNDS, TRANSFERS, AND/OR CREDITS.

In the event of race cancellation due to wildfires, hazardous air quality, hazardous weather conditions, natural disasters, COVID and/or other global pandemics, or any 'act of God' that is beyond our control, we cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or credits. Please note this has only happened ONCE due to COVID in 2020, but anything is possible. Please make sure you are comfortable with these potential risks before you sign up. 

In the event of race cancellation due to any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result. 

We also cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or race credits if you get injured in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if your schedule changes in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if a work trip comes up that makes it impossible for you to attend on race day, and/or any other professional or personal matter that arises making it difficult for you to attend in person on race day.

In the event of any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to said participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result.

name: The Long Beach Halloween Run 5K. 10K. Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🎃 The Long Beach Halloween Run
5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash

📍 Start/Finish: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr., Long Beach, CA
📸 Iconic Backdrop: The legendary Queen Mary

Get ready for a hauntingly good run along the Long Beach shoreline.

The Long Beach Halloween Run brings spooky-season energy to one of the most iconic coastal courses in Southern California. As you race along the waterfront, the Queen Mary looms in the background — rich with history, mystery, and more than a few ghost stories of her own. 👻⚓️

Costumes are encouraged, vibes are high, and the miles are unforgettable. Whether you’re chasing a PR, running for fun, or just here to show off your costume, this is Halloween done the CaliFlow way.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
6:00 AM – Runner Check-In & Bib Pickup Opens
7:30 AM – Half Marathon Start
8:30 AM – 5K & 10K Start (All Ages Welcome)
9:15 AM – NEW! Kids Dash (200-yard dash for kids 10 & under) 🎃🧒

 
🕸️ Why You’ll Love This Race
✅ Iconic Course: Flat, fast waterfront miles at Alamitos Beach
✅ Professional Chip Timing: Accurate results for every runner
✅ Incredible Photo Ops: Queen Mary, harbor views & skyline
✅ Finish Line Festival: Music, energy, and CaliFlow vibes
✅ Free Race-Day Photos: Memories included
✅ Kids Dash Medals: Every little ghoul earns one
✅ Beginner-, walker-, stroller-, and dog-friendly 🐾

 
🧡 Run the Coast. Feel the Spirit.
CaliFlow Runs brings together community, creativity, and unforgettable race-day experiences. Whether you’re dressed spooky, silly, or somewhere in between, the Long Beach Halloween Run is a celebration of movement, fun, and a little October magic by the sea.

Come for the run.
Stay for the vibes.
Leave with candy, medals, and memories. 🎃

name: The Long Beach Leprechaun Run - Kids Dash, 1 Miler, 5k, 10K, & Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
Get ready to feel the luck of the Irish at Shamrocks by the Shore in beautiful Long Beach on Sunday, March 14th!

This is a Chip Timed Race

This festive St. Patrick’s Day run invites runners of all levels to a fun-filled 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon along the scenic waterfront.

Put on your best green gear and join the fun with Irish-themed cheer zones, a costume contest, and the chance to find golden coins hidden along the course for special prizes!

Celebrate your achievement at the finish line with a one-of-a-kind medal, festive refreshments, and photo ops with pots of gold and rainbows.

Bring the whole family—kids can join the Little Leprechaun Dash or explore the Shamrock Treasure Hunt for even more fun!

Don’t miss this lively celebration of fitness and Irish spirit—register today!

Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:
Bib Pick-Up Begins: 6:00 AM –  (Race Ready Athletics Tent)


Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM

1 Miler - 9:00AM

Kids Dash - 9:30 AM
Important: There are no late starts. Please arrive early to ensure you're ready for your race!
 

Start Location:
5100  E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

Granada Beach - Rosies Dog Beach 

Parking Information:


Free street parking is available.
Metered parking is $2.00 per hour (credit card and coin payments accepted).

Additional Race Day Info:


Restrooms are located near the start line.
Water and aid stations every 2 miles.
Stroller and walker-friendly event.
Course is fully marked.

 

Weather & Safety:
This is a RAIN or SHINE Event

In case of severe weather, (Like tsunamis, titlewave, or zombie apocalypse),  updates will be provided via email and our social media channels.

Join the Community:
Tag us on social media with #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured! Tune in on Fridays for a chance to win a free race by answering our #FreeEntryFriday questions.

name: The Long Beach Sweetheart's Run  - Valentine's 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
❤️ The Long Beach Sweethearts Run – Love on the Run
Sunday, February 14, 2027 | Long Beach, CA
5K • 10K • Half Marathon

Celebrate love, friendship, and movement this Valentine’s Day at the Long Beach Sweethearts Run! Whether you’re running solo, with your sweetheart, your bestie, or your fur babe — this is your moment to shine with miles, smiles, and signature CaliFlow energy. 💘

 
🏁 Race Info
📍 Location: Granada Beach — 5000 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

Race Day, Feb 14th – 5000 E Ocean Blvd

Bib Pick Up - Runner Check In
⏰ 6:00 AM 

⏰ 7:00 AM Half Marathon Start (Half Marathon Only)

⏰  8:00 AM 5K 10K Start

 

 🚗 Parking
Street parking is free (check signs).
Beach lot parking is $2/hour via the Passport App or kiosk.
Best address:5000 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach, CA 90803

Granda/Rosie’s Dog Beach — you’ll see us near the lot entrance!

 
🏅 Medals & Awards
❤️  Valentine’s  Finisher Medal for all participants
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards
🎭 Costume Contest: Prizes for best couple, solo, and group looks
 
💌 Race Highlights
✔️ Professional chip timing
📸 Free race-day photos
🎉 Finish-line celebration with snacks, music & photo ops
💧 3 on-course water stations + restrooms
👶 Stroller-friendly & walker-welcome
🐶 Dogs allowed — bring your fur bae
🎽 Vendor village + pre-race warmup
🍳 20% off food at Monty’s Dog Beach Café with your bib! 

 
🌺 Why CaliFlow Runs?
Because we’re not here for average.
CaliFlow Runs hosts over 50+ races a year that are inclusive, low-cost, beginner-friendly, and full of joy. We bring people together through movement — no gatekeeping, no elitism, just community and good vibes.

Whether you’re chasing a PR, pushing a stroller, or simply showing up for yourself — you belong here. ❤️

 
💞 Who Can Participate?
Everyone!
Runners, walkers, stroller-pushers, solo heartbreakers, couples, besties, and four-legged friends. Show up as you are — and leave with your heart full.

 
📣 Final Word
If it’s not CaliFlow…
it’s just an average race. 💘

🔗 Check out all of our events: califlowruns.com

name: The Long Ride Home (Virtual)
description:
The Long Ride Home (Virtual) is a 22-day cycling challenge created to bring riders together in support of veteran connection, mental health awareness, and Project Echelon.

From July 6th through July 28th, participants from anywhere in the country can ride alongside The Long Ride Home mission by logging miles through RunSignUp and joining a growing community committed to showing that no veteran fights alone.

This is an honor-system virtual cycling event open to all experience levels and all cycling disciplines.

Ride indoors or outdoors.
Ride solo or with a team.
Ride one mile or hundreds.

All cycling disciplines are welcome:
• Road
• Gravel
• Mountain Bike
• Commuting
• Indoor Trainer / Zwift
• Cruiser & Recreational Riding

Participants will upload activities throughout the event and track cumulative mileage on a live leaderboard.

Recognition categories include:
• Top Male Mileage
• Top Female Mileage
• Top Team Mileage

Additional community recognition and milestone achievements may be announced throughout the challenge.

Whether you are riding to support a veteran, honor someone you lost, improve your own mental health, or simply be part of something bigger than yourself, every mile matters.

Registration:
June 8th – July 6th

Event Dates:
July 7th – July 28th

Entry Fee:
$10 (+ processing fees)

All proceeds from this virtual event will be donated directly to The Long Ride Home fundraising campaign benefiting Project Echelon.

Not everyone can ride the Pacific Coast.
But everyone can ride with us.

Veterans don’t fight alone.
And none of us ride alone either.

ABOUT THE MISSION

The Long Ride Home (Virtual) was created by fellow Project Echelon Vanguard member Greg Fields as a way for riders across the country to participate in and support The Long Ride Home mission from wherever they are.

In July 2026, retired U.S. Navy Senior Chief Brandon van Baggen will ride more than 2,200 kilometers down the Pacific Coast from Portland, Oregon to Coronado, California to raise awareness and support for veteran mental health through Project Echelon.

This 22-day virtual challenge allows participants to ride alongside that journey by logging miles, building community, and supporting the message that connection saves lives.

Whether riding indoors, outdoors, solo, or with a team, every mile represents support for veterans, mental health awareness, and the reminder that no one rides alone.

All proceeds from this event will be donated directly to The Long Ride Home fundraising campaign benefiting Project Echelon.

name: The Master's University Winter 5K
description:
RACE DAY NEED TO KNOW:

Check-In and Packet Pickup: Begins at 7AM at TMU's North Campus, and ends at the start of your race. You will receive your Race Number, Timing Chip, and T-Shirt (sizes subject to availability for participants who registered after 12/15/26)

The Master's University, North Campus Address: 24736 Quigley Canyon Rd, Santa Clarita, CA 91321

Parking: Arrive early to find parking. Parking is NOT available at North Campus (P3). Free parking is available in any of TMU's lots apart from P3. CLICK HERE for a campus map. (Available lots: P1, P2A, P2B, P2C, P4. Additional parking is available at TMU's Centennial lot). Carpool recommended. 

 

Since 2011, The Master’s University Winter 5K has been a favorite among local runners thanks to the welcoming atmosphere, scenic course, and community partnerships. This year we are continuing 2025's new features; the Kids 1K, and a more competitive 5K race – the 5K Challenge. The 5K Challenge will be limited to participants whose goal is to complete the race in around 35 minutes. Our traditional 5K Run/Walk will take place immediately following the 5K Challenge.
 
This year's course will replicate the 2025 course. The race will start on TMU’s north campus, wind through Placerita Canyon and Quigley Canyon Open Space, and will finish at the starting point on north campus. The Master's University Winter 5K boasts a scenic and entirely flat course with varying terrain, perfect for participants of all ages and abilities. Come experience what local runners have called their “favorite way to start off the new year!”

 

2026-27 REGISTRATION SCHEDULE

 

Kids K:

JUL 1 -- Early Registration ($10)

SEP 1 -- General Registration ($15)

DEC 15 -- Last day to register and guarantee souvenir T-shirt

JAN 23 -- Race Day Registration ($20): Online or In-Person (Credit, Check or Cash Available)

 

5K Challenge & 5K Run/Walk:

JUL 1 -- Early Registration ($30)

SEP 1 -- Priority Registration ($35)

NOV 1 -- General Registration ($40)

DEC 15 -- Last day to register and guarantee souvenir T-shirt

JAN 9 -- Late Registration ($45)

JAN 23 -- Race Day Registration ($50): Online or In-Person (Credit, Check or Cash Available)
 

 
AWARDS
Participants in the Kids K, 5K Challenge and 5K Run/Walk will all receive event t-shirts (exact size not guaranteed for late registrants) and medallions.
 
Prizes for the overall male and female winners, will be awarded per age group of the 5K Challenge race.

name: The Retro Run – 5K, 10k, 10m, and Half Marathon
description:
Lace up and throw it back for the Retro Run, a beachside race bringing old-school vibes, bold outfits, and plenty of fun to the shore. Come ready to run, walk, dress the part, and celebrate every mile in retro style.

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Ave, Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1-3:00pm – Bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon and 10-miler start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged in advance for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More About the Course
This is an out and back course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location.

Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The course never goes off the beach path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

name: The Rock the Loch 5K/10K/Half Marathon (LIVE or Virtual)
description:
We cannot promise you'll encounter any cryptic, aquatic creatures at Loch Chabot, but you might! We DO promise a gorgeous trail run on the scenic trails of Loch Chabot Regional Park, some quality nature therapy, and some incredible views!

We'll also hook you up with some awesome swag (an awesome shirt, a handcrafted race woodallion), a Rock the Loch beer sampler stein, & more), quality post run beverages/snacks, DJ Cryptid spinning your favorite tunes before/during/after the race, and more!

If you can't join us LIVE at Loch Chabot, no problem! We're supporting a VIRTUAL participation option as well.

Where: Lake Chabot in Castro Valley, CA.
When: Sun, 6/28- Early Half Start-8:15AM (for those needing 3.5-4 hours), Standard Half Start-9:15AM (for those needing 3 hours or less), 10K Start-9:30AM, 5K Start- 9:45AM.
Course Maps: 5K Course Map, 10K Course Map, Half Marathon Course Map.

Course Details:

  • The 5K is 100% paved. It's a great course for conquering your first and/or fastest 5K!
  • The 10K is 50% paved, 50% trail, and includes '1' tough climb. The 10K is a great option for those new to trails. 
  • The Half Marathon includes 3ish miles paved and the rest is trail. The Half includes nearly 1,700 feet of ascent/descent. The half is a STOUT challenge we'd recommend only for experienced trail runners. 

Aid Stations:

  • The 10K includes '1' aid station approximately 3 miles into the race. The Half Marathon includes aid stations at 4.1 miles, 7.65 miles, and 9.85 miles.
  • Aid stations include water, Skratch Labs electrolyte drink, GU Energy products, Saltstick products, chips, and pretzels. 

The Experience:

All Rock the Loch participants receive....

  • An epic, trail run at Loch Chabot (assuming you're not participating virtually)
  • An AWESOME race woodallion designed by Aravaipa Artworx
  • A sweet lifestyle tee
  • A custom Rock the Loch beer sampler stein.
  • Post race snacks/beverages including Bellwether Farms yogurt, Jambars, and more!
  • Access to the post race BREWFEST
  • DJ Cryptid spinning your favorite tunes before/during/after the race

Pre-Race Bib & Shirt Pickup: Sat, 6/27 from 12-4PM at Renew PT (460 Boulevard Way, Suite 2D) in Oakland.

*NOTE-A friend can pickup your bib/shirt for you provided they furnish proof of your registration and a copy of your ID/driver's license.

If you cannot claim your bib/shirt on Sat, 6/27, we will support race morning bib/shirt pickup from 7:30-9AM at the start/finish area.

name: The Rocky Hill Triathlon
description:
The Rocky Hill Triathlon returns for the 11th year in Exeter, California! We are the best kept secret in the Central Valley with a course that is challenging and showcases the foothills of the Sierra Nevada mountain range. Our fun course will help push you to new limits and you can earn some of the best swag to prove it! We will be offering two different distances on race day. The Short Course will have a 400 yard swim, 12.5 mile bike & 3.1 mile run. The Long Course will have an 800 yard swim, 24.8 mile bike & 6.2 mile run. New this year is the 10k course which is challenging with two climbs over Rocky Hill. Or choose the 5k which is less challenging

We are USAT sanctioned

Events

-Short Course
-Long Course
-10k
-5k


Why the Rocky Hill Triathlon?

  • Scenic Ride and Run into the foothills

  • FREE Race Photos

  • FREE Beer Ticket to VIP Pizza

  • Rocky Hill Trucker Hat (Triathlon)

  • All Finishers get a Pullover Hoodie

  • Towel (Triathlon)

  • Polar Cycling Water Bottle (Triathlon)

  • Finisher Medal

  • Epic Finish with Music

Age Group Awards

10 Year Age Group Awards for Male and Female short distance, long distance, 5k, and 10k 

Artletic Apparel Kits Available

Artletic has designed custom kits available during registration. A portion of sales will be donated to the Rocky Hill Triathlon
Artletic Store: https://runsignup.com/Race/Store/CA/Exeter/RockyHillTriathlon2023

Who we Support

The Rocky Hill Triathlon has invested more funds back into the Exeter community than any event. Since day one the board and race director have elected to volunteer their services unpaid. A large portion of your registration will used to benefit a park or project in the city of Exeter

name: The Running Fence Run: A Run of Freedom- Celebrating Christo's 1976 "Running Fence” art project
description:
The Running Fence Run: A Run of Freedom

On September 12, 2026, runners return to the stunning Sonoma County hills to celebrate two milestone anniversaries:

  • The 50th anniversary of Christo & Jeanne-Claude's Running Fence art installation  —  September 10-24, 1976
  • The 2,516th anniversary of the Battle of Marathon — September 12, 490 BC

The Connection Between Art and Running

In September 1976, artists Christo and Jeanne-Claude stretched a 24.5-mile ribbon of white fabric across the hills of Sonoma and Marin counties — for just two weeks. That distance echoes the original marathon: the ancient Greek messenger Pheidippides ran from Marathon to Athens to announce a stunning military victory, one that saved the cradle of democracy. That run inspired the marathon we race today.

Christo fled communist Bulgaria in 1957, seeking freedom in the West. He called the Running Fence "a scream of freedom" — art that answered to no one, funded entirely by the artists themselves, rippling in the open California wind.

Featured in Runner's World magazine (Nov. 1976), a few runners ran the length of the fence, including Christo's fabric supplier, Bob Urie, a marathoner who helped organize the 1976 New York City Marathon.

Running is freedom! Like a long run, freedom takes endurance, courage, and the willingness to go the distance.

Choose your challenge — 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, or full 26.2 — and run through the same beautiful landscape where the Running Fence once stood.

Race Packet Distribution:

Sports Basement -Santa Rosa

Saturday, September 5, 10am-2pm & Friday, September 11, 4PM – 7 PM

That distance echoes the original marathon: the ancient Greek messenger Pheidippides ran from Marathon to Athens to announce a stunning military victory, one that saved the cradle of democracy. That run inspired the marathon we race today.

Christo fled communist Bulgaria in 1957, seeking freedom in the West. He called the Running Fence "a scream of freedom" — art that answered to no one, funded entirely by the artists themselves, rippling in the open California wind.

Featured in Runner's World magazine (Nov. 1976), a few runners ran the length of the fence, including Christo's fabric supplier, Bob Urie, a marathoner who helped organize the 1976 New York City Marathon.

Running is freedom! Like a long run, freedom takes endurance, courage, and the willingness to go the distance.

Choose your challenge — 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, or full 26.2 — and run through the same beautiful landscape where the Running Fence once stood.

name: The SF Mile
description: Trials of Miles Racing and A Runners Mind are excited to introduce the inaugural SF (Road) Mile, coming to San Francisco this August. This classic point-to-point road mile will take place on Old Mason Street in the Presidio, offering a flat, fast, and USATF-certified course built for speed. With multiple heats for runners of all abilities, the SF Road Mile invites everyone, from first-time milers to seasoned competitors, to test themselves over one of the sport’s most iconic distances.

name: The Sober Endurance 2-4-6 | A  public movement against alcohol-centered wellness culture
description:
THIS IS NOT YOUR AVERAGE RACE. 🏁 THIS IS YOUR COMEBACK.
The running world has a drinking problem. We built the alternative.

 
Islay Hill Park, CA · Virtual Worldwide · 5M / 2HR / 4HR / 6HR · June 27

Real talk?

The pub runs. The finish line beer gardens. The drink tickets handed out like they're part of the medal package.

We love running. We just don't love that part.

So we built a race that ends with a ceremony instead of a bar tab. A community instead of a hangover. A finish line that actually means something.

 
THIS ONE'S FOR YOU IF:

✅ You're sober, sober-curious, or sober-supportive

✅ You're a non-drinker tired of being the odd one out at every race

✅ You want to run with people who actually get it

✅ You're ready to prove something to yourself

Still reading? That's your answer. 😉

 

WHO'S LEADING THIS

Amber Graziano & Vinny Wood. 6 and 4 years sober. 100-mile finishers. On the course with you — not watching from the sidelines.

 
WHAT PEOPLE SAY

"I crossed that finish line and broke down. Not because it was hard — because I finally proved I didn't need alcohol to feel alive." — Sarah M., first 4-hour event sober after 8 years

"I left with a community I didn't know I needed. I haven't had a drink since." — Marcus T., virtual participant turned in-person finisher

WHAT'S INCLUDED

🏃 Timed loop course — Islay Hill Park to Righetti Hill, and back

👕 Official Sober Endurance tee

🎉 Post-run ceremony — your name called out loud in front of everyone

🤝 Community from day one to finish line

🌍 Virtual option — run from anywhere in the world

Total value: $550+ Your entry: $50. Yes really.

Islay Hill Park- 1511 Tank Farm Rd.

Strava Segment: https://www.strava.com/routes/3497256477417972926

 
⚡️ 50 in-person spots. Closes June 26th. Virtual is open worldwide.

→ SIGN UP NOW — 5M · 2HR · 4HR · 6HR


YOUR COMEBACK STARTS HERE.

name: The Sports Spectacular 5K/10K WILL be now in May, 2027.
description:
SPORT SPECTACULAR 5K & 10K
Bolsa Chica State Beach – Huntington Beach, CA

LOT25
17851 Pacific Coast Hwy
Huntington Beach, CA US 92649

The SPORT SPECTACULAR 5K & 10K celebrates how running helps every sport and every sport helps running. IT's SOON to be an OLYMPIC YEAR.  Let's RACE TOWARD that. 

Whether you're a runner, soccer player, basketball lover, volleyball athlete, or part of any sports community, this event brings athletes of all backgrounds together for a fun and energetic morning at the beach.

Running builds endurance, strength, and mental focus. Qualities that benefit every sport. At the same time, cross-training through other sports can make us stronger, faster, and healthier runners.

This event is designed to celebrate that connection while encouraging everyone to stay active, try new sports, and build community through movement.

EVERY PARTICIPANT RECEIVES
🏅 Custom themed cast finisher medal
👕 Themed Sport Spectacular race shirt
🏆 Chance to win Age Division Awards
⏱ Professional RFID chip timing by Itz About Time
🎵 Music, refreshments, and a fun community atmosphere

Caren Ware Events are designed for Every BODY and EVERYBODY — welcoming runners, walkers, families, and athletes of all abilities.

Expect great energy, creative themes, and one of the BEST themed race experiences around!

 
SPORTS EXPO
A Sports & Fitness Expo will be open race morning featuring:

• Youth and adult sports programs
• Local clubs and teams
• Coaches and instructors
• Fitness and cross-training opportunities


Before the main race, join us for some playful sports-themed activities at our EXPO

If you’re looking to discover a new sport, improve your training, or connect with your local sports community, the expo is the perfect place to start.

Sports organizations and teams are invited to host booths and share their programs with participants and spectators. Please email info@kourseevents.com if interested in hosting a sports booth. 

RACE DAY SCHEDULES:

6:30 am  Registration OPENS
               Shirts are given with bibs at registration.  Medals when you finish 

8:00 am START Kid's Dash 

8:30 am Mass START of 5K/10K Mile

9:15 am Start of 5K AWARDS CEREMONY

9:30 am Start of the 10K AWARD CEREMONY

Bring EXTRA CASH FOR STREET TACOS, AGUA FRESCA, FRESH FRUIT, GALLETINAS AND SPECIALTY COFFEES.

FINISHER MEDALS to every Finisher

AGE DIVISION AWARDS:
5-year Age Spans:  3 deep with 5-year age spans:  5k and 5 Mile  1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80&over 

Top  3 Overall Trophies to Males & Females     Plus award to Oldest finisher. Youngest finisher. 

Pets: Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Stroller: Families can bring strollers, but agree to use at their own risk.  We do ask that you line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course. Note, that only registered participants with a BIB will receive a finisher medal. Please make sure your BIB is in the front and visible to our volunteers.  And watch for cyclists enjoying the same beach bike path you are running on.

The race will take place rain or shine.  

RESTROOMS are in the public buildings at the end of each of the parking lots. 

Enjoy a beautiful course along Bolsa Chica State Beach with ocean views and fresh sea air. Whether you're chasing a personal record or enjoying a relaxed run with friends, this race is designed for athletes of all levels.

name: The Stuffing Shuffle – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
It's almost Thanksgiving, let's celebrate the day with community and thanks!

Race Details

Start Location: Mile Square Park, Parking lot D. Across the street from 11014 Lavender Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708. 
Parking: $5.00 per car at Mile Square Park (Opens at 7am). Limited free street parking is available

Event Schedule

Friday
Early Bib Pickup at Sports Basement Orange County TBD

Saturday
7:30am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
8:00am – Half marathon
8:30am – 5k & 10k start
11:10am – Course closes (3 hours, 10 minutes for the Half)

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: this 5k route is used for the 5k (one loops), 10k (two loops) – route here 
Half Marathon: this route is used for the half marathon, it's similar to the 5k route but there is an additional out and back – route here

More About the Course

This is a looped course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location. Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must be courteous and share the path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: The Syty Marathon
description:
The SYTY Half Marathon is built around one idea: every day is an opportunity to be better than you were yesterday. This September in San Diego, we're bringing that to life on a 4.1-mile loop course where every lap is a chance to prove to yourself how far you've come.

Half marathon runners will complete just over 3 laps. Each time you come back around you'll feel the crowd, feed off the energy, and find out what you're truly capable of. The loop format means you're never alone out there and the support never stops.

Whether you're running your first half or chasing a new PR, you're out there with people who get it. People who showed up for themselves the same way you did.

What's included:

Performance finisher shirt
Water stations on course
Electrolyte stations
4.1-mile loop style race

Early bird pricing is open now. Register today and take the first step toward your best race yet. Better yourself starts here.

name: The Wascally Wabbit Trail Race
description:
Formerly known as the Wascally Wabbit Half Mawothon, we've taken this race to the trails, on the Finegold Creek Preserve, operated and managed by the Sierra Foothill Conservancy. 

Feel the sense of satisfaction when you complete this race knowing that you've also helped a great cause. All race proceeds go to Kids Kasa Foster Care to help college-bound former foster children & Sierra Foothill Conservancy. With your support we have helped many former foster children attend higher education at a community college, four year university, or trade school.

Kids Kasa Foster Care Inc. was started in 2004 and is a non-profit 501-(c)-3 which has always worked toward helping children reunify with their families.  

About the Venue

The Austin and Mary Ewell Preserve at Fine Gold Creek was acquired by SFC in 2008. It protects 718 acres of land and one and one half miles of lower Fine Gold Creek starting where it flows into Millerton Lake. Like most foothill streams Fine Gold does not flow in the summer, but it does maintain several large pools of water even in the hottest months.

History
The Preserve was established with funding from Mr. Ben Ewell and family, the Pacific Gas and Electric Company, the Bureau of Reclamation, and the Wildlife Conservation Board (part of the California Department of Fish and Game).

Habitat
In addition to the riparian vegetation along the creek, the Fine Gold Preserve protects Valley Elderberry Longhorn Beetles, Western Pond Turtles, and one of the few southern Sierra populations of the Dutchman’s Pipe Vine Swallowtail butterfly.

Directions to the Austin and Mary Ewell Preserve at Fine Gold Creek
From Fresno, take Highway 41 north. 11 miles from the Friant on-ramp turn right on Highway 145. Go 3.3 miles to the first stop sign; keep going straight as Highway 145 becomes Road 211. Go 3.7 miles from stop sign; turn right onto Road 210. Go 2.5 miles; stay to the right on the  paved road, which becomes Road 216. Go .5 miles; you will see  a double-wide gate on the left. You will arrive at the race venue. Driving time is about 25 minutes from the Friant/Highway 41 on-ramp.

name: Thrive San Diego Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The Kaiser Permanente Thrive Half Marathon & 5K returns for its 10th year!

We’re excited to THRIVE with you on Saturday, November 14, 2026! More than just a race, it’s an invitation for the entire San Diego community to “Thrive” together—staying active, eating healthy, living well, and giving back. All courses start and finish at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, offering fast, flat stretches with beautiful Mission Bay views and refreshing ocean breezes.

 
Half Marathon: 
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Experience 13.1 miles of scenic San Diego beauty on a loop course that starts on Ingraham Street, winds along Mission Bay, and finishes at Ski Beach. Enjoy fast, flat stretches, picturesque bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes as you chase your personal best.
  • Go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon/ for more information.

 

Half Marathon Relay:
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Take on the Half Marathon Relay with a partner and split the challenge of 13.1 miles! Each runner will cover approximately 6.5 miles before handing off the "baton" to your teammate at Telecote Shores. This scenic route along Crown Point starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, featuring fast, flat stretches, breathtaking bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon-relay/.
 
5K:
  • Start Time: 7:30AM
  • The 5K is a scenic loop route along Crown Point that starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/5k/.
 
Entry Includes:
  • Official Thrive Short Sleeve Tech Tee
  • Racer Bib
  • Finisher Medal Unique to Each Distance
  • Chip Race Timing
  • Live Finish Results and Rankings
  • Award Winner Prizes
  • Overall & Age Group Awards
  • Access to Thrive Expo
 

Virtual Runners:
  • For runners who can’t make it to San Diego but still want to participate and benefit Make-A-Wish San Diego! Complete your distance anytime during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/virtual-runners/

 

Charity:

Run to benefit Make-A-Wish® San Diego! Join us in granting wishes for children diagnosed with critical illnesses. Donate today to show your support for Make-A-Wish® San Diego on Race Day.

 

For more information on Make-A-Wish San Diego, visit thrivehalfmarathon.com/charity/.

name: Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the 10th Annual Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot
                                            Benefiting The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation


                                                            www.hamannfoundation.org


                              Giving A Hand Up To Patients Along Their Journey Fighting Cancer…


Since the inception of The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation in 2014, the Foundation has granted over $1.5M to patients giving a HAND UP with rent and mortgage payments, gas & groceries, medical expenses, utility payments and other needs. The form of support is direct to the patients’ needs to help make a difference along their personal journey fighting cancer. The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation continues to grow each year. This is the 9th Annual Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot and we have various fundraising events throughout the year.

name: Torrance Memorial Medical Center, BRA Run, Los Angeles
description:
Day of Event Schedule

Our 14th Annual 5K & 13K are held on a fully paved course next to the sand in Playa Del Rey on August 30th, 2026

5:15am: Parking Lots Open (LA County charges $13, bring cash). The line backs up so arrive early. 

6:15am: Registration and Vendor Booths Open

6:30am: Bike Tour Starts 

7:05am: Costume Contests

7:16am: National Anthem 🇺🇸

7:30am: 13K start (2 hour time limit, 15 min per mile pace or faster)

7:50am: 5K start

9:30am: Kids Run starts (time is approximate and depends on when the last 13K walkers are clear of the kids run course)

9:45am: Awards Ceremony

Share your photos on social media! We are @brarunla and @runmercury and our official hashtag is #brarunla. We will be resharing your posts all week post-race!


Charity

In its 14th year, The BRA Run supports Evelyn’s BFF, a charity that helps breast cancer survivors get back to their new normal while supporting counseling, reconstruction, and other items that people are often not able to get covered by their insurance. Most of our grant recipients have bills going into 6 figures! This event is the biggest fundraiser for this all volunteer organization and determines how many people they can help this year.

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

Make it a Virtual Run/Walk

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.


Location

12000 Vista Del Mar
Dockweiler Beach
Playa Del Rey, CA US 90293

In its 14th year, The BRA Run supports Evelyn’s BFF, a charity that helps breast cancer survivors get back to their new normal while supporting counseling, reconstruction, and other items that people are often not able to get covered by their insurance. Most of our grant recipients have bills going into 6 figures! This event is the biggest fundraiser for this all volunteer organization and determines how many people they can help this year.

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

Make it a Virtual Run/Walk

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.

name: Trail Challenge - The Dublin 26
description:
The Dublin Trail Challenge – "The Dublin 26"

The Dublin Trail Challenge is officially returning this fall. Join us from September 7 through October 11, 2026, for the Dublin 26 and challenge yourself to get active while exploring the City of Dublin.

Challenge Options

Walk, Hike, or Run Challenge

  • Complete a total of 26 miles anywhere within the City of Dublin
  • Miles can be completed all at once or over multiple days
  • All miles must be tracked and recorded using the RaceJoy application
  • Choose from recommended trails, neighborhood parks, or your own favorite routes around the city

Bike Challenge

  • Complete a total of 65 miles all at once or over multiple days
  • All miles must be tracked and recorded using the RaceJoy application
  • Participants should begin their rides in Dublin but are welcome to continue into surrounding cities as part of their mileage

Participants are encouraged to explore the community in their own way. Whether you are discovering a new trail, visiting a local park, or enjoying neighborhood streets and surrounding areas, the Dublin Trail Challenge is designed for all fitness levels and abilities.

How to Participate

  1. Register for the Dublin Trail Challenge at runsignup.com
  2. Download and use the RaceJoy application on your phone to track and record your miles
  3. Complete either:
    • 26 miles walking, hiking, or running, or
    • 65 miles biking
  4. Finish and record all miles by October 11, 2026

All registered participants who successfully complete and record their miles by the deadline will receive a commemorative 2026 Dublin Trail Challenge t-shirt.

Need Help?

If you need assistance registering for the challenge or learning how to use the RaceJoy application, Contact Christina Brekelmans at Christina.brekelmans@dublin.ca.gov and ask for an appointment at the Shannon Community Center Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Get outside, stay active, and experience Dublin one mile at a time during the 2026 Dublin Trail Challenge.
