name: Tri Santa Cruz
description:
Come play at  of one of the most fun and scenic events on the west coast. This race has a sprint and international (Olympic) distance triathlon, with relays, aquathalon and aquabike categories for both races. Clydesdale and Athena triathlon categories are available.

 

There is a special, non-competitive Family & Friends wave for people who are new to triathlon or just want to race with family and friends regardless of age or gender. 

 

Special youth pricing is available for youth 12-17 and seniors 70+ for all individual distances.  Contact us for a discount for an all youth/senior relay team.

 

Triathlon club disounts available.  If your Tri Club does not have a code, have a club officer contact us.

 

Sheltered swim and flat bike and run course make this a perfect place for your first race or a PR. Voted one of the best late season triathlons in the country. The bike ride is a totally closed course and both the bike and run courses follow the coastline to create one of the most scenic races around! (Pending approval of the 2025 bike course)

 

Stick around and play for a day at the famous Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk or visit the Surfer Museum or National Marine Sanctuary Center.

 

Participants will receive a finisher medal and custom t-shirt as part of their registration, plus a post race lunch and awards.

name: Tri to Inspire
description:
Tri to Inspire, formerly the DJFE Triathlon Race Series, was created to introduce the sport of triathlon to the Sonoma County community in a welcoming, inclusive way. This short-distance event is open to all abilities and is ideal for first-time triathletes and families looking to experience a fun, supportive race environment together.

Athletes may choose between two distance options. The Mini Sprint includes a 100-yard pool swim, a 3-mile bike, and a 1-mile run. The Sprint distance features a 400-yard pool swim, a 9-mile bike, and a 3.1-mile run. Tri to Inspire is a non-competitive, untimed event designed to help participants complete their first triathlon—or simply enjoy the experience without pressure. More experienced athletes are also encouraged to participate and will find a positive, community-focused atmosphere. The race begins with a pool swim at the Finley Aquatic Center, followed by a flat, family- and beginner-friendly bike and run course along the Santa Rosa Creek Trail.

Each athlete’s registration includes a custom finisher medal, swim cap, and athlete goody bag. Proceeds benefit Inspiration Sports Foundation, a local 501(c)(3) nonprofit supporting youth in Sonoma County through sports camps and fitness-based programs.

name: Trick or Trot 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🎃 Trick or Trot 5K, 10K & Half Marathon
Sunday, October 25, 2026 | Long Beach, CA
👻 Our 2nd-Year Anniversary Run!

Witches, goblins, ghouls, and more — come run the coast in costume lore!
It’s our annual Halloween run by the sea,
with miles, medals, and good vibes for free!
Whether you’re spooky, silly, or somewhere in between,
Trick or Trot is the place to be seen!

 

🎃 Trick or Trot 5K, 10K & Half Marathon
📅 Sunday, October 25, 2026 | 📍5400 E Ocean Blvd  Long Beach, CA
👻 Our 3rd-Year Anniversary Run!

🕸️ Join us for a spooktacular morning of miles, music, and memories as we celebrate one year of CaliFlow Runs!
🎭 Come in costume, bring the crew, and enjoy a race day packed with good vibes and fun extras! 🧡🕷️

 
📍 Race Details:
📌 Location: 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
📆 Date: Sunday, October 25, 2026

 
🏃‍♀️ Race Day Schedule:
🕕 Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM – 7:35 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)
🕖 Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
🕢 5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
🎃 Kids Run: 9:15 AM (approx., after the 5K/10K are underway)

 
🏅 Race Highlights:
✅ USATF Certified Course
⏱️ Chip Timing with Live Results Synced to Athlinks
📸 Free Race Day Photos
🏆 Overall + Age Group Awards for all distances
🧛‍♀️ Costume Contest with prizes!
🧙‍♀️ Epic Photo Areas for your best spooky or silly pics
🎊 Finish Line Festival with:
🎶 DJ & music
🍪🥤 Yummy snacks & drinks
🪑 Family seating & shaded viewing area
🎁 Fun surprises and community energy ✨

 
🚗 Parking Info:
🅿️ Free street parking along Ocean Blvd
💵 Beach lot parking available for $2/hr (pay at machine)

 
🎟 Register Today:
Whether you’re chasing a PR, dressing up for fun, or just showing up to move your body and cheer on others — 🎃 Trick or Trot is the place to be.
Let’s make this one-year celebration unforgettable! 💜👟

name: TriFind Race Director Summit
description:
The Future of Multisport Starts Here

The TriFind Multisport Race Director Conference brings together the industry’s most influential race directors and brand partners for an afternoon of insight, collaboration, and recognition.

With representatives from 1,600+ multisport races invited, this gathering is designed to deliver real data, actionable strategy, and meaningful connections that shape the future of endurance racing.

Who’s Invited

  • 900+ NGB races
  • 600+ Non-NGB races
  • Leading brands and sponsors seeking 2027 partnerships
  • Industry media and nonprofit leaders

Important Registration Information

This registration is intended for race directors attending the TriFind Race Director Summit.

Sponsors and brand partners are warmly invited to participate, but must register through the 2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes race registration at the sponsor rate. 

This ensures sponsors receive the appropriate race weekend access, exposure, and activation opportunities, while allowing the summit sessions to remain focused on race director collaboration.

What You’ll Experience

2026 State of the Sport
A comprehensive look at participation trends, athlete behavior, and market outlook.

Actionable Research & Insights
Channel and consumer research presentations you can apply immediately to grow and strengthen your races.

Brand & Sponsor Engagement
Connect with companies actively seeking race partnerships and activation opportunities for 2027.

Race Director Awards
Honoring excellence and leadership in the industry, including:

  • Most Innovative Race
  • Most Collaborative Organization
  • Additional peer-recognized honors

Hosted & Emceed By
Bob Babbitt — Breakfast With Bob, the voice of endurance sports.

Registration & Giving Back

Introductory Registration: $100
100% of proceeds benefit the Challenged Athletes Foundation (CAF)

Your registration directly supports athletes with physical challenges, reinforcing the multisport community’s commitment to inclusion and impact.

Conference Hotel & Room Block

A limited block of hotel rooms is available at a discounted rate for attendees.

We strongly recommend booking early, as availability is limited and rooms are expected to sell out.

🔗 Reserve your discounted room here.

Exclusive Race Director Benefit

Registered race directors are invited to compete at no cost in the
 2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes
 📅 November 1, 2026

The longest-running triathlon in the world operating continuously from the same venue - a chance to race, connect, and celebrate the sport alongside your peers.

Why Attend

  • Gain clarity on where the sport is headed
  • Learn what’s working and what’s next
  • Build relationships that power future races
  • Be recognized for the work you do
  • Give back to a cause that strengthens our community

Secure Your Spot

Limited capacity. Early registration recommended.

name: Trip to Kate Sessions Park
description:

Register online for transportation.

name: Trip to Volunteer at Comic Con
description:

All participants may only volunteer for one day of the show Thursday July 23rd through Sunday July 26th.

Volunteers must be ages 17+.

name: TSCL 5th Annual Mental Health 5K Run & Walk
description:
The Self Care Lab 5th Annual 5K Run & Walk for Mental Health Awareness In Partnership with The Claremont Unified School District 

Run for mental health. Walk for community. Every step helps expand access to healing-centered programs.

Join us for the Self Care Lab’s 5th Annual 5K Run & Walk, a community event raising awareness for mental health while supporting programs that promote healing, movement, and wellbeing for both youth and adults.

The Self Care Lab is a clinical boxing gym and wellness space focused on the connection between mental health and physical movement. Through boxing, fitness, and supportive programming, we provide tools that help people regulate stress, build resilience, and strengthen their overall wellbeing.

This year’s 5K also serves as a fundraiser to expand our programs and secure a larger facility, allowing us to serve more members of our community and provide scholarships for underserved youth.

Whether you’re a seasoned runner, casual walker, or simply looking to support a meaningful cause, we welcome participants of all ages and fitness levels.

More information to come.

 

Event Details

Location: Claremont, CA

 

Move with purpose.

Run for mental health.

Support programs that strengthen our community.

 

Learn more or donate:  The Self Care Lab

name: Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon 5k
description:
Get ready to join the community for the 23rd annual Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon 5k, hosted by the Tulare Sunrise Rotary Club! This fun and impactful event supports the club’s High School Scholarship Program, which in 2024 awarded a $5,000 4 year college and a $1,500 trade school scholarship to two Tulare High School seniors. 

Event Details:

Date & Location: The race begins and ends at Live Oak Park, Tulare, offering a scenic route and plenty of space to enjoy the day.

 

Time: Onsite registration and bib pickup will run from 8:00 am to 8:45 am, with the race starting promptly at 9am.

 

Registration: This year we are charging a registration fee of $15 per participant. This fee helps cover the costs of the finisher and winner medals and the timing system costs. We will also accept donations this year.

Awards and Prizes:

Finisher Medal: All finishers will receive a commemorative medal and lanyard and Rotary participant pin.

 

Age Group Awards: Medals will be awarded to top finishers in each age group: 9 & Under, 10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60+ (Male and Female).

 

Fastest Runner Awards: The top male and female runners will each receive a special trophy and $100 gift card!


Sponsor Opportunities:

Want to help make a difference in the lives of local students? Consider becoming a sponsor! Contact Matthew Hamilton at matt@hamiltonmarketing or Petrus Tjandra at ptjandra@aol.com for more information.

 

Join us for a memorable morning on the Santa Fe Trail as we come together to support education and enjoy some friendly competition. See you on race day!

name: Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk - Huntington Beach, CA
description:
Date/Time/Place

Saturday, September 19th, 2026
8:00AM - Race Start
Main Beach 21501 Pacific Coast Highway Huntington Beach, CA 92646

What is a Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk?
The Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk Series was created to honor the heroic life and death of Stephen Siller, a New York City firefighter (FDNY) who lost his life on September 11, 2001 after strapping on his gear and running through the Brooklyn Battery Tunnel to the Twin Towers. Honor all of those who lost their lives on September 11, 2001 and support our first responders and military who make extraordinary sacrifices in the line of duty! For more information on the Tunnel to Towers Foundation, please visit www.t2t.org.

This will be our 1st Annual Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk in Huntington Beach and we are excited to grow the community’s commitment to honor first responders, remember 9/11, and raise funds for the Tunnel to Towers Foundation.

How far is a Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk?
This is a 5K (3.1 miles). Anyone can run, walk, or experience this event

Where can I pick up my packet?
Packet pick up will be available on the morning of the event beginning at 7am as well as at Fleet Feet Cosa Mesa on Friday, September 18th in the afternoon. Please check back for information for the Fridy packet pick up as the event date approaches! 

Can someone else pick up my packet for me?
Yes, they can. They must present a copy of your registration receipt. And don't forget to thank them!

Can I register the day of the run?
Yes. Registration will open at 7 AM the morning of the run at Main Beach. You’ll save time and money if you register in advance. In addition, if you wait to register we may not have a shirt for you and we do not guarantee sizes for late registrants.

Are there event T-shirts?
Yes, everyone who registers is eligible to receive a race day T-shirt. Please register by 8/31/2026 to guarantee that you receive a shirt.

Is there parking available?
Yes. There is plenty of parking available. Free parking is located along the streets across from the beach parking lot. Please follow the signs and parking guidelines. Parking on-site at Main Beach is subject to a fee collected by the city of Huntington Beach

Do I have to wear my bib number?
Yes, please display your bib on the front of your outermost garment. The bib number is how we record the time. Those who run without a bib will be asked to leave the course and will not be allowed to finish.

I am a fast runner. Can I get a front line position?
Runners predicting a pace faster than 6 minute/mile will be seeded in the front corral (arrive early).

Will there be awards for running?
Award medals will be given to the top three men/women, boys/girls under 18, and the top 3 first responders running in their turnout gear.

Will water be available?
Yes, water will be available at the Start Line and Finish Line. 

Is there a medical staff available on-site?
We are currently making plans to have an EMS team on site. 

What can you bring to the event? Can I run with a stroller, backpack, wheelchair, roller blades, bicycle, etc?
Strollers and wheelchairs are permitted, but we ask that those with strollers start towards the back. Firefighter turnout gear and military backpacks are also permitted. Please leave all personal items and valuables in your vehicle. All items should be stored securely at the owner's risk. Tunnel to Towers Foundation will not be responsible for the loss of any items.

How can I volunteer?
It's simple, either register online or email us at huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org and we will reply within 24 hours. Volunteers are always needed for the day of festivities. Thank you!

As a participant, can I fundraise/encourage others to donate?
Yes! Once you are registered, you will be given directions to start your own fundraising page and you will be able to accept donations online. Do you want to donate cash/money? We can help you with that. Contact us at huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org and we can walk you through the process or you can send donations directly to: 

Tunnel to Towers Foundation
ATTN: Thomas Mazza
2361 Hylan Blvd.
Staten Island, NY 10306

Please  give us your information so we can add it to your fundraising page. It's easy!

Does my registration fee count towards my fundraising goal?
Your registration fee does not count toward the fundraising goal.

Does Tunnel to Towers offer fundraising incentives?
Yes, we offer fundraising incentives each year; check out our latest in our Fundraising Guide, which is on the main event page, about halfway down.

Can I still donate to a team and/or individual after the start of the race?
Yes. Donations will be accepted for 6 weeks after the event.

How can my company/organization sponsor this event?
Please send all sponsorship correspondence to huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org with your contact information and someone will be in touch with you within 24 hours.

I would like to donate goods or services to this event. How do I do that?
You can contact us at huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org. We make every effort to keep costs down to allow us to give the most to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation’s programs.

Where can I mail an OFFLINE donation (check made payable to Tunnel to Towers Foundation)?
Please mail any offline donations to:

Tunnel to Towers Foundation
ATTN: Thomas Mazza
2361 Hylan Blvd.
Staten Island, NY 10306

Can I transfer my registration to another participant?
Yes. Please contact us at huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org and we will manually change it in our system.

Can I get a refund?
We do not provide refunds for the event regardless if you cannot make the date or the foundation needs to cancel the event for extenuating circumstances. Registration may be transferred to another person.

Do registrants get receipts?
When you register online you should automatically receive a receipt via email.

Packet pick up will be available on the morning of the event beginning at 7am as well as at Fleet Feet Cosa Mesa on Friday, September 18th in the afternoon. Please check back for information for the Fridy packet pick up as the event date approaches! 

Can someone else pick up my packet for me?
Yes, they can. They must present a copy of your registration receipt. And don't forget to thank them!

Can I register the day of the run?
Yes. Registration will open at 7 AM the morning of the run at Main Beach. You’ll save time and money if you register in advance. In addition, if you wait to register we may not have a shirt for you and we do not guarantee sizes for late registrants.

Are there event T-shirts?
Yes, everyone who registers is eligible to receive a race day T-shirt. Please register by 8/31/2026 to guarantee that you receive a shirt.

Is there parking available?
Yes. There is plenty of parking available. Free parking is located along the streets across from the beach parking lot. Please follow the signs and parking guidelines. Parking on-site at Main Beach is subject to a fee collected by the city of Huntington Beach

Do I have to wear my bib number?
Yes, please display your bib on the front of your outermost garment. The bib number is how we record the time. Those who run without a bib will be asked to leave the course and will not be allowed to finish.

I am a fast runner. Can I get a front line position?
Runners predicting a pace faster than 6 minute/mile will be seeded in the front corral (arrive early).

Will there be awards for running?
Award medals will be given to the top three men/women, boys/girls under 18, and the top 3 first responders running in their turnout gear.

Will water be available?
Yes, water will be available at the Start Line and Finish Line. 

Is there a medical staff available on-site?
We are currently making plans to have an EMS team on site. 

What can you bring to the event? Can I run with a stroller, backpack, wheelchair, roller blades, bicycle, etc?
Strollers and wheelchairs are permitted, but we ask that those with strollers start towards the back. Firefighter turnout gear and military backpacks are also permitted. Please leave all personal items and valuables in your vehicle. All items should be stored securely at the owner's risk. Tunnel to Towers Foundation will not be responsible for the loss of any items.

How can I volunteer?
It's simple, either register online or email us at huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org and we will reply within 24 hours. Volunteers are always needed for the day of festivities. Thank you!

As a participant, can I fundraise/encourage others to donate?
Yes! Once you are registered, you will be given directions to start your own fundraising page and you will be able to accept donations online. Do you want to donate cash/money? We can help you with that. Contact us at huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org and we can walk you through the process or you can send donations directly to: 

Tunnel to Towers Foundation
ATTN: Thomas Mazza
2361 Hylan Blvd.
Staten Island, NY 10306

Please  give us your information so we can add it to your fundraising page. It's easy!

Does my registration fee count towards my fundraising goal?
Your registration fee does not count toward the fundraising goal.

Does Tunnel to Towers offer fundraising incentives?
Yes, we offer fundraising incentives each year; check out our latest in our Fundraising Guide, which is on the main event page, about halfway down.

Can I still donate to a team and/or individual after the start of the race?
Yes. Donations will be accepted for 6 weeks after the event.

How can my company/organization sponsor this event?
Please send all sponsorship correspondence to huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org with your contact information and someone will be in touch with you within 24 hours.

I would like to donate goods or services to this event. How do I do that?
You can contact us at huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org. We make every effort to keep costs down to allow us to give the most to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation’s programs.

Where can I mail an OFFLINE donation (check made payable to Tunnel to Towers Foundation)?
Please mail any offline donations to:

Tunnel to Towers Foundation
ATTN: Thomas Mazza
2361 Hylan Blvd.
Staten Island, NY 10306

Can I transfer my registration to another participant?
Yes. Please contact us at huntingtonbeachrun@t2t.org and we will manually change it in our system.

Can I get a refund?
We do not provide refunds for the event regardless if you cannot make the date or the foundation needs to cancel the event for extenuating circumstances. Registration may be transferred to another person.

Do registrants get receipts?
When you register online you should automatically receive a receipt via email.

name: Tunnel to Towers Sporting Clays Fundraiser - WING & BARREL RANCH
description:
SPORTING CLAYS (9AM - 4:00PM) 

WING & BARREL RANCH
6600 Noble Rd, Sonoma, CA 95476

Join the Tunnel to Towers Foundation for our Sporting Clays Fundraiser at Wing & Barrel Ranch in Sonoma, California on August 29th & 30th.

The event kicks off with breakfast, followed by a safety briefing. Afterward, enjoy lunch and a presentation of awards. Ammo, clays, rental shotguns, and eye and ear protection are included.

Breakfast/Registration: 9:00AM
Safety Briefing: 9:30AM
Shoot Time: 9:45AM-11:45AM
Lunch Set-up: 11:15AM
Lunch: 12:00PM
Awards/Raffles/Announcements: 1:00PM
Leave Time: 4:00PM

What's Included?
- Ammo, Clays, One Golf Cart Per Foursome, Continental Breakfast, Lunch, Awards, T2T Swag Bag.

We recommend those bring their own, eye & ear protection as well as their own shotgun. Rentals will be available but are limited to a first come first serve basis.

RSVP sportingclays@t2t.org, (347) 708-5272 by July 31, 2026

Can I get a refund?

Unfortunately, ALL SALES ARE FINAL and we do not allow refunds.  For more information please contact sportingclays@t2t.org

name: Turner's Tuff Ten
description:
We put the "ish" in "ten-ish". Just think of the extra distance as a FREE bonus.

This 12.4-mile course winds through the beautiful Red Hills Recreation Area in the Sierra Foothills. Winter is an amazing time to run in Red Hills. Water-crossings and mud add difficulty to already challenging, technical terrain.

NEW THIS YEAR!! - Giving you options is what DB is all about!  This year we have added a second distance, giving you the choice between a 10ish mile or 10ish K event.  Whichever distance you pick, you will still be seeing the Swisegoods at our only aid station.

description:
Join Union Rescue Mission at Griffith Park and be part of a powerful movement to address homelessness in Los Angeles. LOCATION: Griffith Park

REGISTRATION: 7:00 am

START TIME: 8:30 am

name: USS Hornet Halloween 5k
description:
Event Details: October 30th.  Friday pre-halloween Evening Run 

We have partnered with the USS Hornet to bring back a super fun and unique race experience to Alameda. Our "day of the dead" Twilight Run we did a few years ago is back, just moving the date slightly to coincide with Halloween. The event will still benefit the USS Hornet Museum and will start at 6:30pm. Sunset is scheduled that evening for 6:12pm, so headlamps are recommended but we will have lights on the course. 

Costume highly recommended and encouraged! 

The run will take you for a scenic loop around Alameda Point, starting and finishing at the Pier. Runners will enjoy views of San Francisco, spirit alley and the estuary shoreline along the flat and fast 5k course. There will be our normal beer garden, food, music and Age Group awards

THERE IS NO KIDS RUN FOR 2026 - DUE TO TRAFFIC CONCERNS ON FRIDAY NIGHT.

There is plenty of parking at the Hornet and around Alameda Point. 

Event - Schedule 

  • Packet pick-up ~ Lauren's Closet: 1420 Park st: October 28th - 29th: 10:00am - 5:00pm
  • Race day Registration and Packet Pick-up ~ USS Hornet: 4:30pm
  • 5K run starts ~ 6:30pm 
  • 5K awards ~ 7:15pm
  • Expo and music ~ 6:00pm - 8:00pm

name: Vacation Isle
description:
Vacation Isle sits at the center of Mission Bay — a bona fide island, connected to the mainland by a single road and surrounded by sparkling blue water in every direction. Open lawns, shaded trees, sandy beaches, and bay breezes make this one of San Diego's most scenic venues. And yes, July mornings here are just about perfect.

Whether you're picking up a map for the first time or you've been navigating by compass for years, you'll find a course built for you. Beginners get a welcoming, manageable challenge in a gorgeous setting. Experienced orienteers get terrain that rewards sharp navigation. Everyone gets to spend a Saturday morning on an island. 🧭

Event Team:

  • Event Director: TBD
    Course Setter: Julien Ouellet
  • Visit the Volunteer page to learn how to help with the event.
    • See "Volunteer" at the top right of the page. 🔝
    • Volunteers get up to a $20 credit toward a race registration fee.
    • Volunteer roles explained in detail

Format: Traditional 

Map:  scale  1:4000  |  2.5 m contours

Courses: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced

​Starts: 10am to 11am

Time Limit: Two hours. All competitors must return to HQ and download by 1pm so we know you are safe. If you don't check in before leaving, volunteers will search the course to ensure you are not lost. Please check in before you leave.

Scoring: Electronic punching will be used. All participants must bring, rent, or purchase one. Controls will be AIR+ enabled. 

E-Punches: If you don't have your own E-stick, rental electronic punches will be available for $5. (Use "000000" when registering).

Clinics:  An introductory clinic will be offered at 9:45 am. An experienced orienteerer will teach you the basics.

Registration: All participants must pre-register. All standard SDO registration policies apply.

Fees:

  • $20 for adults, $10 for juniors (under 21)
  • $5 early bird discount through midnight, Saturday, June 27th.

Closes: Registration will close at 10 am on Friday, July 17th, or when we reach our limit

Entry Limit: This event is limited to 75 participants. See the "Find a Participant" tab to see the registration list.

HQ Location: TBD

Parking: There is ample parking at the park.

 

San Diego Orienteering: Home page  |  Events

name: VALENCIA Trail Race
description:
Run the VALENCIA Trail Race, run the awesome trails and killer hills with breathtaking views of the Santa Clarita Valley in a 10K, Half Marathon, or 50K Ultra race. For runners who love to run great trails and want to accomplish a good challenge. Prepare to take on the Awesome Trail Challenge in Valencia, California. Southern California features a diverse range of nature and terrain, giving runners a wide variety of spectacular trails and running experiences. Located north of Los Angeles up against the California State park boundaries is Valencia, a suburban community that is surrounded by hills and mountains featuring awesome trails to be experienced.

Registration is now open with course distances for all types of runners to offer a variety of challenges. Experience a course that takes you up challenging hills to the peaks and along the ridgelines with panoramic views, then into the canyons and valleys for a truly awesome trail challenge.  Registration is available on VALENCIATrailRace.com or on the popular Active.com running network. 

Learn more at >> VALENCIATrailRace.com

name: Valentine's Day Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
💘 Celebrate love and fitness this Valentine’s Day with our charming Valentine's Run! Whether you’re running solo, with a partner, or with friends, this event is all about spreading love and joy.  Let’s make this Valentine’s unforgettable! Sign up today and let the love run wild!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

name: Vampire Run - Unite for Bleeding Disorders
description:
Join us as we have fun raising funds in support of the bleeding disorders community!

Featuring:

Vampire Run 5K – join us at our first ever 5K on the trails of Roseville, CA! All runners will get a special Vampire Run medal and entry into our Community Festival. We encourage capes, teeth, and costumes! Entry fees are $30 for adults and $10 for those under 14. Five and under can enter the festival for free. This is a timed run.

Food – all entrants will receive coffee from a coffee cart, juice, donuts, and other snacks! Who could pass up sno-cones and popcorn?

Games and Fun! – join us for carnival games, crafts, and face painting…all included in the race fee!

Schedule of Events:

8:30       5K starts

9:00       Carnival and booths open

11:00     Bleeding Disorders Remembrance Ceremony

11:15     1 Mile Walk

12:00     Carnival closes

name: Vaquero Strong 5K
description:
Description:

Get ready to run, connect, and celebrate community at the Vaquero Strong 5K hosted by the PTSA and ASB of Irvine High School!

Join us on Saturday, October 24, 2026 for a fun and energizing event that brings together students, families, neighbors, and runners from across Southern California. Whether you're racing for a personal best or walking with friends, this 5K is all about showing what it means to be Vaquero Strong.

Every participant will receive a race t-shirt and finisher medal, with top runner awards by age group up for grabs. Stick around before and after the race to enjoy coffee, food, and treats available for purchase—it’s more than a run, it’s a celebration!

Proceeds from the Vaquero Strong 5K directly support Irvine High students and staff, including updates to the Mental Health Wellness Center, teacher mini grants, student scholarships, and recognition programs like the Spur & Heritage Awards—along with many other impactful campus initiatives.

Come be part of something meaningful. Come be Vaquero Strong.

 

Race Location:  

Start/Finish Irvine High Stadium
4321 Walnut Ave, Irvine 92604


5K Registration Entry fee:  

$30.00  early  October 1 price goes to $35
$20.00 18 & under october 1 goes to $25
$12.00 5 & under

 

Awards:

All age division, 3 deep. UP to 70 plus.  

Custom finisher medals and shirts

 

Raceday Schedule 

6:30am race day.

8:00 am 5K Start

name: Velzy Stevens Pier to Pier Paddle Board Race
description: The Velzy-Stevens Pier to Pier Paddleboard race is part of the International Surf Festival! The race is a 2-mile open ocean race starting at 7:30am sharp on August 2nd 2026 at the end of the Manhattan Beach Pier.  The course parallels the shoreline, concluding on the south side of the Hermosa Beach Pier. Hosted by the South Bay Boardriders Club, this annual event attracts young and old alike.   Soft-top boards, prone paddleboards, and SUPs are all welcome.

name: Vineyard Stomp 5K - Wise Villa Winery & Restaurant
description:
Get ready to lace up and let loose at the Vineyard Stomp 5K—a race experience that blends scenic beauty, great competition, and a well-earned celebration at the finish line!
This unique course winds its way through beautiful vineyard property at Wise Villa Winery & Restaurant, offering runners a one-of-a-kind setting with rolling views, fresh air, and the charm of the vines all around. Whether you’re racing for a personal best or simply enjoying the atmosphere, this is a course you won’t forget. 
All participants will be treated to a fantastic race shirt and a custom finisher medal to commemorate their run. After crossing the finish line, athletes 21 and over can enjoy a complimentary pour of wine, while those under 21 will receive juice—making it a fun and inclusive celebration for everyone.
For the competitive runners, there’s plenty to chase. Awards will be presented to the Top Three Male and Female Overall finishers, as well as the Top Three in Masters, Grand Masters, and Senior Masters Overall categories. In addition, awards will be given to the top three athletes in each of the traditional five-year age groups, ensuring runners of all ages have a chance to shine.
Come for the run, stay for the experience—because nothing pairs better than a great race and a great pour!

 

This event is capped at:  200

name: Virtual Outrun Lupus Run/Walk
description:
Help us Outrun Lupus across California!  

Celebrating over 32 years of community, connection, and hope this year, we are hosting the Outrun Lupus virtually to celebrate so we can include ALL of California!   We are excited to bring awarness to lupus across the state and maybe even some other states!  Lupus patients and supporters from every corner of California can help us OUTRUN LUPUS—anytime, anywhere during the month of September!  You can choose to walk or run however far you want over the month of September!  

Proceeds from this event go towards funding our mission of Improving Lives Impacted by Lupus and allow us to continue to offer FREE Support and Education programs to lupus patients and those who love them.
 

Be sure to invite your friends, family and co-workers and help us OUTRUN LUPUS!!  The more people that participate - the more people will learn about lupus!!  Create a Team and walk or run together to raise $$ for the California Lupus Foundation!

HOW TO COMPLETE YOUR VIRTUAL RUN/WALK

  • Register for the race (you can even print a customized bib!)
  • Join our Facebook Group to share and celebrate with other participants. Don't forget to follow our Facebook page too!
  • Run/walk at your convenience, any time, anywhere between September 01-30th, 2026
  • Submit your time (optional) to see how you placed overall and receive your finisher certificate.
  • Don't forget to sign up as a fundraiser:
    • Raise $125 earn an Outrun Lupus T-Shirt 
    • Raise $250 earn an Outrun Lupus Baseball Cap
    • Raise $500 earn an Outrun Lupus  Sweatshirt

You can also tag the California Lupus Foundation Facebook or Instagram account and share and celebrate with other participants.

Don't Forget!  As a virtual event you can participate anywhere and log your walk/runs throughout the month of September.  Let's try and Run/Walk across California and raise lupus awareness!

name: Volleyball Skills Clinic
description: Kick your flip flops off and get ready to get sandy!  Join us for a fun intro into beach volleyball with a skills building class. Play a friendly game of volleyball with a refreshing drink or two. For ages 21+.

name: VPA Summer Solstice Challenge
description:
The longest day of the year is almost here.

On June 21st, Team VPA is launching its first community-wide virtual endurance challenge — and we want you in it.

Solstice to Equinox. 94 days. Every mile counts.

THE TEAM VPA SUMMER SOLSTICE CHALLENGE

From the Summer Solstice to the first day of fall, you'll run, ride, and swim your way through summer — alongside a global community of vegan powered athletes who show up every single day.

This isn't just a challenge. It's a reason to make this your best summer of training yet.

HOW IT WORKS

Log miles across any endurance discipline throughout the summer. Every effort counts toward your individual goal. Choose your tier, log your miles, and track your progress on the leaderboard from solstice to equinox.

Mile Conversions:
🏃 Running — 1 mile = 1 mile
🚴 Cycling — 3 miles = 1 mile
🏊 Swimming — 0.25 miles = 1 mile

CHOOSE YOUR PERSONAL GOAL

🏅 Finisher — 100 miles (~1 mile/day)
A goal for every athlete, regardless of where you are in your season.

🌱 Thriver — 250 miles (~2.7 miles/day)
For the athlete who shows up consistently and puts in the work.

⭐ Elite — 500 miles (~5.3 miles/day)
For the athlete who needs something to chase all summer.

RACING FOR A CAUSE

100% of registration proceeds go directly to animal welfare. Because vegan athletes know that how we fuel matters beyond performance.

Want to give more or just want to support? Additional donations are welcome at checkout — every dollar goes to the same cause.


WHO THIS IS FOR

Team VPA members. Followers. Friends. Anyone who wants to spend their summer moving with purpose alongside the best vegan powered community on the planet.

All sports. All levels. All welcome.


Spots are open. Summer is coming. Let's make every mile count.

See you on the leaderboard.

— Team VPA

Follow us @teamvpa | veganpoweredathlete.com

name: Waffle Run
description:
Waffle Run Hosted by Huckleberry's (Fresno-Clovis)

Join us for the Waffle Run, a fun and delicious way to kick off your holiday season while supporting a great cause! Whether you’re an avid runner or just looking to enjoy a scenic walk, our event offers both a 5K and a 2-mile distance on the beautiful Clovis Old Town Trail.

 

Starting and finishing at the California Health Sciences University, this is the perfect opportunity to work off that turkey and earn a well-deserved waffle breakfast!

 

As you lace up your running shoes, know that every step you take contributes to a meaningful cause. A portion of all proceeds, along with your generous donations, will go directly to the Poverello House, an organization dedicated to helping those in need in our community.

 

Youth Pricing: Special pricing for youth 12 and under.  Includes Medal, Shirt, and Breakfast Coupon.

Choose Your Distance: Participate in the 5K run or take a leisurely stroll on the 2-mile route—perfect for families and all fitness levels!

Waffle Breakfast: After the race, join us at Huckleberry's to enjoy a delicious waffle combo breakfast featuring a half belgium waffle, 2 eggs and choice of bacon or sausage. Fuel up and celebrate your accomplishment with fellow participants!  You can redeem your waffle breakfast on race morming, or any day before January 1st.

Bib tear-off coupons valid at these locations:

Huckleberry’s

  • 222 E Bullard Ave, Fresno
  • 4360 W Shaw Ave, Fresno
  • 2100 Clovis Ave, Clovis

Support a Great Cause: Your participation helps provide essential services to those facing challenges in our community.

 

Gather your friends, family, and fellow waffle enthusiasts for a day filled with fitness, fun, and philanthropy. Don’t miss out on this unique opportunity to indulge in waffles while making a positive impact.

 

Register now to secure your spot and join us in supporting the Poverello House!

 

Let’s make this a waffle-filled day to remember! 🧇✨

name: Walk 4 Life
description:
The Child Abuse Prevention Council’s Suicide Prevention Team is thrilled to invite you
to participate in our 9th annual Walk 4 Life event on September 5, 2026.

Join us for CAPC’s Walk 4 Life—a free community event dedicated to remembrance, healing, and hope. This meaningful day honors families, friends, and communities who have lost someone to suicide, and reminds us all of one powerful truth: You are not alone. With each step, we move closer to raising awareness, breaking down stigmas, sharing resources, and creating safe spaces to ask for help. Lend your strength and steps to the cause.


Join us on Saturday, September 5th at Victory Park, as we walk for those we’ve lost, for those who are silently struggling, and for a future built on support, compassion, and understanding.

Let’s walk together—for healing, for hope, for life.

Important Reminders:

Day of Registration and Check In starts at 8:00 am on the day of the event.

For any questions or concerns, please call Mishelle Aguila at (209) __________.

name: Walk for Jenna's Joy: A Mental Health Awareness Walkathon
description:
This event is a walkathon on April 24th, 2027 in El Dorado County (EDC). This walkathon will raise money for the non-profit Jenna Sue Souza Furst Memorial Scholarship Fund which provides scholarships and a free therapy session to local high school students within EDC. name: Walk for Water 5K Los Angeles
description:
Walk Their Journey. Change Their Future.

Join us for a powerful and transformative experience at the Walk for Water 5K Charity Fundraiser, co-hosted by Pathway To Tomorrow and Drop of Water. This isn’t just a walk—it’s a step into the daily reality that millions of women and girls in Africa face just to access something as basic as water. 

Every day, women and girls spend 200 million hours hauling unclean water, often walking miles under a burning sun, along dangerous paths, carrying heavy containers. Every two minutes, a child dies from a water-borne disease, and 1.5 million children under five die annually in Africa from diarrhea caused by unsafe water. 

Ethiopia, Africa’s second most populous country, is in the grip of this devastating water crisis. Nearly half of its 125 million people lack access to clean water, according to UNICEF.

The situation is even worse in rural areas — where 80% of Ethiopians live and are hit hardest by this crisis, forcing women and girls to walk long distances just to find unclean water. Girls are expected to miss school to collect water for their families. Each journey robs a girl of her education, her safety, and her childhood. For far too many, these walks end in tragedies, like gender-based violence and death — not just exhaustion.

We walk not just for awareness—but for action.

This 5K fundraiser challenges participants to take 7,000 steps, representing the average distance many walk each day to collect water. As you walk, you’ll carry not just steps—but stories. Stories of resilience, hardship, and hope. You'll walk in solidarity with those who can’t just turn on a tap.

We’re asking each participant to go further by asking friends, family, and coworkers to sponsor their steps with a donation to the cause, or join their team to fundraise or walk alongside them!

Our goal? To raise $250,000 to fund 2 deep borehole wells and rural piping systems in up to 16 rural villages in Ethiopia. This will provide clean, safe, and sustainable drinking water for up to 16,000 people. 

Your steps can change a life. Your walk can build a well.

Register today. Walk their path. Bring water home.

The 5K route is along the Main Trail at Griffith Park - 4800 Crystal Springs Drive, Los Angeles, CA 90027

The course is flat, scenic and shaded, covering the perimeter of the golf course.

name: WalkGood-The People's Pace Walk/Run
description:
Join us for The People’s Pace — This is Your Race, Your Pace. On Sunday, September 20, 2026, WalkGood LA invites you to Kenneth Hahn Park for our annual 5K/10K run and walk fundraiser — The People’s Pace 2026. This isn’t just a race; it’s a movement. Open to all ages and abilities, we celebrate every stride — whether you’re sprinting, jogging, strolling, or rolling. Set against the beautiful backdrop of one of LA’s most iconic and historic parks, this community-powered event brings the city together in joy, healing, and solidarity.
Your participation directly fuels WalkGood LA’s mission to uplift and empower underrepresented communities through accessible, donation-based wellness programming — from yoga to hikes to runs/walk, and so much more. Funds raised will also support the growth of The WalkGood Yard, our creative wellness studio in Mid-City LA, where culture, healing, and resistance come to life. 

Let’s move together for wellness, justice, and the soul of the city. This is LA’s race. This is The People’s Pace. Register today and start building your team!

name: Wild Flowers 10k
description:
Join us for the 2027 Wild Flowers 10K 🌸

Run in Auburn… Finish in Spain! 

Trip to Spain is on  September, 2027 

 

 

Get ready for the most empowering girls’ day of the year! The Wild Flowers 10K is a joyful morning where besties, sisters, and mamas bloom together — running, walking, laughing, and celebrating every step.

🌸 From the stunning views of the scenic Auburn trails, you’ll experience a race filled with heart, sparkle, and pure women’s magic.

🌸 Every 10K finisher receives a beautiful Wild Flowers race tee as a symbol of your strength and sisterhood.

🌸 The magic doesn’t stop at the finish line. the winner and 4  finishers earn an all-expenses-paid trip to Spain to represent Auburn.

🌸 4 will be randomly chosen to enjoy a dreamy week in Spain at an exclusive women’s running camp in VIGO Galicia lead by our elite runner Aroa Sio! (Yes , you just have to finish the race )

🌸 Your journey starts at the Auburn … but it might just take you across the world.

Girl Time + Celebration ✨ 

After the race, join us in the pavilion for a warm, complimentary breakfast cooked by the Wild Runners crew.

Take photos, celebrate your shine, and enjoy a morning filled with love, friendship, and community.

Tell every wonder woman in your life 

🌸 This is her day to bloom grab your besties. Hold hands. Believe in your bloom. 

🌸 You don’t have to be the fastest — every woman has a chance to win big!

🌸 the winner and 4  finishers earn an unforgettable trip to Spain, representing Auburn.

 

Packet Pick-up 

Friday, April 16th 2027: 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. (Wild Runners Auburn – 198 Sacramento Street)

Saturday, April17th 2027 (Race Day): Packet pickup opens at 7:15 a.m. (Starting Line)

Event Day Schedule 

Saturday, April, 17th 2026:  Packet pickup opens at 7:15 a.m. (Starting Line)

Wild Flowers 10K start at 8:30 a.m.

Awards 

Overall Awards: There will be a prize for the top 3 overall 10K winners.( only the winner gets the first ticket to Spain the other spots are via raffle )

 

10K Age Division Awards

Awards to the top three finishers in the following age groups:

18-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, and 75-over

Course Information 

Saturday, April 17th 2027: 8:30 am

Your journey begins at the beautiful Auburn Overlook, where the Wild Flowers 10K takes off into some of the most scenic trails in Northern California. This fun loop has a little bit of everything — smooth downhills, peaceful flats, and (because this is Auburn) a reminder that if you go down… you will go back up.

You’ll experience sections of gorgeous single-track, rolling stretches perfect for finding your rhythm, and viewpoints that will make you stop and say “wow” or at least pretend you’re stopping for the view and not to catch your breath.

We’ll have two fully stocked aid stations, a cheerful crew directing you every step of the way, and… breaking news…Sasquatch has officially confirmed his appearance. (He promised to cheer loudly, but we can’t guarantee he won’t photobomb.)

Get ready for fun, adventure, and the most unforgettable 10K you’ll ever run.

Course Preview Day

TBA

Parking Information 

Saturday, April, 17th 2027

You may park at Railhead Park, along nearby neighborhood streets (please do not block driveways or entrances), by the high school, or in the two public lots in Old Town Auburn.

Please note: parking in Old Town may require up to a 1-mile walk to the start.

Plan to arrive early to give yourself plenty of time.

RACE RULES

🌸 Friends may pick-up packets and register for you.

🌸 No entry refunds, transfers, or exchanges.

🌸 Due to course congestion, NO STROLLERS or ANIMALS are allowed on the course. 

🌸 No leg or foot casts allowed

🌸 No pacers 

🌸 This is a female only run 

🌸 Per our official event rules and guidelines: Sale and/or transfer of race entry/bib is strictly prohibited and will result in the disqualification and/or banning of any individuals involved from future events. All entry fees are non-refundable and may not be deferred toward a future event.

🌸 Winners must show or get a passport within 30 days. If winners cannot attend the trip, a new winner will be randomly drawn from the finishers.

name: Winter Runderland 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon. Kids Dash
description:

Clip on those bells, grab your crew, and make Long Beach your very own North Pole with sand. Jingle all the way, CaliFlow-style!

 

🎅❄️ Winter Runderland 5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash
📍 5000 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803 (Easy Parking)
📅 Sunday, December 13, 2026
✨ Where jingle bells meet running shoes and holiday cheer hits full speed! ( We provide the Jingle Bells, you provide the running shoes)

🏁 Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
🏁 5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM

🎄 About the Event
Welcome to Winter Runderland, where snowflakes meet shoreline vibes and everyone on the “nice list” gets a medal!

Clip jingle bells to your shoes and jingle-jangle down the coast like you’re leading Santa’s warm-weather reindeer squad. It’s a holiday tradition with a Cali twist — ocean breeze, twinkle lights, and the sound of bells in rhythm with your stride.

📸 Epic Photo Ops every few steps — elves not included (but encouraged)

🥇 Age-Group & Overall Awards — show off your “run-deer” speed
🍪 Finish-Line Snacks + Hot Cocoa + Candy Canes
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations every 2 miles
🎭 Festive Costume Contest!
 – Most Festive Outfit 🧣
 – Best Group / Family Theme 🎁
 – Most “Extra” Holiday Spirit 💃

🎅 Special Guest: Santa Claus!
He’s trading the chimney for the coastline — wave, snap a selfie, or tell him what PR you want for Christmas!

 
🅿️ Parking & Event Info
🚗 Free street parking
💵 Beach lot $2/hr (Passport app or machine)
🚻 Restrooms near the start
👶 Stroller & walker-friendly
🏁 Fully marked, flat, fast course with sleigh-worthy views

💫 Know the Difference


Other event companies may operate in the same areas, but the CaliFlow Runs experience is one of a kind.

If you’ve found our races and love our vibe — the community, the energy, the photos, the finish line fun — make sure you’re signing up for the real thing.

Before registering, always look for the CaliFlow Runs name or logo so you know you’re joining our event — where every race is built with heart, inclusivity, and good vibes only. 💙✨

 
☀️ Weather & Safety
This event is RAIN or SHINE — because elves don’t cancel.
(Only postponed for tidal waves or zombie reindeer 🧟🦌 — we’ll email you if that happens.)

 
💫 Join the Holiday Movement
Post your sparkle and tag @CaliFlowRuns + #WinterRunderland #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured!

name: Winter Whirl – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
Bundle up… or don’t! It's California! Winter Whirl is spinning into Long Beach where the only flurries are the kind that come from the waves. While the rest of the world is shivering, we’re keeping it cool with sunny miles, festive fun, and just a hint of pretend winter magic. Whether you’re chasing a shiny new PR or just cruising the path with a smile, this run is all about coastal cheer with a wink at the season.

Race Details

Start Location: Mile Square Park, Parking lot D. Across the street from 11014 Lavender Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708. 
Parking: $5.00 per car at Mile Square Park (Opens at 7am). Limited free street parking is available

Event Schedule

Friday
Early Bib Pickup at Sports Basement Orange County TBD

Saturday
7:30am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
8:00am – Half marathon
8:30am – 5k & 10k start
11:10am – Course closes (3 hours, 10 minutes for the Half)

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: this 5k route is used for the 5k (one loops), 10k (two loops) – route here 
Half Marathon: this route is used for the half marathon, it's similar to the 5k route but there is an additional out and back – route here

More About the Course

This is a looped course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location. Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must be courteous and share the path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Witch Way to the Polls 2026
description:
In addition to the walkathon, Witch Way to the Polls is a family-friendly event will feature a lively Voter Election Resource Fair with community booths, music, face painting, games, candy, and nonpartisan voter information. Attendees can connect with civic organizations, learn about voting resources, and celebrate the power of community participation in a festive Halloween atmosphere.

We encourage all eligible voters to learn about the issues that affect their communities, make informed choices at the ballot box, and to make their vote count. The event is also an opportunity for participants to show their civic pride while helping strengthen voter engagement and democracy in a fun and welcoming environment.

Family friendly - children aged 5 and under are free!

description:

The ocean’s not the only thing making waves this Halloween! Get ready to lace up for the Witches Wave Halloween Run, where the beach meets the boo for a fright-filled 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon. name: Woodbridge Village Association 50th Anniversary - Ralph J. Redington 5K/10K Run and Kids Run
description:
Race Registration:  All registration will be handled online for the race.  Please note the last day to register will be Friday, July 3rd by 12:00 p.m.  No registrations will be accepted on the day of the race or in person at the Woodbridge Community Center. 

Calling all runners! Compete with your neighbors and friends in the annual 4th of July race. The races will start by the North Lake Gazebo on Barranca Parkway.

Check-in time for the 5K and 10K Runs is 6:30 a.m. The 5K and 10K Runs will begin at 7:15 a.m. The Kids Run will begin at approximately 8:15 a.m.

The entry fee for early registration 5K/10K participants is $45 per person, including an official race T-shirt, or $40 without a T-shirt, up until Sunday, June 14th.  

The entry fee for all 5K/10K participants registering on Monday, June 15th through Friday, July 3rd at 12:00 p.m. is $60 per person, which includes an official race T-shirt, or $55 without a T-shirt.

The entry fee for the Kids Run is $20 per child, which includes a T-shirt, or $15 per child without the T-shirt, up until Friday, July 3rd at 12:00 p.m.

Please note: All registration is online only. There will be no in-person “cash” sign-up registrations prior to or on the day of the races.

description:

Inspired by the belief that Movement is Medicine, this event brings together runners, walkers, families, and community members for a morning dedicated to healthier lives and stronger communities.

5400 E Ocean Blvd

Long Beach, CA 90803

In addition to the race, participants and spectators can enjoy our Wellness Expo featuring local health, fitness, nutrition, and wellness organizations dedicated to helping people live healthier, happier lives.

name: World Spirits Festival 5k Run/Walk
description:
Celebrate community, culture, and movement at the World Spirits Day Festival Run/Walk 5K, happening Saturday, June 27th at 6:30 PM. This unique dusk event invites participants of all ages and fitness levels to enjoy a scenic evening course starting and finishing at Smith Park. Runners and walkers alike will travel along the historic Whittier Boulevard, which will be fully closed to traffic, creating a safe and festive route through the heart of Pico Rivera.

As the sun sets, the experience expands beyond the race. Smith Park will host fan experiences and watch parties featuring all of the weekend’s top games, bringing an added layer of excitement and community energy. After crossing the finish line, participants can continue the celebration at a vibrant festival complete with a carnival featuring a giant Ferris wheel, interactive games, local vendors, and headline entertainment. Food options and beer gardens will be available, making it the perfect setting to relax, celebrate, and enjoy the full World Spirits Festival atmosphere.

name: Zoom San Francisco
description:
All races start/finish at East Beach and head West along the popular Golden Gate Promenade. The 5K event climbs up Battery East trail to the Golden Gate Bridge before heading back to the finish. The 10K and Half Marathon courses continue underneath the Golden Gate and follow the Coastal Trail to Baker Beach with spectacular views of the Pacific Ocean along the way. The 10K turns around at the Baker Beach aid station while the Half Marathoners head through Seacliff and continue along Coastal Trail to the turnaround at Lands End overlooking the historic Sutro Baths.
(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

name: ‘A CHARLIE BROWN CHRISTMAS 5K/10K’ (Los Angeles, CA)
description:
Join us as we celebrate five amazing years of timeless holiday cheer, iconic characters, and heartwarming tradition on Saturday, December 12th at Griffith Park right in the heart of Los Angeles (Flat and Fast, Out-And-Back Course in the park). The Snoopy Kids Dash kicks off the event at 7:10am followed by the 5K at 7:30am and the 10K at 8:15am.
ALL participants will receive a festive top-notch, Officially Licensed Peanuts® finisher medal, participant bib, and performance blend t-shirt.  There will also be an appearance by Santa and Post-Race Refreshments! So, come out and show everyone your best holiday attire and spirit! 
Don't wait long to join the fun! This event will be very limited to the first 2,000 participants and this event 100% sold out the last 3 straight years! This event is a part of the ongoing ‘Peanuts® Event Series’, with over 125,000 participants that have participated in the series across all 50 U.S. States!⏰
© 2025 Peanuts Worldwide LLC @snoopy #snoopy
